They constantly cancel flights, extremely unreliable you can't really use them to plan your trip because they will cancel and change your flight multiple times, they will even cancel an ENTIRE flight route. For example their direct flights from Melbourne to Kuala Lumpur completely disappear and re appear on their website with different schedules all the time that's because they are using the same plane and rerouting it to different locations while sacrificing their customers who paid for their tickets! This is an extremely big problem

A choice of hot meals were 25 MYR (~AUD 8) each to buy on board if you didn't pre-book. The food and drinks were not bad. The service seemed good even though they worked pretty hard - I believe there was only 3 flight attendants on board. The piloting and landing was good and hardly any turbulence was encountered. In flight entertainment and USB charging is potentially available based on the aircraft, but need to plan for there being none there. So overall, I've had worse service and worse food from Singapore Airlines while paying triple the price, so I think Batik Air is a great option on the Australia to KL route.

I had booked flights from Phuket to Bali; however, we were unable to reach the airport due to severe flooding obstructing the roads leading to Phuket Airport. Despite our efforts to contact Customer Care for assistance in obtaining proof of our inability to show up for the flight, we were unable to receive any support. Professional customer care entails taking responsibility for any damages caused to customers. Their WhatsApp AI is terrible and no one answers the phone so it's just waste of time and energy! Never travel in Batik Air - I wish I had never booked with them and I will never book again.

1 hour delay from Brisbane to Denpasar, no leg room, have to pay for basic things like water on the flight after you have had to discard it if flying internationally. Muppet service crew and pilots made us board an hour early only to then start refuelling the airplane making us stay later than the original take-off time. Useless staff all round, avoid at all costs.

Firstly they cancelled both my flight return from kl to turkey and that caused so much inconvenience as I have to rebook with another airline who is much costlier. This flight today from Kuala Lumpur to Perth they have told us 2 days (only 2 days in advance) that it has been changed to more than 24 hours later so we lost a day and had to pay one extra night hotel and lost 1 day of work. Now they have technical issues which have caused 4 hours delay in taking off. This is too much for the passengers honestly. Why operate why you can’t operate properly and cause people to suffer? Enough is this.

Absolutely doesn't feel like a full service airline but it definitely feels like budget airline. I have flown this airline many times and it has never been on time. One time, my flight was changed from ID 6588 (depart at 6:00pm) to ID 6576 (depart at 5:00) so I had to cancel some itineraries in the city to leave to the airport earlier. But when I got to the airport, ID 6576 was delayed at least 90 minutes to even later than the original 6588 schedule. Would stay away from this airline in the future.

Check-in was a breeze and the staff was professional, but little did I know, I was given a seat that does not even exist. My seat was in row 13, but upon boarding, which was slightly late, there was no rows 13 and 14. This caused chaos during boarding with me having to negotiate with the cabin crews, ground staff, and the passenger who originally occupied row 12 as I was asked by the crew to be seated in row 12. Luckily, both the crews and ground staff were quick-thinking and professional, and offered a win-win solution that satisfied all the parties involved even though the crews and ground staff had no fault whatsoever. If anything, this was the fault of Batik Air for not standardizing their plane's interiors (Batik had multiple A320s with multiple configurations) and not providing the check-in staff with the correct diagram. That being said, I think the check-in staff should have known that the same aircraft, PK-BKF, had been regularly operating the route in 8 out of 10 occasions around the time I took this flight. Take-off was delayed by 33 minutes, and what could have been a 5 or 6/10 flight was turned into a 9/10 flight thanks to the helpful ground staff members and the cabin crews. They were fantastic. They could have been just a little more friendlier, but overall, they were professional, active, caring, courteous, and helpful. My seat had a headrest which is something not all Batik Air aircrafts have and increased comfort by a lot. It was, however, jammed in the recline position and covered with age-old grime. The cabin was also covered in some grime, but it was clean, comfortable, and in good condition considering it was almost 18 years old. The air conditioner setting was perfect. On this 50-minute flight, snacks and water were provided, which was delicious and greatly appreciated. There was also a Wi-Fi based in-flight entertainment which was speedy and had a lot of up to-date contents. Landing was only a tad late, and I arrived at CGK only to wait another hour for my bag to arrive. Overall, this could've been a 5/10 flight due to the slow baggage handling and the erroneous "ghost" seat assignment, but the in-flight experience was more than enough to forgive these shortcomings and turned the supposedly 5/10 flight to a 9/10, enjoyable flight. Batik might have made awful mistakes on the ground side of this flight, but how they handled them was worth a praise.
Then they delayed boarding. They baggage cost is huge compared to AirAsia. It’s too cold on board and they have nothing to do but SELL me a blanket. Hate this conpany. Never again!

I booked a return to Brisbane and during the booking I failed to see they changed their baggage allowance. I called them to add baggage two weeks before my flight and was charged $99 per 20 kg bag. Then on the departure day the flight was cancelled with no offer of help or compensation. The flight was rescheduled for the following day and it was late. I tried calling the office in Malaysia but had no luck. Their app is useless like the airline. I would never fly with this airline again.

Their response on the request was quite prompt (5 hours) and the recovery was within 10 hours. Excellent. Kudos to all these guys. Reported by 3pm, 13/5/24 and received the item before 2pm, 14/5/24. Thanks to the Lost and Found team.

All until around 1pm, people were only informed that the flight was changed to another gate, yet no update was shown on the monitors, and when people reached the newly assigned gate, the gate was still not ready yet but catering to two other flights from Singaporean airlines. Disorder. Eventually the flight departed at 1.57pm, which was delayed over 2hours, the airlines did not offer free meal either as compensation suggested on Mavcom. On the flight, the stewardess was kinda rigid to repeatedly require passenger to SWITCH OFF mobile phones (flight mode is not even allowed). It looked like Batik Air is ready to degrade itself to budget airline following their retraction of free checked-in baggage service.

Never on time. Delayed my flight by 2 days and after that once we reach airport flight got further delayed by 2 hours making total waiting period of close to 8 hrs for me. Besides, customer service is pathetic and lousy. No prompt response and no compensation for such time waste. Request to all not to use this airline for Mumbai - Malaysia route

In the last 3 weeks they have cancelled flights without notification, when flights where changed the next 4 flights have all been a minimum of 1.5 hours late. When I missed my connecting international flight they at first said it was my fault until I showed them the cancellation of the the 1st flight and that the second flight was 1hr 20min late. And today I was supposed to leave Denpasar airport at 19.50 and its now 21.35 with no sight of the plane turning up. This is the last time I will ever fly with them and I am a regular traveller as I work in Indonesia. If you are looking at booking a trip in Indonesia avoid using this substandard airline.

Economy class passengers entered business class cabin right after landed. Business class No wifi offered, very limited movies selection, no monitor provided. Return kudos to the staff, I requested for paracetamol or panadol & was informed it is not available but she did gave her personal fever pills. Economy class passengers entered business class cabin after landing.

I had to ask the flight attendant twice to come and clean the seat. Some white stains still stuck to the seat, so I asked to change seat which they approved. Looking around, all seats had some dirt and stains on them. Terrible experience, and hope to never fly with Batik Air again.

review_header: "never be flying with Batik Air again"
review_text: When I went to check in the man at the desk that checked me and was very rude and treated me like I wasn’t a human being. When I asked if he could help me move my bag over to get weighed because I just had surgery, he asked for my fit to fly letter and I said to him that it’s in my bag I just have to get it. He kept asking for it rudely and it takes me longer to do things just because I’ve had surgery. He started asking me about my surgery and what I had done even though I had showed him the fit to fly letter and it says it exactly what I had done. Then told me that I shouldn’t have a fit to fly letter. If I can’t lift my baggage, I explain to him that the surgeon advise me that I’m not allowed to lift anything over 5 kg for the next 6 to 8 weeks. He then got even ruder and when my bag had to get x-rayed, he threw my bag on, I didn’t understand why he didn’t just place it down because it’s heavy he had no reason just to throw it like that. Overall I will never be flying with Batik Air again. The staff do not have any kindness or respect towards . There was a lady watching this all happen and she could tell that I was on the verge of crying and she didn’t stand in to help me once. I understand people have bad days but I would never come to work and be rude to my customer you leave that problem at home.
Attempted to fly twice but aborted due to technical issue. Had to u-turn back to terminal. Long waiting time at terminal without update or feedback from staff too.

My father became very unwell during the flight. Despite having pre-booked their meals, by the time airline staff got to their seats there was no more food available. My father requested water, only warm water available. When disembarking he was unable to walk, my mother requested a wheelchair for him and explained he'd become unwell. This request was refused. Appalling behaviour, this has really put them off flying again. Such a shame they had such a negative experience with this airline.

I planned for return ticket from Kota Bharu- Kota Kinabalu and I supposed to go back from Kota Kinabalu to Kota Bharu on 5/3/24. There was no direct ticket so they gave option KLIA as my transit. Long story short, my trip from Kota Kinabalu to KLIA around 11am and my next flight to Kota Bharu supposed to be around 6pm so that I somehow can manage if the first flight going to be delayed and of course it was. Mind you, I purchased the ticket from their official website. And they suddenly changed the schedule without notifying me with no proper email or whatsoever. My first trip Kota Kinabalu to KLIA around 11am (no change) and without no common sense at all, managed to re-schedule my KLIA to Kota Bharu at 8.30 am on the same day! Earlier that my first trip. Was I suppose to swim all the way through Laut China Selatan to reach the KLIA airport? You tell me. And I purchased the ticket as round trip, not separately. I had tried calling the customer service hotline to no avail ofc, I had sent few emails regarding my enquiry but again, to no avail. I came earlier to the check-in counter at Kota Kinabalu International airport, but there was No definite answer. The staff nonchalantly informed me there was no flight at evening from Kota Kinablau but he asked me to go to check-in counter in KLIA once I arrived there. When I first arrived there, I managed to ask politely why they re-scheduled my ticket absent-mindedly and the staff talked to me condescendingly. Your staff tried to gaslight me like I am a stupid person but she is working with bad company. And now I have to spend almost RM800 at KL while awaiting for my next flight.

We were about to check in at 4:30am NZ time for 7:30am flight. We reached airport on time then check the screen it says time has been reschedule and instead of 7:30am our time has been rescheduled to 1pm. No one came to inform us until then we received an email at 8am saying our flight timing has been changed from 7:30am to 1pm. The flight time was rescheduled for 1pm but when we took off its almost 3pm. We purchase extra meal for the flight but we didn’t get any meal as we don’t have the screen shot of want we have ordered, we use our USD currency to buy food. We reach Perth and we found lots of people having the same problems like us who stayed in airport for more then 10hrs due reschedule of the time and no one has been informed. We didn’t get new boarding time table display on the ticket, none of the staff know when we will arrive in Malaysia and when we are taking off from Malaysia to Kathmandu. We booked our domestic tickets for Kathmandu to our home but we never know what time we will reach to Malaysia and Kathmandu. Our domestic ticket has been cancelled as we didn’t know what time we will reach to Kathmandu. Our family has to stay in the hotel who came to receive us in Kathmandu and we were unable to tell them that how long will it take us to reach Kathmandu. We landed to Malaysia at 12am midnight, original timings when we bought the tickets we were suppose to land by 4:30pm. In Perth we were told we have 2 hr transit in Malaysia instead of 1.5hr we were okay as its only half an hour difference. Then we meet staff from Batik Air with few other passengers, he mentioned due some problem instead of 2 hr transit we have 8 hr transit now. It’s almost 24 hr but we were unable to reach our destination, the airlines didn’t provide any complimentary food, they didn’t even give us what we had purchased in advance. Suddenly one more staff from Batik airlines came to us and apologize that instead of 8hr transit we have 20hr Transit. The only reason me and wife travel to Kathmandu is for the wedding and it looks like we cannot make it to the wedding. I have mention this to the staff but looks like they don’t even bother. Then all the passengers start questioning and asking for refund. He said you can email and ask for your refund but it will take you almost 90 days for your refund. They he managed to get us into the hotel as we have to stay in Malaysia for almost 20hr. They did provide a meal for the day. We are still in Malaysia and hoping the time doesn’t change anymore. We were suppose to reach home by 27th 8:30pm Nepali timezone now it looks like we will arrive to Kathmandu on 29th Feb at 9pm if incase the new timings doesn’t change.

After hours of being thrown around to different team they told me I have to buy new tickets and then later I will be refunded my unused tickets. I proceeded to do this and when I asked for my partial refund out of $1700 paid they only refunded me $70 because their admin fees were so high. I was never told any of this information prior and they put me in a difficult situation. Every time I called to speak to someone they would put me on long holds and each time they hang up the phone on me without resolving anything. This is a big scam of a company.

The staff appeared indifferent and unresponsive to my needs and concerns. They provide last-minute information regarding flight delays, causing unnecessary inconvenience. The in-flight services do not offer good value for money. The quality of food and amenities provided does not justify the cost,

Holes in the carpet upon entry into the aircraft. The seats felt unclean. The request for an aisle seat due to my senior age was ignored. The food was well below par and almost unpalatable, with most menu choices unavailable. I do not expect high-class provisions in the Economy class  but I do expect basic cleanliness and a meal paid for during the flight that doesn't taste like last week's afterthought. On a lighter note, the cabin crew were polite and friendly. I harbour no ill will towards them as they are not responsible for the condition of the aircraft or the poor quality of the food. Management should be ashamed.

Leg room is OK, very comfortable. Access to gates in the KLIA 1 Main terminal (instead of the Concourse terminal) which is excellent to board the plane after immigration and to also quickly get to immigration after landing (you can walk straight to Immigration within 10 minutes after leaving the plane).  Expect delays or rescheduling to happen. My first leg was rescheduled to be 1 hour later, but good thing is the airline informed almost a month in advance. Ground service was not consistent - my 1st leg to Hanoi was great but on the 2nd leg back to KL, the ground staff at NIA kept checking my backpack and complained that I would exceed my carry-on limit. I had to put my pack on checked and carried my laptop throughout the journey, and at the same time I was seeing many other passengers carrying their backpacks like nothing. I guess it's a thing for LCC that you'd get randomly targeted for bag-check 2. Food and drink has to be purchased which is expected for LCC however they're still quite pricey. 10% price drop could make purchasing much more sensible.  My second leg back to KL was the first time ever I flew Boeing 737 MAX. I was feeling unease during take-off, but then it all went fine after that. Treat this airline as one of the better LCC options with checked baggage included. Solo/budget travel recommended only, or you have to go doing personal thing carrying many personal items (like I did). Don't choose this for leisure travel.

I have sent several email no reply, I called customer service no reply. Food service only snack, no main course you need to purchase the main course. No cold water only lukewarm water. I will never travel this airline again.
Delays galore. Hours of delays. No explanation, no apologies. Please avoid this airline at all cost.

review_header: "I will never fly with them again"
review_text: Every flight we took was delayed by at least 30 mins sometimes hours. There was no communication from their ground staff around change of gates or delays. Their subsequent replies and responses to our complaints via your post flight customer service were disgraceful & empty. I will never fly with them again.
Friendly and helpful service. Nice food was only $7aud and one free Water halfway through the flight - which was on time. I would travel with them again - better than Jetstar.

The last flight was changed to Batik Air, Turkish Airlines was who we paid the fare to but they have passed the buck. Customer service does not exist On arrival in Perth our two bags were missing for 5 days. A year later we are still trying to receive compensation for £202.71 for the clothes etc. we had to buy until our baggage turned up. Over 80 Emails and phone calls they have not produced a penny. Planes are old and dirty no entertainment payment has to be made for food and drink.

In all my years of flying international with many airlines I have never experienced such a ridiculous sorry excuse of an airline. Upon boarding the aircraft, the air smelt like stale garlic noodles. An 11 hour flight (split in 2, Adelaide to Bali then Bali to Bangkok) I was served a complimentary 250ml water in a plastic juice like cup, fit for a 3 year old and a miniature bun that tasted like cardboard. Onboard meal from Adelaide to Bali was provided at a cost to the passenger. From Bali to Bangkok the same complimentary water and bun provided with nothing else ! No onboard entertainment provided. I am appalled that this airline has the right to fly with such below average service. The experience was disgraceful and poor and did not match the price they charged for their tickets.
Instead of wasting time just waiting for a mistake made by the airline and must be borne by the passengers. From Jakarta to KUL delay until 3hours.

The Cabin crew was very supportive, all ordered food received (cant expect more from a low cost air line) flight was clean and mostly on time. Enough leg space to sit comfortably. All baggage received intact. Initially we feared to travel Batik air but now we can recommend it to friends, even though the Perth transit was a bit of a hassle going through screening. Hope they will do better in time to cone.

These flights get cancelled or rescheduled at the last moment, forcing passengers to choose alternate flight arrangements from the same airline. Despite paying for extras (meals, comfy kits) - airline staff is reluctant to provide the same. They either give only after multiple requests or simply refuse and ask customers to follow up with the customer care team for a refund (which is another headache).Inferior flight conditions, not a single screen in economy class is working.  Surprisingly, we have to prove that the airline has damaged our bag. None of the airline staff noticed that. Further, it's made impossible for customers to claim by asking for unnecessary documentation or reports, which no one knows where to obtain from.

review_header: “I didn't get the service which I paid for”
review_text: Series of events. 1) I booked a ticket from Auckland to Kuala Lumpur to New Delhi, India for my 67 years old Mother-in-law and disabled sister-in-law. I intentionally avoided booking flight transiting from Australia to avoid any hassle (past experience relating to the transit visa and not getting wheelchair for elderly and disabled person). 2) After some time I got an email notifying that flight has changed from 29/11 to 30/11 and another stop Perth was added. 3) I called Batik customer care (the representative on call was too rude and unprofessional) and booking agent (Go to Gate) but ended up being a ball passed from one corner to another one. I was informed by Batik that all the Batik flights are routed from Australia and the booking agent hasn't provided the clear information on their website. Really! Forcefully, I had to apply transit visa for both the passengers. 4) In the meanwhile, I called the airlines again to secure the wheelchair assistance for 67 years old Mother-in-law having knee issues and for disabled sister-in-law, during that call I wasn't told that wheelchair assistance is a paid service with Batik. 5) On the travel date we reached to the counter to get the wheelchair assistance, but we were bluntly told to pay $90 PP to get the wheelchair (I heard this first time that wheelchair assistance is payable) otherwise passengers will have to walk by themselves. I ended up paying $180/- at the counter but wheelchair was provided only at Auckland airport, my mother-in-law and disabled sister-in-law had to struggle and walk in Perth, Kuala Lumpur and in New Delhi. I didn't get the service which I paid for. My mother-in-law’s knee is swollen due to all these hardships, and she is under doctors’ observation for last 3 days. 6) I was told by Batik representative on call that the passengers would not need to change the plane in Perth stopover (1.10 hrs only), we got ourselves assured that there will not be any hassle for the passengers as the wheelchairs have been arranged. However, after plane landed in Perth, my mother-in-law asked for the wheelchair, but she was rudely told there is no wheelchair and upon insisting and notifying that we have already paid for the wheelchair, she was told to take the wheelchair, if needed and get to other gate after security clearance. An elderly and a disabled person didn’t get the required wheelchair assistance for such a short period of layover (1.10 hrs) and they had to push themselves hard to reach to boarding gate for flight to the Kuala Lumpur. 7) The worst thing ever, I paid for food while booking the tickets and the receipt clearly shows the meal charges, however, both the passengers were refused to serve even water saying you must pay for it! Could you imagine an international flight without food, they had to suffer for the whole flight duration. 8) After reaching to New Delhi, they were again told that there were only 6 people on airlines list to get wheelchair assistance and My mother-in-law and sister-in-law’s name wasn’t there. This is a clear case of gross negligence and deficiency in services on Batik Airlines part. I am badly disappointed about the rude behaviour of airline people, ignorance, non-sympathetic behaviour, and the hardship, mental trauma, inconvenience and the hunger they felt during this period is unforgivable.

We change our flight and paid which is normal. Then they change it back 1 week prior both flights were change. They don't have call centre for you to talk. They will ask you to email only. Both flights change back and they said its either you cancel your flight or refund. And refund will take months to get. Is that right? U pay for change flight and they will just change it back to the original flight with nothing. Then they change the flight going back to Melbourne as well. So you need to book additional hotel accomodation and take another leave and they wont care. Other airlines will compensate after 12 hours. This airline 24hours but nothing.  My baggage was crushed on the flight so on next flight i asked the check in person if they can be more careful. He just smiled at me. That's it. No sorry. Or anything to assure you. Don't go to this airline. They will cancel ur flight anytime they want and wont care about your schedule.
So missed the flight! Forced to bought new ticket.

review_header: "fly them again if the price was right"
review_text: Once on board, FA's were nice and helpful. The seats were worn and the aircraft looked tired. The flight left on time and it was quite uneventful. Food and drinks need to be paid for, so two FA's were in charge of an economy cabin and took forever to make their was from the front down to the back were I was seated. The price of food was reasonable and I didn't buy a hot meal as the flight departed at 2355 but the food eaten by my neighbour looked and smelt very nice. The seats were cramped and legroom was awful if you're tall like me. We landed on time and out bags arrived without any fuss. I would fly them again if the price was right.

My client paid the ticket. I had bad experience which they change the schedule for almost 3 times (Ticket from Jakarta to Semarang). And the experience happened again with a delay. This caused me canceling an important meeting. Batik Air and lion group never care about their customers. The worst airline ever.

Flight rescheduled by Batik Air with no explanation, no further information. Booked and confirmed flight Melbourne to Bangkok with a layover in Denpasar on Nov 25. This morning I got email from Batik Air that my flight Melbourne - Denpasar has been rescheduled from Nov 25 to Nov 26. No word about connecting flight Denpasar - Bangkok. I sent email to [email protected] and got rejected several times with the message "The group customer_care only accepts messages from people in its organization or on its allowed senders list, and your email address isn't on the list." Even I registered my email and got booking confirmation on it, "my email is not on their list". Then I tried so called "24 hrs support whatsapp chat" and no one responded, no support whatsoever. Then I called their phones in Melbourne and Brisbane airports. The numbers are not in use, not surprise. So, there is no way I can check if I will have the connecting flight at all. Or this is their way to make customers buying another ticket. Batik Air, never again.
However, after several follow ups via email and phone calls, I have have not received any refund till date. They are extremely unprofessional and do not care about customer service at all.

The issues we faced haven't been fixed, and we're not sure who's responsible for treating us so badly during the flight. They didn't even apologize or say thanks, which was very rude. First, there was no warning about the flight delay, and we were left waiting in the boarding area without any information. The plane's air conditioning wasn't good, and it made the journey uncomfortable for our baby and us. To make things worse, they sprayed something unpleasant when we got off the plane. We can't find any way to talk to them or fix these problems. It's not just about getting money; we felt disrespected and taken for granted as passengers. When we wrote to Batik Air, they responded with generic sorry messages and flight rescheduling terms and conditions that didn't address our concerns. Our journey was supposed to be nice, but it turned into a nightmare.  Originally, we planned to arrive in Bali at 11 am on October 8th, with a 3-hour flight, then a 2.30-hour layover in Kuala Lumpur, and finally a 1.30-hour flight to India. But Batik Air made us suffer for almost 20 hours, delaying our arrival in Chennai, India, until October 9th. This was the worst flight we've ever had, with long delays, poor communication, and not enough help for passengers.

We got an email on 13th Oct 8:35 PM IST, that due to unavoidable reason, they are changing the flight date from 15th Oct to 16th Oct. I paid 7.5K extra to get baby bassinet and seats together on KUL to DPS flight separately. All the effort and planning is gone down the drain. We had to rebook new Singapore Airline so that our travel is not impacted due to this pathetic airline. They customer care seems so local as if this is getting run from a single room. They say they will email the e-ticket but then forget and then you to have call them and mail them multiple times to remind. Highly unprofessional. Just before the travel, we will be paying 3X to get on the right flight and also fighting with Batik Air to refund all our money. They caused us great inconvenience but I wonder if they will pay us anything. This all is done with a family traveler (1 infant and 5 year old) Pathetic Pathetic Pathetic Airline.

I had a substantial amount of luggage, for which I purchased additional weight allowance, and I also desired extra legroom. Surprisingly, the additional costs were more reasonable compared to other airline. From my first encounter at the check-in counter at 4 am, I had the pleasure of experiencing exceptional customer service from Matthew. He went above and beyond to assist. The outstanding customer service continued throughout the entire journey. Everyone I encountered was incredibly friendly and had a smile on their face. My flight took me from Brisbane to Kuala Lumpur with a one-hour layover in Bali. I had pre-purchased meals, which were promptly delivered, and I spent most of the flight comfortably sleeping in my seat. Since this was a smaller aircraft, it did not have onboard entertainment. However, in today's era where almost everyone carries their own screens, this was not really a requirement. Upon landing in Kuala Lumpur and clearing immigration, I was pleased to find my two suitcases standing side by side in good condition beside the luggage carousel. Having not flown in years, I was initially skeptical about using this airline for the first time, but I am extremely glad that I did. I wanted to express my gratitude and leave a glowing review of my fantastic experience, extending my thanks to everyone, from the airport staff to the airplane crew.

review_header: "I had no major problems with them"
review_text: I had no major problems with them - just a couple of minor ones. Given that it is a low-cost carrier, similar to all low-cost carriers, it's plus, plus, plus, i.e. meals, drinks, preferred seats, etc. The reason why I chose this budget airline over Air Asia is because the cost of the ticket includes baggage allowance.. My flights were from Hong Kong to Colombo, via Kuala Lumpur, and back. The outbound layover was 2 hours, the inbound layover was 5 hours. On all 4 flights, there were no delays, no last minute changing of gates, no lost luggage, the cabin crew were fine, the ground staff were courteous, polite and helpful in all 3 countries. I asked for window seats all the way, and got 3 out of 4. The minor problems: firstly, only the Kuala Lumpur-Colombo leg had inflight entertainment. But they do not provide headphones. If you have your own, bravo! Secondly, seeing we can not bring drinks on board, bottles of water should be free. I did not have any meals on the plane, so can not comment on the quality of their food. Would I book Batik Air again? With their prices, for a short-haul flight, yes.

Only use if you absolutely have to do so. Over fours hours delayed as airline decided to use our aircraft for another route. And then decided to use the next aircraft for yet another route. No proper announcements and no renewed timings given.

review_header: "fly Batik air for this route again"
review_text: Though delayed by 30mins for return. Flight were smooth throughout. Came with a 20kg free luggage and 7kg carry on. Rates were lower compared to other budget flights. Will fly Batik air for this route again.

review_header: "I don’t fit in the seat, I’m too wide"
review_text: I was told I could upgrade to business class at least 1 hour before flight, at check in 3 hours before flight I was told by your staff that the staff had gone home in charge of updates. I then get in the plane where I am right now. On board. In row f. Near the window, I don’t fit in the seat, I’m too wide. I ask flight attendants to upgrade me. They said they can not but no one is in business class, there is plenty of room. I’m very uncomfortable and will need to stand up all the way. I can never contact your company by phone. This is wrong. Not happy.

The reason they gave was because the cabins were full. Why on earth would I leave my carry on bag at the final minute? Why would they allow the other passengers to have multiple carry on baggage that would occupy my designated space. I insisted on taking my carry on bag with me. Some of the crew members gave me rolling eyes and said try your luck. Is that a humane way to treat your client? Later found out some cabins were still empty. When I asked a crew that I wanted to purchase some food from their menu, she asked me to go at the front where there's been the sell of food. The crew looked fatigued. I was sitting at the almost at bottom of the aircraft. I walked all the way up to the front to buy chicken biryani. They told me there was no Chicken biryani left. I purchased Jeera Rice with Vegetable. Later they sold chicken biryani to the man on my side.

review_header: "I won't be flying Batik Air again"
review_text: I won't be flying Batik Air again, even based on price. Issues I struck include: 1) Batik Air website allowing me to book a connecting flight had too short a transit time so I missed the connecting flight and the connecting flight was the last flight of the day. Batik Air rebooked me next day fee free, it took 20-30min of waiting time to process but would not cover accommodation, 2) maintenance inside the cabin wasn't up to standard including a toilet door that had a door lock latch that wouldn't operate, seats which reclined when you sat in them without locking in the upright position, 3) incorrect information at the Batik Air check-in desk in Sydney who said I did not need to collect my bag in Denpasar it was checked through to Lombok. It took another 1-2 hours to get back into the International Terminal and retrieve my bag, 4) food service was poor with only noodle, biscuits or chips and when ordering Coke it was poured from a 2lt bottle into a paper cup. The only payment method was Australian Dollars and they didn't have adequate change which meant I ended up paying $1 more than the list price rather than them saying out fault. 5) in Denpasar they don't use aerobridges, so relying on buses to get to the terminal adds time required between flights, besides the inconvenience of stairs, climate etc.

I read the reviews after I bought the ticket and before our flight, we where a little concerned.. however, this was not necessary. I had checked something incorrectly when purchasing the tickets and after sending an email, this was immediately picked up and arranged by the office service team. We were able to check in online and choose seats 12 hours in advance. Everyone was very friendly and helpful at check-in and baggage drop-off. Our flight left on time and was not delayed. The plane was clean and spacious. We had been given seats near the exit and had extra leg room. [we were lucky that the plane was not completely full and the seat next to us was free] During the flight the stewards were also very friendly and helpful. We even had some entertainment choices. The only thing that was strange is that if you are not allowed to bring water on the plane, they should hand out water instead of selling small bottles water. What is also very nice is that afterwards, after booking your tickets, you do not have to pay another 20-40 euros for 1 piece of checked baggage costs for 20kg. We had a nice and positive flight and experience.

I had no choices to book a last minute Batik Air ticket from Bali to Maldives recently with a stop in Kuala Lumpur. As expected, another time I got flight rescheduled! This is the 3rd time in a year I book a flight for my work and always got delayed / rescheduled / cancelled with Batik. Please do something! You’re making people lose time, energy and money with your outstanding unprofessionalism!
After we enter the gate, we waited about 30 minutes for the take-off. The flight was delayed for an hour.

They will not provide any information on the travel requirements (such as transit visa requirement) even customer would have reached out to them they'll not be providing any information and if you could not be able onboard to aircraft due to the transit visa requirement they are not even ready to provide a refund or option for an alternative ticket. Such a pathetic service from the airline and the customer care service team.

Delayed, no internet, no entertainment. Food menu in front of us nothing available for an international flight. The tray was sticked with a tape which was opening regularly hit my partner’s head when she was sleeping on my lap

Just consider delays as normal, they always wait for every other airplane in connection so you can easily expect hours of delays, just relax and enjoy your waiting. They board the aircraft and they just leave you there waiting for a lot of time, if you want some water of course you have to pay, like it’s normal to keep you for hours on the ground inside a plane with air conditioning not working. Do not pre-book meals, just eat something before boarding. First time they change the food I ordered with a different meal (not caring about food restrictions), second time they didn’t even sent the food, there was a miscommunication. The ground staff is very unprepared, every problem you have they say they can’t fix it but you can open a compliant, like it makes something. Batik is for sure the worst airline company I’ve ever tried. Stay away from them!

The schedule was to have 3 hours transit time in Denpasar. Unfortunately the flight from Jakarta was delayed for 3 hours ground crews were not very helpful, they did not properly annouce when the air plane would depart. This airline is just the same with its group airlines, delay is part of the culture.

review_header: "Do not fly Batik unless you have free time"
review_text: When I insisted they said because the flight would be arriving late - no announcement. I think a regularly delayed airline is disrespecting their passengers, travelling is already a stress event to have them delayed EACH time (my flight from KL to Bali on 31 Jul was also delayed) is irresponsible. At least as a courtesy, you can announce it so we can let people know and the disruption of time is not extended to our family or colleagues expecting us at the other end. Do not fly Batik Air unless you have much free time

This is one of the first flights that sells water in the aircraft. They should find some better ways to earn money then through this inhuman practice. First they ask passengers to empty the water bottle due to security reasons and then they ask for money in the aircraft. There was an inflight service in the Kuala Lumpur to Bali leg, when I asked for headphones, they refused. Why were they providing such services when we could not use it. The staff were also rude and uncourteous. I feel such airlines should be disallowed from operating.

They gave him blankets, medicine and even hot coffee. Further gave my aunt and sister a different place to sit so that my uncle can sleep and rest. Special thanks to Aira for the extra help. In general the entire crew of OD208 did an amazing job!

Flying in from Singapore to KL on 16th Jul 2023 was also delayed because of my arrival into KL. On the 19th Jul 2023, heading back also turned out to be a disappointment as the flight OD 807 was delayed by 1 hr 45 min.

On the 7/7/2023, between Singapore to Indonesia, AC was faulty. Every passenger was sweating throughout the trip with select individuals hyperventilating from the heat, and nothing else was offered for the fares we paid for adequate serviced planes that is supposed to be operationally ready for their customers. Have contacted customer support, and they refuse to make amends for passengers that had to endure this tiresome 2hr journey without proper air conditioning. Such a disappointment.
Late flight, late baggage. Disgusting food onboard. Simply worst experience. In flight entertainment was not working.
Poor inflight service and on customer service when returned home even with numerous emails and documents relating to problems.

We waited 20 minutes for airport bus and only arrived at checking at 7:45. Was informed by the airline that we had missed the check-in period. We then asked if we could fly and our bags could be checked into another flight to which the representative said that bags have to fly with their passengers. The representative was not helpful and no alternatives were offered or assistance was given.

review_header: "Last time buying anything from Batik Ai"
review_text: After queuing, plenty of time for boarding the plane with no check in luggage (50 minutes before departure), just needing the ticket, and Ground staff flat out refused to help. It seems as if they do not want you to board at all. Last time buying anything from Batik Air / Malindo Air / Lion Air, no matter how cheap the tickets are.

Little did I know it it is nothing like that now it is Batik Air (although our tickets said operated by Malindo Air).  There was 5 of us flying, I originally booked for 4 & then added an extra person 1 month later, (still several months before we were due to fly). I called the airline to add the passenger to our other booking & was on hold for over an hour. Then I advised that since we were flying together could we be seated together, they said chose seats online. Works out they want you to pay $14.90 per seat to chose any basic seat. I advised that we didn't care where we sat, just as long as we were seated together. They said they couldn't allocate the seating until closer to the date, but would link our 2 bookings. So when seats were allocated we were surprised they weren't together. They did link our bookings, but then sat 1 person 21 rows away from the rest of us. And when I tried to call to have the allocated seats changes (after another hour + on hold) I was told they couldn't help, but check in would sort it. So 1 person sat at the other end of the plane.  No food or drinks are given and they run out of food & drinks quickly. They refused to serve any tea or coffee, saying we had to wait until the seat belt light went off. It never did. There is also no inflight entertainment. So charge & download something to your device prior to boarding. Then only maybe half the baggage came out, with passengers checking other carousels trying to find their missing baggage. Approx. 15 minutes later suddenly the rest of the baggage final started coming out.  Worst airline ever. We are all dreading our return flight & will never use them again.

We had confirmed not once, but three times, that my elderly parents, who are not fluent in English, did not need to disembark the plane during the layover. However, to our dismay, they were taken off the aircraft and instructed to obtain new boarding passes and seats. This unnecessary inconvenience caused distress to my parents, who were already facing language barriers and challenges navigating the airport environment. Furthermore, there was frequent changes in flight details were incredibly frustrating. The flight timings, transit arrangements, and layover duration were altered multiple times, causing significant confusion and inconvenience. Such unpredictability is challenging for all the elderly passengers unfamiliar with English and relying on clear communication and consistent schedules.

Our luggage were delivered in good condition and no delay in flight time. I guess I wouldn’t go for this airline again given all the bad reviews but just wanted to share that my experience was very good with them.

Not the strongest of all starts for this flight as it was delayed by 35 minutes, causing me to feel anxious and panicked as this would mean missing my connection to Bangkok and eventually to Tokyo. The ground staff at Yogyakarta refused to rebook me to an earlier flight, but they kept their promises that my flight will leave before 3 in the afternoon, which is a good thing. The seat was comfortable for a 50-minute hop, and because I was assigned an emergency exit seat, more legroom is guaranteed. Crews were just okay; not rude but also not too friendly. Light meals were served for this 50-minute flight, which consisted of bread and a bottle of water. The biggest letdown was the in-flight entertainment - it used a system produced by an already bankrupt company that lacked content although it won in terms of responsiveness and layout. Their advertised Wi-Fi system did not work at all on my flight as the app kept on crashing and hanging. However, since this is only a 50-minute flight, I could not complain much. There are improvements to be made, especially in on-time performance and their in-flight entertainment, but aside from that, my experience is not heinously bad by any means.

Delay was at midnight making it more difficult to secure an Uber. No boarding pass printing kiosk, need to queue with those who dropping their baggage. No separate counters. Making it a slow and painful process.

No option to checkin online. Return flight was cancelled and then 3 days after I returned home I received an email to say the flight had been rescheduled. Takes 60 days to receive a refund. Customer email doesn’t work. Took me 3 weeks to speak to someone.
We choose budget airline to save some cost, but after delay like this more money need to spend at destination place for pay car rental extra money for delay. Very disappointed, not recommended.
No food or drink is provided you have to purchase it. Aircon is high and they don't provide pillows or blankets.
Sad to say got no help from staff at thw counter so i missed my flight. I hope other senior citizen gets assistance, lets try to be human beings. You will grow old too remember.

I will never fly with them again. 2 hours of delay on first flights, as there was no engineer available to sign the approval for landing, very uncomfortable seats, they ran out of toilet paper in both flights, in the first they didn't have even tissues, you need to pay for everything, even for a glass of water!!! This is egregious as airport security usually don't allow water to be carried on-board on many international flights. They don't offer anything for free and even the options for purchase are very limited and expensive. Cup noodles to eat, and water, coffee, tea, Milo (with hot water) and two options of warm soda. One bag of tea is AU$4!!!! As it was a night flight and it got very cold, I asked for a blanket and had to pay AU$9 for a piece of flannel. Needless to say that there was no entertainment system available. The absolute worst. Do not recommend to anyone.

Staff at counter did not want to accept our Childs Passport. She said we need a visa for the baby. We told her several times that we double checked that it is the right passport and that we already entered Thailand and Malaysia with it. She asked her Boss and both refused to take us. We tried to talk to the manager that day. He didn't really talk to us. Also he told us we can't fly. They told us the passport has to be valid for Minimum one year. We had to discuss about two hours and nearly missed the flight.  At the end the manager let us sign a paper we didn't even know what we signed because he did not talk to us. He let us board but we had to run and didn't know why at the end we we're allowed to fly. In Singapore everything was fine. So we are very angry with Batik Air for this bad and unnecessary experience. Plane was in good condition and staff in plane was very nice

All the destinations were lumped together, resulting in people yelling, changing queues, etc. Several customers missed their flights, which could have been avoided if the airline had organized the check in counters by say, Langkawi, Singapore, Bali etc. but the airplane itself was clean and the crew was courteous.

I had travelled in this flight from Bangalore to Malaysia and then Bali, and the same way back. Comfort level on the flight is also not up to the mark. Crew members don't attend issues the right way, take a lot of time to deliver food, especially if you get the seats around 20 and beyond. I would never recommend this flight. Not a smooth journey overall.

They don't care about the connecting flight timings. They twice did that and i had to call and get us back on original flight. Even on the day we had to travel our flight was delayed and we barely catched next one. They do not provide water or food even on 5 hr international flight. Forget providing liqour. You have to buy it all in Malaysian Ringgit. If you buy in dollar they charge you more. Their swiping machine doesn't work most times. They don't even care to carry enough food to feed people even if they are willing to buy their severely overpriced food. Staff is very very rude.  No headphones are provided even if the flight has entertainment screens. Nothing to cover yourself even if you are feeling cold. This has to be the worst airline I have travelled.

In both cases, everything went perfectly well: there was almost no queue for checking-in and dropping my checked luggage (it's worth noting that a checked luggage is included even in the cheapest prices, BTW), the airplanes were in perfect condition (they actually looked almost new), the space for legs was OK (even during the domestic flight, it was definitely wider than in the Air Asia domestic I also took during that trip). Almost all of the cabin crew were kind and helpful (and also elegant), and during the long haul flight there was even an individual screen (which is not the case on Scoot, for instance). Also, their prices were very competitive, even when booking hardly a few days before departure. The only negative things I noticed are: - their onboard menu was very limited, both for food and for drinks. It would be great to have more choices, - they didn't offer a Wifi option (even on long haul flights). Based on the other reviews I can read here, things can be hectic if there is any problem (rescheduled flight or canceled flight...), but if it's not the case then flying with them is a breeze and the price / quality ratio is great.

This experience taught me a massive lesson in the pitfalls of saving a few bucks on a budget airline. Only about half the app functions worked. There was no notification given that we would have to pre-purchase meals 24 hours in advance. And they would not even give us free water - we had to pay for bottles.  Then half way through the food “service”, their eftpos machine broke and they would only accept cash. At one stage, they said they couldn’t provide change. The check in process was a mess, and took over an hour. The whole time we were waiting to check in, there was another customer screaming at the (I use this term loosely) “customer service” staff about his lost booking. Staff were standoffish, vague and at times rude.  Pathetic excuse for an airline.

No high-quality service but at least the standard. Well...not with Batik I guess! To begin with, online check-in was not functional but that is not an issue. The check-in process in the counter was smooth. By the way, the airport in Bali is top class! When boarded the plane, it took literally 1.5 hour to complete boarding! They boarded people in groups every now and then. No announcements, no information, only some rumours from the flight attendants that the check-in system was broken. After departing with a 90 minute delay, and while there was no reference from the pilot and not even a typical apology, the flight service was also a delight. No surprise, you had to pay for everything on the plane but at least they should be accepting cards. It seems that Batik is an old fashioned merchant who asks only for cash and gives no receipts. The entertainment system is just typical. A collection of 10-20 movies, most of which were Indonesian, the rest mainly from Bollywood and a couple of Hollywood movies which I have never heard of. If you attempt to read the airline magazine you need to know how to read in Indonesian. No English. The same with many signs and guidelines in the aircraft. Very few were in both languages. The crew was not rude, but not polite either. It was always that awkward situation where they go only by the book when announcing things or when taking actions. When we finally landed, we were asked to stay in the aircraft for another 30 minutes for no obvious reason. Overall, the airline needs to change many things to become at least a standard service provider. I should mention here that the ticket from Bali to Perth (one way) was not at all cheap.

I was massively dehydrated asked for water 3 to 4 times but was never served water by the attendant. After 2 hours or so, I was served water by another attendant. I had to pay to get a blanket and the attendant never returned me the change despite requesting twice. Only when the flight was about to land is when I reminded her again and that's when I got the 45 dollars I was owed. It didn't look like she was planning on giving me the change had I not reminded her again. The attendant kept ignoring my requests and constantly asked me to wait.

We booked flight from Semarang to Jakarta at 4.30 pm and we try to check in via web a day before. But we couldn't and pop up message show there is an error in our booking. We also try to reach the Customer Service but there is no response. Later on we got the info from our colleague that our flight was moved to another flight which 5 hour earlier than our booking, without notice. We have to rushed our check out from hotel so we could catch up the flight. But what happened later more surprisingly, we got the information that our flight was delayed about an hour. What else, after we board, we knew that our cabin wasn't available because already full with another passenger luggage. And what the crew do? Nothing, they just moved our luggage into baggage without confirmation. This is the last time we used Batik Air and also another airline from Lion Group.

Airline ground staff at Lahore airport was very courteous & professional, went out of the way to accommodate family with kids. Air hostesses were smiling & helpful. Food  quality was up  to the mark, served hot. Journey was pleasant.

review_header: "surprised to see that are flight was cancelled"
review_text: When finishing are weekend and going to the airport on Sunday evening was it our surprised to see that are flight was cancelled. I got no mail or message from them telling me that my flight was cancelled. I can confirm that they had my Indonesian number and email address since they send my on both a message to confirm my flight and check in time on Thursday. So they had all my information, but now they are telling me that they have another number and e-mail address which is why I got no information. I get no compensation or no help to find a hotel around. Their system was wrong by sending the mail and message to the wrong message but they are making me believe that it is mine. Don’t trust Batik Air and always check your flight because they easily cancelled their flight!

From Jakarta to Perth, transit at Bali. Really bad Service. At Jakarta the Lounge was so disappointed, the food is bland and cold, the soup pot lid were broken and they use like aluminum foil cover with tape, and the toilet was so dirty. Arrived at Bali the thing getting worse, they take Economy Class passenger at the Business Class counter, me and another 2 passenger end up standing about 45 minutes, until the passenger behind me go to complain and finally we can get our turn. Next, there's no Batik Air Lounge at Bali Airport, you gotta be kidding me!!!

review_header: "don't book a flight with Batik Air"
review_text: The agent at Melbourne airport promised that I will be reimbursed for all costs that result from this, including hotel, meals and transfer and that I would automatically be booked on a flight the next day and that information will follow via email. For this reason, I decided not to go for the option of claiming a refund and booking a different flight. Well, I did not receive any information that day about when I would be flying. Also the service hotline was not picking my call until I gave up after more than 2 hours waiting on the line. I just went to the airport again the next morning and ended up flying with the same plane I was supposed to be on the morning before. I arrived at my destination 24 hours late. Costs for another night in Melbourne etc. resulted and I handed in all invoices to the Customer Care service email address that was mentioned on the flight cancellation letter I got at the airport. And now they are telling me that their terms and conditions state "Malindo Air reserves the right to cancel or change the planned departure, schedule, route, aircraft or stopping places of any flight for which fares have been paid, at any time and from time to time, for any reason, without notice to any Passengers affected thereby and, in connection therewith, the Carrier shall not be liable to any Passenger in respect of such cancellation or change, whether or not resulting from an Event of Force Majeure which includes but not limited to bad weather and Acts of God." If their agent on the airport would not have lied to me, I could at least have saved a few hundred bucks!!!! Customer Service only replies within more than a week not being a help at all. I'll probably end up loosing 500 Euros. Do yourself a favor and don't book a flight with Malindo Air or Batik Air or whatever they will call themselves in future.

However, in Melbourne they couldn’t check in my bags so they did manual checked in from Kuala Lumpur to Kathmandu. I haven’t received my bag and it’s been 4 days. I am never flying with this airline. I keep on calling airport but no help till yet. This has just ruined my start of holidays.

So they have to wait like the rest of the economy class passengers. The flight was delayed by 1 and half hours and no announcement was made. We only got to know when we went to the staff to inquire. There is no way in hell you can manage your booking online, so once you booked and paid you are at the mercy of their Customer Service which doesn't care.

The website doesn’t work properly, manage booking or check in or change bag allowance. Planes are never on time. They’re too cheap to pay for the airbridge, so you have to board via bus. When I arrived at my destination all of my clothes inside suitcase are soaking wet. So they must’ve left my luggage in a huge puddle for quite a long time in order for that to happen. Baggage takes forever to come out.  The food is terrible. And there are no monitors in the back of the seats for entertainment. It’s not worth saving the money to fly on this airline.

The staff at airport, especially Amritsar airport the staff don't know any rules for traveling to a country and try to educate others needlessly.  I didn't understand their policies, even food was requested on my ticket but i didn't get any food in a long flight. The attendants only served water in small glasses and left the person if he/she was asleep. No entertainment source used while flying. Overall, a terrible experience.

Staff have problem with everything, what the passengers need. Once food is in the price of ticket, once you must paid extra. Nobody ask you, if you need something to drink or if you want a food You must buy a water and everything. Definitely last flight with Batik Air

I bought a business class ticket and expected my luggage to get a priority label. They didn't, as I found out in Jakarta, after waiting for almost one hour for my luggage. In Solo you shall not pass, into the executive lounge, although also being a Garuda Platinum Member. The girl was quite adamant about that. But there are no first class planes form Solo, so who is going into this lounge? Family, friends? Checkin, together with economy class (pushing as always). No service personel detected at Soehatta. I will not recommend Batik Air.

Flight attendants were impolite and giving orders instead of asking politely. During flight when i asked if they had a food menu, i was told they did not have food anymore. When my husband asked, they told him they had noodles. We couldn't pay for water as we only had our bank cards (which they didn't take) and money in euros which they also don't take!). My husband needed his meds and although i have nicely asked for a free cup they did not give me one. When we landed we were without explanation for 15 minutes or so in the plane for no logical reason. I am never flying with this company again.

Moved flight three times with no regard to connecting flights, visa expiry, personal need to arrive on the day. Not flight delays, complete three times date changes on the flights. We regret to inform you that your flight has been changed to xx date? Never seen this happen before. - Customer care doesn't pick phone, nor replies to mails. - Cannot cancel online. - Extremely rude staff at Subang airport when you go to their counter. They keep shuttling you from one point to another point. No answers, no responsibility.

I will never fly with them again. 2 hours of delay on first flights, as there was no engineer available to sign the approval for landing, very uncomfortable seats, they ran out of toilet paper in both flights, in the first they didn't have even tissues, you need to pay for everything, even for a glass of water. This is egregious as airport security usually don't allow water to be carried on-board on many international flights. They don't offer anything for free and even the options for purchase are very limited and expensive. Cup noodles to eat, and water, coffee, tea, Milo (with hot water) and two options of warm soda. One bag of tea is AU$4.As it was a night flight and it got very cold, I asked for a blanket and had to pay AU$9 for a piece of flannel. Needless to say that there was no entertainment system available. The absolute worst. Do not recommend to anyone.
Being a full service carrier, Batik offered no onboard beverage or meal service. The flight seats were average, and the crew were courteous. No inflight entertainment.
Further purchase food are sucks and very small portion. When order looks good, when food received it was trash. Picture deceiving. Look at attached Picture vs Real

review_header: "for the price I paid, they impressed me"
review_text: Ground staff at both Manado and Jakarta were all friendly, communicative, and very courteous. At first, they announced that the flight will be delayed for 30 minutes, but we ended up waiting for only 10. Upon boarding the ex-Batik Air Malaysia plane, I was greeted by a somehow-cold cabin crew and a pretty hot cabin. Then, I figured out that my plane had no in-flight entertainment screens at all. I was about to be disappointed but it turned out that they offered Wi-Fi-based in-flight entertainment through the Tripper app, which was very sublime with never-seen-before options. The absence of the music selection was covered by e-magazines, vlogs, and podcast selections alongside TV shows, games, movies, and many more. Some lags still happened, but this was miles better than their old IFE system (I'm referring to the old ones installed in older A320s and 737s, not their newer PK-LU* A320s). The seat was good enough for a long flight like this. As the flight progressed, the cabin crews became even friendlier, communicative, and attentive, although they were not as friendly as on my previous Batik Air flight. They could have been friendlier by explaining the food that I had - which I assume was a delicious, nicely presented grilled chicken with sautéed beans and carrots and a chocolate muffin. Overall, for the price I paid, they impressed me in several aspects including their new Wi-Fi based in-flight entertainment, but they obviously still have several rooms for improvement.

The rule as per the Batik Air website states that you need to carry a certificate of fitness from the doctor in case you are pregnant for more than 28 weeks. Also double confirmed from customer care about the rules. However, to my surprise, when reached at the airport counter, the check in staff doesn't want to listen and started to point out at a board on her desk. When I asked that, if I am supposed to check the rules coming to airport every day, she said yes. Later when I called the customer care and asked again, the answer was same and handed over the phone to her supervisor to make him understand but still the staff, as mentioned earlier, made their own rule of getting check up done by airport doctor. The doctor just checked BP and oxygen level which assured him that my wife is fit to fly.  Certainly, not flying again with you guys.

One trip was a business meeting in Jakarta, my 8am outbound was moved to 10amwhilst I was in the air the return was brought forward 2hrs from 16.30 to 14.30. Terrible customer service. When I tried to bring flight 6 forward to return early they attempted to charge me full price to downgrade from business to economy.
Good thing was that the plane left on time and arrived on time, but this is the only really positive thing I can mention.

I booked my flight from Bali to Doha via Xiamen and received three full meals, a 24-hour entry permit to explore Xiamen during my 18-hour transit, a free single hotel room, and a free shuttle from airport to hotel, all for $200. It is simply incredible to believe that you can fly from Bali to China to Doha for only $200.

We start off from Singapore's Changi Airport and the check in was quite smooth( note that their carry-on is only 5kg) we get our boarding pass finish security and customs, we finally managed to board the plane, the cabin crew was very sweet and nice , we are not delayed however the landing was super bad.
Flight attendants are friendly and polite. Seats can be reclined easily. The food is delicious and fresh. Flights departed on time.

Due to the long transit time, I book hotels for the round-trip. After the booking, Xiamen Airlines made several changes to the flight schedule. All those changes are minor. But each time I receive a change, it is very stressful to ensure that my trip will not be badly affected. On 20 Feb 2024, Xiamen Airlines made a very drastic change in the flight schedule by 1 day later. This drastic change of course adversely affected my trip. Given such unreliable schedule, I do not think I want to book Xiamen Airline anymore. Now I have to work with the travel booking company to cancel my flight and hotel bookings. Request for a full refund. And search & book another flight.

I went back to china in October 2023 and checked in two luggage bags, everything went well. When I came back to the USA from china things happened. First they cancelled the flight, then they transferred me to other airlines but only allowed me to checked in only one luggage bag! And the manager on duty in the airport on that day couldn’t solve the problem, she seemed like just wasted my time because I didn’t have time to argue as I needed to board first in order to catch the next flight to the United States. She asked me to pay for the second luggage by myself which was the only way that I could do. I tried to explain that I came from America with two bags, she said maybe other staff made mistake and later they would do investigation then someone would contact with me. However more than two weeks have passed, nobody contacted me. Very disappointed with this airline and I feel very angry about what they did.
They lost my bag. Already waiting 3 days to pick it up. Instead of delevering it to my hotel they leave me waiting and barely replying to my emails. Dont fly with them

On my return flight, I went through arrivals again and then did not know where to go to get the free hotel. I ended up at the transfer desk where hustlers were telling me no more room at hotels but they could take me to a hotel for 30$. The Airport staff using their phone apps to translate advised me where to go. I was happy with Xiamen Airlines except for the fact that I paid extra for premium economy but after boarding found that it did not exist. The cabin staff suggested I contact a Chinese number which didn't make any sense as I couldn't use my phone in Xiamen. I just emailed them for a refund. The Xiamen hotel was super and the buffet breakfast was superb. Glad to have walked around Xiamen for a few hours before flying further.

The Xiamen Airlines crew has not a good knowledge and they deny me boarding and i have suffered losses. Now they are even care to check what mistake they have done to refund my ticket money even. They have no care and no customer service.

review_header: “I will not fly with them again”
review_text: The flights themselves were fine but the transit in Xiamen is a hassle and not worth the lower price the airlines offers compared to their competitors. On the route I flew, the main competitors are KLM, Qatar airways, Emirates and Singapore Airlines. To transit in Xiamen to your onward flight, you need to clear immigration twice which means filling in a form, queueing up, cleariing immigration as if Xiamen is your final destination and you are entering China (which I was not). Some other travellers have reported being questioned by immigration (WHY?) and even being held for an hour or so. In my opinion, this is unncessary and inappropriate. Then also you have to go to the check in area again, wait in line and check in separately for your connecting flight whereas it is common that you are checked in and receive boarding passes for all your flights at the point of origin. I have sent an e-mail to Xiamen about this and am awaiting their reply. For now I will not fly with them again until the transit procedure has been changed to not require going through immigration and checking in separately for a connecting flight. None of the competing airlines mentioned require these things, allowing for a more pleasant experience and more time to relax and use airport facilities.

Food in Business Class from KL to Xiamen was really not reflective of price you paid, can say worse than any food you get in a local Malaysian coffeeshop. The return flight to KLIA has better food but still not up to the mark for Business Class. No wine was served. Bread is cold. The seat has no TV monitor and no power or USB plug in points. It is also hard to adjust the seat. It reminded me of the 737 plane we took in the 90s. I would rate it as a low cost carrier and not worth the price we paid. Some LCC is better than this. Maybe their Economy section is better than other airlines but I wont know.
The crew was really nice and helpful. Food was good. Enough legspace. Xiamen airport is small and it was hard to get wifi but ask the staff and you will be oke.

review_header: "worst airline I have taken so far"
review_text: Poor passenger service during check in. You can’t see any facial expressions from the staff face, look like so crucial and unhappy. The staff attitude is also a disaster. Can’t answer the questions properly and put so much weight constraint in the luggage weight, even there is not much exceeding of the weight.  Do not recommend to take this airline if there is alternative airline.

Their booking site shows one price in the calendar, then much higher when you go to book. You try to request a special meal: after a lot of emails and even requests to send your passport by email (!) you are told it can’t be done. Meat meals only. You try to check-in online. “This option is being implemented”. Except it’s not. The flights from Amsterdam are jam-packed and everyone’s randomly allocated a seat before check-in is opened, so there’s nowhere to move seats to even if you come early. Yes you could (perhaps) have bought a seat during booking if you feel $54 US is a fair price for 67B. The booking process loses my frequent flyer number (deliberately?) Confusing emails (some only in Mandarin) are sent about how to pay for a return flight if you’re denied entry for covid reasons. You have to register a RAT test on a dysfunctional government website (yes travel in August 2023 still requires RAT tests). Airport Check-in is full of misinformation: Skyteam check-in staff have been told that bags and boarding passes are good only to Xiamen, then you’ll have to leave the airport and go through the whole process again. This is “because there are so many people on the flight”. Hello?!! Amsterdam to Xiamen is chock a block full, with nice attendants, reasonably clean plane and 31” legroom, but it’s ghastly looking chicken or beef only, and no bassinets mean screaming babies are randomly scattered around the plane. Can't understand dialogue on films with the awful headphones; bring your own. People who wanted windows have been given aisles and vice versa, couples seated apart, etc, and it was all solvable; 11hrs is a long flight. Disembarkation is met with long unexplained delays. Xiamen airport is a confused mess. Eventually, after 90 minutes chasing our luggage, it’s discovered that bags DID go through, but it’s not possible to check-in till 3hrs before the next flight (9hrs). You have to join the massive customs queue anyway. Transfer passengers are guided (well, not really … you eventually find it by queueing in the wrong place) to a subterranean basement for 6hrs; I try my luck with the free hotel. 2.5hrs after landing I’m there. It’s good (but be prepared to share a room), but you have to find 100 yuan somewhere for the taxi (on a Sunday it was only 25 each way but you should allow 50). Money changers charge a whopping €5 commission even for small amounts. Hotel has no free wifi for foreigners and staff speak zero English. Check in again (regardless of whether you went to a hotel or not) maximum 3hrs before the flight. Oh, except if the immigration or customs officers have found something they don’t like about you. My neighbour (from Spain) was detained by them for 3hrs over questions about her Australian visa which were already resolved in Amsterdam. She shouldn’t even have had to deal with them as she was planning on staying in transit. This is not possible at XMN. Once again the terminal wifi is not working (no authorization codes for foreign phones). There’s no help desk. Sit in boredom in an extraordinarily dull terminal. Yes I saved €100 but it was absolutely not worth the hassle and stress. I’ll stick to more professional airlines in future!

The aircraft was quite modern, and the business class seat was quite comfortable, a standard 1-2-1 layout. That is where the good ends. The staff were unable to speak or understand English, and the service is done to suit Chinese customers only, not for foreigners. The food was very bland and limited choice, the hot dishes not properly heated, and white wine and soft beverages incl water were served warm. The amenities were cheap and below acceptable levels. Most airlines economy service is a lot better than this, and they should be ashamed that this is what they provide on international routes. Before Covid I used Hainan Airlines from Brussels, and they were so much more advanced than Xiamen Airlines. As a warning to other international travelers, I say to avoid Xiamen Airlines.

Very friendly service, even though English communication was limit. Flight attendants were on point and helpful. The nightmare started when I landed in XMN awaiting my transfer flight to BKK. Covid restrictions had the airport lounge closed down! The hotel service provide was 20 minutes away in a known covid positive area. The Official at the desk had limited skills and stated there is a risk my health code would change and I wouldn't be able to board my flight tomorrow, nothing he could do. No refunds for this situation. Very poor manners, ended staying on a bench outside of the airport ,after the airport it's self lock the doors around 2 am. BTW flight is scheduled for 9am, Flight times changed twice on day of departure. On the ground service and attitude was horrible. First time flying business class with this airline was a trip I wish I forget.

The flight was rescheduled to 7pm. I missed the dinner because of that. Came to the airport on time and the flight was deleted one hour. This seems to be a joke, but it's not. I see this as a bad management or bad structure of this airline. It made my day a very bad day

review_header: "has been, by far, the worst airline"
review_text: I showed up at Xiamen Airport (Xiamen Airlines flagship hub) 5 hours in advance of my flight for two reasons. First, I knew that my bags would be overweight (I was moving back home to the states), and I wanted to see by how much. I had some items I could discard to make the baggage lighter, but I wanted to see how much over I was. Second, since COVID still had regulations, I wanted to be sure that I had enough time to get through the process on time. Xiamen Airlines, unfortunately, did not make any of this process possible. When I arrived at the airport, I was informed that I would not be able to set foot into the international wing until two hours before the flight took off. This forced me to wait until they opened the wing. Once the wing was open, the sold-out flight loaded up the kiosks. The line was moving unbelievably slow, but I knew that the attendants were able to see me waiting and that I probably will need extra help. This entire process of getting through the line nearly took an hour and a half.  Once I got to the front of the line, the first thing that they informed me of was that there were only middle seats left.
