Seat was comfortable and flight departed on time and arrived early into Singapore. I would definitely travel with China Southern Air again for the right price!

The check-in process was smooth, and the counter staff (Xiao Xu) was friendly and efficient. The flight attendants on board were also very attentive, constantly checking on passengers and providing excellent service. The in-flight entertainment system offered a wide variety of movies, TV shows, and music, making the long flight pass by quickly.

If anything goes wrong, you are completely on your own. On my outbound flight, they lost my luggage, luckily I had an airtag in it so I could lead them to its location, but they were yet to deliver it to me 10 days later.  Despite multiple calls and follow-ups, the airline offered no real assistance or compensation. I had to spend my own money just to get by.

The trip was from London to China then transit onto Vietnam. China Southern changed the time/date of my outgoing flight 3 times. The last change moved the flight forward by 24 hours. They did not think to move the connecting flight as well causing us to have to contact the travel agent to have that moved. This incurred an additional admin fee of £92. Even though it was not our fault that the flight was changed, the travel agent said we had no choice but to pay it or wait in China for 24 hours until the connecting flight. They said we had to take it up with China Southern as they changed the flight. When we were finally able to fly we were stuck in China and delayed for over 4 hours. On return I raised a complaint to claim back the £92. The complaint system was a nightmare - if you did not reply on the day a different person would takeover the complaint and ask for the exact information the previous person asked for. After exchanging pretty much the same messages over a 2 week period they finally said they were not responsible for any of the costs from the travel agent and that they would not cover anything. Between the airline and the travel agent they were blaming each other - ultimately I am the one out of £92 even though it was the airline which changed the flight when I did not want to and gave me no options but to change the connecting flight myself. Very poor customer service.

She assisted me with an upgrade and was incredibly friendly, professional, and never pushy. I appreciated how smoothly she handled everything.  Her helpfulness and positive attitude truly made a difference—thank you!

When I boarded, I noticed a strong, nauseating smell of vomit coming from my seat. I alerted the flight attendant right away. Their only solution? They handed me a bottle of perfume spray to mask the stench. After it became clear there were no other available seats on the plane, my husband switched seats with me so I wouldn’t have to sit directly in the seat. As a result, both of our clothes were ruined, saturated with the smell. We paid for a premium experience, and instead we were exposed to unsanitary conditions. Even worse, China Southern’s customer service has been dismissive and unresponsive. No apology. No refund. No accountability.

The stopover option is incredibly well handled with transport provided to and from your hotel, I thoroughly recommend this as Guangzhou has a great easy to use metro system and its very easy to get around. The A350/ 787 fleet used are in excellent condition with pleasant staff although meals can be a let down, one on my return journey was actually inedible, However the real test of a good airline is when things don't go to plan. My return flight from Rome was cancelled due to a technical issue after we had boarded the flight. We spent 2 hours on board with regular updates provided before the Captain made the decision not to fly. Prior to disembarking which involved re-entering Italy and collecting our bags, lunch was served on board, a nice touch. Once back in the terminal we were given further meal vouchers and asked to return an hour later. On return, we were bussed to the nearby Sheraton where all accommodation and meals were covered for 24 hours while the plane was repaired and put back in service. These changes left only 6 hours to change to my rescheduled flight from Guangzhou to Sydney however to my delight China Southern provided a hotel option close to the airport allowing for a refreshing stop and rest before the final long leg back to Sydney. So, sure I arrived on Sunday morning instead of Friday night as planned , but the way I was looked after was very good . I would certainly recommend China Southern and will fly with them again .

However, this is a heads-up for snowsports travelers. Unless you are in business class, you will be charged excess luggage for your snowboard or ski bag unless you pay it when purchasing your airfare. They advertise free ski equipment and I am sure my travel agent and I checked to make sure it was true. They do, but the total length + width + depth has to be 203cm or less. There is no snowboard or ski bag under that size. We somehow missed this fact. In business class it is 300cm, which is more than enough, but for me it meant a $US170 penalty. No pay, no boarding pass. Be aware, when they say they will carry your snowsports gear despite being oversize for general luggage, it is not entirely true. Very strange for a country trying to promote its own snowsports industry.

As I bordered the Boeing 787-8 I was greeted with kind flight attendants who directed me to my seat. On my seat was a pillow, a thin blanket and  headphones for the inflight entertainment. We departed on time around 9:50 in the evening (UK time). There was 3 meals served and many drinks services with a variety of drinks ranging from fruit juices, alcohols (beer), fizzy drinks and waters. The meals were served on trays made up of a warm main dish with a side dish such as vegies and a desert. Overall the food was tasty and plentiful. There was a wide variety of movies which included Chinese and Western movies in many languages, there was also fun mini games and an inflight map showing the progress of our flight, I would say my flight to Zhengzhou took around 9 and a half hours. The seats were reclinable and padded well, In my opinion it was quite comfy and I fell asleep quickly after watching a movie. The cushion was soft and surprisingly the blanket offered a good amount of warmth. The bathrooms and seats were all cleaned and maintained well and overall the flight was relaxed and peaceful. My only complaint is that the cabin was a bit warn out and old with some pieces of fabric missing from the front bit of my seat. This did not serve as an issue to me, it was only aesthetically unpleasing. Another suggestion from me is to offer an amenity kit as the flight was long haul. Overall I had an amazing experience with friendly staff, delicious meals and extreme comfort and good entertainment that kept me busy.
The aircraft is clean and so are the toilets. Decent food. Comfortable seat. No WiFi on the last flight. The service on board is amazing.  All flights punctual. Would fly them again anytime.

Very nice in flight meal. I had ordered vegetarian lacto OVO meal, I was confirmed with a type " western vegetarian meal" and was served a meal with tag AVML. However whatever I got to eat was served hot tasty and was tasty. I was given a blanket to use for the mid night flight . The in flight entertainment was not of my taste though. I used the flight information and enjoyed it. The cabin was clean and everything else was good. Good experience!!

After purchasing four tickets online, I discovered that changes or cancellations could not be processed through the app. This forced me to visit the Sydney office in person to make adjustments to my booking. Subsequently, I needed to cancel the tickets and request a refund, which required an in-person visit to the office. I submitted my refund application over five weeks ago and later received a call from the Sydney office informing me that the refund could not be processed to my original payment method as the tickets were purchased online. I provided my bank details as requested. Despite multiple follow-ups, I only received an email a week ago stating that my application had been received and was under review. The lack of responsiveness from the Sydney office is appalling, they do not answer phone calls, making follow-ups frustrating and time-consuming.

No apology, no explanation, no alternative flights, and no refund despite the Regulation (EC) No 261/2004, Article 5. Their customer service phone lines were unreachable all the afternoon. My online profile in their website didnt reflect this cancelation. They refuse to pay the €600 compensation I am owed, claiming they sent me a cancellation email in late September, which I never received. Despite my requests and reminders of the EU law article 14, they refused to provide any proof of this email. I had to contacted them on November and shared my flight number and booking reference at their request. They confirmed that day baggage details for this flight in question but never mentioned the flight has been canceled 2 months ago.

review_header: "found out that there was no flight"
review_text: Some observations: There is no one who can help because your office was closed. You make use of the services by KLM though in your service agreement there is a clear gap as KLM claimed I had to go to China Southern (CSA) for by cancelled flight. When I called early next morning to CSA, the customer service told me I should have received an email on Friday the 13th of September about the rescheduled fight to the next day. In all honesty, we never received it; it is not in 'received', 'deleted', 'forwarded', stored or in 'spam' or any other folder or at another date. After contacting Service Desk again, it sent its overview out of which it should be clear that it informed us accurately. The e-mail address was scratched out though partially, though I can clearly see that it was not my e-mail address. The booked flight through their website was received by me, concluding that it cannot be my mistake of a wrong email address. It might be a technical failure in their system. What strikes me is that is Service Desk aims to cover up mistakes. This cannot be, it is not acceptable for me that a Service Desk purposely misinforms you.

I recently had an experience that, despite starting off on the wrong foot, turned into a testament to the incredible dedication of the airline's ground crew. Unfortunately, we mismanaged our time and ended up missing our flight. It was a stressful situation for our family of four, and we were worried about what would happen next. However the ground crew went above and beyond to assist us. They were understanding and reassuring, immediately helping us to rebook our tickets. What truly impressed us was their effort to ensure that we could sit together on our new flight. The staff worked diligently and communicated openly throughout the process, making a stressful situation much more manageable. Thanks to the remarkable support from the team, we were able to travel together without further issues. I can't express enough gratitude for their exceptional service. It truly made a difference in our travel experience. Highly recommend this airline for their commitment to customer care!

com. At the last minutes before my departure I received an email saying my flight back to London has been rescheduled which will add 24hours more lay over at the stop in China. They gave me no reason nor explanation why. And I was told if I do not wish to flight, I could have a refund. I guess they knew it will leave me no choice but to accept it because the chance to buy another tickets is difficult. However, I decided to cancel them because I couldn't trust them with the way they do business. They have ruined my journey. I have requested a refund but it has been 3 days without any response.

At first ,we were told that our luggage were overweight. With the help of the airport workers ,we solve the problem successfully. The staff in Baiyun airport is patient and helpful. Second ,the services on the airplane is really nice too. Soft chairs and nice services makes our flying more enjoyable.

When I first flew with them 20 years ago, the standards were appalling but the country has made massive progress since then, and so has their airlines. The chance came when I managed to snag a bargain for a one-way ticket from Shanghai to Bangkok via CZ's Guangzhou hub for a mere USD 110 including all taxes and surcharges despite just booking it a week prior, and along with that came a chance to try out the experience on their older A330 widebody as well as their newer A350 widebody aircraft. They definitely left quite an impression, beginning from a smooth and efficient check-in experience, as well as a systematic boarding process. Within the aircraft itself, the cabin space provided sufficient and reasonable seat pitch (legroom) together with an engaging and modern IFE system available in multiple languages (A350 but not quite the A330). The food by the way was rather tasty as well and made for a decent meal. The cabin crew were professional and courteous, always smiling, and were superb in keeping the passengers well looked after. Announcements were made in both Mandarin and English, and apart from the accent the English was perfectly comprehensible. Above all, both flights departed and arrived safely and on time with no delays. If there was some room for improvement, that would be the booking and check-in process, as their website and mobile app still seems rather rudimentary and dated. Along with that, digital boarding passes were only available on certain sectors and done as a print-screen rather than being added to the mobile digital wallet. The queue at the check-in counter seemed rather intimidating at the start, but it moved along quickly. If the company is able to address these small teething inconveniences, it can potentially make CZ one of the best in the world. After all, the devil is always in the details. But at such a price point, there can be absolutely no complaints about the experience.

From start to finish, everything was impeccable. The booking process was smooth and straightforward, and the customer service team was incredibly helpful and responsive. The check-in process at the airport was efficient, and the staff were friendly and professional. Boarding was quick and well-organized, and the plane itself was clean and modern. During the flight, the cabin crew were attentive and courteous, providing excellent service throughout. The in-flight entertainment offered a great variety of movies, TV shows, and music, making the journey enjoyable. The meals served were delicious and catered to various dietary preferences, ensuring everyone had a satisfying dining experience. The seats were comfortable with ample legroom, allowing for a relaxed and pleasant flight. Additionally, the flight arrived on time, making the overall travel experience seamless. I highly recommend China Southern Airlines for their exceptional service, comfortable flights, and dedication to passenger satisfaction. I look forward to flying with them again in the future!

The service was very good when I checked in. We had a lot of luggage, and she was careful to help us to go through the formalities. When we were in a tight time, I actively took us in and let us catch the plane. The food on the plane was also good.
Staff were friendly and approachable. Service was beyond expectation. Seat was comfortable. I will travel with China southern again.

China Southern don't provide assistance in situations like sudden cancellation of flight. We tried to reached out to service team at the airport office and the online support to see if they can help or assist. Nobody actually there to help the customers. We have wasted a whole day and our little 2 year old son got sick because of all the hassle we had to deal with. Absolutely hopeless service!
The cabin staff are very friendly but their English language is very poor. No menu was offered in business class and the food offered linguistically very ambiguous. IFE is horribly poor.
Hostesses practical and very serious, smile is free. Aircraft very dirty, it needed cleaning. Meal very poor, mainly rice.

The seats are clean, good leg space, and Excellent inflight entertainment with plentiful movies on long-haul flights. All flights were on schedule. Their website is slow, in Chinese so Google Translate needs to be used, not easy to book through their website, so forced to use an aggregator, and their direct website price is almost double that the online aggregator. Need to pay upfront to reserve a seat. Unable to do online check-in. Need to undergo slow security, immigration and documents check at Guangzhou when you are in transit.

I had a foot injury during my travel in Guangzhou, and I was not able to move into narrow space. The staff was very friendly and help me to select an aisle seat. Flight attendants were very considerate and frequently come over to check on my need. My heart is touched by their patience and passion. I have a wonderful flight. For sure I will select China southern airline as my flight again and also recommend China southern airline to my friends and family.

Boarding was organised in KUL by row number but not in Guangzhou Airport where there was no announcement and everyone just queued up and boarded randomly. The aircraft was clean and seats were very comfortable, adequate legroom and width, even for me a big guy. The IFE was good with a huge selection of movies but no TV series. The food was mediocre at best but they did serve a full hot meal on KUL-CAN sector and two hot meals from CAN-BNE, which was unusual. Beverage offerings were decent but only Chinese beer was available. The staff were very professional and worked hard although they were a bit abrupt at times. Overall, this airline is cheap and cheerful and in my experience, reliable. One of the drawbacks of Guangzhou Baiyun airport is that often the A350s seem to be parked at a remote stand which entails a 10 minute bus ride which seems to last forever!

This is one of the best China flights I think. Smooth and punctual flight, smooth transit even a bit strict checking, lovely stewardess checking on safety frequently. No issues with English speaking. Guangzhou airport was nice too. I'd recommend it.

review_header: "an issue with one of our visas"
review_text: We then realised there was an issue with one of our visas. We advised the check in staff of this visa issue, and our bags had to be pulled as it meant I could not fly. Staff were grateful for us informing them, as they were meant to have checked our visas at checkin, so they would have received a large penalty. While this issue was being sorted we asked about rescheduling our flight, but we’re told this would be dealt with after we had our bags back. Once we got our bags back however all staff had disappeared, and no one could assist with rescheduling, they advised we speak to our travel agent. The airport was now empty. We spoke to our travel agents as advised, but they required just a written email to confirm that we had been checked in and then our bags had been pulled (simply an outline of the situation). We went back to China southern airline staff several times the next day to ask about this and spoke to the supervisor, however they continued to refuse to write any email or provide any confirmation of what had happened. This meant our travel agents could not help us and we were stuck in our situation.

Booking my ticket was a breeze. The airline's website is user-friendly, offering a seamless booking process. Upon arriving at the airport, the staff were courteous and attentive, ensuring a smooth and hassle-free check  in experience.  The seating was comfortable, with ample legroom in economy class. China Southern Airlines excels in providing entertainment options during the flight. From the latest blockbuster movies to a diverse selection of music and games, there was something for everyone. The high-quality screens and responsive interface enhanced the overall entertainment experience. The menu offered a delightful array of dishes, showcasing both local and international flavors. The cabin crew exhibited professionalism and warmth and were attentive to passengers' needs. The flight departed and arrived on schedule. The support staff were readily available to address any concerns or queries, demonstrating a commitment to customer satisfaction that is truly commendable. My experience with China Southern Airlines surpassed all expectations.

Having taken our seats which I'd re-booked them making sure no one would be sat behind us. The 1st meal wasn't to my liking but I'm not keen on fish or any seafood so my hubby had both and thoroughly enjoyed it. Breakfast was OK sausage tomatoes mushrooms scrambled eggs etc which was pleasant. In between we were offered drinks from water to wine. Leg room was OK tv good. Hopefully our journey home will be the same. Overall a good experience 9 out of 10.

When I got to the airport to check in, it’s says the flight is cancelled. I did not receive any notification from China Southern about this cancellation nor was given a reason. It’s now 6 hours since my flight was due to leave and I’m yet to receive anything in writing from China southern about this. They offered for me to board a flight to Guangzhou the next day but that there is no availability to complete my journey to Sydney, at least for several days and even then there is no guarantee. They did not offer any other solution or refund. I had to purchase another flight to Sydney with another airline and there doesn’t seem to be anyway to get my money back. Also, because I don’t accept their flight to China, I lose my return flight.

Especially the flight attendants during my 4 flights were very kind and very service minded. Special thanks to the ladies of my flight from Guangzhou to Frankfurt. The A350 is a wonderful plane to fly with, very quiet, seats and food are good, only the movies are subtitled with Chinese which is a bit annoying. Overall comparable with Emirates. I had a layover of 24 hours in Guangzhou and the airline arranged everything for me, hotel with food and drinks, visa and transport.

Service really good by cabin crew. On the 787-9 dreamliner good leg room. Food was also good. Good all round service. Very good value for the ticket from Bangkok to Heathrow, £234 including using the lounge in Guangzhou China.

So couples are assigned seats in two rows. Children separated from their parents by other passengers. We had 4 such cases within 6 rows of our seat. Who knows how many others in the flight were separated because they chose not to pay for their seat.

I couldn’t eat on the flight or in transit and they took no responsibility for it. The staff gave me a meal ticket and when I arrived for stopover in Guangzhou and there was no gluten free options. The staff at the counter did not not did not speak English and no one would translate for me. Everyone looked at me like I was an inconvenience and then, it was time for my next flight and I had to run to the gate. People on the flight from to Melbourne coughed and hacked up phlegm. There was no hygiene protocols.

As tourists from the Netherlands, we were facing a visa issue for New Zealand, and their wholehearted and patient support effectively resolved the problem. We are truly grateful for their outstanding help and will always remember their assistance.

review_header: "price of the flight is really cheap"
review_text: The meals is quite good. The seat are comfortable. Although there's no TV, the crew member provide headphones. There are many channels. Luggage claim was fast. The price of the flight is really cheap.

The check-in process was smooth and hassle-free, thanks to the courteous and efficient staff.  The aircraft was modern and well-equipped. I was pleasantly surprised by the comfort of the seating. The cleanliness of the cabin was impeccable. The flight attendants were attentive, friendly, and available to assist with any needs. Their dedication to ensuring passenger comfort was evident throughout the flight. The food was delicious, with a variety of options.
The service was very good when I checked in. We had a lot of luggage, and she was careful to help us to go through the formalities. The food on the plane was also good.

review_header: “far better value for money than expected”
review_text: Staff on the ground in Beijing were very efficient with the boarding process, and cabin crew were attentive and professional. Of particular note for me is that the cabin crew actively goes around the cabin helping passengers with their carry-on luggage, and is more firm with passengers about suitcases taking priority over backpacks, purses, coats, etc. The cabin crew is also more strict with enforcing pre-takeoff and pre-landing rules, like seatbelts, seat recline, and tray tables than other airlines I have flown with. Cabin crew were also very diligent in frequently cleaning and checking on the lavatories, and keeping them clean and stocked. Being a new plane, the seats were clean and comfortable, with enough legroom in economy for me, who is 183cm in height. The seat also felt like it reclined more, and the tray tables were able to be folded in half to take up less space when there is only a drink. One point that I was disappointed by was the catering: before the pandemic, I recalled that China Southern always had a more "Chinese" option such as congee for the main dish, rather than the standard "chicken or pasta". That was a real selling point for me, and I was disappointed when the meal options this time around were "pork or fish", though the meals were still very good. The IFE had a good variety of programming, with all the latest Hollywood movies and over 200 pieces of programming, but suffered from mediocre-quality headphones and lack of customizable subtitle options; these two made it very difficult to understand the programming on the IFE over the loud sounds of the plane, which only had English subtitles for Chinese-language programming. Overall, I felt like the experience in economy was a far better value for money than expected - there are economy-class products out there which are far more expensive for the same or lower quality. If not for the long layover in London on my way home, I would hands-down choose this itinerary every time. I would definitely fly China Southern again from Beijing.

No vegetarian options available online in the FCO-CAN route and I was given rice and boiled vegetables. On arriving for transfer in Guangzhou the bus took a long time to get to the building and gave very little time to transfer. Airport officials were literally screaming at each other and the baggage check was ridiculously slow and bureaucratic. The officials continuously yelling at each other was extremely stressful and threatening. The airport is huge and has a large amount of shops with no one in them. The whole experience was awful. Interestingly, the flight to Melbourne involved staff being much more polite and there was an ability to choose a different meal online.

review_header: "I would like to thank the staff"
review_text: I might have faced the problem of not being able to enter France. When it was determined that there was a problem with my preparation materials, they communicated and tried to find a solution. Finally they contacted their colleagues in French and with the help the Thai immigration office confirmed that I could leave. The staff actively tried to find a solution, and through their efforts I successfully embarked on a flight. I am very thankful for their help, patience and kindness.

The website is shockingly outdated and frustrating to use. I save my special meal preference and it did not process as the airline crew told me they did not have it. Seats were cramped with no inflight entertainment or outlets. Guangzhou Airport was dreary and not one of my favorite transit hubs.

The trip exceeded my expectations, I was very happy with the service from the ground staff and flight attendants. Despite the language differences, nothing was too much trouble, they even indicated by a little sign on my tray table that I had missed a meal service whilst I slept, they had saved it for me. I enjoyed the food, it was plentiful and tasty. The in flight entertainment is a bit disappointing, the films and programmes were old, nevertheless I would recommend this airline and will use them again.

I tried to contact them by email more than 10 times, I sent the photos and footage, and they are  saying that they didn't receive any photos by email, and I can prove that I sent them, I've already sent them more than 10 times and they don't solve my problem.

review_header: "the bag was waiting for us in Da Nang"
review_text: One of our two bags didn't arrive. Easy to find the missing luggage counter. Exceptional service from English speaking locals (my apologies for being completely ignorant of your local language!). Quickly informed that the missing bag was on the next flight, arriving in 3 hours. Unfortunately we had a train to catch to Da Nang that was departing before then. No problem, they would fly the wayward bag to Da Nang and we could collect it from the airport, which is close to the train station. A few hours into our overnight train journey I got an email that the bag was waiting for us in Da Nang and we duly collected it 12 hours later.

The down side was a six hour layover in Guangzhou on the way there. On the other hand, on the return trip, I went straight from my first leg flight to the other without pausing. I was pleasantly surprised by the cabin. The layout is fantastic: 1 2 1, with the middle two seats facing in opposite ways, so there are no "bad" seats. As long as the seats can turn into lie-flat beds, I'm happy, and this airline's ones do. Another tick. The service was impeccable. Being the only non-Chinese passenger in the business class cabin, it was fair enough that none of the staff spoke English, but the language barriers were overcome by the staff eagerness to understand and to please. All the flights departed perfectly on time and all landed early. Not so good was the on board entertainment - very little choice and a lot of older stuff - meaning that I had already seen a lot of the films. I would recommend this airline without hesitation.

Before the baggage enquiry post was open, Ms. Xu from the international departure office actively helped me contact various departments to find my passport, then I successfully caught the flight, and avoided the trouble and loss of the subsequent journey. I am very grateful for that!

I had a 15 hour layover, and they still tried to charge me top dollar for their VIP lounge. This is also taking into account that their shower facilities are broken. So one cannot clean, yet must pay a hefty entry fee. I paid over $2,000 for a long haul economy class flight, only to be pinged with more fees as a result of their layover times — for a link fee that’s out of service. This will be the last time I fly with China Southern. They should learn to treat their customers better.

We were a bit apprehensive to fly with them as their website and booking process was a bit bad, but the flight experience was really good. Everything went well since the moment we boarded in London until we arrived in our final destination in New Zealand. The planes were on time, their crew was very professional and the connection in Guangzhou was really easy. The only bad side was that they said that we couldn't order special meals on LHR - CAN, as my partner is vegetarian. But during the flight, they had half the meals vegetarian and half non-vegetarian. So it was fine for us. On the flight CAN - AKL we were able to request special meals, but the default meals were all non-vegetarian. Overall we would definitely fly with them again, as they did everything really well and we had no issues with our trip.

One standout moment for me was the impeccable service I received from the ground crew, especially Zilian. Zilian showcased professionalism and warmth, ensuring that every detail of my boarding process was taken care of, from check-in to baggage handling.  I am sincerely looking forward to my next flight with China Southern and would highly recommend this airline.
The nice staff in Guangzhou airport organised proper seats for six of my family. We pretty enjoy this trip with China southern airlines.
The cabin crews were friendly and attentive to passengers' needs. Meals were hot and prompt, and inflight entertainment kept me occupied throughout the 11-hour journey from Guangzhou to Auckland.

When I booked my flight from China to Los Angeles, I saw that China Southern had the best deal out of any airline available for that route. In this flight, the cabin crew were very nice, interactive and considerate. They were enthusiastic when welcoming passengers and during flight they go to passengers who are awake and offer cups of water as well as snacks.  The Boeing 777-300ER had a 3-3-3 configuration, the seats were very roomy, with a great amount of legroom. Blankets and pillows were given. In-flight entertainment had quite a lot of movies.  Prior to eating, each passenger was given a nice wet towel to clean our hands with. The food was good, nothing too dull. This flight also provided very useful amenity kits. Overall, had a very pleasant flight.

Not recommended. China Southern canceled part of my itinerary. They did not reroute me. They ignored my emails and until now offered neither appeasement nor compensation for the inconvenience.  Booked China Southern London to Chiang Mai with a stopover in Guangzhou, where I would meet my fiancé. Booked originally with Booking.com (GoToGate) on 9th May and on 12th May after booking accommodation and activities became aware that return leg from Chiang Mai to Guangzhou had been cancelled less than 1 week before my trip. I was not informed of this. Only became aware because my fiancé was booked on a separate ticket. Contacted GoToGate who said the airline were unable to offer rerouting due to no available route with this airline. They said I would need to cancel and rebook my tickets with another airline. They offered a refund with no compensation and said that I would need to raise a complaint with China Southern. Subsequently rebooked flights with Emirates and Air Asia staying in Bangkok and Phuket rather than Chiang Mai. A great experience. Upon my return to the UK I complained directly to China Southern using the EU compensation scheme. After considerable effort, received a communication from the airline's Amsterdam office on 26th July stating that the flight was not eligible for the EU scheme as it was not with a UK (or EU) airline and it was departing from a third country. I acknowledged that that was factually correct. I visit China regularly so on the 27th July I wrote to China Southern detailing the inconvenience caused and requesting that whilst this flight was not covered under the EU scheme the airline should offer a voucher and/or upgrade for my next visit to China to compensate me for the inconvenience and additional costs incurred. The airline never responded to and continually ignored this communication stating that they had already answered the complaint on the 26th of July and that I should refer to the email history. No matter what I wrote in my emails I received the same response. China Southern staff were clearly neither reading nor understanding my emails. I am still awaiting China Southern to engage collaboratively with me to achieve a satisfactory outcome to this situation.

On arrival, I was directed to stay aside with 8 others reason being that they were to screen our baggage before being allowed for entry which was very unusual during transit. They kept us waiting for an hour plus, no staff was updating us on the way forward. Eventually, we all lost our bags.

No one arrived till 9.30 and the flight was at 10, at the end we had to walk through departure ourselves, lack of management, no professionalism among staff members. Never going fly this airline again.

review_header: "still waiting for one of my luggage"
review_text: Even the local Sydney team doesn't deem it fit to call and let me know what's happening with my missing bag. I'm just patiently waiting to see how this would pan out. First time flying with this airline and I don't think I would ever again.
I returned home on the sixth day. The only compensation I was offered was USD 75 - totally unacceptable! And even then I am still waiting for this 3 months later.

Flight was cancelled after boarding. Taken to hotel and asked to share with hell lot of people. No one was there to talk about the issue or the next flight. Totally irresponsible. Office in Kathmandu does not receives calls. While calling upon china they are hard to communicate.

Booked several legs of a trip through China, from and to Japan with China Southern Airlines. One of the flights was cancelled and they changed it to a flight 10 hours later ruining the itinerary for the trip. When trying to fix it if we cancel the flight they needed to cancel the whole reservation (and cancelling two other flights bought months in advanced). After significant help from the concierge at our hotel we manage to get redirected with a different airline. However, they downgraded our entire reservation to economy because they needed to reissue the tickets. A problem with the airline and I had to pay for everything,

The friendly ground services, attentive cabin crew, comfortable seats, and diverse entertainment options made the journey enjoyable. Timeliness, delicious meals, and a strong focus on safety were also notable. I highly recommend China Southern Airlines.

The airline's commitment to customer satisfaction and the extraordinary service provided by their ground staff, especially Zilian, truly stood out and made my journey memorable. From the moment I arrived at the airport, I was greeted with a warm and welcoming smile from Zilian. She exuded professionalism, courtesy, and genuine enthusiasm, putting me at ease and setting the tone for the rest of my travel experience. In the the flight a spacious and well-maintained cabin, delicious meal options, and a wide range of entertainment. The flight attendants were attentive and courteous. I recommend China Southern Airlines to fellow travelers.

Friend and I booked our tickets together but the airline wouldn't let us choose seats so we weren't even in the same section. How are you supposed to enjoy an overseas holiday when you can't even travel with your colleague? And when we asked the check in lady about the seating she was very dismissive and borderline rude. If that wasn't bad enough they lost BOTH my pieces of luggage.

The trip made me experience the warmth of home and the staff was very professional and welcoming. She assisted me in the security check, helped me with my luggage and advised me to carry my personal documents and belongings. It made my trip feel more comfortable. It made me feel that China Southern Airlines is a well-managed, professional and high quality team. I will continue to support China Southern Airlines' service and will recommend it to my friends and family.
Fortunately, a staff member picked it up and took the initiative to contact me and gave it back to me to calm me down. The service of the ground staff and flight attendants was very good.

review_header: "seat, plane and amenities are super clean"
review_text: The seat strangely enough isn't comfy when it's in recliner mode, much better in normal seating mode with leg rest/lumbar support adjustments. The message function is awesome. However, the seat design isn't really for storage of bags/shoes. The spaciousness of the seat is more for writing and putting many dishes/items etc. Nevertheless space is plenty in overhead locker. The CZ business class experience isn't designed for people who want luxurious/special flight experiences. It's more for passengers who want good products, great (Chinese) food and things that just work. The seat, plane and amenities are super clean. The punctuality is outstanding. The service is more on the practical and task-completing sides than those of Emirates/Singapore/Qatar airlines. Great attendance, efforts and politeness. Despite not being fluent in English the crew are very hard-working and proactive in helping people. It's remarkable that it wasn't too long ago since China Southern resumed it's "normal" ways of operation. To have abundant numbers of staff (seven, even for not-big business cabin) is quite impressive.

The staff at the airport were very helpful and helped me deal with the new ticket, she is very supportive and patient. I am very grateful to her. China Southern Airlines provided free accommodation. Thank you for the service of China Southern Airlines.

The seats were comfortable and spacious, contributing to a relaxing flight. The crew was professional and their attentiveness to passenger needs was commendable. The quality of the in-flight meals was a pleasant surprise, adding to the comfort of the journey.  I highly recommend them for any travel plans and look forward to flying with them again in the future.

What stood out to us the most was the professionalism and courtesy displayed by the flight attendants. Their service was attentive and they were ready to assist with a smile. The onboard amenities were impressive, from ample legroom and comfortable seats, to the variety of in-flight entertainment options which kept us entertained throughout the flight.
The plane is clean and the interior design makes me feel comfortable. We are looking forward to next flight!

The level of service I received was truly unparalleled. From the moment I checked in, I was greeted with genuine warmth and hospitality by the airline staff. Their professionalism and attention to detail were noticeable and very much appreciated. The in-flight service was remarkable as well. The cabin crew was attentive, responsive, and consistently ensured that my needs and comfort were their top priority. The flight attendants were incredibly friendly and patient, answering questions and fulfilling requests with grace and a smile. I was particularly impressed by their dedication and commitment to customer service. The seating was comfortable and spacious, making the long journey much more bearable. The meals were delicious and the entertainment options available were diverse and enjoyable, adding to the overall positive experience of the flight. Moreover, the punctuality of China Southern Airlines was impressive. Both my flights departed and arrived exactly on schedule, which is a testament to their operational efficiency. I have flown with many airlines, but the service provided by China Southern Airlines truly stands out. I would highly recommend China Southern Airlines. This airline clearly values customer satisfaction and it shows in their service.

Both ground and onboard services are friendly, enthusiastic, and professional. Flight attendants  wear a smile on their faces and are very prompt and attentive.  If I have the opportunity to take their flights again, I will definitely choose them without hesitation, looking forward to enjoying their excellent services and delicious meals again.

They tried their best to find my lost visa documents in time, and help me to get my plane smoothly. The attendants on board are very welcoming and the facilities on plane is quite new. We landed on time without delays.

The flight attendants were friendly and attentive, the meals were delicious and there was a good variety of options to choose from. The entertainment system was also top-notch, with a great selection of movies and TV shows. I had a positive experience flying with China Southern Airlines and would recommend them to others.

The staff were friendly, professional, and went out of their way to ensure my comfort. The in-flight meals were delicious and served promptly. When we encountered some turbulence, the pilots kept us informed and made every effort to minimize any discomfort. I would not hesitate to recommend them..
The ground staff were patient and with their help, I finished the boarding procedures swiftly. Thank you, ground crew!

Compared with several well-known low-cost airlines in China that provide low-cost services to reduce costs, China Southern Airlines is more reassuring in terms of service level, aviation safety and flight punctuality.

review_header: "ticket change and refund is much greater"
review_text: Business class can lie flat and in 1-2-1 layout.  At this time, the initiative of ticket change and refund is much greater. This is very good.

review_header: "Save your money and fly with someone else"
review_text: Was told once we land we'll be given a hotel to stay in while we wait for the next flight. When we land in Guangzhou the help desk then tells us "No we've changed the rules, we only give out the hotel rooms if you're business class or higher". Save your money and fly with someone else.
This is a good trip. I will choose China Southern Airlines next time. It's good.
The staff of China Southern Airlines were very friendly and gave me the best service. I will choose China Southern Airlines in the future.
The staff who handled the formalities were very friendly, and I will choose China Southern Airlines in the future

Exceptionally clean surroundings and up to date equipment for entertainment etc. Meal service was polite and quick with plenty of good, tasty food. I would happily fly this airline again and recommend it. I would like to thank the airport information worker who gave me vital information and advice about necessary travel preparations, and PRC test requirements before my journey, without her support, it would have been very stressful days.
Quite an exhausted day before my flight which made attention to the crew, suggest me to upgrade to business class. It was really worth it, a spacious seat and let me had a good rest on the plane.

The trip made me experience the warmth of home and the staff was very professional and welcoming, assisting me in the security check, helped me with my luggage. It made my trip feel more comfortable.  I will continue to support China Southern Airlines' service and will recommend it to my friends and family.

The crew is very considerate to help with the luggage. The food is relatively monotonous but the portion is sufficient. I hope that it can be improved after the epidemic is over. The on-board WI-FI has no option for paid use, which is not very friendly to non-members.

A kind lady took me to choose my seat, helped me address my oversized luggage, and led me to the security check. the airline service is good too, almost everyone could get a blanket if they wanted. The next flight from Sydney to Perth, I even couldn’t get a blanket in the plane from Qantas.

The staff of China Southern were very friendly and enthusiastic and assisted me to handle the luggage check-in matters and helped me to get through all the procedure that needed for Covid-19 application. However, the cabin service should be enhanced, especially there are no socket and USB-plot on the aircraft A380, and no pillows and earphones are provided, which are necessities for international flight. Meanwhile, the crew members should smile more when they work. Hopefully they can attach more importance on these aspects.

The staff was serious and responsible throughout the whole journey. Since I had a lot of luggage, the staff helped me carry my luggage and assisted me with the security check. I will continue to support China Southern Airlines.
The staff assisted me with the security check All in all, it was a very good and memorable trip and I will choose China Southern Airlines again in the future.

review_header: "seats on the plane are very comfortable"
review_text: Maybe there are fewer flights and fewer people at the airport, but the staff at the check-in counter are more careful than before. Boarding is also very smooth. The seats on the plane are very comfortable. The greetings from the flight attendants make me feel great!

Guangzhou is the headquarters of their company, so there are many self-service check-in equipment at the airport. Although they are unavailable due to the epidemic, their staff are very professional. The check-in counter does not have a long queuing time. The meals on the plane are simple, even it is only a four hour flight time, But the flight attendants provided me with blankets and slippers, the service was very comprehensive.

It's not easy to travel everywhere you want from China in the current situation. This was the fifth time I had bought a ticket to London and I was looking forward to my trip. But on the morning of the day of the flight, I received a call that I would not be able to board the flight due to capacity restrictions at London airport. During the following ten hours, I was told to wait for the phone call and someone would help me with this problem. I was really desperate until my friend suggested I go to the airport directly and ask the ground staff to see if there is a better solution. So I arrived at the airport 6 hours before my flight left. I talked to the check-in desk manager who talked to me so warm and very kind and my hope was relighted by him. After he knew my situation, he did not make me wait and just try to help me to find a way to get on the flight. He told me that if any other passenger cancel the trip, I could take place the seat of the flight as a standby passenger. And he kept my phone number and told me he would contact me as long as he get any news. Half an hour later, I went back to his counter and he told me that I was very lucky that a passenger canceled the ticket and I was able to get on the plane. Then he have done my boarding pass very soon and showed me where to go for security just within 5 minutes. I was so appreciative that everything this manager did. Now I have arrived in London and I am very grateful met such a professional ground staff. With his help, I saved time and plenty of money to rebook flight tickets.

On the morning of 14 September, I received a call that my seat had been canceled. I was so angry and confused, so I went to the airport after I got the call. I arrived at the airport and spoke to the duty manager at the check-in desk. I was told that there were 4 passengers who have the same problem as me and he could help me to see if anyone cancel his seat before the departure so that I could get on the flight. I was so lucky that someone canceled the tickets and I successfully boarded the flight. I appreciate the staff help.

In order to make the trip more comfortable, I handled the upgrade at the counter. The price is very favorable. The staff are also very professional and they also provide a lounge. There are hot food and drinks in the lounge. The service, food and drink on board were also excellent. After arriving at Incheon Airport, the helpful staff came to talk with us and told me the entry precautions. There was no problem with customs and immigration.

They made the process nice and smooth for us from arriving at the airport to terminal. The check-in staff patiently clear instructions on where to go after passing security and all our check-in luggages were properly handled. We were on the second level on the aircraft and the journey in air was comfortable with no surprise.
thanks a lot.

I would like to thank the staff for helping me double-check the information to ensure this trip. In addition, taking this flight, you can clearly feel the seriousness of China Southern Airlines in epidemic prevention and control. It is commendable that the passengers can strictly enforce the safety distance of one meter during the queue and be very responsible to the passengers.

But my next stop after LA is Chicago, and I asked the counter of China Southern Airlines. The staff advise me to leverage the luggage in case the trouble might raised in Chicago airport and helped me to issue the LA to Chicago ticket.  Very appreciated your sincere service and wish you all the best.

The VIP lounge for China Southern Airlines in Baiyun airport is one of the best lounges in China as they provide private washrooms so I can take a shower and refresh myself before the flight. The attendants on board are very welcoming and the facilities on plane is quite new. We landed on time without delays.
Overall is pretty good, the A380 is a little bit outdated, but the crew provided good service. Looking forward to see 777 or 787 fly this route.

review_header: "upgraded my cabin at a low price"
review_text: I am a student from China to study abroad, and the crew at the airport upgraded my cabin at a low price, which is pretty good. The services are wonderful not only at the airport but also on the plane. I’ll choose China Southern Airline the next time.

Whether it's from getting a boarding pass to checking in your luggage or talking about the excellent service of the flight attendants on the plane, it makes you feel good. If there is a trip next time, I will continue to choose China Southern Airlines.

The staff were very attentive and patient in calming me down, and they were able to locate my passport and confirm that it was mine in just 20 minutes. As the cabin was about to close, the staff reduced the process to ensure that everything was normal, allowing me to successfully take my flight. I am very grateful for this.

review_header: "patiently helped us for nearly two hours"
review_text: Due to my personal negligence, I forgot to apply for an international travel health code. However, the ground staff who checked in our luggage that day patiently helped us for nearly two hours, and finally successfully boarded the plane. Here, I would like to thank the ground staff who helped us. Thank them so much!

I arrived safely in Sydney on the 30th of March 2022. Everything went smoothly during the departure preparation process at Baiyun Airport such as check-in and baggage check-in.  I was impressed by the seriousness and enthusiasm of the crew on this flight and would consider choosing China Southern Airlines again if I had the chance.

Exceptionally clean surroundings and up to date equipment for entertainment etc. Meal service was polite and quick with plenty of good, tasty food. I would happily fly this airline again and recommend it. I would like to thank the airport information worker who gave me vital information and advice about necessary travel preparations, and PRC test requirements before my journey, without her support, it would have been very stressful days.
Not much expectation due to fly since we are still in Covid-19 period. Out of expectation very smooth along the journey. nice experience. I will recommend China Southern Airlines.

review_header: "thank the staff of China Southern Airlines"
review_text: I might have faced the problem of not being able to enter Thailand. When it was determined that there was a problem with my preparation materials, they actively communicated and tried to find a solution. Finally they contacted their colleagues in Thailand and with the help the Thai immigration office confirmed that I could leave for Thailand. The staff actively tried to find a solution, at the same time asking my colleagues in Thailand to communicate with the Thai immigration office, and through their efforts I successfully embarked on a flight to Thailand.  I am very thankful for their help, patience and kindness.
Multiple kinds of food is provided on the airplane and it is delicious. But i don't know why they arranged the seats to let everyone sit close together.
Crew members provide excellent services on the aircraft. Staff on the ground also provide great service.

It's a pity that the A380 model is about to withdraw from market. They still keep this route during the epidemic, and this is my fifth time fly on this A380 from Guangzhou to Los Angeles in the past few years. The good boarding, excellent cabin service and comfortable seats left me a deep and warm impression.

The flight attendants took adequate precautions during COVID-19, masks, protective suits, multiple temperature measurements, etc. Due to the epidemic, in-flight meals have been changed to snack packages, with a variety of snacks. The crew and airport staff was excellent.
They carefully checked our entry info and guided us through the lines. it took some time for us to go through all the procedures, but i can feel their seriousness regarding the pandemic.

review_header: "Thanks to all the staff that day"
review_text: Due to a problem with the procedures, check-in is only possible at 8:00. At that time, the boarding channel was closed, and the staff opened the emergency channel and helped me through the customs quickly. I just caught up with the flight at the last moment. Thanks to all the staff that day.

I arrived Guangzhou airport at 10AM. It took me too long time on check-in waiting line before departure. There is no notice board what passenger need to prepare for check in, except a reminder of China Customs Health Declaration Form. After 20-30 mins waiting, I came to check in counter and show every document requested to ground crew of airline (IPA-VISA, vaccination report, Covid-19 test results report, international travel health certificate, and SG airport PCR test reservation). Everything was fine except my COVID-19 test report, that was written by both English and Chinese and provided by formal hospital of Liaoning. However, it was refused as informal certificate. Then I showed my International Travel Health Certificate which was also not recognized as valid document. The clock went to 11:20 that time and ground crew requested me to ask a new COVID-19 report from hospital and find a printer to print every document out. The scene was a mess disaster that time. The time is tight, I was not informed the priority of doing all these things and i was unclear would those document use for boarding the airplane or enter SG customs. is that necessary to print all these out? At the final time, ground crew gave me a Declaimer Form to sign then they can allow me to board. I didn‘t print documents for tight time. My new COVID-19 test report (as requested it has my passport number and date of birth) came to me when I was on the flight before I arrived SG. However, the most dramatic scene is, SG customs didn’t look my new COVID-19 test report at all. They just checked my International Travel Health Certificate (e-version on my phone), then let me pass. I feel ridiculous for this intense process.

On the first day of the new vaccination policy in the United States, I did not have the English version of the vaccine report ready. The ground staff helped me download the English version of the vaccine certificate from the International Passenger Health Code. I appreciate it very much.
The cabin and ground service staff treat passengers with a warm smile. Must be praised that the elderly and children are given priority service for customs clearance.

review_header: "My family and I are very thankful"
review_text: It is the moment of COVID-19 and it was required to perform a PCR test within 72 hours before enter the airplane. However I forgot it. I was informed that I should change my ticket and I was upset about the fact that I couldn’t set off at time. It was when I don’t know what to do that Miss Xu asked me what happened. I explained that I didn’t perform the pcr test. They told me not panic and asked me if I have taken the two doses of vaccine. I said yes. They lead me to a person who was responsible for this issue. I was finally able to board the plane with my attestation for the vaccine. My family and I are very thankful for the whole thing.

review_header: "Thank the staff of China Southern Airlines"
review_text: The transfer time in Guangzhou was up to 10 hours. I arrived in Guangzhou at 2 p.m. According to the ticket information, there are still 7 hours before the check-in time. There were only a few passengers waiting at the international check-in area . Just as I was waiting for the counter to open in the seat area, ground staff asked me if I needed to check in and led me to the counter for priority. The ground staff helped me fill in the health declaration and told me to pay attention to the boarding time. The service is still as excellent as before. Thank the staff of China Southern Airlines

To my surprise, almost all restaurants inside the international terminal are closed because of the epidemic. I am very grateful that the China Southern Airlines ground staff checked my visa and took me to the China Southern Airlines lounge so that I could enjoy a wonderful breakfast.
When there were problems in the system, they solved the problems. I am very satisfied with their service.

review_header: "A350 was new and seat was comfortable"
review_text: The A350 was new and seat was comfortable. It's nice to kill the time by watching movies on board when you have so many options. What could be a little frustrating was the jab test at the airport, but the ground staff gave me a lot of help. The aircraft from GZ to Toronto was Boeing 787, which was also new and comfortable, however the price of the flight was not cheap, literally more than 12000 bucks. I'm thankful for the help all the staff provided the way I went back home.

It was not a carefree journey at all to travel such a long distance especially during the pandemic, however, it turned out to be quite comfortable and relaxing. Guangzhou to Toronto the dinner was quite simple, which made it possible to have meals separately for the passengers. The cabin of  787 was comfortable and the crew member were so nice and careful that they treated me timely enough with warm water. All in all, it was an impressing trip.

I needed to print out the Passenger locator form at about 11pm, all the stores were closed; took it to the staff there. He was really friendly, understood my need and printed it out for me. Saved my day really. The flight was also great, although the cabin was a bit too hot to my liking.

review_header: "staff helped me think of various ways"
review_text: When I went through the formalities, a staff member of China Southern Airlines found that my nucleic acid report did not have an ID number or passport number, which did not meet New Zealand's requirements for nucleic acid reports, which may cause New Zealand customs to refuse my entry. The staff helped me think of various ways and told me that there is a nucleic acid test point operating 24 hours a day in the airport T1 terminal, and a nucleic acid report can be issued within 2-3 hours. It was already 19:30, and there were only 5 hours left before my plane took off. I hurried to T1 and found the nucleic acid test site, but their last batch of specimens had been sent away at 18:30, and now I can only do nucleic acid reports. The report came out before 9 o'clock in the morning on the 22nd. I called the staff to explain the situation, and they suggested to me that the electronic version of the nucleic acid report is also available at 9 am on the 22nd. Because my plane only landed in Auckland at 11 am on the 22nd, it was in time.
Their onboard service is delineable. I hope they can improve the passenger seats and equipment some day. Because the cabin now looks like out-time.

When I checked in at Changsha airport, the counter staff told me that the flight to Guangzhou was cancelled and I couldn't go through the connecting formalities, which forced me to buy another ticket to Guangzhou. After I finally got to Guangzhou airport, the check-in counter couldn't handle the formalities for me because of the ticket problem. Just as I was complaining about my bad trip, the ground staff helped me solve the problem of ticket. Finally, thanks to his help, I finally got my boarding pass and got on the plane smoothly. Thank the staff of Guangzhou Airport for their professionalism and enthusiasm.

We can get new movies and TV shows as entertainment during the flight. When landing at Guangzhou Airport, we have a sequence waiting number and clear entry instruction, then the ground staff assist us with one-to-one Custom information check services.
After arriving Guangzhou, staff helpedme figure out how to file the code on my phone. She and the China Southern crew did a good job.
Ground staff which met my husband and I at the aircraft upon deplaning, assisted us through the entry process in Guangzhou which made clearing the COVID protocols stress free.
Very good protective / barrier measures make the passenger feel safe / good comfort level. Arrival process in Guangzhou managed very efficiently

Ticket prices have not become unacceptable due the epidemic, certainly the price is not as cheap as low-cost airlines. The flight attendant was very patient, because I needed operate the health code. He helped me and answered my questions. The flight provides a meal, but if it goes more delicate will be perfect.

Their prices are reasonable, they have a good flight schedule (two flights a week), even though outside is Covid. We can arrange tickets and check reservation on their website and phone App easily. In general, the cabin and ground handling service still in high level.

I almost gave up waiting for the class upgrade but before I enter security check, they called letting me know there is a seat becomes available, so I immediately took that spot, paid for my upgrade and slept through my entire trip.

We need to provide a valid PCR test report for 48 hours before boarding. When we arrived at the airport to check in, we were told that our test report might not meet New Zealand's entry requirements, we were very frustrated. Fortunately staff from China Southern Airlines kept inquiring about relevant information for us. Finally, with the help of staff, we took the flight back to New Zealand on time. Thank you for your quick, accurate, professional and solving problems for us.

Though it was not a smooth trip due to the unexpected sudden flight cancellation, but luckily I was impressed during this trip with the ground staff of China Southern Airlines at Guangzhou International Airport who checked in me and calmed me down with excellent service.
The friendly team of ground staff and clear immigration health inspection procedures left a deep impression on me. Finally, we also got a great quarantine time in the hotel.
After landing, the ground staff carefully check the declaration content.  If you have a chance, you want to take China Southern Airlines. The experience is really good.

The temperature in Guangzhou was 37 degrees and we saw no less than 50 China Southern staff, customs and border control officers waiting for us in protective clothing. After disembarking from the plane we were placed in our seats to wait for the epidemiological investigation. While we waited we were assisted by ground staff to check our customs declaration. After the investigation, we were guided through the sampling process. I was reassured by the social distance that needed to be maintained at each step of the process and the fact that everyone was seen to be disinfected when they left their seats. I would also like to thank one of the staff at China Southern Airlines. When I got to the sampling area, I realised that my iPad left it on the plane, she saw me rummaging through it and asked if I needed any help. I was grateful for her help as the iPad contained important documents for my work.

At the airport, the ground staff reviewed the results of the nucleic acid test. The flight attendants in the section from Shanghai to Guangzhou were very careful and friendly. It was a trip with my father, since it was inconvenient for him to move, the flight attendants took the initiative to contact the wheelchair and carefully explained the transfer process in Guangzhou. In the second section, the meals were very simple because of the epidemic, but the flight attendants were very enthusiastic to help solve the passengers' problems. Thanks to all the staff to make my flight safe.

However, when I arrived at the check-in counter, I was told that I had not applied for ETA in Canada.  I was extremely anxious there and didn’t know what to do. The staff of China Southern Airlines told me they can help apply for me. He took 30 minutes to apply ETA . He is professional and I was lucky to get their help and finally on board. A nice trip!
Again, a big big thank to the China southern airline staff of their professional services.
Really thank all the airport staff for helping me Especially the ground service, they are so patient and helping me to carry my heavy baggage. They control the situation for swab test and everything.
My little daughter and I got the flight CZ8102 from Narita to Guangzhou on 2 Jun, the A380 type seat is clean and comfortable, we got a great rest. Warm and polite ground service also keep well.
When arrived I had trouble with bag claim, the ground staff were very helpful. They were working hard on covid19 safety, like help to sanitize personal items and let everyone keep social distance.

My two little babies and I got a wonderful trip from KUL to Guangzhou airport in March. The cabin crew paid  attention on my babies and provide us a nice service. I would praise the ground staff which helped us from the aircraft to the quarantine hotel and assisted us with heavy luggage. No doubt that China Southern Airlines will be the top choice.

review_header: "I am so grateful for all the staff"
review_text: For the first route, I got to the airport late, as it was the busy traffic hour in Shanghai. A staff gave an express pass, so I could make it to get onboard just in time. Cabin service was excellent. I was hungry, and a crew gave me some extra hot meal. The aircraft type was B787. WiFi was available, but it need to apply for it in advanced. Transit in Guangzhou was easy and efficient. My second flight was on time. It was quite a long journey, I am so grateful for all the staff who offered help and kindness during the epidemic situation. I think China Southern stuff did a really good job. Highly recommend.

Thanks to the  staff, passengers were well-ordered during the delay. The cabin crew were friendly and patient answered my questions about the regulations of nucleic acid testing in Guangzhou. All cabin crew wore protective clothing throughout the whole journey from Guangzhou to Vancouver, so appreciated they were trying their best to keep us safe. We didn’t have WiFi service during the flight, I hope they can improve this next time.

review_header: "makes me feel at ease to fly in the epidemic"
review_text: I flew to Jakarta from Beijing via Guangzhou. All passengers need to be one meter apart from each other when checking in and boarding, and there have staff to guide and maintain order. Before boarding, passengers with breathing valves will be reminded to change into ordinary masks without breathing valves. Hand disinfection is also required after boarding. This series of epidemic prevention work is really in place.

The section from Beijing to Guangzhou was delayed for 5 hours due to bad weather, but the cabin crew was very friendly and considerate. They answered my questions about the transfer patiently and gave me clear instructions to go to the ground service for free transfer accommodation after landing, which saved me a lot of time. There were not a lot passengers from Guangzhou to Manila due to the epidemic. All passengers were required to wear masks and comply with the relevant regulations. Thanks to the cabin crew for their work and efforts.

When I arrive I realize that I need to print out my covid test results in order to fly. I was in a hurry and was panicking. A ground staff saw me and asked if I needed any help. I told him that I am going to miss my flight to LAX if I don't have my covid test results. He then quickly led me to the airport's business center to get my results printed, and then help me get through customs to save even more time. I really appreciate the help that he have given me.

Our party arrived at Guangzhou Airport on May 14th by flight CZ6586. My next flight needs to catch up with flight CZ387 to Jakarta. Due to the weather, it was delayed for nearly 5 hours. Faced with the complicated exit procedures during the epidemic, it is impossible to catch up with the next flight under normal circumstances. The staff of China Southern assisted us, picked up my luggage and taking us through various formalities.

Ground and Cabin staff service demonstrated great hospitality, they were really willing to help. Treating everyone nicely and giving instructions as detail as they can, which I appreciate so much during this pandemic. Great thanks to all the staff.

Seat could use extra padding. I would praise the ground staff which met my wife and I at the aircraft upon deplaning and whisked us through the entry process in Guangzhou Airport which made clearing the COVID protocols stress free.

My parents arrived at Guangzhou Airport on CZ328 on May 2, 2021 after a long flight. I asked for wheel chair services since my parents are over 80 years old (dad is 88 and mom is 81) and have health issues. My cousin had been taking care of my parents during the trip and had to carry all the luggage’s by herself and did not rest well during the long flight. All passengers needed to go through hours of complicated border procedures due to the Covid situation after arriving at the airport.  They took my parents and my cousin to go through health checks, health declaration and border entry documentation, then picked up the suitcases and sent them on board the bus heading to the hotel. The entire process took nearly 5 hours, especially the luggage collection was long and complicated because all luggage had to be disinfected. Thumbs up for their five star performance.
When I landed at Guangzhou the process of customs clearance and COVID-19 test was extremely smooth and quick. They also assisted me to find the coach going to the designated quarantine hotel.

A380 type business class cabin environment and the crew members service are good, provide us a quiet flying atmosphere. Arrived in Guangzhou airport, we got a clear guidelines for immigration procedures that make us free from the worries. We can see the ground crews will build a good order in the whole process. I can’t wait to choose China Southern Airlines again in May to LA.

Outstanding hospitality. I am very impressed with the customer service from China Southern Airlines staff, we flew from Melbourne to Guangzhou with Business class. My husband needs wheelchairs because of knee replacement, I was so struggling to grab all the luggages by myself.China Southern Airlines's ground crew very considerate to help us push the wheelchairs and pass through the customs， also helped us to pick up our luggage. Thank you very much to China Southern Airlines for bringing us back to our homes during the epidemic, and your miraculous service makes us always choose to travel with China Southern Airlines.

There were a lot of inspections and epidemic prevention work during the trip, but this made my journey safer, the anti-epidemic staff is responsible and patient with passengers, which I respect very much.  Especially for elderly customers, not only have enough patience, but also take the initiative to help them carry heavy objects and escort them to successfully enter the country. Finally, thank our epidemic prevention staff again and express our highest respect to them!

The procedure of check-in, boarding, the declaration is very smooth. The staff from China Southern Airlines is very professional. They are equipped with full PTE including a face mask, a face shield, whole-body protecting plastic clothes. They are well-trained, friendly, and helpful, especially in this special pandemic period. Check-in, the counter allocated me a front B seat since I do not prefer C or D seat. On-board. They checked body temperature 4 or 5 times during the flight.  The luggage is thoroughly sanitized. And it takes a long waiting time at the claiming area, I saw the ground staff helped elder people with wheelchairs and carried luggage for them many times. The onboard entertainment system is hard to use. None of my fav movies or shows are provided. The space is too narrow for tall people.

During the epidemic, all the staff wore protective clothing, but the service of both the stewardess and the ground staff was very good. Because of my foot injury, it's a little inconvenient to walk. Although I didn't apply for wheelchair service, I got special attention. Before taking off, the stewardess also told me to call them for help if I need to go to the toilet. After getting off the plane, the ground staff saw that my foot was injured and asked if I needed a wheelchair. When I refused, they gave priority to help me check the customs declaration. Their service is really wonderful.

The services that should be provided on the plane are provided, and the service attitude is good. Especially for ground service, there are many inspection steps, which is very complicated; there are many staff members who prompt step by step to guide passengers, and all the procedures are completed smoothly.
In this special period, the airline has done their best to ensure the safety of passengers. When the plane arrived, the service was patient to help me fill in the information, made my trip easy.
When my wife and I arrived in Guangzhou Baiyun airport, the ground service team also very kind and friendly.

We applied for a wheelchair service from China Southern Airlines because of his difficult in hearing and movement . The wheelchair staff help him with the luggage, complete the test, and successfully transport him to the quarantine hotel bus. The staff also help him to call us and report his safety. Recommend China Southern Airlines as first option.

I flew to Seoul today. During the boarding I felt the excellent service of the staff. The boarding gate staff adhered to the epidemic prevention requirements and let each passenger stand one meter apart in the boarding queue.
While waiting at the waiting hall in Guangzhou Baiyun Airport the staff named Zhimei Liu helped me. With her help, my trip was comfortable and easy.

review_header: "I want to say thank you again"
review_text: UK government requires all passengers to have the negative covid test certificate prior boarding. Due to my carelessness, I overlooked the requirement that it needs to be translated into one of the 3 languages (English, Spanish or French). When I showed up in the airport counter at 8pm on Thur night (8/4/21), they told me I couldn't fly. The issue is that I have already booked everything in the UK for the quarantine requirements, such as covid tests and government forms and notify the quarantine location and isolation period. It will be a logistic nightmare to rebook everything, not to say I have to pay for everything again! Feeling hopeless and pressure to step aside for other passengers, I approached the counter manager who was very kind and understanding. He asked around to see if possible to fly with the Covid Test certificate in Chinese. To no avail, it's not possible. He told me there are translation companies which can do urgent translation services. I told him that I am not a local and have no clue where to find these companies.
