He helped me find a translation company, communicated with them and told them what it's required by the airline and the UK Immigration. Then he told me where to print it out in the airport once I received the translated certificate. This type of service I would called it "Above and Beyond" any customer's expectation. We are all living in a fast pace society, and quite often brush away others when they needed help unconsciously. Sometimes we really need to take time to appreciate other's kindness. To Li Changlong I want to say thank you again; you saved my day.

I am very impressed by the crew of China Southern Airlines and the staff of Guangzhou International Ground Service to be able to return home safely during this difficult period. Whether we are on the plane or before takeoff, and after landing, we are very careful about my grandma and my condition. Next time I will continue to choose to return to Toronto in Guangzhou and choose China Southern Airlines.

I forgot my baggage in the custom control area when I did the COVID test. The ground staff at Guangzhou help me to contact with the custom officer and airside staff to help me take my baggage back. Thank you so much for the help.

review_header: "taken care of by the flight attendants"
review_text: When we checked in in LA, the staff initiative asked whether we need wheelchair assistance. During the flight the stewardesses helped us every time she went to the toilet. When we arrived in Guangzhou, the staff came forward to help us both and took my mother and me to the bus station without any problems

My father is 80 years old and suffers from Alzheimer's disease, so I am very nervous on this journey. However, when I arrived at Guangzhou Airport, we were very lucky to have the kind help from the ground staff of China Southern Airlines. They helped me find my luggage, successfully passed the virus test, and successfully reached the hotel. Without their help, I really don't know what to do. I would like to thank the team.

I flew with my little baby and 5 luggages. It's difficult for me to pass the custom and immigration. The Staff helped me a lot, taking care of my baby, carried my luggage until the shuttle bus arrived. The ground service was excellent and it is worth to fly with business class.

The lady who checked the ticket of China Southern Airlines came over to help me find the national certificate. When I asked if she could give me a pair of gloves, colleagues brought me double gloves.  The staff of China Southern Airlines have been soothing my emotions.  The staff who checked the ticket said that they would provide me with more later. In short, the problem was handled very quickly and meticulously. I am also sorry for the unnecessary trouble to the staff.  今天早晨候机的时候情绪比较激动，也忘记了戴一次性手套，南航验票的小姐姐很热心的过来帮我找出国证件，然后我询问能否给我一双手套时，也很快叫她其他同事帮我带了双手套过来，今天情绪很不稳定，南航的工作人员也一直舒缓我的情绪，我一直担心出国后不好回国的问题，验票的姐姐说后期再给我提供更多的新消息并且也叫我落地后给她报声平安。总之处理问题非常迅速，细致，我也很抱歉给工作人员添了不必要的麻烦。

Upon departure from the aircraft, China Southern Airlines provides pick-up service at the door of the stroller compartment, the staff helped me assemble the stroller and claim my baggage, The service is really great.

I had trouble filling out the form which was in Chinese. Yushouyu came to my rescue. She was very knowledgeable, very efficient and took the initiative to help in many ways. Her English was quite good and she was excellent at her job.

After that, we went through the process of waiting to board the plane. When we arrived in GuangZhou, I said goodbye to all the staff on the CZ350. On arrival we finished the information upload. Then i and my girlfriend with two staff  took some group photos, they told us today is the festival of YuanXiao. Last we waiting for the bus taken us to the hotel, thanks your help, my dear all of people who i met in this travel, thank you for your help.

I impressed by their professional and kindness. They are taking good care of me during the whole flight. The airport ground crew helped me contact my family when I arrived to China and kept my status updated with them. It is my best flight experience ever.

Want to say thanks again to all the people that gave our help. I appreciated the all effort China Southern Airlines made, and that give us the chance to go back to hometown in such a special covid year.

review_header: "flight attendants are all friendly and professional"
review_text: Each seat comes with an individual digital screen which will not lack in entertainment during the trip. Flight crew are well trained by COVID safety code of conduct, passengers feel safe during the trip.

I really recommend this airline, everything is wonderful. Staff are kind and patiently meet our demands timely. The entertainment equipment includes some TV series I am very interested in, so it is useful to kill time onboard.

I took my little child with me to fly from Guangzhou to Vancouver. I had more luggage and it was very inconvenient on the way. When I arrived at the counter, the supervisor saw my inconvenience and arranged a spacious seat for me. My child was also very obedient on the plane. Thank you very much for your service.

review_header: "thank you for all the hard work"
review_text: Our special thanks go to your amazing duty supervisor ZhiJian Tan. We truly appreciate the tremendous effort (4-5 hours) to help my mother, an elderly travelling alone in Covid ragging environment. You not only helped her but also connected with our hearts. Without you, my mother would have not made it back home safe and sound. We can't say thanks enough to tell you how grateful we are to be with your airline.

They lead my mum to the boarding gate from the ticket counter since the old lady doesn't know any English. Their enthusiasm and high efficiency really give us peace of mind. Beside the professional operation above, the ground support service is exceptional. A young staff called ZhiMei Liu provide a meticulous and personal service for her customer. She explained the quarantined policy to my mum, and help her to reconnect the local mobile data service. That means the old lady can contact her family member ASAP. I am very satisfied with the service on this journey

I am very grateful to the staff of China Southern Airlines. They were wearing protective suits in the hot weather, but they worked carefully and patiently taught me to fill in the customs declaration and helped me check. China Southern Airlines is my first choice every time I travel.

The ground service staff of China Southern Airlines were very friendly. When a group of our colleagues made mistakes in the declaration contents, they helped us to correct them patiently. Their professional assistance made us feel truly welcome home.

She took us to the infants passengers waiting area and provided me a warm reminder about baby strollers. After we finished the entry process, they brought us the stroller quickly. Caring baby service, nice experience!

As soon as the plane landed, the ground staff helped me a lot in the waiting area, she patiently explained to me the entry requirements of China customs, and also assisted me in completing all the information required for customs health declaration in a very short time. It's my pleasure to meet her in the airport, thanks to her kindly guide and make me a smooth entry in Guangzhou.

I chose China Southern Airlines, their gentle attitude made me feel reassured and they safeguarded the security of passengers. The flight attendants prepared straws for me to prevent air exposure when I was drinking water. I soon arrived in Guangzhou after 9 hours of flight. Although I did not choose the meal on the plane, the flight attendants prepared biscuits, jelly and beef jerky for each passenger. The only inadequacy in an otherwise perfect thing was that I could not find a USB interface to charge my phone on the plane. Anyway, it was a satisfying trip.

The staff and cabin crew show 100% of their profession, that offers a wonderful and reliable services to me. During the global pandemic, The arrangement and services on board are in perfect order, not rush and strict. Therefore, I feel much confidence from the team of China Southern Airlines. Appreciate for the whole team of CZ306!

review_header: "staff in the flight were nice and helpful"
review_text: My trip with China Southern Airlines was awesome. I was traveling with my one year child. The whole check in and on boarding process were smooth and quick. The staff in the flight were nice and helpful when I need assist with caring my baby.
I lost my baggage in the airport and they helped me to find them back quickly. Everything in my bag is still there. It really helps a lot. I Really respect them and appreciate it.
Good service attitude, clean and tidy cabin, good quality and low price.

When I arrived at the airport too early on flight CZ391 and the staff of the quarantine department didn't go to work. I was very confused and didn't know what to do.  She contacted the staff of the quarantine department and volunteered to help me fill in the customs declaration form correctly. Her professional service saved me from long waiting times.

Without their assistance and help, the plan of going abroad this time could not be completed. The two made dozens of phone calls to communicate with colleagues about the ticket issues, and then rushed to the security checkpoints at the airport with us to overcome all difficulties to help us get through the security check and board the plane.

review_header: "thank the staff of China Southern Airlines"
review_text: While attending the flight, I was told that my dog is required to be masked and leashed. At the moment I didn’t know what to do and as I started to panic, airport ground crew staff Penny quickly reached out and assisted me in solving the problem. She approached the flight captain and negotiated for granting permission. I would also like to thank the flight attendants for their enthusiasm and professionalism. My experience with the China Southern Airline at the Guangzhou Baiyun International Airport -departing from Guangzhou to LAX- truly brought me warmth during this cold winter. Thank you again to all who helped!

China Southern staff were very friendly to me, and the advice was useful, thanks to their help I was landing successfully in Milan, Thanks for you hardworking in this difficult situation, wish you all the best.

The pilot announced he was delaying our departure 30 minutes for transfer baggage and I heard bags getting loaded. Unfortunately, my bags got next to the plane but were never loaded. Upon landing in Taipei, I informed the staff that my bags were never loaded; they said I was wrong and to wait for my next flight to talk to a supervisor. Tried for 4 hours to get ahold of customer service. The staff at the gate for my flight from TPE / OKA, said my bags would be in Okinawa and if they were not, then to file a delayed baggage claim there. Arrived in Okinawa; took an hour to get the claim filed through Japan airlines as they're contracted for starlux. Complete radio silence on where bags were and when they'd arrive. Bags took another 72 hours to arrive after being assured that I'd have them within 48. Got them just in time to turn around and go home. On the return flight, they could not tag my bags through to my final destination stating that they're not responsible for transfers with partner airlines.

The booking experience was straightforward and smooth, when online check in opened I managed to select a seat at no extra cost, and successfully managed to download the mobile boarding pass into my digital wallet. So we were off to a good start. The A330neo is a great choice for regional and short to mid-haul flights, its 2-4-2 configuration in economy making the cabin intimate and cosy with fewer passengers stuck in window seats. Another good start was when boarding proceeded smoothly and we took off on time. Legroom was comfortable without being too generous, with Google putting it at 79cm, the long-haul industry average but nothing spectacular. The cabin appeared to be spanking clean and in tip-top condition, with its comforting shade of brown appeasing to the eyes. Both USB-A and USB-C charging ports were offered, and the seat even included a pillow for this short hop cross the Taiwan Strait. Unfortunately, dining options seemed to have fallen short, with the food rather bland and not as appetising. A small packet of juice was offered, but no choices were given and neither was plain drinking water. Another pet peeve is that in this day and age, somehow Starlux does not have their IFE system connected to their PA system, hence the IFE system was not allowed to be used during takeoff and landing. It’s the first time I’ve experienced something like this on an aircraft that has an IFE system, which by the way was pretty comprehensive. The crew were all very professional and courteous, and consistently checked on passengers during the short flight. As a bonus, we landed 12 minutes ahead of schedule, thanks to the speedy boarding and takeoff process. All in all still a very attractive option in this competitive market, though it falls short in an few areas and certainly has room for improvement.

She manipulated our seating while appearing to rearrange our seating so that our children (under 12) could seat with an adult/parent. It is against US Transportation Laws not to do so. At the end, we were still separated and had to go through extra security screenings. STARLUX claimed that we could arrange our own seating on our own 24 hours before departure, but their website is poorly designed and wouldn't allow us to do so.

I had always wanted to take a Starlux flight. Before boarding at NRT, I spent time in JAL Sakura lounge, as Starlux doesn’t have its own. The inflight meal on the flight bound for TPE didn’t satisfy my appetite. Concretely speaking, a grilled pork shoulder in sauce was tasteless. I regretted not having preordered it. Also champagne was served not so cold. For my part, I am not so interested in inflight entertainment. On my return from Taipei, prior to boarding, I entered the Galactic lounge at Taoyuan airport T1. What surprised most was that they offered an a la carte menu, on which I found an appetizing salmon steak and ordered it. How tasty!  The dish served on the flight, one similar to beef steak, was totally different from the previous one. It was superb. The generous flow of chilled BOLLINGER champagne delighted me well. Meticulous services offered by a Japanese flight attendant are worthy of a special mention. Though this was a short haul, or a 3-hour-and-10-minute flight, I could not help wishing it would be much longer! Both flights were punctual.

Check-in in Singapore was breezy and easy, and the staff replaced my self-printed boarding pass with a Snoopy-themed one. Security took 30 seconds, and boarding commenced without delay. I was welcomed in a friendly way by the crew, and once I was onboard, the BMW Designworks-crafted cabin gave me a very nice first impression. The wonderful mood lighting system, and the electronic window dimmer, combined with a very comfortable air conditioning system, made the cabin perfectly comfortable, clean, and well-maintained. The same can be said for the Recaro CL3710 seats I was sitting in. We didn't move immediately as suddenly there was a medical emergency onboard; but thanks to the very fast-moving yet calm crew and helpful passengers, the delay only lasted 1 hour, relatively short for its nature considering the passenger and bag needed to be taken off the plane. Once we took off, the service began, and the fried noodle that I had was absolutely delicious, with the exception of the slightly overcooked meat. The IFE, which was filled with Snoopy decorations, was also responsive. Despite being tired after the medical emergency, the cabin crews still put their best calm, collected, friendly, and attentive behavior forward, which was something not easy. Landing was around 50 minutes late, but that didn't matter for me as I had 4 hours of connecting time (originally 5), which I wisely used by relaxing at the Plaza Premium Lounge. The flight to SFO was much longer, but the same wonderful cabin, awesome seats, and glorious IFE system remained. I was surprised to see a Japanese crew member doing this flight, and I had a nice conversation with him. The crews of this flight were also equally friendly, nice, awesome, and courteous; but since the crews of my previous flight endured tougher situations, I must say that the crews of my SIN-TPE flight had the extra positives over the crews of my TPE-SFO flight. The service on my TPE-SFO flight, however, was endless. The crews offered unlimited drinks, snacks, and light meals. I was served 2 meals; both were nicely presented, however, the first one, the pork BBQ, was delicious. The second one, the congee, tasted better compared to the previous congee I had on my SFO-TPE flight, but it still tasted bland. That being said, Starlux provided a bag of salt and pepper for us to manually adjust. The Wi-Fi on both of my flights worked well and I was able to text my family and friends without too much of an issue; although, stability-wise, the Wi-Fi onboard my SIN-TPE flight was more stable. That, however, was a given, since my TPE-SFO flight mainly passed through the ocean. The landing was slightly late, and I disembarked after a slight confusion between me, the crews, and the Starlux ground/security staff at SFO. My bags came up very fast, and the entire process from disembarking to checking in for my next American Airlines flight took only 45-60-ish minutes, and that could have been faster since I needed to wait for some travel parties. I had a hard time picking which Starlux flight of mine was the best because both flights were equally wonderful. Starlux showed resilience under tough situations, and they taught me lots of life lessons. They made every dollar I spent for this flight worth it. If they keep surprising me like this, I can obviously choose them on all of my flights, because the trust has been strengthened!

Booked a return flight with a “Full” Economy ticket which had a 65sgd cancellation fee and they charged me 200sgd. They claimed that because I booked the going flight as a different package for economy class that they would take the higher fee. False advertising and false display of pricing. You can’t put one price for each individual flight and not put a disclaimer that it wouldn’t matter which package you chose. Whether it is Limited, Saving, Basic or Full you will always pay the higher price. I had 1PC luggage on the going flight and I paid a lower fee. I had 2PC luggage on my return flight and had a higher fee. By this logic they should apply the refund to the flights individually just as they have for the luggage. You cannot charge a fee and tell someone that the least favorable outcome for the customer will be applied. Disappointing customer service and user interface.
All the staff were friendly and very helpful. Will definitely choose this airline again. At Chiang Mai the airline uses the Thai Airways lounge.

However, Starlux quickly proved me wrong and made me feel guilty for having such a narrow-minded mindset. Check-in in San Francisco took less than 2 minutes, and so did TSA PreCheck. Boarding was orderly and not chaotic, and once I stepped inside the plane, I was welcomed by a friendly cabin crew. The cabin, designed by BMW Designworks, was absolutely glamorous, luxurious, and clean. My seat, 38K, was absolutely comfortable with plenty of features and items waiting to be used in this 12.5-hour flight. Blankets, pillows, headphones, and even a bag of amenity kits were provided. The IFE screen was the size of my 13.3' laptop, which was something to marvel at. Starlux really took into account the fact that every person has their own favorite way to access and scroll through contents, which was why they programmed the IFE to let users decide how the contents will be laid out. The contents were plenty, and the system itself was very responsive. The crews were absolutely fantastic, to the point that I must say they were too kind (in a good way) because they went as far as giving me a bag of souvenirs for free and a thank you card. If there was anything that was worth calling out on this flight, it was the food. The dinner I had, the roasted chicken with potatoes with chili sauce, was a bit too spicy for my liking but was still delicious, and the fish congee I had for breakfast was absolutely tasteless and it killed my appetite. I, however, appreciate the continuous service of beverages, rice crackers, and light snacks every 30 to 60 minutes. Landing in Taiwan was 15 minutes ahead of schedule, and I was immediately sent to the next flight without any nonsense. The flight to Singapore, again, operated by an A350 with the same glamorous, bodacious, and comfortable cabin, IFE, and seats, also had the same kind, nice, energetic, and compassionate cabin crews who again went as far as giving me extra drink and souvenirs, but the thing that made this flight slightly better than the previous was the fact that the "deconstructed beef bibimbap"-style food that I had was absolutely divine. Wi-Fi on both flights was functional, but it did take a while for me to connect, although, after further investigation, it was an error on my phone's behalf. Landing in Singapore was slightly behind schedule, but the fast baggage delivery made things much easier. When I purchased this ticket, Starlux gave me the third cheapest option, and for the price I paid, they surpassed my expectations and surprised me. With the exception of the food that I got during my SFO-TPE leg, I enjoyed every single moment of my first two flights on Starlux Airlines, and these two flights were the first two flights where I actually felt like I did not want to leave the plane and wanted to stay longer inside it. Starlux was that good, and everyone who had never tried it should try it ASAP. You will not regret spending a thousand dollars on this airline.

Check-in was quick and easy. The plane is new, quiet, spacious and spotlessly clean, featuring a large screen with many entertainment choices. The flight left a few minutes late from Terminal One, which was recently renovated and quite comfortable. The onboard service was caring and professional. My two "oriental veg" meals were somewhat bland but were generous and well-prepared.

Nowhere does it show in the email confirmation your assigned seating so you have no proof. By the time you realize it it is too late. Prompting customers for more money through upgrades without delivering it, and giving no proof in the confirmation. Either that or please fix the bug in your system!

On my return i was informed the connection was going to be late so i can't make flight home. No customer service till 930am till 530pm New flight next day. No reimbursement for hotel or food. I was told my flight was early the next day so nothing. I still have not been able to talk to a live person. Tried live chat waited 2 hrs then it just closed.

I did have an entire row of 3 seats to myself, but since I'm older I could not use it to sleep. The flight attendants were polite and efficient but not overly friendly and only gave service when requested. The food was very basic (I would bring my own sandwiches if I went again). Sort of like a flying bus! I would not say this carrier gives 5* service/food to their economy passengers.
The service wasn't great as the stewardesses were not smiling at me or friendly enough to me.

As there is no direct flight from Singapore to Japan, I purposely brought 2 sets of tickets, 1 to Taipei and 1 to Fukuoka. As this is the first experience with Starlux, i was prompted to join their Cosmile club. However i have made a mistake while doing so. Although as a frequent traveler, i made a mistake of joining the club with just my email address. As it did not take my full name, the ticket was bought with 1 word of my name missing out, even though my first name and last name are included. After speaking to the customer service of Starlux for nearly an hour, they advise me that the only way is for me to cancel the ticket on their website and rebook the ticket myself. While asking why other airline can do this and they cant, they finally broke that its their companys rule.  As this is an anniversary trip for my wife and I, there is no choice but to follow Starlux instruction. So the break down of the cost is as follows: New Ticket to Taipei SGD 64 more than original ticket. New Ticket to Fukuoka TWD610 more than original ticket. Admin fee of refund charged by starlux; SGD150 and TWD3000 Using exchange rate of TWD100 is SGD4.25 =SGD348.16

The staff who was scanning ticket told us to go to the end of the line. The reason was "Are you special or priority? Your kids have to be exactly under 2 and then you can board now. You need to get back to that line" So we had to go all the way back to the end of the long line. We are very disappointed with the staff who was supposed to help the family. We ended up having no space for our bag because our seats were at 27 row and we were the last one boarded.

The Flight took off -20 mins late from Singapore & arrived 10 minutes late in Bangkok. On the return the Aircraft was A-350-900 & we took off 1 hr late & arrived 1 hr late at Singapore. Both flights were good and comfortable, with good entertainment. The food (we had ordered AVML (Indian Veg Meals) was good in taste but badly arranged with regards to the Menu. On both flights we received the same food. Pita Bread, Paneer masala, Palak Paneer in Basmati Rice, Paneer Starter, Gulab Jamun Sweet, Bun & Margarine. This overdoing of Paneer dishes was disappointing as Paneer does not consititute as a vegetable. I hope Thai Airways removes these Paneer Dishese.  Service was weird  with drinks being served after food completed, instead of before the Meal. Baggage handling was good & efficient. We will continue to fly Thai Airways in future!

However, the tension in Doha prevented me from flying there. The QR office in Manila rebooked me to a new carrier and I chose Thai Airways. The experience was reassuring. Clean plane, lavatories and walking spaces made this trip comfortable. The food remains at par! Although they did not give us an amenity kit, the comfort was already fine for a 3.5-hour flight. Thank you, TG. And I hope to fly with you again.

The staff are gracious and seem comfortable. However, IFE is an utter disgrace, and there is no wifi. Food was an extension of economic class, with one of the worst seafood meals ever experienced. This is definitely not the Thai Airways that I used to love to fly. Anyway the plus point was that the flight departed on time and reached a bit before schedule as well.

Food wasn't good. Second leg was not a good experience. The aircraft is dated and entertainment wasn't working - not system but most of the screen were so dated that you can hardly see anything. Passengers ought to get the service they paid for beside flying from point A to point B.
Food was ok and IFE was good enough for the 5 hour trip. Mild turbulence near the end of the flight, but otherwise no major drama or delays with boarding or exiting.

Crew were lovely and were always available if needed. Breakfast and dinner were delicious and a great size. Fresh fruit available in flight between meals and no issues getting drinks if needed. Some more updated tv programs and movies would be good . Music selection was outstanding. Would be nice if all crew wore the Thai Dress again. Only staff in Business Class wore it. Some flights they all wear it and some even to and from the flight as I noticed in the terminal. As much as the purple suit is nice the Thai Ruen dress is iconic with Thai and consistent branding should be used at all times.

Seat is one of the most comfortable I’ve tried, selection of entertainment is decent, not the best but it’s alright. I’ve pre ordered Muslim meal which was arranged and was delicious. The only negative thing was the seat looks a bit tired and the cabin probably need some refurbishing but overall was a great experience. Also the lounge at BKK airport was huge and comfortable.

The flight left on time and went smoothly. The initial food service was prompt and the chicken pad Thai, was delicious. IFE is ok, still needs a bit of updating. Breakfast wasn’t great. Overall an easy 12 hour flight.

After a 16-hour delay with no real explanation, I arrived in Bangkok to face an overnight delay with no food, water,  hotel or communication access.  Thai Airways avoided canceling the flight, so insurance wouldn’t apply and passengers couldn’t rebook on their next available flight, which they still operated on time. They exploited every loophole to dodge responsibility while we were left stranded and helpless. Months later, they continue to refuse even the most basic reimbursement for a hotel. I now go out of my way to avoid flying with Thai Airways.
The check-in and boarding was smooth. The cabin crew was very nice and friendly. The seat was comfortable, We were served snack and a bottle of water and the flight arrived destination on time.

Check-in and boarding was smooth as my wife who had problem walking after knee surgery request wheelchair service both at Suvarnabhumi airport and Melbourne airport (the service by ground staff who help us with wheelchair were excellent). The cabin was nice and the seat was very comfortable (we can sleep for a few hours even on day flight). The cabin crew were very nice, helpful and friendly. The food on both meal was very good and delicious. The flight was on time and it was a very nice flight. On the way back to Bangkok, we flew in Economy class. the cabin crew were very nice and friendly as well. The seat was quite comfortable and food was good. Overall it was a very good flight though we sat near mother with very young kid.

The check-in and boarding was smooth. Because my wife just had knee surgery and we ask for wheelchair which they provide for both flights The seat was quite comfortable. The cabin crew were nice and friendly. the food of the main course was good and we were served with snack before landing. Both flights arrived on time. Very pleasent flight.

Flew business class for the first time, flying from BKK to MEL late April 2025. The cabin crew did a good job with their service, and providing plenty of snacks and drinks during the 8hr flight. No major issues during the flight except for minor turbulence over the Java sea, and the plane was held up for about 30-40min at BKK airport due to other planes arriving late. Cost me less than $3k AUD for the oneway trip, so would think about doing business class again in the future, if I ever go back to Thailand again. Also the business lounge in BKK airport was really pleasant and clean, with a lot of food & drink options. No issues checking in luggage with the priority group.
I did not hear the reason for seat change from the ground staff and he used the pen to write the new seat (unclear) in my boarding pass. This made me irritable.

Was a slightly older plane. The first 4 hours was a struggle then the latter 7 was fine. Food was ok onthis flight. The in flight entertainment is in need of being updated. Fly with Thai Airways is ok, they serve the purpose for the direct flight, which is the reason I fly with them.

There is a delay, and we missed the connecting flight. Either the air crew and the group crew have an attitude. We were given a hotel and told to take a flight the next day, although I have to work the next day.

They charge an additional fee per kilogram rather than allowing passengers to add a checked bag for a fixed price. As a result, adding a 23kg suitcase cost a staggering $1,120. This price is completely unreasonable especially considering that for a similar amount, I could have upgraded to Business Class, where 40kg of baggage is included. Unfortunately, due to technical restrictions related to our ticket type, we were not given the option to upgrade, despite being willing to pay for it. Their rigid and inflexible policies left us frustrated before our trip had even begun. What makes this even worse is that on the return leg of our journey, flying from Japan to Israel, we had no problem adding the same 23kg suitcase for just $100. This inconsistency is unacceptable and feels like a way to exploit passengers on certain routes. I expected better from Thai Airways and will reconsider flying with them in the future. I strongly advise other travelers to check their baggage policies carefully before booking.

I was uncomfortable sitting in my seat and the food was difficult to eat, which was quite disappointing. One of the crew members serving me had noticeably long nails with visible dirt underneath. I wouldn’t choose to fly with them again.
Thai doesn't allow that and wanted to charge me 6000THB which was more expensive than the ticket.  Gate agent was very rude and not sympathetic.

After a nice cocktail in the bar things however started to go badly wrong - a short 90 min delay was announced, that later turned out in 5.5 hours. Everything was very poorly managed, with no support from the airline, I did not get any vouchers. Boarding went with an overloaded bus and it took a very long time to get on board. Once on board we faced a very old business class 2-2-2 with no direct aisle access for window seats. Storage was very limited and the seats unacceptable tight for 2025. The flight had a very extensive crew but service was average. I even had to push very hard to get an expresso from a 'broken' expresso machine. Thai seems to suffer from complacency and needs to invest to bring its equipment to a competitive level. Bangkok is a great airport and has massive potential.

I followed the instructions on their website to email the cancellation and refund request to their customer service team - they didn't respond. I sent a follow-up email - they didn't respond, I sent another and the same. So no response to their instruction on how to cancel a flight (that was within the window for a refund) and they even had the cheek to send me a survey link to rate my flight with them!

I thought we were going to be landing way in advance. Unfortunately we were then in a holding pattern in Bangkok for 15mins. You win some you loose some. It was a ten year old Boeing 777-300. The first meal service was lovely, the breakfast was poor I didn’t eat that. The recline on my seat was broke, which isn’t a deal breaker for me anyway. Crew were great, I still think they can improve but the convenience is the key with a direct flight.

They are always a convenient airline to fly to Thailand with, but each flight varies so much. From IFE to food to the cabin crew service. The food on this flight wasn’t nice. The IFE was much better. Was a comfy flight, managed to sleep for 8 hours ON this 13hour flight.

We were contacted at least thrice for seat changes to end up with this aircraft. The aircraft has 1-1-1 seat configuration (seats A, G, K). The seat seems narrow (29”?), storage space is limited, fully reclined bed is possible but you’d need to rise up to use this feature. Although the A seat is a window seat but your feet always point to the aisle and some seats may not be able to see out of the window. The G & K seats are worse since both have feet pointed to the opposite and face each other. Thus no privacy is assured as hypothesised. The IFE has no map features, only elapsed times are available (aircrew couldn’t get the map features for me). Honestly, we notice that service quality varies depending upon who you’re (ROP/Star Alliance status, ages, familiarity with crew, etc.). This flight was over booked and some were offered to downgrade to P/E with USD 200 compensation, experiencing what just described we regret that we didn’t take that offer! As THAI loyal customers, we’d suggest the airline to consider our comments to improve its quality to be competitive with other Star Alliance carriers in the similar routes which we had rated all of them as excellent.

Online check in, lounge access, & boarding were fine. The aircraft is quite old with 1-2-1 config. Breakfast, Japanese & Thai, were mediocre. Second servings, as well as alcohol, appear in the printed menu but have to be requested. When asked why, we’re told that this is a morning flight and very few passengers request them.

The plane clean, but older, staff were exceptionally nice. They advertise for WIFI, but it is a scan, none of their older planes have WIFI. They park faraway in the airports and use buses not bridges to save money. Entertainment, all older movies. They either need to drop their prices or improve the service.

Requested for special meal for diabetics but were told that they’re not available. Quite surprised because this is premium economy class where hot meals are served despite short flights. One of the flights was delayed for at least 30 minutes without any explanation.

Firstly due to high season it was extremely expensive. It wasn’t terrible, but wasn’t great just did its job. The plane seemed really old I was surprised that it was only ten years old. The food on flight was actually really good. A beef pad krapow for evening meal then mushroom omelette for breakfast. The crew member who controlled our section of the plane was loud and blunt. Overall the cabin crew dealt with a very drunk passenger very well. The IFE this time was very poor, 80% off the movies were sci-fi, great if that’s your thing.
One flight attendant was particularly nice. Feels like home because I have flown this airline many times in the past.

review_header: "Delicious food on a one hour flight"
review_text: Plane clean. Boarding orderly. Delicious food on a one hour flight -spicy! All fine and crew worked hard in an hour. New terminal in BKK a bit of a journey though so don’t be late.
When in Phuket my bag and the stuff in it was soaking wet. Company acknowledge no responsibility.
Fantastic service. Attentive, small meal provided - very nice touch. Cabin Crew kind and friendly. No delays on arrival in Bangkok.

The flight to Fukuoka was night flight. The ground crew was kind enough to help us to get wheelchair service for my wife who have trouble with walking. We did not sleep much due to the noise during meal preparation. The food was good. The cabin crew were nice and friendly (except the noise they made) The flight was delayed due to heavy traffic for Bangkok. The flight back to Bangkok was delayed as well due to technical issue by airport tow truck. The food was quite good and cabin crew were nice and friendly, however during their rest period, their conversation was quite loud. Otherwise the flight was smooth.

The only thing that could be improved is their inflight entertainment which has a very poor selection compared to most other airlines. I have used them in the past and will definitely use them again in the future.

While it is a typical, average airline with no differentiator per se, there are several things which left us unsatisfied.  The planes offered for both the sectors were old with archaic entertainment systems. While checking in at Mumbai, the person at the desk told us that the screen for the aisle seat was not working. On our return journey too, the one at the aile seat was not working; and this time, no one informed us too. The system at the other two seats was also acting crazy owing to which we dropped the idea of watching anything after a substantial amount of struggle.  The boarding process at the Mumbai airport was extremely chaotic & stressful, and this was solely due to the airlines staff. Unresponsive Customer Service Team: Around a fortnight before our departure, we found ourselves in a situation where we might have to cancel our travel. While booking our tickets on the Thai Airways site, I had glanced over the cancellation terms & charges. When our travel came in jeopardy, I again visited their site to understand the cancellation charges. I realised that neither were the cancellation charges & terms shown on the site nor was there a provision for online cancellation like all other airlines. I learnt that we had to write to [email protected], which I did. Despite my email and follow-up, no one ever responded. Meanwhile our trip got confirmed again and hence the issue got dropped. Overall, there are many better airlines to fly than Thai Airways.

Refused to fly me without a fit to fly certificate even though I produced all the documentation they required and was not asked for this info prior. Arrived at the airport with three hours to spare. Their policy states that after 28 weeks they need to see proof of due date and that it’s a singleton pregnancy - provided that information but they then kept changing their minds over what information they needed to see, wasting hours on the phone to each other. Whilst I, my three and five year old grew increasingly concerned that we would miss the flight. They then made me go to the hospital medic and pay for an examination and certificate, which confirmed I was fit to fly, by this point they told me we had missed our flight and that we couldn’t get another flight for another 6 days and that we would have to pay another £800 to take. Absolutely AWFUL service.

Thai Airways International is an airline that I have been flying for the past 25 years and is therefore close to heart, and unfortunately it's deterioration of standards have got to the point that it is glaring and apparent. Even before stepping onboard the aircraft, I tried to do online check-in, but when I tried to download the mobile boarding pass it only showed me an error page multiple times so I had to get the physical boarding pass at the counter. My flight on 9 Oct TG408 according to flightradar24, (only departed at 1953 and arrived at 2052hrs), despite being scheduled for an 1815 departure. The aircraft, HS-THR, prior to the flight to Singapore, did a rotation to Seoul Incheon (TG 656 & TG657), and the SCHEDULED ARRIVAL time at Bangkok Suvarnabhumi from Seoul Incheon was 1410hrs despite the SCHEDULED DEPARTURE time to Singapore being 1350hrs on the outbound flight (TG407). This means that the aircraft had ABSOLUTELY NO WAY of being on time for the TG407 & TG408 rotation because IT WAS ALREADY ROSTERED TO BE LATE. The on-time performance of the past week's TG408 flights according to flight tracking data, has been pathetically dismal. This flight was delayed by 75 min, but I have experienced a 12-hour delay when flying with them in 2022, on a 2-hour flight. Once onboard the aircraft, the wonderful service begins. The warmth of the cabin crew and their sincerity was felt almost instantly. The FAs were also courteous and professional. Food was average though. Despite the new aircraft (A350 & B787), the IFE system is still the same ones as those used on their older aircraft like the 777. The IFE system across the Boeing 777-300ER fleet appears to be at least 15 years old, has screens that are lagging terribly and are serious need of an overhaul. The ones on the A350 work fine though. Legroom/seat pitch is acceptable and decent without being generous or luxurious. The 777s had a footrest that was more of a hindrance rather than a help. In spite of its aged interior, the cabin appeared to be cleaned and sanitized well. Despite the warm touch from the cabin crew and their best efforts, Thai Airways is a serious letdown thanks to the poor management that is in charge of the scheduling and rostering of its aircraft. What used to be SouthEast Asia's second-best airline and second-largest fleet is now in shambles.

When I tried to change the seat, Thai showed economy as full, apart from a handful of mid-row seats. The agency wouldn't do anything. I checked the seating chart regularly online. To my surprise, two-to-three days before the flight, it suddenly showed the plane was more than half empty, and I was able to change my seat. The same thing happened on the way back. The load factor in each direction was perhaps 30% to 40% and I was able to get three seats to myself. It's the first time I've flown long-haul economy on Thai for more than 30 years and it was OK. The food wasn't bad and the flight attendants were polite. The IFE screens were small and unresponsive, but that hardly mattered as I didn't find anything I wanted to watch, other than one episode of a decade-old series in which a friend appeared. Overall, I'm positive about the flight, and about Thai.

I'd no checked baggage so I figured that should be enough time, but was still a bit worried. When my flight from Chiang Mai was delayed, I checked with a Thai staffer. He stamped my domestic boarding pass as international, walked me to international departures, took me to the front of a long queue at security and ensured that I made it to the right gate. He could not have been more helpful. The flight was fine, but it was the ground staff at Chiang Mai that made the experience special (But anyone else in my position should sort this out before flying! If you had to exit domestic and go through immigration/security at Suvarnabhumi, that might be rather time-consuming.

All things about the flight were good or on par comparative to other airlines. The leg Kolkota to Bangkok was on an old plane which meant my economy seat was more spacious than the seats economy passengers get on new planes. The shocker was the excess baggage fee I had to pay. My excess was 7kg for which I was billed $600 to pay at checkin. Is this the industry standard? It was effectively almost the same as the original one way airfare. The other perplexing thing was I was not able to use the Amex card I had purchased my ticket with. Incomprehensibly I was told Thai Airlines does not accept American Express. Clearly this was a lie. What is this outfit up to? I felt like I was being scammed.

I had to book last minute. Economy only available so obviously no upgrade. They wouldn't let me sit in the exit row or bulkhead because I had to pay extra. You'd think my status on a partner airline would get perks.

The check-in and boarding was very smooth and systematic. The seat was quite comfortable. The air crew were very nice and friendly. The meal they served was very delicious (main meal - Thai fried rice with spicy chicken/Japanese rice with pork, light meal - chicken carbonara bun). We were also served with snack and a couple bottles of water during flight. The flight arrived a little late due to raining at Bangkok airport. Smooth and excellent flight.

We flew from Bangkok to Sydney with A350-900 which was quite comfortable. The check-in and boarding was smooth and the plane leave on time. Air crew on board were nice and friendly,. Ther service was fast and efficient. We were served 2 meals which taste quite good. They also served us snack and fruits between the meal. We arrived on time and it was a pleasant journey. On the way back to Bangkok, we flew from Melbourne with Airbus A350-900 as well. The check-in and boarding was smooth and fast. The plane leave on time. The service by young male and female crew who took care our section was excellent. A lot of smile with nice and polite mannner. They served us 2 meals and the food may not as good as the flight to Sydney (particular Thai dish) but it was OK. The crew also served us biscuit and cheese with Banana and apple between 2 meals and also a couple bottles of mineral water which made us quite pleasant. The flight arrived about 30 minutes ahead of schedule. Overall, both flight was very good with excellent service.

My wife had accident before flight and was unable to walk normally. During check-in at Suvarnabhumi airport, the young male staff at check-in counter was very kind and helpful. He tried to find the front row seat to move my wife from the back row seat but was unable to do so because the flight was fully booked. Therefore, he arranged wheelchair service for my wife to the gate. Unfortunately, this flight would depart from bus gate not normal gate with Jet bridge and my wife was unable to walk up by stair to airplane. Thai Airways staff at the gate were very helpful and kind enough to prepare the Lift bus to take my wife to the plane’s side door and also prepare special wheelchair that can move in aisle of the plane as we were seat in Row 54. The cabin staff were very attentive and helpful as well. The flight was good, arrived a little late due to heavy traffic at airport of departure. The service by cabin staff was very good and friendly indeed. They served us with snack (green curry bun - very tasty) and a bottle of mineral water. We really appreciated excellent service by Thai Airways staff both ground and flight crew.

Not a bad flight. Flew the other way last month and the plane felt more quiet and comfortable than this one. I ordered a special meal because of allergies, but they either gave it to someone else or didn't have it on board, so I ended up having to have a kids meal. I'm a big guy and was left hungry. No snacks on the flight or water handed out. Really frustrating when they dont on long hauls. Also discriminating that I have to pay for an exit seat because of my excessive height. I'll start an online petition soon so tall people hopefully won't have to pay anymore to be as comfortable as other people on aeroplanes. I used to get them for nothing, but now airlines charge for those seats, just to make more money (after Covid). We shouldn't have to pay! Second meal on the flight was also insufficient. Entertainment lacks too, quality of films is poor and the amount too. Same movies as 6 weeks ago, not sure how often they're changed. Luckily I had Netflix on my phone or I'd of been very bored. TV shows very basic and not much range of English speaking ones too. Staff are great, cleanliness of the plane too. BKK - MEL. Very comfortable seat. OK entertainment, but could be more variety for English speaking people. Food was great. They didn't have the meal I requested, but they sorted me out and I was very happy. Same entertainment on TA for the last 6 weeks, so if you do a return flight with them choose what you watch carefully, as there's a limited amount of shows and movies. Great staff as always, and always clean and tidy in the bathrooms. When at BKK I was given the wrong seat (I'd paid for exit row as im very tall), they said I couldn't have it unless I paid again, which was very frustrating. Eventually after 45minutes at the counter and showing them all my documents, they changed it. A bit ridiculous really considering I had proof I'd paid for the seat(s). There were many empty ones anyway. Good flight overall. I booked last minute and paid a lot for it. I was shown only a few empty seats, however, there were a lot upon boarding. Slightly misleading. That's why Im giving 1 star for value for money.

Both flights were delayed without explanation. The business class seats are at the lower level of quality .If you are seated in a window seat you have to step over an adjoining passenger to reach the aisle. The seats are old and narrow and very uncomfortable for sleep and on my seat the light did not work . The Screen is very small and is situated on the back of the seat in front. The food from Perth was of a good standard but from Bangkok there was no European breakfast available and the Coffee and bread that were offered were cold. All in all a far cry from the old Thai experience. BKK remains one of the least passenger friendly airports and the walk from the plane to immigration was a tad under a kilometre. The good news was that the baggage that was labelled priority actually did arrive as priority and that is a rare occurrence these days . I would not fly on a longer segment with Thai until they upgraded their planes.

Pierre is a good quality luggage and it was the third time I used it. The weight did not exceed 25 kgs so, it could not have been a heavy luggage. I made a complaint and it took 3 weeks for them to reply asking me to send pictures of the damage. I sent the pictures the same day. Then, didn't hear from them like 2 weeks again. Then, they replied for the second time and asked me to take the luggage to the repair shop and they will reimburse the expense. I went to the repair shop with my luggage and the expert on the luggage said that the cost to repair will not be cheap and suggested it is rather better to buy a new luggage or put a duct tape. I don't want to put a duct tape on my nice luggage and replied to Thai Airways on 6th june and they have not replied me until today (21st July). Definitely not flying with them again and will definitely not recommend anyone.

From SYD normally I take Qatar or Qantas! Was over 7 kg weight limit due to tight allowance compared to others they charged me $450 extra! Top service in air& food but $450 extra for 7 kg bus class ticket was too much! No more Thai for me!
The air ticket is a bit expensive. There are TV and many delicious foods to eat. This is the best airlines I have travelled.

I was impressed by the legroom! 32 inch (81 Cm), it gives a feeling that THAI actually cares about experience. Overall food was good. You had 2 options I had chicken with rise the other was mashed beteatos. Inflight entertainment was fine but could be updated. Cabin crew was Super friendly and hard working. Overall the flight was smooth as Silk!

Check-in at Bangkok Suvarnabhumi was relatively smooth sailing, but considering Thailand is known as the "Land of Smiles", I think the check-in agent could have been just a bit friendlier and more smiley. That being said, the rest of the ground staff members lived up to that title. Boarding was done late, and once I stepped onboard, I was welcomed by the fresh, clean, and comfortable cabin with wonderful mood lighting. The crews even set the light to do some rainbow-themed light show onboard. My seat, 57K, was very comfortable, user-friendly, and had plenty of features. The only possible drawback was that the seat slid forward when reclined, but for me, it wasn't a problem. The take-off was late, but afterwards, despite some turbulence, meal service commenced. There were two options: an omelet with chicken sausage and a chicken stew with rice and vegetables. I opted for the latter, which was presented nicely and tasted delicious. It reminded me of what I would usually have in some Asian restaurant. The In-Flight Entertainment was very responsive and had a customizable, beautiful layout. It wasn't too bad on the content side as well; however, more contents could have been added, especially the Western selections. The flight attendants of this flight truly lived up to the Royal Orchid branding. They were all hardworking, friendly, attentive, caring, and cheerful, although they were sometimes rushed when it came to explaining the menu. What I liked about them was that they strictly enforced the no-lavatory policy during turbulence but were also polite in enforcing it. The flight crews also gave the passengers enough time to prepare for the turbulence, with announcements warning passengers that a cloud-covered area was coming. They also put the seatbelt sign on long before the turbulence and everyone complied. There were a couple of passengers who, perhaps by an honest mistake, disregarded the sign, and the crews remained polite while staying firm. Landing was only a few minutes late, and the bag did take a considerable amount of time to arrive. Overall, this flight was better than my previous TG433 flight, and that Royal Orchid branding just keeps on blooming. This flight just strengthened my trust in them.

However, so far never had to cancel. This time wasn’t sure I will need that flight so bought a refundable fare. When trying to cancel, realized that the airline makes this specially difficult to do as there is no way to do it yourself online nor clear instructions how to do it. My emails were not answered. After finally getting through via the phone was told that it will take 180 days not including holidays and weekends to process the refund. 5 months on and still waiting for my money. Never again Thai Airways, this is not a way to treat your customers.

Food was OK, nothing special, but adequate. Lack of snacks and drinks though which is disappointing, liquids should be regularly provided on long hauls. Seat was very comfortable though which was nice, very good recline. Entertainment sub-par from a big airline like TA, I was disappointed, a lot of the films were unknown to me and not 'good' movies, TV shows were barely watchable. Quiet and comfy journey, polite staff, overall a good flight, no complaints. Two people had medical problems, fainting, which I think was due to the heat inside the plane, it was very hot in my opinion. Usually I wrap up because it gets cold with the AC, but I had to strip off and I was still dripping with sweat. Maybe they had an issue with the system. Second leg was on a 777-300, which had a random seat layout. I was in 49H which felt was obstructing the aisle, I was in front of the curtain and there was only just enough room for the trolley to get past. When I booked the flight there were only a few seats left, however, the plane was only half full, which meant many lucky passengers got rows to themselves. I'm frustrated at that because I only had 2 seat options for extra leg room as I have to have one due to my excessive height, yet there were many exit seats empty which had more space than my seat. The TV was all sticky and dirty, covered in coffee and tar which I had to clean myself. Barely any water or drinks handed out on the 12.5hr trip which is frustrating. Seat was comfy though, great recline, food was better than the first leg. There seemed to be a leak from the AC near my seat and a lot of water was running down the bulkhead. Quiet flight, same entertainment as the first leg (not uncommon), but overall a good trip. Staff were friendly and helpful, which I always expect from TA. I paid a lot for the return flight, as I had to book last minute, and due to the amount of empty seats I'm scoring it low on value for money, I feel mislead because of what I was shown as seat availability.

The staff in Perth informed us that Thai sell the bulkhead seats as premium legroom, and if the seats are booked by others, babies don’t get accommodated. This is totally unacceptable and dangerous: new parents are generally sleep deprived anyway, and shouldn’t be expected to stay awake and alert whilst holding a baby for over 24 hours. The staff in Thailand confirmed this policy and despite no other babies being on the flight we had no bassinet. Even worse, if the bulkhead seats weren’t already booked, we would need to pay the premium for the legroom seats (over $170 each seat), if we want to avoid the danger of holding the baby for the 24 hours of flying. Unbelievable penny pinching that is putting babies’ safety at risk.
Get your timings right so that all these passengers are not waiting because of your scheduling issues.

Online check-in was done, immigration & security procedures went well. We cannot comment on the lounge that much because time was short due to our delayed airport train arrival from an accident with injury along the route. Boarding & seating, again in 1-2-1 configuration were fine. Welcome drinks and lunch menu service were fine. I chose a Thai meal, and the request was well taken. But later on, when it comes to the main dish, I was told that it wasn't available! I thus have to choose the western dish which is a steak. The steak is overcooked (well done texture) but tender enough. A choice of very good Laugen roll makes the meal forgivable. Wine was good. The overall teamwork, attention, service mind are above average. Again, as in the previous review, inconsistencies among flights are among THAI weaknesses to be competitive with other Star Alliance partners serving similar routes.

Check-in, immigration, & security checks are efficient. The lounge F & B items are mediocre. BTW, some of the male toilets & urinals were out of order. Boarding was efficient and seating in 1-2-1 configuration is fine. I'd need to request for the welcome drink, we also need to remind an attendant for the meal choice after being inadvertent passed by, but the in-flight manager/purser later came in to politely apologise. I chose a Japanese course for the lunch, but unfortunately there was no Sake to complement it. Am I wrong about this observation? Thus, I requested for a Sauvignon Blanc but was given a Chardonnay! The Japanese choice was very good, but rice was quite dry on the top perhaps from over reheating. After meal, I requested for an Espresso but was told that it wasn't available because someone forgot to load it and I was then given a black coffee in lieu of it. IFE was fine. In all, we are not impressed with this flight, and it wasn't THAI that we used to have very good impression. The team wasn't synchronised nor consistent. THAI needs to recognise these points and improve them to be competitive with other Star Alliance carriers in the region which we used to fly, and they seem spotless in their services.

The check-in and boarding was smooth. The flight was on time and arrived Haneda a little earlier. The seat was comfy and had very good legroom. The cabin crew were nice and friendly and provided excellent service. The food was good though not so delicious. Overall, it was very good flight.

review_header: "no longer what it used to be"
review_text: The poor crew try their best to offer a gracious service but there are many things lacking which makes this airline lag behind and lose its previous glory. The aircraft was dated and the IFE was an utter shame. Most of the controls were not working and games were not working either. No Wifi on the flight. There was 1 meal only for a 6-hour flight and all the items had pork in them making it so difficult for someone who is not a pork eater.
Asked for water twice and served. Pathetic experience.

The transit lounge in Bangkok was very comfortable with a good selection of food and drink. (We initially went to a mini-lounge called a "tea room". The toilets there weren't functioning so we decamped to a main lounge just a minute's walk away.) Boarding was orderly and the cabin crew's warm welcome set the tone for the rest of the flight. Our seats by the window were very comfortable, with adequate storage, and food and drink were brought frequently. The Thai dishes were particularly tasty. The plane arrived 10 minutes early and our bags emerged on the carousel just as we got there to pick them up. A perfect end to a long series of flights.
But the recliner from Bangkok to Mumbai was again broken. This is a repeat of last time and is so not acceptable. They gave me a 5500 baht as compensation. Not flying with these guys again.

I brought this to the attention of a flight attendant in the galley area – who was irritated but did offer to have a look as soon as possible. Waited 30 mins – nobody came to look at the screens. I asked another flight attendant who looked at the screens and said “I’ll get them reset”. Waited another hour - nothing happened. Asked yet another flight attendant who said “they will be reset”. I asked how long this might take – a shrug was the response. Over the next hour we asked attendants twice more about the progress with no further information being forthcoming – we had lost faith in the ‘it’s being reset’ comment. Now 2 hours 30 mins into the flight a ‘minor manager’ arrived to offer us “compensation” – a choice of ‘2500 Thai air miles’ or $100 off our next Thai Air flight. We explained that this was not compensation because as we were unlikely to fly to Thailand again the offer had no value to us. We asked to speak to the ‘manager’. After another 30 minutes and now about 3 hours into the flight the ‘flight manager’ arrived and explained that no other offer of compensation was available, but, she would take my email address and we would be contacted after the flight via email with an offer of compensation. The flight manager apologised for the failure of the systems and said that she understood how disappointed and inconvenienced we were by the equipment failure – this was the first apology received. As of now, 21 April, five days after the flight no contact has been made to my email address. I would like to point out that all power to the systems in our row of three seats was off. Obviously, we had no access to any of the ‘provided’ films or other entertainment/information. As we had no power to the row of seats it was not possible to ‘call’ an attendant; so our contact was achieved by repeatedly moving through the cabin to find an attendant. We had no lights to read from. This was a problem as the passenger in the window seat was trying to sleep so had shut the window. This passenger was woken up and provided with an eye mask and then opened the window so that it was just possible to read, but with difficulty. There was no power to charge phones – so whilst I was able to watch my phone for a while, this became impossible later in the flight. There was no air ventilation from above and at times the space was very stuffy and uncomfortable because of this. We would also like to point out the poor communication with flight attendants. Until the ‘flight manager’ spoke to us three hours into the flight none of the attendants had apologised or shown any sympathy. I felt like I was an inconvenience to the attendant and found their manner short and off-hand. We did appreciate the apology of the ‘flight manager’ and the offer to reach out and contact us after the flight – it is a shame that this did not actually happen. We remain very disappointed in the lack of facilities available to us on the flight and the manner in which our concerns were dealt with by staff. It was without doubt the worst long haul flight we have experienced in many years of travelling.

Then I was put on another flight via Singapore. The flight was about Oct 10, 2023, and per EU regulations, Thai Air owed us compensation. They would bounce me around during calls & emails and finally said an office in the USA had to provide the compensation. It is now 19 April 2024, and I have yet to hear or receive anything from them. I will never book with Thai again and suggest you strongly consider other options yourself. Their flights may be cheaper than others, but you get what you pay for. In fact, you don't even get what you pay for at a lower price.

We tried to book seats before departing Bangkok, and could not. My husband and I ended up in the middle seat of 3 seat plane - behind each other. We ordered vegetarian food, and got inedible vegan food. Obviously Thai Airways does not know the difference between vegetarian and vegan. Cabin crew practically non existent after serving food, staying at the back. Entertainment poor selection. No blanket on my seat - had to ask my husband as he was not using his for the overnight flight. No amenity kit provided. Would not recommend Thai Airways.

review_header: "wait months without any updates or contact"
review_text: It was impossible to do this online. Getting hold of anyone in customer services is an absolute nightmare. The phones are hopeless. If you search around online you may be lucky to get an email address that someone will answer. It wasn’t  as if this was a cheap ticket. If you need any kind of money back, including for a flight cancellation, then after they have helped themselves to a sizeable slice of your pie, you may wait months without any updates or contact.

Consequently I missed the flight and they would neither provide a refund or reroute me to the next flight. I reported the forgotten baggage to immigration desk at 7:50 PM and was attended to by the airport staff at 9 PM for a flight at 9:35 PM. I had 35 minutes to redo the security check, claim the forgotten luggage and take the airport train to the gate - an impossible feat to achieve!

This time from Bangkok to Frankfurt round trip. The first leg was day flight which we enjoyed very good service. The check-in was smooth and the aircrew onboard were friendly and helpful. We enjoyed a nice meal and drink served with efficient and fast service. During flight we also had snacks i.e. sandwich, fruit and soft drink. The flight was smooth and we arrived a little early than schedule. The second leg back to Bangkok was night flight. The check in which serviced by Lufthansa staff had some problem with my seat which was changed unnoticed but this was solved before our boarding. The service by aircrew on board was excellent eventhough the flight was fully booked. The food was very good and tasty both dinner and breakfast. Of course the crew privide some snacks during the flight which we were very much appreciated. We arrived on time. Excellent flight and service.
With a delay stretching five hours, the airline failed to provide customer service beyond the instruction to wait in limbo.  Neither sustenance nor refreshments were offered. Highly do not recommend.

Multiple attempts to get an attendant and they just keep turning the call light off until you give in. Food ordinary with no coffee served after the meal and no rubbish collected. Check in easy and quick. Baggage delay on arrival- more than 1.5h.

Food and service is sensational, Thai Airways never get this wrong. Inseat tv was slow to respond and ear phones are uncomfortable to wear. Got moved to a empty seat towards the front of the plane was very appreciated

The system charged me twice. I called immediately Thai Airways and the agent told me yes I see you will be refund in two weeks through your credit card. Two months after despite new calls to the airlines and many mails I do not receive any refund. I am a ROP member of Thai Airways and do not understand the behavior of the airline. Unbelievably dishonest. Cannot trust them any more.

The flight attendants were just that, very attentive. Food was of superior quality. The seat is large and comfortable. There are only two rows of 4 seats each in this cabin. As this was a morning flight I didn't sleep. At the airport, one is attended by an airline employee from check-in, through immigration and on to the first class lounge.

The Indian check in agent did her job, but there was no warmth or friendliness from her. Then one of our bags was put behind the check in desk while the others went down the belt. I had to insist firmly that the bag be put on the belt and I then watched it move on as far as I could.  Unfortunately boarding is run by Air India staff and I am so glad that I cancelled our original flight with them. Boarding was a shambles and once we got down to another jetbridge, Air India staff were waiting insisting on searching people's hand baggage. I was asked stupid questions like if i had any scissors, lighters etc - my reply was no, but these would have been picked up by security screening if they were in our bags. Finally we got to the aircraft and had the Thai crew in sight, what a relief to see some friendly faces. Once in our seats I made myself as comfortable as possible as I was not feeling well. Unfortunately the aircraft was stuck on the taxiway for about 20 minutes waiting to take off most likely due to the incompetence of Indian Air Traffic Controllers, but the crew did their best to keep us informed. I tried to sleep and did not eat any food offered to me, but my family said that it was inedible and they weren't sure what it was - certainly not food that would have come from Thailand. The seat was very uncomfortable - hard seat bottom and it did not recline, I had a sore back when we arrived in Bangkok 3 hours later. I was disappointed that the crew closed off the window shades so you couldn't look out the windows. There was a limited variety of inflight entertainment available, but adequate for a 3 hour flight - not enough for a long haul flight. On arrival, we got off the aircraft pretty quickly and as usual ... all of our bags were waiting for us by the time we arrived at the baggage belt. Back to the start - as I mentioned earlier, I insisted on staff putting my bag on the belt, not leaving it behind the counter. I assume that If I had just walked off, then that bag probably would not have made it past the counter - and a little surprise for anyone who would have opened it - my son had vomited over his clothes on the way to the airport and we put them in that bag before we went to the check in counter. Basically - make sure that all tags and bar code labels are removed from your bags before checking them in and make sure that you actually see your bags on the belt and moving down the belt before you leave the check in counter. This will reduce the risk of you losing your bags. We have gotten 3/4 of our way around the world so far and have not yet had any luggage go missing.

Not as good as Qatar/Emirates etc, but better than most. Service was excellent. Food was delicious, well presented. Good wines etc. Entertainment had a good choice. Flights roughly on time despite huge snowstorm in Stockholm. Good transfer service in BKK so kept connection. Very modern A350 plane. Overall, I would recommend them and would happily fly Thai again.
3 of the flights were delayed by 1+hrs. Due to the above I missed a connecting flight once, staff on the plane just laughed it off. Wouldn't be picking them again unless I had to.

Very good hard product, perfect in time, efficient check-in, lovely, friendly, caring crew, even their entertainment system has changed from below to good average and food was really satisfying. Even my flight from MUC to BKK one month before and my flights to and from CNX were convincing and the prices were not cheap, but very fair. I definitely recommend them again. Well done!
Flight attendants are friendly and helpful. Seats are comfortable and can be reclined easily. The food is delicious and fresh. Flights departed on time.

Thai Airways International (THAI) operated today's flight. The biggest change in the operation concerns the business-class food. Thai Smile used to give us a choice of 2 tasty Thai meals (often one with rice and one with noodles). On today's flight, THAI offered no choice. The meal was mediocre Western food: macaroni & chicken in a bland tomato sauce. The dessert was a nondescript cake with a few flakes of coconut on top, versus Thai Smile's usual offering of something that included a lot of fruit. Please bring back Thai food! Both Thais and foreigners like it!

Outward trip has a broken table and return trip ripped my jeans on sharp bit of metal not screwed in properly. Cabin crew wrote a report and took photos, was told to submit a claim to Thai Airways. Despite weeks of producing all documents and photos over emails has a reply saying nothing wrong with seat. Total rubbish and cabin crew report should have reflected this. Basically they are lying, they are now an airline without any credibility. Service is random and all round gone downhill. Have used them and EVA many times along with BA on this leg and sadly as BA have pulled out Thai service is now at rock bottom, no better than a budget airline trading on past glory!

I paid $485 for Business thinking it might be worth a more comfortable ride, even if it’s only an hour. Mistake. The economy and Business seats are exactly the same. Exactly. No privacy. No seat comfort. Nothing. It’s a total rip off. You are crammed together with people with smelly naked feet and your legs rammed against the seat in front listening to people broadcasting soap operas from their phone. What a joke. I’d ask for a refund but Thai Air probably couldn’t even manage that. My advice: just fly economy and save yourself $300. Obviously, I should have known.

Recently my family & me flew to Bangkok & back by TG-404 & returned by TG-409 flights (after nearly 7 years). The flight TG404 was full from Singapore & arrived 20 minutes late from Thailand & left 20 minutes late but arrived 10 minutes late only at Suvarnabhumi Airport. Service was a bit slow at start but Cabin crew was able to serve all passengers & clear the cabin in the short time of the flight. Unlike in the past, there was no drinks offered first but instead the Meal was served followed by drinks! Seems most airlines are doing this these days. We are Vegetarians & had ordered AVML meals on both flights. The meals were loaded in Bangkok itself & was in general satisfactory. However both meals to & from Bangkok were identical, AVML meals are normally served with Plain Yoghurt, but this was lacking. The toilets were clean & adequate. The aircraft seemed a shade Old but was clean & well maintained. Overall journey by Thai Airways was satisfactory.

Flight itself good, nice crew, good food and drink offerings. I tried to change the return to an earlier flight but I found the thai website really hard to use. Loads of seats unavailable on way out only to find a half empty flight. Needed to return earlier but impossible to do on the website which seems very old fashioned and unresponsive.

The flight was smooth from check-in to boarding. The seat was quite comfortable and we managed to have some sleep on the way. The breakfast is OK though not large portion. The service was very good and the cabin crew was quite nice friendly and attentive. On the way back to Bangkok we flew on Economy class. The check-in and boarding was smooth. The seat was very good and the entertainment onboard was OK. However, some of the crew were not attentive on our request (we asked for seat change and a cup of hot coffee but we did not received any response) while the young male crew was nice and responsive to our request for coffee and he did making hot coffee for us right away.

review_header: "wonder how they are still in business"
review_text: Eventually delayed the delivery twice, and the luggage never arrived. They provide complete pointless documents to say they did their part. Result: no luggage, no compensation, and the customer service saying it's not their problem. This and countless problem with all their aircraft, really wonder how they are still in business. Note: I'm gold card member.
Missed original flight due to an IT issue at the gate. Then given wrong information by the Thai staff over multiple days. Lots of money and time wasted. Horrible staff at Bangkok made problems worse.

This time we flew Business class which was very nice. The check-in which run by Lufthansa staff was OK. The cabin crew were very nice and friendly. The seat was quite comfortable and we were able to have some good 4-5 hours sleep along the route. The food was OK, we asked the young female cabin crew for something more hot and tasty. She brought us Hot Tom Yum noodle with onsen egg and shrimp ball which taste very good indeed. We also enjoy breakfast that they served. Overall it was a very nice and enjoyable flight. We flew economy class on the first leg from Bangkok to Frankfurt. The flight was OK but the food was not at their best. The cabin crew was nice and pleasant.

review_header: "seating was worn and looking very tired"
review_text: Then I ended up having a row of three to myself and then things changed. The food was really tasty and I managed to get about 6 hours sleep. This flight was on time, normally they have an hours delay.

They changed my aircraft type at the last minute and then told me my seat 16A was broken so they could not allow anyone to sit on it. So they downgraded me to 31A. Later I realized that they had some one seating in my seat, so it was all a big lie.
