On the aircraft, on the short hop to Phuket we weren’t offered a glass of water; interestingly the spare flight deck officer got a lovely meal, drink and attention from the crew,  people paying for the seat got nothing. The airline is awful and has made no attempt to improve itself, unless I am in an absolute emergency I will never fly with them again.

review_header: "1 year since I have asked for refund"
review_text: I believe that what the Airline is doing is not logical nor it is credible.

review_header: "seem to to be using COVID as an excuse to cut all costs"
review_text: Before flight needed to contact Thai Airways and all their phone lines are completely closed due to Covid. Only way to contact them is through email which they do not reply (still not received any reply after 6 weeks to an email sent before this flight) or Facebook messenger where they are unable to help with anything anyway. This fact alone should stop anyone booking with Thai Airways in the current Covid situation as if anything goes wrong that requires you to contact Thai Airways (which in the current situation is always a fairly high possibility) there is literally no way to contact them. As a comparison with my recent flight with Singapore Airlines they replied to emails within the hour, and phone calls within 2 minutes. Then the flight - Seats are the usual Thai Airways business class product. Nowhere near the best, but not bad and as expected. However for a 12 hour flight there was no inflight entertainment. Apparently due to risk of covid from people touching the screens. (Obviously that is completely different from people touching seats or trays). Far more important for safety should have been the used washbag that was still in my seat when I sat down, and the rubbish in my wife’s seat. Clearly Thai Airways cleaning measures during COVID are inferior to other airlines cleaning measures during normal times, let alone in the current situation. No WiFi. Didn't bother me as I rarely drink alcohol on planes, but for information purposes there is no alcohol available apparently due to Covid. Again for comparison Singapore Airlines inflight entertainment currently works fine. Clearly just a cost cutting measure from an airline in financial trouble. Which when paying a normal Business Class fare is just completely unacceptable. Poor quality food (economy class meal standard). Main served mostly cold. Of course being served on one tray is understandable in the situation, but what is not understandable is the pathetic quality. Again other airlines are still managing to serve good quality food. They frankly just seem to to be using COVID as an excuse to cut all costs and offer an appalling business product The only good thing that could be said about the whole experience is as usual the cabin crew were generally friendly when they were actually in the cabin. But that obviously does not make up for appalling food, no entertainment on a 12 hour Business Class Flight, no ability to contact anyone at the airline by phone to make changes to tickets (something that is actually more important during the current COVID situation, not less so), tired and worn seat, poor boarding procedures, uncompetitive carry on luggage for business class etc. Used to be a good airline (I have flown them many times before in First, Business and also Economy) but they have gone so far downhill I will never be flying them again unless I have a flight for which it is completely unavoidable. Would recommend people avoid them at all costs.

I encountered check-in problems both online and at the self-service kiosks, which already caused unnecessary stress. When I approached the staff for help, I was told to go to the counter only to be refused assistance because I was apparently 10 minutes late. I arrived at the counter around 8:35–8:40 AM for a 9:35 AM flight, and yet the staff informed me I should’ve been there before 8:30 AM. What makes this worse is the fact that the flight ended up being delayed and only took off at around 10:15 AM. This experience showed a real lack of customer care and flexibility.

Booked a 09:30 flight but still waiting for the flight even at 13:30. This is ridiculous. I would rather pay more than having my 2yo baby to wake up early just to wait in the airport for 5 hours. Better pick AirAsia, Scoot or Citilink.

So late departure at 6.55 pm. Flight kick off at 8.35pm. Better I can take late hours flight rather than at 6.55pm. Seriously unprofessional at all. All other flight can kick off on time what’s wrong with this flight.

Fabulous experience, smooth checkin, luggage included. Friendly attentive staff. Much more comfortable seats that either Air Asia or Jetstar. Good pricing. I have already booked another 2 flights. Impressive economy airline. 5 ⭐️ for the price you pay.

Batik Air is known for providing basic services without the frills, and it certainly lived up to that reputation. The seating arrangements on the plane were comfortable, but don't expect any luxurious features. The seats were standard with enough legroom for a short to medium-haul flight. However, the absence of in-flight entertainment and limited amenities made the journey quite straightforward. For those who prioritize a no-fuss travel experience, this may be a positive aspect. One notable issue was the apparent lack of thoroughness in the cabin crew's safety checks during the landing phase. It was concerning to observe that the crew did not seem as attentive as one would expect in ensuring that all passengers were securely seated and that all items were stowed away properly. The usual announcements and visual checks were noticeably absent, creating a sense of unease among passengers. Safety is paramount in air travel, and any oversight during critical phases of the flight, such as landing, is a cause for concern. It is imperative that the cabin crew conducts meticulous checks to guarantee the well-being of passengers. This lack of attention to detail on Batik Air raises questions about the airline's commitment to ensuring a safe travel experience.

They scheduled our flight without any notification. We know on Malaysian airport that out flight has been rescheduled from Malaysia to Nepal. don’t know what is a actual issue but they just said technical issue to us, the flight was cancelled from Malaysia to Kathmandu, and our transit time increased from 3 hours to 17 hours. We were around 12 passengers. Initially, they made a drama about providing accommodation, but after more than half an hour discussion, they finally gave us food and accommodation. And in morning I knew that there way more than 5 Nepalese passengers, they didn’t get any accommodation or facilities. I would not recommend Malindo Air or Batik Air based on this experience. And the service was OMG can’t able to explain.
They don’t give you food or water. You can’t even buy on plane. Service were terrible. Plane has no Tv monitor or charging station. Seats are really bad but you still pay lot of money.

First after touch down in Kuala Lumpur, we waiting for our baggage to be on belt for one hour. And when asked the ground staff, no answer was given and they are not sure was is happening. After going home with our luggage, during unpacking, realised that our luggage cracked. Have been traveling for so many times, this was the first time we encounter this problem.

Due to operational constraints Malindo cancelled the flight and put me on flight the next day, which would be useless for me as I was attending a family wedding and would be reaching after the wedding is over. They refused to give me a refund but instead gave me a credit which is really unbelievable. when I called customer service they refused to give me a refund for an issue that was entirely Malindo's.

New Year's Eve is not a busy time to fly and as expected the flight was only 60% full. The crew made a good first impression but the flaws started appearing early in the flight. Both lavatories had not a drop of soap in them and the crew confirmed they have no soap at all. The temperature inside the cabin was very cold and if this wasn't bad enough the air conditioning was blowing at full force. This was true even once we landed and waited to disembark. The onboard meals are reasonably priced but they come with only one a 350 ml water. The menu doesn't display prices for water bottles (only soft drinks) The cabin was clean and the crew provides good service.

review_header: "this issue remains unsolved after 4 months plus"
review_text: When tickets were purchased in July for my upcoming trip end of Dec 2022, my credit card charge vs tax invoice received did not match. They did not send me tax invoices for extra luggage. Since their e-ticket does not have any luggage info, I wanted the receipt. Numerous emails & calls to customer service, this issue remains unsolved after 4 months plus. I finally had to dispute charges through my credit card company. My kids are coming later on the same airline & the departure time has changed twice. This is impacting our bookings in KL. I tried to call them & was on hold for 2 hours & no one picked up. I finally hung up. After reading all the reviews, I pray we will actually depart as stated.

Flight schedule keep changing when your flight is nearby and the they don’t want to listen you. Never get any emails reply and they don’t provide any refund. So be careful before choosing this airlines.

Regret traveling with them. Flight got cancelled 4 days before, due to operational requirements. I had their travel insurance, which doesn’t cover that. They have zero care for passengers. They send me another ticket with missing connection flight. Their customer care never picked up the phone. I literally went to airport counter and got another ticket and ended up 14 hour transit time at KLIA airport. Try avoid flying with them and never buy their insurance. It’s a joke. Covers nothing.

Then I email 6x urgent email to recall me back. From my last experience, it take 1 month to reply which i already done travelling.  No reply, no answer. It seems that the air ticket just burn out like that? .
Then the time of return flight has changed back and forth twice. Come on? During the flight the staff does not really enforce the mask mandate. I won't fly with Batik/Malindo anymore.

Malindo cancelled our return flight KL to Perth at short notice causing us 4 days additional hotel, food and extra leave from unhappy employers, who served verbal notice. Malindo's response they don’t care, no compensation for our losses. Recommend using another airline
Refund requests submitted but ignored. When pushed, they will promise to process but they then go to ground and ignore you.

review_header: "Only advice is don't book any flights with this company!"
review_text: They dont give any money back but give travel vouchers. Anyway, we are now in a position to rebook our trips. The voucher says we have till the 20th May to rebook. I tried to rebook on the 12 May and entered the Travel voucher number only to be told that these vouchers had been used already! I have emailed Malindo in the past and it usually takes them a month to reply so it looks like we have lost our money! Over $1000 lost! No point trying to ring them as others say they cant get through! Only advice is don't book any flights with this company!

50pm flight today and it was delayed until 8.50pm. Sms told covid restriction by MKN.  Really mad. How come you delay a flight to such a long period and it is only fly locally. Keep your promise. Very bad service. Not even a complimentary voucher meal given to your passenger.  Will not fly this airline again.

Generally not great and not terrible. This trip im extremely disappointed with Malindo. Our mid morning flight was cancelled and changed to 8:30 am. Then 3 days before flight, it was changed to 7 pm. Basically our whole day has been destroyed. I thought I’d help Malindo by flying them but now regret not sticking to the competitor.

review_header: "Is this legal to hold our money"
review_text: The flight was cancelled from Malindo side stating the reason for covid. it has been more than 1-1/2 years now and when contacted to Malindo air in October 2021, they replied to my email that the Malindo flights are not operational from Kuala Lumpur to any part of India. Is this legal to hold our money and be in mercy of Malindo. There are bubble flights operational with other flights (Air Asia etc) and I need to travel urgently to India. I have asked for refund via email communication but the email reply / process from Malindo side is very slow.

review_header: "I would not trust them not to cancel again"
review_text: I went direct to the airline at much more expense thinking booking direct would be a safer option. Within a day of receiving my booking and money they sent me an email bringing the flight forward by 2 hours. The next day they sent me an email cancelling the flight altogether and offering me a flight the next day due to operational reasons. When I contacted them, they informed me that they would only issue a voucher not a refund. I cannot use this voucher and had to book another airline to get to my connecting flight. This is totally outrageous as they cancelled the flight and cannot provide the service that was paid for. So they just keep everyone’s money and hope that you can’t use the voucher. The voucher is totally useless to me and in light of their behavior with this last flight even if I could use the voucher I would not trust them not to cancel again. Travel is stressful enough as it is in the pandemic, but to refuse to give a refund when the cancellation is totally the fault of the airline is just plain wrong.

I was offered a voucher but declined - they don't fly enough routes I'd want to use. Eventually they agreed to a refund (after many emails). Since then I've chased every month. I keep being told it's being passed to another department for payment but over a year later - no refund.

Only received a year after I requested it. If not because of the travel voucher, I wont use this airline anymore. Not worth your money at all. Customer service also very bad. Didn't reply to customer's email, if you didn't call to ask about the email, they won't reply to it and respond to it. Too many times the flight was cancelled but they didn't help at all to assist to get the new flight date. Customer call centre also very hard to reach. I called hundred times but too hard to answer. You cannot call using your mobile phone because cannot press "1" or "2" to choose English or Bahasa.  Email didnt respond, call cannot reached - the worst airline ever!

Flight cancelled in early March 2020. Cannot seem to get a refund after months of emails and phone calls. Consistent lying and unforeseen delays, I believed this excuse at the beginning but it has been over a year now and really don't believe this is a legitimate airline.

1st flight delayed by 1.5 hours which left us very little time for our connecting flight. We were told by the cabin crew that staff would be waiting at the gate to guide us to our connecting flight. At the gate, the staff just said go look at the board. We raced across the other side of the airport only to find that the connecting flight was also delayed & hadn’t arrived. Whilst this was a relief that we hadn’t missed it, surely the ground staff should have known this. We arrived in Vietnam & our luggage was lost so we had to go out & buy some essentials. Wanting to keep our expenses to a minimum, we went to the local market & purchased 1 tshirt & 1 shorts each & some toiletries & had to get the market stall holders to write out a receipt. We still had no baggage the following day so we purchased another t-shirt & I needed a hat. In total we spent £66 (£33 each) on essentials to keep us going until luggage arrived. We were without our luggage for 56 hours. It has now been over a month since the holiday & Malaysia Airlines are refusing to reimburse us because the receipts were hand written. They say it’s their ‘policy’ but they refuse to provide a copy of their policy.

Staff said because of bad weather. But 2 flight after mh0720, fly first. I lost my 1 night hotel, my time. Also your ticket not consider the cheap one to Kuala Lumpur. If you want the better statistic of delayed, better not sacrifice 1 flight to delayed to 8 hours waiting.

It s an old A330-200 but still comfortable and clean. The best of all was the inflight crew. The food is just ok. The only issue was the security check during boarding. Its the airport services that was a little bit chaotic. Boarding follow the group number, and some passengers were sent to the back when trying to cut the queue.

They made me pay another £400 to change my flight and were unsupportive during a horrible time when someone just needs help and for things to be made a little easier. I will never fly with this airline again.
Flight crews were impeccable, friendly and very helpful.

A complaint was sent only to be told that the airline reserves the right to modify the aircraft as stated in the general conditions of carriage and that he can elect to ask for a refund - subject of course to the terms and conditions of the ticket originally purchased.

review_header: "service on board was efficient and friendly"
review_text: So we ended up in the middle seats, which were comfortable but with limited storage. They felt a bit claustrophobic, having no direct sightline to a window. The service on board was efficient and friendly. The vegetarian food and drink offerings were good, and the plane operated on time.In Melbourne MH uses the Merhaba lounge, which was comfortable with a reasonable range of food and drink options.

30pm at Tawau Airport due to flight was delayed from KLIA. I need to thank the Cabin Crew for their genuine and friendly service. Mr Ahmad, Mr Ron, Miss Ain have a positive and excellent customer service with sincerity.

Flight was on time. Departure process was very efficient by group number. Priority seats provided at the from of waiting lounge. Crew were friendly and efficient but not extra ordinary like the outbound crew that I experienced two days before. No choice of food this time although passengers get different kind, no explanation. The Roti Jala with chicken curry were delicious. I got my baggage early as promised by the priority tag. Cabin was clean and the seat which was the old type is very comfortable for short domestic flight. Overall satisfied with the whole experience.

The old seat configuration of the 737 aircraft, which I found to be very comfortable for a slightly less than one-hour flight. This time, the cabin crew were friendly, attentive, and interactive. The best I have ever seen and experienced. Boarding according to the group was followed by ground staff. Pre-departure drinks were served, and food order taken by the cabin crew. Two choices are offered to business class passengers: chicken sandwich and chicken satay, which were more than adequate and delicious. Upon arrival, the cabin crew thanked me for flying Malaysia Airlines. I was highly satisfied with the overall experience=.

Old A330-200. Exit row seat at the front of economy, thank goodness as leg room further back looked minimal. Old aircraft, reasonably comfortable though. Service was ok, food fine. Portions on the small side. IFE limited selection. KL to Amritsar in Business. Business lounge in KL very pleasant with good food selection. Fairly new aircraft, comfortable recliner seats. Service was excellent with a lovely flight attendant looking after us. Only 4 of us in the cabin. Food delicious. How I love their sate service. Entertainment via Wifi which I don’t like. Choice was better than first leg. Bags took a while to arrive. Overall a good experience.

Check in at Amritsar ok, confusion trying to get through to customs. After arguing I got through. Business lounge at Amritsar dreadful, an issue with the airport and not the airline. Once on board service was lovely and food delicious, again with the wonderful sate service. Entertainment the same as before. Arrived on time in Kuala Lumpur and an easy transit. Kuala Lumpur in economy on new A330-900, with extra legroom seat. What a lovely aircraft to fly in. Economy seat really comfortable with generous recline. Service and food good, entertainment via a very responsive large screen. Better choices here. Arrived on time in Auckland and luggage off quickly.

The original booking was with an A330 operating between Perth and KL and this was changed to a 737-800. This meant we ended up with a 5 hour and 40 minute flight with the most uncomfortable seats I have experienced, Plus trying to get a refund for the seat arrangement we paid for was next to impossible after much communication. They apologised for leaving Perth almost an hour late, but I don’t know why they don’t change their schedule as looking over previous departures, late departure occurs almost every flight. The KL to London leg on the A350 was a much better service, although I don’t know why they offer wifi access when it is unusable. .

Our flight from Penang got delayed and when we got to KL, we only had 45 minutes before departure of the Jakarta flight. The lines at the immigration counters were long and no staff was there to assist. We had to ask passengers ahead of us at the immigration line to let us through if possible as our flight to Jakarta was only a few minutes before take off. When we got to the boarding gate, I asked the staff why no airline staff was at immigration to assist. They said, they cannot do anything as immigration is by the government.

Pleased with the 36" extra legroom seats and cabin crew were good. Asked for G&T which was rather potent but had no cause to complain. I was offered another one with certainly helped with sleep on this thirteen hour duration of the second London bound flight. Flight arrived half hour early and baggage unloaded efficiently.

However, despite your spouse (who also requested a veg meal suggests you swap seats on the long haul, it certainly makes a flight attendant frown - we're both the same surname btw) Now, given what happened with the Singapore Airlines incident in bad turbulence last year, does it really warrant a ban on hot drinks due to an odd bump or small bounce? The second flight was great, but leg room was a bit tight. However, thank you to the attendant who asked the woman in front to realign her seat because I couldn't get my tray table down.

As the new aerotrains are not yet commissioned, Business Class passengers are transported to the satellite terminal by a fleet of Mercedes EQS electric limousines and very nice they are too!! We used the Golden Lounge in the satellite terminal, a good choice of food was available but disappointing that the buffet food was luke warm and a bit concerning from a food safety perspective. Boarding was slightly delayed and the flight was then further delayed while they waited for connecting passengers coming from Denpasar. Flight eventually departed around 40 minutes late. My wife and I were seated in seats D and G, both with direct aisle access, much needed on an overnight flight. The meal service was disappointing, I had the tenderloin, which wasn’t! and the vegetables were poorly cooked, my wife had the chicken which she was also disappointed with. I have been using Malaysian Airlines for about 30 years and this was my first poor experience with the catering. For the first few hours of the flight over the Bay of Bengal, the flight was very turbulent and they were unable to serve coffees, etc. No fault of the Airline. Cabin crew service was however very good as usual. The toilets were also kept very clean and stocked throughout the flight. Flight arrival into LHR was further delayed due to air-traffic congestion over Turkey so we finally arrived around 40 minutes late. No queue at immigration at T4 and the bags delivered promptly. Overall a slightly underwhelming flight on Malaysia Airlines, hopefully the catering was a blip as the airline offers a good product and reasonable pricing into the SE Asia region.

During boarding, the lead crew in red colour is standing at the gate to warmly welcome all passengers with a great smile, the crew demonstrated a level of hospitality that exceeded my expectations. 1>. The lead crew manager in particular stood out, helping the team with economy class drink service even after finishing their duties in business class. This showed impressive leadership and teamwork. During the meal service, the crew team carefully put ice in the cup. They remember my request. As the economy class toilet is full of passengers, the lead crew member guides me to use the business class toilet.  The announcement is very clear with a warm feeling of hospitality in dual languages. I ordered a special non-vegetarian meal on my flight, and I was thoroughly impressed. The chicken dish with Malaysian sauce was delicious - I would rate the meal quality as 5-stars.The boarding process is smooth and well organized.  The web-check in is easy to use. My flight is from Bangkok to Singapore via Kuala Lumpur. I can get two digital boarding passes from digital check-in without any system issues. The auto-checkin feature is available too. This aircraft does not have IFE as it is a 2 hours 20 mins short haul flight. However, all passengers can connect to MH studio by their own devices. There are many entertainment selections from movies, TVs. The only reason I don't rate five star is to compare with Singapore Airlines, Emirates, and those global premium carriers that provide IFE for all flights. However it is value for money for the level of entertainment I received. I would not hesitate to fly with Malaysia Airlines again and would highly recommend the airline to others.

review_header: "I could not board with two items"
review_text: At around 2 AM, while boarding in Perth Airport, I was harassed by the ground staff simply for carrying a 3kg laptop bag in addition to my hand luggage, the staff insisted that I could not board with two items. I pointed out that several other passengers were carrying two items, yet I was the only one targeted. My friend, who had no hand luggage, kindly offered to take my laptop bag, but the staff refused this reasonable solution. To make matters worse, the supervisor of the Perth Airport ground handling team rudely harassed my friend, telling them to board immediately or risk missing the flight. She then gave me an ultimatum, demanding that I choose within three seconds which bag to take—or be denied boarding. I was forced to leave behind my Samsonite handbag. After filing a formal complaint, I was met with zero accountability from the airline. Instead of acknowledging their unprofessional behaviour and poor customer service, they dismissed my complaint, claiming they were simply following procedures. Not even a basic apology was offered.

Used the Plaza Premium Lounge, ok but nothing special. Flight boarded slightly late but the boarding process was well managed. Cabin was clean and included the latest short haul business class seat, comfortable and ample legroom for a short flight. Even on a 45 minute flight business class passengers get a hot meal, in this case chicken satays, which were very tasty. Flight landed on schedule and baggage already on the belt by the time we had walked from the gate. Good experience with Malaysia Airlines.

Business Class passengers on Malaysia Airlines have access to the Qatar Airways lounge, which is excellent and we enjoyed a nice light breakfast before the flight. Malaysia use A350-900 for the flight to KL and my wife and I had chosen seats D and G meaning that both seats have aisle access. Malaysia Airlines cabin crew are some of the best in the industry and as always the service was very good. The meal service starts with signature satays, followed by smoked salmon, for the main course I tried the Malaccan-style seabass fillet, very tasty. An area where Malaysia Airlines could improve is in the in-flight entertainment, the choice of films is quite limited and well below the standard of airlines such as Emirates. Flight arrival into KL was 30 minutes ahead of schedule, which left quite a long transfer time for our connection to Penang. The Malaysia Airlines lounge in the domestic departures area is ok, but can get very busy. Our onward flight to Penang was on an B737-800, one of the upgraded aircraft with new business class seats and WiFi based entertainment system, which you use with your own device. We did not use this for such a short flight. We were impressed with the service on this 45 minute flight, which included a small hot meal. Arrival into Penang was on schedule and the bags were delivered promptly. Overall a great couple of flights with Malaysia Airlines.

Overall vey satisfied with the experience. An exceptional service by the friendly cabin crew. The airline offers an exceptional value for money. The economy class cabin very clean and features new seats and wi-fi entertainment using own device. The food is good for a domestic flight. In both sectors, boarding by groups and strictly follow. The ground staff is good but can be better. For one and half hour flight am not complaining.

review_header: "haven't paid me the money they owe me"
review_text: A few days before my flight on the 26th January 2025 I decided to go online to check everything was ok with my flight. I noticed that my seat booking had disappeared from my account, so I sent an email along with a copy of my receipt which showed my seat reservation to Malaysian Airlines asking them to rectify the problem. They replied saying they would respond within 14 days, so the next day I phoned their office in Hong Kong, They were as useful as a chocolate fire guard! A couple of days before my flight I logged in to my account and paid around £35 for an isle seat which was a rip off in the hope of getting a refund later. As soon as I made the purchase I got an email from Malaysian Airlines saying they were sorry for the inconvenience they'd caused me and that they would refund me MYR 120.00 within 14 to 21 days. I had to send them yet another email pointing out that they owed me MYR 189.75. Malaysian Airlines still haven't paid me the money they owe me, nor have they replied to any of my other emails.
The crew very helpful and nice. Will fly again for sure. Writing this review from the air between China and Malaysia!

However, HNML (Non Veg Meal) was served by the right aisle crew. The passenger was not familiar with the codes, hence opened the food and could only then identify the contents as meat which made her very uneasy, and fortunately did not consume it. When the female attendant on the left aisle who was nearby informed, she was angry that the food package was opened and did not have any regrets about the wrong diet being served which is a grave mistake. No way this would have happened in top a rated airline like Singapore or Qatar.
The cabin manager checked I was OK. The food was great, drinks plentiful. The satay is amazing and I was offered more. The IFE was good. The wifi less so. Happy with Malaysian hospitality.

Received an email but the new flight time was not updated.  The cabin crew offered a meal right away but after that they were not to be seen. The flight was originally scheduled to last 3 hours, which seems to be the limit for serving alcoholic beverages but nothing was loaded on this flight. The seat belt sign was on for the most of the flight.

Staff was greeted with poor behavior from the beginning of this flight. After take off, we were served with a breakfast which was terrible. For the meal, I opted for Nasi Lemak, but it ran out when the crew reached me. I opted for the Beef option. The Satay on the other hand was ok, but not special. The entertainment was poor and lack of choices. The WIFI is slow even though it was free.

Boarding was smoothly handled, and I was greeted, addressed by name and pointed to my seat. There are just 12 recliner seats in a 2x2 layout. The 39-inch seat pitch was perfectly adequate as I settled down. Pre-flight drinks were served and I opted for orange juice. The cabin was full. I briefly explored the seat functions. The cabin colour scheme is blue, from the seat to the pillow and blanket in shades of blue. The recline buttons were on the armrest as in older narrow-body aircraft. The tray table could be pulled out from under the armrest. A small pop-out tray for drinks did not seem sturdy enough in case of turbulence. No seat back TVs. Instead is the personal electronic device (PED) shelf clips open to hold your phone or tablet. Having been used to seat back monitors, I just could not be bothered to go through the process of connecting to Malaysia Airlines Studio streaming entertainment. Besides, the phone would be too far away from my seating position. I observed no one in the cabin was making use of the IFE either. Soon after take off, menus were handed, and I chose Red Snapper curry with rice, which was delicious. This was followed by coffee. A second round of drinks was also served, by the attentive cabin crew. It was an uneventful flight, yet very comfortable and relaxing. And enjoying the views from my window seat the hour and fifty minute flight arrived in Bangkok on time.

We drove all the way from Canberra to the airport, only to be told the flight was canceled. No prior communication, no warning, just canceled. Even our travel agent, who booked the tickets, was only notified two hours before the flight.  How is that even acceptable? We were offered nothing but a hotel stay for the night and rebooked on a flight the next afternoon. And all we got was a cold, almost robotic, “Sorry for the inconvenience.” That’s it. As if those four words could somehow undo the chaos you caused in our lives. Our hotel reservation in Malaysia was canceled without a refund. We had to rebook a domestic flight with AirAsia, incurring extra fees. And worst of all, we lost a whole day of our holiday—a day we had planned and saved for months in advance.

It was almost a full cabin from Kuala Lumpur to Jakarta but only about 50% load in the return flight. The total flight time is about 1 hour 50 minutes for both sectors. The flight was on time on the outbound and about 30 minutes delayed on the return. Crews were attentive, friendly, and cheerful, especially on the return flight as they interacted more with passengers. Food and beverages were adequate for short regional flights. The same also goes for entertainment. They imposed systematic boarding based on the zone and as a member, I was provided with the benefits. Overall satisfied with the service and hard products. Not a five-star but absolutely more than a 4-star airline.
The food Nasi Lemak was delicious and peanuts were given to passengers. Inflight entertainment varied and functioning well.
Fantastic flight. Boarding excellent, service excellent and small meal excellent. Very good disembarkation and Phuket, and great arrival experience. Excellent for short haul flight

Both flights were on time despite the heavy rain on the return sector. The cabin crew was friendly, attentive, and smiling throughout the flight. Personally greeting the top tier members in the cabin. Old aircraft in both sectors and the outbound aircraft have one seat with a footrest malfunction. Fortunately, it remains vacant throughout the flight. The food was delicious catering to the local taste, satay, and roti jala for a very short domestic flight. The ground handling staff was doing their job efficiently during the boarding process but this can be improved further. Apart from the old aircraft, the whole experience especially the inflight service deserves a five-star rating.

No info from the ground agent until other passenger found out by the late arriving of the new set flight crew. It was a full flight, during boarding we already can stream the wireless ife, wifi via own device and it run smooth. A new movie Twisters is presented. A 30" pitch seat is not a good idea but with USB A/C ports added point. All seats have a fold-down device holder and a mineral water and small packet nuts provided for this short 29 mins flight then we reach KUL smoothly.

Com. Three persons booked a flight from Goa to Kuala Lumpur for an urgent meeting, leaving at 7.50am using Indigo on a code share. We were given boarding passes for two flights. The reason for booking this flight was we had a very important meeting in KL for business on the 15th which necessitated us being in KL the evening before. Once we arrived at Chennai at 9.30am, we proceeded to the next flight. The flight was initially delayed and at 12.15pm, 30 minutes after departure, the flight was cancelled. 15 minutes after this we got an e-mail from Malayasia Airlines informing us the flight was cancelled. The ground crew provided no information and over 100 people can attest to this. We were not told of our rights, nor were we offered assistance in rebooking. Due to urgency of the meeting we booked another flight with Indigo at 10.15pm on the 14th November 2024. In this instance and under international travel law, we are entitled to a full refund of the flight and compensation for the delay which was 11 hours. We have also lost out on the hotel booked in KL. It has happened to my family on a previous occasion from London. It is unacceptable that refunds are not offered on the day and we have to beg for monies back.

Unfortunately for us, Malaysian Airlines decided to suddenly cancel a whole batch of flights including ours and my sister-in-law's identical route flight one month later. No refund was offered, at the late notice that they cancelled, there were no alternative flights available within 24 hours. Our travel agent had to reroute us with another airline through a different country (Indonesia). We incurred an extra nights accommodation, had to rebook our connecting flights in Sydney and 2 travellers missed a heavily scheduled day at work (we are self employed) as we arrived 24 hours later than scheduled. Even though we had paid Business class, they did not include lounge costs when we had an 8 hour layover - tough on my 83 year old mother travelling with us. Worst of us, they were impossible to contact, deny all responsibility for the cost incurred and only reply with automated emails or no reply at all. I will NEVER fly with this airline again. I cannot give about 1 for the ratings below because we had NO flight.

As frequent travelers, my partner and I often purchase economy tickets and place bids to upgrade to business class. With other airlines, once upgraded, business class passengers enjoy the same benefits, regardless of how the ticket was obtained. However, Malaysia Airlines takes a different approach. The airline advertises a 40 kg baggage allowance for “Basic” business class and 50 kg for “Flex” business class. Yet, upon check-in, we were told we could only bring 20 kg each, with the rest subject to additional charges. Apparently, if you purchase business class through a bid, you’re only allowed 20 kg—a crucial detail that is nowhere to be found on the main baggage allowance page. Instead, it’s on a separate MHUpgrade page, which only mentions an “extra 10 kg” without clarity on how this compares to the regular business class allowance. The result is a frustrating lack of transparency, leading to unexpected fees and a poor customer experience. I would strongly advise against flying Malaysia Airlines if you expect clear policies and consistent treatment.

The flight MH 149 on 28 October was one of the most unpleasant experiences, especially concerning two of the cabin crew. The supervisor and his assistant were quite pleasant. Two other staff were unpleasant, never smiling. They gave us the impression the passengers are a nuisance to them. My partner asked for a pair of slippers and he just said “later” and walked away and never delivered the slippers, while in the other three flights the slippers were put on our seats. The toilets were dirty. Two crew members sit in the galley and talking to each other. In the morning after breakfast I could not find a tooth brush in the toilet, I went to the galley to tell the supervisor there was no tooth brush, in turn he asked the female crew member but she ignored him, he felt embarrassed and opened the cupboard to take out a bag of tooth brushes and gave me one. Another passenger told the same woman that there was no toilet paper in the toilet and she ignored him. During the flight they never offered me drinks or snacks. . After serving the satays they just disappeared from the cabin till in the morning. In contrast the crew on MH148 on 27 September and flights MH 53 on 20 October were very professional and proactive. They were walking around all the time asking passengers if they needed a drink or snacks. This is not the Malaysian hospitality they advertised

Tickets had been booked at least eight months before flight dates and all legs were Business Class. About ten days before the flights I received an email from Malaysia Airlines simply stating that their flight to Perth, my flight, had had a schedule change and my wife’s booking had been changed with no further explanation - not a word. Nothing about my booking. Upon closer inspection I saw that her flight was now two days later. We were unable to change our booking to fly from Heathrow to KL with penalty so we had to fly to KL and wait two days for the rescheduled flight. Malaysia Airlines offered no explanation, no support and no compensation for additional time and expenses incurred. If this is how they treat Business Class passengers I hate to think how they would be treating Economy Class passengers. Have tried to contact Malaysia Airlines. Have contacted Malaysia Airlines complaints line only twice only to be responded to that my case would be reviewed and they would get back to me.
Great service and food options on both legs of the journey. Seats on the second leg Kuala Lumpur to Hanoi a bit small and no entertainment screens.
Tey gave us free wifi for the whole flight. Amazing crew, very well dressed and they have the best food! I would certainly recommend Malaysia Airlines.
Special thanks to cabin crew Mr Ramzi and Ms Lo for being friendly and helpful! Lunch is tasty and kid meals delicious as well.

The help line advised me to buy a second ticket and my first ticket would be refunded. It has been 5 months I am calling them madly using international talk time for hours and every time they ask me to wait for a reply from finance team. Until now they didn't even let me know the status of my case. They simply scammed my money. They have all call recordings with them but they don't do any email communication.

Boarding well organized. The B738 was one of the refurbished planes with a free and bright interior. Food decent for this 2h flight. Flight attendants friendly. Just a few blanket available for the 150+ pax on this very cold flight. Overall recommended

review_header: “refused to let me bring my baby jogger travel pram”
review_text: They refused to let me bring my baby jogger travel pram on the plane despite me having purchased two business class seats. This was my only carry on and they still refused to let me bring it saying there was not space. I had paid for the space with my tickets. I do not recommend using this airline if you have small kids based on my experience.

Stuffed up both. Seat 28a, 28c on A330-300 and return flight 28c / 28h. They charge people $70 per seat upgrade paid you $280 on my exit row seats. Some how ground staff muck around on both flights and staff don't fix their mistakes.

A333 older aircraft,  touch screen poor. Cabin crew great, food quality improved. KUL to LHR A359 newer aircraft, quiet and crew very good. Food quality very good Champagne Duval Leroy good, other wines could be improved. Kabuli Pulao / Ayam Perchek excellent. MAS has certainly improved.

Every flight was delayed some by 7 hrs or more. Cabin staff were surly. We booked extra luggage and they dropped it from the return flights and tried charging 700USD to take the amount we had already paid for. They were a good airline, but I will never fly them again.
Ground staff very helpful, delicious food
My flight was cancelled 3 times over 3 different days and on the last day the flight they put me on had a crazy long layover. The service was unacceptable too. Avoid this airline.

During checked in, I showed them our GB Pockit pram with a non GB Pockit bag. The check in staff gave us an all okay to use this and can be kept in the overhead cabin as well. Unfortunately the flight attendant on the plane lectured us that it is not acceptable and was telling me that this can be offloaded because it was not safe. I have used the same pram and bag in Singapore Airlines with no problems at all and I made the due diligence to ask in the check in counter as well. What I didn’t like was the manner and attitude of this flight attendant in dealing with us. I don’t want to argue anymore because it’s already stressful traveling with a nonverbal autistic toddler. My husband and I were anxious whole flight it was a traumatic experience and MAS should train their staff on how to deal with passengers with special kids. I was expecting some empathy considering that their check in staff said it’s all good to bring on board. Appalling and disgusting experience overall!

Friendly welcome by purser, was addressed by name throughout the flight. New upgraded cabin with comfortable seats and well functioning streaming IFE with an IPad holder where the screen used to be, good choice of movies. The usual good and hearty Malay catering. MH started giving out beer for flights under 3hours. Friendly and efficient staff, highly recommended.
Boarding well organized, flight uneventful, on time, they even served a snack and water on this 45 min flight; recommended!

Boarding began 20 minutes prior to departure and the flight departed on-time. The cabin crew were friendly and welcoming. I had the new narrowbody interior without IFE. Instead, wireless IFE was provided called MHStudio. I must admit it was absolutely annoying trying to connect to the WiFi and watch movie without buffers and lag. I only managed to watch the movie 45 minutes into the flight. I was too frustrated and exhausted to watch anything and went to sleep instead. The seat was quite uncomfortably hard and narrow. On the positive side, the lasagna did not disappoint me, although I wished the portion was larger.

The aircraft had been recently refurbished, and looks bright, clean an comfortable. New wifi based entertainment system on own device worked well, with a decent choice of entertainment options. There were 3 meal options on this 2h flight, which was good in quantity and quality. Service was impeccable. Transit in KL was smooth, short flight to Singapore touched down 20 min ahead of schedule. The only negative point was that my high upgrade bid was unsuccessful, despite a half empty business class section. Overall, highly recommended

She even recognised that I flew in her fight a few days ago from Sydney to Kuala Lumpur. She even remembered the drink I ordered. That shows the wholehearted service by this crew member. I was really impressed with her quality service in both flights.
The cabin crew were attentive. The food was good. They installed a new seat with no in-flight display screen but you can use your phone and tablet to watch movies etc after connected to wifi.

The Marhaba lounge was basic but comfortable. The boarding process for business class passengers was muddly as there was no clear queue. Once onboard the welcome was friendly and I was pleased that there was a vegetarian version of the satay offered to all passengers early in the flight. All the vegetarian food served was of a high quality. Seating was 1-2-2 across the cabin. The pairs of seats by the window were narrower than the others and had less storage space - best to avoid these. Strangely there were no signs to indicate whether the toilets were occupied. The plane operated close to time. Overall a good experience for the price.

The first leg flight landed late due to bad weather, told the cabin crew and ground staff that we have connecting flight in 30 minutes. The cabin crew actually did help by informing the ground staff, however there were no ground staff waiting for us at our arrival gate. We had to ask a ground staff that passes by, but were no good help anyway. We were struggling to follow the airport signage heading to the connecting flight gate, but we made it at least. Fortunately, the connecting flight also delayed due to the weather (by 40 minutes!). The flight itself was great, cabin crew were friendly and the food served was delicious. The seat is quite hard and the IFE is sometime unresponsive. Overall, a mediocre flight.

Got the IFE interior but I was too tired to watch any movies, only open the flight info display and slept most of the flight. The noodle with chicken was surprisingly excellent after having it several times over the years. However, the rest of the meal (bun, fruit, and pudding) was decent at best (could be worse I guess). The cabin crew were very friendly, though they were quite busy as there were VIPs in the flight.

The cabin crews were friendly and provided excellent hospitality. The interior of the flight was new and I like the blue color. The seat was pretty hard and it does not have headrest which is a shame. Legroom were fine for a 5'8 guy despite more seats than the previous interior. USB charging ports are available for each seat, but cannot be used during takeoff and landing. The airline replaced its IFE with MHstudio, which is a web-based streaming platform. You have to use your own device, connect to the inflight WIFI (pretty laggy), and open the website to enjoy the entertainments available. Options were great for movies, TV shows, and music. Unfortunately, there is no flight information visual display. The meal I chose was Salmon Frittata and it was pretty disappointing. The portion of the frittata was about 20% of the whole meal, along with one sausage and potato wedges. The pineapple bun and yogurt was decent. The fruit and salted peanut was the star of the meal.

Onboard is the old interior with IFE installed. Seat was slightly hard, and the IFE is sort of responsive. The cabin crew were great despite the late evening flight. Once cruising, the crew serves dinner where I chose chicken with rice. The meal was decent, hot rice and nicely cooked chicken, but slightly bland. The marble cake and salted peanut was excellent (as usual). Overall, the flight was decent for the airline's standard.

My suitcase has a double zip and is a top brand. I remember the captain telling us in KUL that the flight was delayed due to heavy rain and delays in loading the luggage despite boarding completed. Also initially the flight was delayed by 2 hours. I send a message to Malaysia Airlines with photo of the wet clothes. They answered that they did not find any evidence on their side (meaning I was lying?) and that MA will not pay any compensation, that I never ask for. The only objective of my message was to improve passenger luggage handling. It's not about to happen in the future. So after 2 and half hours delay, we start the flight to Langkawi, and we get a small bag of peanuts and a bottle water.
This is poor from Malaysia who are trying to cost cut probably due to pressures from AirAsia.

The check-in process in Auckland was smooth and efficient, which was appreciated. I had booked and paid for extra legroom seats, but I noticed that many of the front-end extra seats were empty throughout the flight. This was disappointing as I had specifically paid extra for these seats for comfort. Furthermore, there was a problem with the entertainment unit in my seat, as the touch system was not functioning properly. Despite informing the flight attendants about the issue, I was told that it couldn't be fixed. As a result, I requested to move to a different seat with a functioning entertainment system. However, I was informed that there were no seats available, even though I noticed that there were empty seats in the front rows. I also observed a lady with an infant who was seated in front of us. Her mother, who was supposed to be seated in the front row with the infant bassinet, was moving around, leaving the infant unattended. I requested the flight attendant to ask the lady to return to her allocated seat so that we could use the empty seat for a working entertainment system. However, I was informed that they were unable to ask her to move. Overall, I was disappointed with the lack of assistance and the unavailability of the seats despite the circumstances.

Our flight was booked through SriLankan Airlines but the final flight was scheduled to be operated by Malaysia Airlines. At the check in desk in Male, Maldives, the Sri Lanka Airlines representative gave us the boarding passes for our first two flights and informed us we needed to ‘pick up the boarding passes for our third flight at the transfer desk in Colombo or Kuala Lumpur’. The rep did not say we weren’t checked in for this third flight, and confirmed our luggage was also due to make the full journey across the three flights without the need for us to collect or recheck baggage. At the Colombo Airport transfer desk the staff member told us we needed to collect our boarding passes in Kuala Lumpur, which was surprising as this information differed from what the first Sri Lanka Airlines rep told us in Male. Our flight from Colombo to KL landed around 25 minutes late and it then took around 15 minutes to disembark and reach the transfer desk at KLIA. We immediately went to the desk and got there around 7.40am. We spoke to someone on the right side of the desk (separate to the Malaysia Airlines section), and they asked to see our flight itinerary. Given our flight was due to be operated by Malaysia Airlines and the staff member had started serving someone else, we then saw there was a separate transfer desk for Malaysia Airlines. We immediately headed to the long queue at around 7.50am. Although the line was long, we expected it would move at a reasonable pace. After taking turns in the line to use the restroom, when my husband and I were both in the line waiting together we soon realised it was not moving. There was one staff member serving the huge number of passengers and seemingly requiring 10 minutes or more per passenger. We heard others around us talk of their flight time with the two women in front of us saying their flight was prior to ours. Passengers were pushing in the line with disorder in the queue. Many people jumped the line saying they still needed to check in or had children. There was also a very large group being served in one line and they appeared to be at the front of the queue for almost the entire time we were waiting. By the time we finally reached the front of the line around 9am, the staff member rudely spoke to us and told us we missed check in 25 minutes prior. We told her we were waiting over an hour in the queue to which she said she called our names, and she accused us of not being in the queue the entire time.  The staff provided no resolution for us but to rebook our flights, so we proceeded to the gate regardless and again were turned away despite our gate still being open. We were given no option to board our flight.

Due to that none of us could eat anything excepts some fruits and croissants. Before my return i requested to have my meal changed to jain veg meals so we wont get meat served and on the ticket counter at Amritsar and again at Kuala Lumpur the staff confirmed that our jain meal is confirmed in system however in flight we were served with non veg meals both times . 2) on our arrival to India the whole flight missed their checked baggage's and my family received our baggage's a week after we reached India. In total 7 checked baggage were missing for more than a week before we received them. It had all our clothes, baby food, nappies etc. I had to buy  everything including clothes (had wedding to attend) . We did not had anything with us as the aircraft from Kuala Lumpur to Amritsar was too small that staff had to put out carry bags with checked in luggage. Myself and my kids went out of airport with no jacket. Kuala Lumpur-Amritsar staff was very rude to all the passengers. As it was a very small plane there were no bassinets. Having a baby on lap i was unable to open the flap to keep the food tray and requested crew if i could sit at different seat as there were few lines which were totally empty for dinner as it will be easier for me to eat and keep my 1 year old baby on other seat. The crew bluntly refused and told me i am only allowed to use the seat i paid for. The solution i was offered was that my wife can eat whatever she could eat out of her plate while i hold the baby and then she can hold the child so that i can open the flap to put my tray and eat. When the meal was served (Hindu meal with chicken in it) out of it we could only eat fruits and dessert. For the above issues i put a complaint and filled feedback form which airline sent me but never heard anything back. For my return flight Amritsar to Kuala Lumpur i booked my seats in advance and paid for it so i don't have to go through the same. When i got my boarding pass the seats were different. When i requested to have the seat i paid for staff at airport could not do as they have already given those seats to someone else. So we had to suffer the same thing but at least crew was very accommodating except they could not find us any veg meal. On our return flight from Kuala Lumpur to Sydney was cancelled and we were given new boarding passes as we came out of the flight from Amritsar to Kuala Lumpur. They also provided us with breakfast vouchers, hotel. In my new boarding pass we didn’t receive bassinet as it was confirmed in my flight ticket. I approached transfer counter to confirm if we still have bassinet. the staff told me we don't have it and i need to pay for it. I had to beg the staff to give bassinet as its not our fault that flight is been cancelled. Finally after some time they decided to provide my wife with bassinet but we had to sit in different compartments now.

There was once when we flew over the Indonesian airspace and the turbulence was quite bad and felt like dying, the crews were very attentive and look out for me a lot. I am seriously very touched about it. Entertainment wise was alright, they have some blockbuster movies, overall it was okay. During my 8 hours flight, I was given 1 hot meal, 1 snack such as pastry or sandwiches and also the famous MAS peanuts. The food option was great as well. The cabin cleanliness was good especially the toilet. I was also given blanket and pillow during the flight.
Entertainment was not working, they gave us 25% to use with in 6 months which is unfair. Very slow answering the requests, and the food is bad.

Food and drink was terrific and customer service was excellent. Perfect brewed Coffee - best I have ever had on an airplane. Why do they not advertise alcohol? If you ask you get! Asked and they had Beer, Wine, Spirits and Champagne. Business Class seats are old fashioned style, not luxurious and basic in design. Lie flat bed was very uncomfortable. Seats were worn out and looked like they badly needed a refresh / upgrade. There was no Onboard Wi-Fi or Internet over the whole 10 hour flight.

Only 3 rows of business class seats (4 seats across in 2 x 2) My wife and I were in 2 D & F. We were offered a choice of 3 main meals, requested our choice and were then told none left. How can the 1st row and the last row get served first and the middle row left to last! No TV, No Audio (must bring your own!)

They came to NZ without any problem, however, there was no wheel chair assistance given. When going back i called Malaysia Airlines to ask them to cancel my sisters ticket and keep my mothers ticket as it is because only she will be travelling and i made sure i booked a flexi ticket so i can cancel anytime. When i spoke to the agent she said she has cancelled the ticket for my sister and had my mums kept as it is. But two days before my mothers travel i went online to check the ticket i found that her ticket was kept on hold. So i called the Airlines and they said its been cancelled. I asked them why and they said I requested it to be cancelled. After a day of fight with them and language barrier of them not understanding English properly they found out that its was the 1st agents mistake as she cancelled both the ticket instead. So, i had to rebook the ticket just one day before the travel which was so expensive. And my mother couldn't be in NZ as she was in visitor visa and had to leave the country in a day. Now the airlines knows that its their mistake and took the complaint but they are not refunding the excess money i paid because of the last minute tickets which would be close to $700 to $800 NZD. Its been three months now and they said they will get back in 40 days which was in the beginning of January to be exact 4th of January. We would have made numerous number of calls to the airline and no one are able to give a proper answer and they kept saying their manager would call back which has not happened till now.

review_header: "No snacks, beverages or water at the gate"
review_text: Itinerary does not use proper English or Philippines abbreviations baggage limits. Waste of time on this airline and needed to haul baggage down stairs to gate. Gate at Manila Airport was extremely hot without air conditioning in February. The manager screamed and said it was not her job to provide customer support. No snacks, beverages or water at the gate even if it’s delayed.

Choice of lounges at Heathrow - Gulf Air or Qatar. We chose Qatar Airways lounge and although very busy enjoyed a lovely expresso martini at the cocktail area. Boarding was on time and we were greeted by very friendly cabin crew and shown to our seats. I had selected 4A and 6A as they offer more privacy. Welcome drinks were offered and then shortly after take off the famous satay snack offering. Flight was very comfortable but what really stood out for me was the exemplary cabin crew - courteous, smiling, engaging probably the best cabin crew I have encountered in my travels. Used the complimentary wi-fi which was excellent. Catering offered Malay and European dishes along with nice drinks selection. The only let down for me was the IFE film selection, not many new movies and a lot of children's movies. Despite the IFE issue I would 100% fly this airline again. Our return flight and several domestic flights were also excellent.

As a result, I had to miss my Monday morning meeting and felt groggy all day. They did not provide a re-routing flight or offer a hotel in the terminal where I can rest. I had to stay in a noisy, smelly, and crowded Golden Lounge for 7 hours of waiting with screaming kids and loud guests - the worst business lounge in the world. There was only one staff handling hundreds of angry customers and from 22:21, I had to wait very long before I could ask for a re-routing flight with Korean Air at 23:50. By then, it was too late and the flight was full.  The staff was rude and unhelpful. This is the third time in my last trip that the flight has been delayed for 5 hours. It is impossible to schedule meetings since the management is totally incompetent and they do not have enough planes to cover all their routes.

Service has been sub standard the whole time. Flight here was equally as woeful with poor food and waking people up at 3am. Seems like Malaysian hospitality no longer means much. No preferential treatment for one world status which seems to be a dishonor of being a part of the group. Would not fly again by choice.

Their services have certainly improved. I found them to be more attentive and responsive than prior to Covid. Food, is as usual, more than sufficient and tasty. Considering that they have to handle a crowded plane, I must commend them for their patience and efficiency. All in all, they deserved to be commended for their improved services. My only criticism is that their widely advertised Free Wifi is dysfunctional, or non-existent.

Unfriendly staff who don't make any effort to help you. Come back the next day after the cancelled flight to find myself sitting in the aircraft because of technical difficulties. Waiting for that one to be cancelled now. Obviously unsafe aircraft if they are having technical difficulties all the times.

The first flight from Hanoi to KL. was cancelled due to technical issues. I was rebooked 24 hours later. Eventually made it to KL to have the second leg cancelled due to technical difficulties. Another overnight delay. Hotels were provided but only after very long waits and not well organised. I wonder if they have any planes that don’t have technical problems as I certainly didn’t get one.
Terrible experience and shame as a country have such airline.

Cabin staff reluctant to serve hot drinks on an 8-hour flight, use the seat belt sign ON as an excuse, even when there is no turbulence. I have not flown on a flight with the seat belt sign ON unnecessarily by the captain for 6 out of 8 hours, when there was turbulence only for a limited time 30 minutes.  It happened on the outbound flight too SYD-KUL they used the same tactic seat bet sign ON and no hot drinks served and I gave them the benefit of the doubt.  Forced to accept rice breakfast on passengers which we are not used to with no other choice. We were seated in the front section of the cabin and the attitude was take it or leave it.  Wine was served in a leaky plastic cup, when requested for another glass, they just added another cup below the leaky cup. How do you drink wine with 2 cups?  Old entertainment system small selection of movies, the Captain and cabin staff have no concerns about damage to ears with announcements through the headphones which happens unnoticed.
The food was great, especially chicken in soy sauce. There was free WiFi and drinks incl alcoholic drinks. The cabin was clean and in immaculate condition. The service was super responsive.

Overall food was decent with chicken kebab for supper and a delicious nasi lemak for breakfast. The seat was comfortable but average in flight entertainment. The cabin crew were friendly, welcoming and cheerful. The overall boarding process was handled professionally.

The food is excellent and the cabin crew are very friendly. I had a slight annoyance prior to departure which I wanted to mention. Malaysia Airlines has a programme where you can bid for an upgraded seat which I decided to do and I wish I never did. You find out 24hours before whether you have been successful. However it meant that I couldn’t check in on the website prior to departure. I like to have an aisle seat, so I make sure I check in. I couldn’t do that and I ended up with a middle seat. Which I was annoyed at, but overall the flight was still fine. I had a two hour delay connecting onward to Bangkok. Still I find them a fantastic airline.

Online check-in was not available in 2024. The counter staff was not accommodating and made me run in a circle and did not assist in any way, they were rude, blunt even the manager. She was very demanding and raised her voice. I felt threatened as a passenger would not recommend flying. It’s not a first class or four-star airline.

review_header: “more expensive than buying a new ticket”
review_text: They suggested I purchase an additional checked bag, but they asked for payment based on weight, amounting to 400 AUD. This is more expensive than buying a new ticket, which is what I ended up doing in the end. I understand there are additional charges but basing it on weight when it is less than a 23kg additional checked luggage is ridiculous!

A 50 minutes flight time. The seat was good, padding was soft and for less than one hour flight it was very confortable. Not sure for much longer flight. The crew was efficient, warm and welcoming. Satay and cold beverages were served for this short flight which was very good. The departure was a little bit behind schedule due to the congestion at KLIA and obviously not the airlines fault. Its not a 5 star service BUT definitely 4 or 4.5 star. Very high customer value for the price paid.

review_header: “the best airline I have ever flown”
review_text: The seats are comfy, food was tasty and staff very friendly. My first flight was a two hour flight from Bangkok to Kuala Lumpur. Fine no problems for a two hour hop. The flight from KUL to Heathrow was just short of 14 hours. Initially I thought I was going to really struggle with the length of this flight. However I had no issues and it didn’t drag at all. What is very handy is having access to all your messaging apps. That is brilliant and you can waste a few hours talking to friends or family. I was extremely impressed all round. I will happily fly with them again.

Check-in was busy but OK. Marhaba lounge was basic. Boarding was delayed and take off a little bit late. The crew in my cabin were excellent, very engaging and proactive. Announcements onboard were the clearest I have ever heard on a flight. Food choices were not too appealing except for the satay. Drinks and snacks were offered throughout the flight. No Wi-Fi. IFE could be improved both in content and operation. For some reason MAS tends to leave the seat belt sign on for extended periods way after any turbulence is felt. I have noticed this on many of their flights. Luggage arrived promptly. Overall pretty good Malaysian hospitality.

I was flying from Sydney to Kathmandu via Kuala Lumpur on 21st December. Flight was delayed. The Sydney international airport staff were unhelpful, no communication and the checkin process was absolutely terrible. The flight was delayed by 9 hours. Reached KL, the transit staff said the hotel was 1 hour away from the airport which was provisioned for the passengers on this delayed flight. Upon returning, in Kathmandu flight delayed..again no communication. Paid for a lounge and came to the gate as expected however got stuck at the gate with the delayed flight. This was the first time I flew Malaysia Airlines  and will never do it again.

First trip was on December 26th, all the way through the day it was postponements after postpones. Even leaving there was a delay. It meant I was at the airport far longer than. When arriving at my destination my bags were lost. My first 3 days on my cruise I had to stay in my room as all my clothes were lost. The cruise didn't have clothes that fit me so I had to wait till we dokc for me to pick up my luggage. The trip back on Jan 5 was a horrible experience. I am a big lad and the seats are a lot smaller than other airlines I had. The food was so bad I gave it back uneaten and just had the water. The flight had no onboard entertainment, like 10 hour flight trying to entertain ourselves.

Very unprofessional and rude staff at counters not cooperating with passengers. There was no intimation or written mention about number of pieces of carry on baggage allowed. Passengers carrying 2 pieces were stopped by the staff and made to adjust the luggage. This has sparked a dispute between many passengers and staff members, who were extremely unprofessional and rude with coordinating with passengers. Horrible experience. A total nightmare. Check in was delayed by more than 2 hours!

When I asked the flight attendant to move my cabin luggage in the compartment she denied saying you need to keep the luggage by yourself while the plane was overcrowded. The seats were randomly distributed in the flight, husband and wife aren’t sitting together, there was complaints. When I asked for my dinner in the four hour flight which was already delayed for 1.5 hour adding up to 5hours 30 mins she said food is on priority basis. Food was served after 2 hours of flight.

Unfortunately, I left my hand carry suitcase at the gate before boarding the flight from KL to Denpasar-Bali. As soon as the mistake was realised, I informed the cabin crew, but the plane had already started pushing back. The crew was extremely friendly and assured me that I would be getting the suitcase back, and that they had contacted ground staff at KLIA. However after landing in Bali. I went to the lost and found at Denpasar airport in Bali, where the person had no idea how to contact anyone at KL or Malaysia Airlines to inquire about the luggage I left. I was told to fill out a form, which I did. (Looking back now if I had done nothing else other than fill out the form, I would never have gotten any information about my suitcase.) Throughout the next few days I repeatedly called Malaysia Airlines numbers, and none of them ever picked up. I was by the phone for hours at a time. Finally, one number picked up, but I was told the person had no idea what to do about my suitcase, and that it wasn't at Malaysia Airlines' lost and found at KL. After numerous calls, I finally got a hold of another person who directed me to AeroDarat, and said that my suitcase might be at their lost and found. The earlier person could have told me that there was more than one lost and found, and that I should call the other ones to check, but didn't. Thank god I found out about the other lost and found.  Once i got aerodarat's number, Aerodarat didnt pick up numerous times, but once they finally did i found out my luggage was indeed with them. They said i could get it when i transited at KL again on the way back to Kathmandu. Howver, when i was at KL again the person at the help desk said the Aerodarat lost and found was beyond immigration. As we didn't have a visa to enter Malaysia, I told the person i couldn't go past immigration to retrieve my case, to which the person kept responding that i should still go. Then they said they couldnt do anything beyond that. Another lady at the help desk also couldn't do anything, and even got mad at us. Finally, a man came and understood that we couldn't cross immigration, so he said our suitcase would be brought to us at the gate before our next flight. Finally, I got my case back at the gate. I never got ANY email or anything acknowledging that i had filled out the form which the staff told me to fill out. If not for my constant calling, i would never have retrieved my suitcase. the form was completely useless. This experience was unfortunate, as the cabin crew and in flight service was splendid. However, like I said Malaysia Airlines needs to change up it's ground service and lost and found services thoroughly. I will not be flying with Malaysia Airlines again.

Second Flight from transit to BKK very poor condition. No leg space. No entertainment, poor meals. When we try return we came to final boarding desk about 10-15 min before departure they didn't allow us to enter.  We had to book different airline tickets.
It was an awesome experience, the cabin crew was just awesome and the food provided was very tasty. A special thanks to one of the cabin crew, Mr Shivan, thanks to his hospitality

After booking tickets we checked with the customer service personnel to add in more baggage allowance. The Airline customer service personnel advised that to add in 10 Kg it costs only $15AUD more. However, there is an additional penalty of $150 AUD to modify them. It is a shame to rip off its customers with an additional $150AUD charge for such a small change request. This Airlines will not be our preferred Airline for travelling from next time onwards.
Don’t ever fly with Malaysia Airlines. The worst airlines out there. They don’t refund, change anything.
Boarding process was quick. Flight was however delayed. The meal chicken could have been better. I liked the onboard wifi streaming.

A simple travel route from Osaka to Singapore should be less than 7 hours. Instead, 24 hours later I’m still stuck in KL airport. First flight from Osaka to Kuala Lumpur was diverted to Ho Chi Min due to engine issue. The ground staff was messy and disorganized, took very long to get things sorted. They booked a bunch of passengers on connecting flights that there’s no way we can make it in time, especially when the flight from Vietnam to Kuala Lumpur was delayed because they took very long to sort out all the passengers. Passengers with different final destinations all realized we missed our flight upon landing and were forced to stay overnight in KL. The transport arranged by the airline didn’t turn up to pick us up from the hotel to the airport in morning. Avoid this airline!

No space to move. Staff at Kaula Lumpur airport are of no help at all.  You have to keep chasing them for any kind of assistance required. Its the 2nd time I have travelled and both experience have been very bad. I wouldn't travel by Malaysia Airlines again.

They exceeded my expectations in their efforts to secure my watch. Kudos to Malaysia Airlines crew of flight from KUL to NRT on the 25 November 2023. As a family, MH has always been our chosen carrier and we have had good overall experience with the airline.

Kuala Lumpur to Singapore 17 December arrived on time. Two of the flights have air-conditioning that aren’t working well. My baggage mishandled. Notified to arrive and delivered the next day. First and last time on Malaysia Airlines.
Mishandled my baggage, still haven’t found until now. The flight was delayed for one hour.

review_header: "can't reserve a seat or check in online"
review_text: Last leg with Malaysia Airlines. Not sure who came up with this codeshare partnership but it's half baked. You get an email to check in on the TK site but they don't give you the TK ticket number and PNR. And of course their link does not work. Once you have that - through the TK customer service line you will find out that you still can't reserve a seat or check in online - explanation - because it's a code share. How stupid is that? And wee had a 2 hour delay in KUL to top it all off.

Sat on defective seats again, when my seat is being reclined it comes back up by itself in the slightest turbulence causing to disturb my nap. Food was terrible, uncomfortable seats and terrible WiFi. At least they delivered our luggage after they nearly lost ours once many years ago.

All flights on time, and requested seats honoured on all. Seats supportive and comfortable for price. Food decent portions and quite tasty for an econ offering. Alcohol seems limited to beer or wine in econ, but no problem asking for refills, plus soft drinks readily available. Staff very courteous. Baggage reclaim was prompt, even at LHR on return. Since the demise of the B747s and A380s on this route, load factors are high, and as with B787s, the A350 seems cramped and poky , but I understand the need for utiliising more efficient planes. Overall a recommended journey, and, being direct, saves the hassle of changing planes in the middle east.

All 4 of my flights were good, with the cabin staff very attentive and caring. I have a severe food allergy and maximum care was taken to ensure I was not put at risk in any way. The ground staff at the various airports were also very helpful. I am a nervous flyer, but thanks to Malaysian Airlines, my trips were not stressful at all as I felt cared for throughout. Our take offs and landings were so smooth so I had no cause for concern throughout the journeys. Thank you Malaysian Airlines!
