You are reading this right, instead of bringing us on Saturday back home, they arranged to bring us back on Monday. Two overnight stays (one in Zurich, one in Munich), for which absolutely no help was provided, you are completely on your own. And when requesting refund for the made expenses, it is refused with as argument that the flights were delayed because of bad weather conditions and thus not their fault, which is an absolute lie. Even the legally mandatory compensation according to EU law for delayed flights is refused. This company is not only disrespectful for the passengers (deliberately not using the word client, as they don't treat you as a customer), but also for the law.

Constant delays or cancellations with lame excuses of heavy traffic, technical issues, online glitches etc. Of my last 20 flights with them, maybe 1 landed on time. This airline is starting to unravel badly. If you book and pay for a seat reservation in order for people to sit together, you get moved and split apart. They get away with everything with their now standard lame greeting of: „We apologize for the delay but hope that you enjoyed your flight with us“.

We had less then 20 min for connecting. An airport guy with signs Chicago, LA, and Washington was waiting us at the gate, got us into a VIP van and drove us thru the security and to the other terminal and all 3 gates. We did catch our flights and got home on time. He told is midway that the luggage was transferred as well. Exceptional, surprising, and unbelievable. We are so grateful! Thank you Swiss Air and Zurich Airport!

On arrival in Zurich in 9am they provide me a ticket to London to next day with connection. I went to connection desk, was waiting in queue for 3,5 hour. A men who worked at desk told me he can give me this day flight with connection. I told where is 2 direct flights ahead. He checked and told yes where is one sit , I asked him so why did you trying to give me with connection one ? He could not explain and after 20 seconds told this ticket gone. But it was showing me tickets for next direct flight With Swiss. He told this tickets not for free. How comes because of this airline I missed a flight and they can not provide me another ticket.

Yes, that is right. I slept in a bench in AND out of my trip to and from Bangkok. Both times in Zúrich. I took a picture of the first bench in case you are curious: This is by far the worst experience flying in my entire career and will make sure never to fly Swiss or to use this airport: They have no respect for their customers and leave them with NO options after cancellation of their flights.
The same thing happened to my friend on the same flight.

I would like to congratulate the team on this flight who went out of their way to help a young lady travelling with a new born alone. I mentioned to one member of the staff (Toms) that it would be very comfortable for her to sit in one of the empty business class seats. They agreed and helped her to a new seat with space for her baby and then proceeded without hesitation to serve her food and drinks and great service. This is what good service and the use of discretion is all about. Well done Swissair.

review_header: "upgrade was only for the second leg"
review_text: I got the new boarding pass immediately, only to see that the upgrade was only for the second leg of the flight which was 1 hour - as opposed to the whole travel (the first leg was 8 hrs). I am thinking why even bother offering an upgrade for the 1hr portion and why was it almost invisible to see that this upgrade was only for a tenth of the journey? I called customer service right away - I ended up talking to three different people that gave me the run around, including one hanging up on me. I decided to wait till I got to the airport, the next day, to get a proper response. The next day on check-in, I talk to the manager who makes a call and assures me that the refund would happen in 8-10 business days, my flight was May 17. He tells me what to say on boarding the second leg of the flight etc, assuring me things are on the system. June 10 I decide to call in again to follow-up on the refund as it still hadn't gone through. This time the CSR tells me right away that the request to process it just went to the refund department that day and I need to wait 8-10 business days. Despite it being well over the said wait time, I decide it's OK, I'll wait. Two weeks later, I find myself calling their CS again - only to be told this time that there is no refund on my file and they cannot help me. There is no other number to call - only a form online, which I already filled. I noticed everytime I called in to the CS, all their reps consistently had the following, an attitude, and wouldn't let you finish your sentence. Very unprofessional for a company like SWISS. At this point I am frustrated because how can so many different SWISS airline employees give me different stories. So I take this query to social media. Now I am told that there is no indication of what I speak and they will open an investigation and will get in touch with me. There's no complaint code, time frame, contact or number to follow-up. So just like the last two times, I am a sitting duck and will have to likely start this process ALL over again. It is appalling how backward their service is - including their online marketing which has brought me to this stage. How can you dupe customers into spending money, then provide customer service that just placates you on a false narrative?  I was on the 1 hour flight looking at the so called upgrade - it was the first row of seats and had the tiniest curtain that just covered the head area, and they got water between the time they boarded and got off. Highway robbery.  Not worth the money and the experience they offer ain't worth the effort.

We had to book a different airline. They said the flight can't be reimbursed until 7 days later. We are 2 months later and I have tried every week to contact them via phone and website with no luck. They are saying that the ticked is expired and my 1000 euro is lost. This is the most disappointing company I have ever dealt with. they do not care for helping the customer. they are sending you to the online form and nobody gets back to you ever. Never using again Swiss airlines. They stole our money.

I asked for rebooking with Turkish Airlines but Swiss disagreed. Thus I had to book with another airline and pay the ticket by myself (of course more expensive, since "last minute"). I asked for refund of my original ticket price (paid in July 2023) on March 16, 2024. Today, June 18, 2024 haven´t got nothing. In May Swiss told me they received my application for refund on March 16, and they´re gonna refund within 7-14 days. Yesterday I asked again about the refund. They told me they haven´t received an application for a refund yet.

A delay of the first leg caused me to miss my connection, resulting in my arrival at my final destination 5 hours later than planned. I applied for EU/261 compensation due to the delay as the captain had informed us that the delay was caused by a technical issue requiring the assistance of a technician. However, my compensation request was denied, with the explanation that the delay was due to "air traffic management for air traffic control." This contradictory information suggests that the airline is misrepresenting the cause of the delay to avoid paying compensation.  It is regrettable that an airline of Swiss's stature has failed to uphold its responsibilities, misled its customers, and doesn’t respect international aviation laws. I am extremely disappointed with the service and conduct of Swiss.

Good crew, modern aircraft, clean cabins. This morning the lounge was not crowded, serving a very good breakfast with omelettes or other style eggs, fresh and warm rolls, croissant, cheese, ham, marmalade, muesli, yoghurt, fruits and the way all was presented, it looked really tasty and inviting. Good job done. Upstairs in the quiet zone, even the air conditioning was turned on and the zone was just about nicely cooled down. Flight was on time. Seat 1F gives a good leg room. Also breakfast on the flight was good with warm rolls, croissants, Bircher muesli.

Very old aircraft, they'll be retiring it by next year. Highly uncomfortable seats. The amenity kit doesn't even had all the basic items. When some airlines give free WiFi (WhatsApp, FB Messenger ..etc) to all classes, this airline charges Business class for Wifi.

Boarding chaotic, aircraft cabin clean. On ground, they had to start the engines twice until being ready to fly, I felt unsafe on this SWISS flight. During the flight, the seat belt signs were always turned on even though the flight was very smooth, did the cabin crew also feel not safe? Service was very inefficient, serving water and food options on two walks throughout the cabin. Whenever possible, I try to avoid this airline. There ist even no WiFi available. What a shame for Switzerland.

On our way to Johannesburg the service was good but on the way back to Zürich we found the cabin personnel to be very aloof. The one Steward dropped food on the floor and casually put it back on the tray to serve it again. Another Stewardess was in the middle of serving food but decided to strike up a long conversation with 2 Stewardesses who were seated in front of us (also passengers). We found this to be very rude and had to wait a long time for our food to be served. This is not the first time we have had a bad experience with the airline - in 2018 flew to Johannesburg and found the Stewardesses were ungroomed and not very friendly. It's a shame that Swiss do not compare well to other airlines eg. British Airways or South African airways.

review_header: Swiss Intl Air Lines customer review
review_text: The gentleman at the check in counter helped us with seats with extra leg room. One of the crew members was a sweet young man, quite friendly and efficient unfortunately couldn't get his name. The lunch and evening snacks served were good. Overall had quite a comfortable journey.

Flight was 45min delayed. Crew was friendly and attentive. Food in Business Class tasty but in quantity too small for a Business Class flight. Lounge in BUD was ok, but no warm food available anymore at 1930h. Boarding was smooth, Security Check as well.

Front Seat in Business is best seat in the aircraft and enables relaxed flying. All Business Seats should have this seat pitch. Crew was friendly and very attentive. Swiss Chocolate a highlight and for once even more food, than expected, however still a bit under expectations for Business Class. Check-in and ground staff acted efficiently and professional. Flight was calm and on time. Thank you to BT LX for a relaxed flight.

40 for exit row seats on the Zurich to Singapore leg I found myself in a broken seat. The cabin crew tried the seat and they could not recline it so I spent the 12 hour flight having to sit in the take off position for the whole journey. On my arrival in Australia I complained to Swiss Air who responded with a £100 voucher. I said this wasn't acceptable. They then offered me back the £53.20 additional seat charge. I referred the case to SOP and got this back The airline has now informed us of the following: „The passenger was booked on LX176 29.03.2024 in Premium Economy and booked the seat 20A. The passenger was actually seated on 20A. The passenger reported a malfunction of the seat. We sent a GBP 100 voucher to the passenger in our previous case and oﬀered to refund the seat charges of GBP 53.20. As the passenger was not downgraded, and the described situation is not in the scope of EC261/2004, we do not agree to participate in the conciliation procedure.“  Not impressed and will not fly Swiss again. Premium economy seat on Swiss Air is not worth the extra.

Our flight was diverted from Dubai to Muscat and my rebooking was for 3 days later. I had to be in Dubai urgently and took a taxi by road. The baggage handling and customer service is completely useless. I was given the go around multiple times. The customer care line is so cold and were of no help whatsoever. Terrible airline and terrible service. I understand that there are circumstances that are beyond the airline’s control but it’s how you help passengers in those times that really defines an airline. I will never recommend this airline or fly with them ever again.

Seat pitch in seat 1A is good. Flight on time. Flight Attendant serving Business Class passengers was terrific. The Swiss Chocolate is always a highlight. However the quantity of food served in Business Class is inacceptable. The re dwine was acceptable The food is the big disappointment if flying Swiss in Business Class on European flights.
Worst that my luggage was badly damaged with one item missing. I had to wait 2-3 days for my luggage.

I asked the gate staff what will be the impact of the delay on my connection. The Staff told me: "The company should wait for your transfer". When entering the plane from Krakow to Zurich, I notified the crew about my connection and asked them to update me. I received no update from the crew. 20 minutes before arrival, the screens had some messages about the transfer. My connection was written as being rebooked. I asked the plane staff the meaning of the message. They told me that I should try to make the connection. After lending in Zurich, I ran across the terminal to catch the Zurich Boston. When I arrived at the gate: the plane was still there, the ramp was still connected to the plane, and the gate doors were still open but the staff refused my access to the plane because "I was rebooked to another plane". The gate staff had no explanation and told me to go to the assistance desk. -At the assistance desk, the agent told me that:  the rebooking was done by a team somewhere because this is usually the best solution for the customers but not for my specific case.  They do that to find an available seat as early as possible and avoid multi-day issues. There was no Zurich Boston the day after so they rebooked me on Lufthansa via Frankfurt. The agent had no empathy and took no ownership of the issue, she proposed no commercial gesture for making me lose a day. The agent gave me a voucher for a hotel night and a meal with no explanation on how to find the hotel -The hotel was good. I was able to arrive to Boston the day after via Lufthansa, the flight from Frankfurt to Boston had a lot of empty seats. I submitted a complaint form to Swiss. The initial answer was that the delay was due to air traffic control restrictions out of their control and they would not provide any financial compensation. I asked for evidence to support their statement of delay due to air traffic control,why Swiss rebooked me without my approval, why the rebooking option was not presented to me when I presented myself to the gate staff at Krakow,  why the staff of the Krakow-Zurich was not able to give me clear direction. The only answer was "delayed due to safety reasons". What don't accept: - Staff not able to give good answer or to propose rebooking when the delay was known in Krakow - Swiss rebooking without my approval while I'm flying (since my Frankfurt - Boston had a lot of empty seats I don't think there was any urgency to rebook me) - Swiss agent lying to me when telling me there was no Zurich Boston the day after. Paying a very expensive ticket for a specific flight and being rebooked on another flight which was certainly a lot cheaper considering all the empty seats without any compensation.

On European flights I witnessed they were serving a kind of cheap sparkling wine (Baccarat) instead of champagne (if already offered-on a few short flights they just served coffee or tea in business class). The nice and tasteful light meals they used to serve were substituted by sandwiches they previously used to serve in economy! For my recent Bangkok to Brussels flight Swiss was one of the only options left so I gave them one more try. I was pleasantly surprised service improved significantly finally. The crew were nice and friendly while previously Swiss crews often left a cold and disinterested impression. For me, a crew makes or breaks the flight experience. I was seated in a throne seat that offered a lot of space and seating comfort. Meals were really good and they were able to offer me my preferred selections which wasn’t the case on previous flights with them. It was hard for me to choose the best pairing wines but they offered me to do wine tastings of all whites and reds available so I could select my preferred ones (no need to say I really appreciated this). Only downside perhaps was the flight map wasn’t working on this flight so it was guessing how much time we still had left in the air. Having Senator status I had access to the Swiss Alpine lounge at Zürich airport before boarding my connecting flight to Brussels; this lounge is really very nice and never seems to get crowed. It has great views of the airport and the runways. Flight to Brussels was also very good with an on-time departure and arrival with an extremely friendly and professional flight attendant offering a super and impeccable service as it should be. For my next flight I certainly will consider flying Swiss again.
It was well past dinner time, people were hungry but we were not offered anything to eat without paying.

Unfriendly sour faces of the crew. It's 3 days and I am still waiting for my Bag. Contacting Swiss Air is a nightmare. They send you on a wild goose chase and they refer you to Global solutions which is the worse people to deal with. The inconvenience is extremely disappointing.

I am by no means tall and I was lucky enough not to have a neighbour. Despite this I got no sleep kit (mask, socks, toothbrush), the toilet was not been cleaned by the staff, the cabin personnel was very lukewarm and were addressing everyone on an intercontinental flight in Swiss German. In flight entertainment was also very limited

review_header: “Swiss refused to do the honorable thing”
review_text: As we had paid transfers and accommodation, the alternative flight they offered would not suffice. The lady in their call center said we can organize alternative flights and be compensated on return. We have submitted all relevant information and Swiss Air have refused to do the honorable thing and compensate us accordingly! Dealing with their call center in South Africa is frustrating and the various reasons why they won't reimburse us, sent from Switzerland, is dishonest and scandalous. I urge all of South Africa to never use Swiss Air as they truly are Star Alliance thieves.

Was lucky enough to get a so-called throne seat for both my partner and me. As always good product on SWISS 777 and food and seat etc. were ok, except for the entertainment options. However, staff were more than disappointing: while the service on the other aisle was fast, efficient and nice, the staff member on our side was slow, unfriendly, disinterested and, to make matters worse, more or less exclusively occupied with private conversations with other fellow travellers who also belonged to SWISS. No greeting, no farewell - as a status customer and a fully paid business class ticket, I have little understanding for this kind of behaviour. The aircraft was clean, the flight on time - as you would expect from SWISS. However, the travel experience on an 11-hour Business Call flight was clearly below all expectations.

They put on an extra plane the following morning I was in a hotel within an hour in Zurich the team picked us from.the hotel The same happened in Joburg on arrival as we flew the following morning The customer services team paid my expenses and gave me a little compensation with no fuss. This was truly excellent from the whole team. Turning to the journey itself The first class lounge in Zurich is fabulous,great food, and winesshowers and the day room beds are so incredibly comfortable great for sleep,only problem is you have to leave it behind! The transfer was accompanied and the team helped with my hand luggage. On the flight the staff were friendly,the food was good if not spectacular.The seat was comfortable and allowed for good rest We were met on every stage of the journey and helped with passport control and security. It was a memorable journey on all legs

Broken seat which was tiny and dirty as well. Cabin crew took photos of items in food and didn’t want me to, so I did. No response from Swiss. Won’t use SWISS again. Business class has been made into economy class yet charge 15k one way. Disgusting.

Both flights delayed by about 30 minutes, but these were explained & apologies given Water and a chocolate distributed, and a fairly expensive trolley service. Flight attendants efficient and polite. The captain in attendance when passengers are leaving the aircraft is a nice touch. Seats and legroom adequate. Free carriage of ski equipment is an added bonus.

I flew Swiss Air going from Oslo to Los Angeles. The day we flew out of the Oslo airport it shut down due to a snowstorm so our flight was delayed 8 hours, which the airline had no control over. However, once we were able to board again, the only consolidation prize we got was free coffee/tea, but we still had to pay for all other snacks and services… I’m pretty sure the coffee/tea was already free to start with. Like really, that’s the best you can do? Anyways, once we got to Zurich, we had to rebook a connecting flight back home to LA due to the delay. The flight from Zurich to LA was roughly 12 hours and was probably the worst flight of my life. At the boarding gate, they made us get special stamps on our boarding passes and if we didn’t have them then we couldn’t board. There was a bunch of confusion as to where to get the stamps and long lines started forming around the boarding area. It delayed our flight leaving by roughly 30 minutes. Once my family and I finally got up to board, they grabbed our bags and told us we had to check them. We were row 30 (only 3 rows behind business class) so it’s not like we were the last to board or like we were in the very back of the plane. After they took our bags I pleaded to keep them, and if we couldn’t find room for them overhead then we’d bring them back and they could be checked. I stressed how this would cause a big inconvenience to us because once we landed we still had a 2 hour drive home and baggage claim in LA can take an hour or more since it’s a busy airport. They didn’t seem to care and continued to tell us it was a full flight and they wouldn’t fit. The thing that really annoyed me was that they let people boarding after us walk on with their luggage AND once the boarding process was complete there were 4 completely empty overhead bins by our seats. I was livid. Once we got in the aircraft it was like a swamp, it was uncomfortably warm, humid, and smelled like sweat and feet. The Boeing 777-300 plane we were on didn’t have any overhead fans. I told the flight attendant I was feeling warm (I have a condition where my body overheats very easily) and she told me that air only circulates when the plane is in motion so I had to sit uncomfortably for 30-45 minutes before they turned on the air. Even after it was turned on during the flight, it felt very inconsistent, and would switch between hot and cold throughout the whole flight. I would also like to add that their economy seats are much smaller than an average plane. I fly internationally roughly 5 times a year, and I’ve taken multiple airlines throughout my life and almost always fly economy. I could barely eat the meal they provided us because my elbows would be touching the people next to me when cutting up my food (I was in the middle seat). It was incredibly frustrating, I felt like I was boxed in. Their trash service was also inconsistent, and after every meal service, our trash was was left on our table for roughly 45 minutes to an hour. I counted and trash service only came by four times on a 12 hour flight. There were two times when I had to get up and throw away my own trash, because I wanted to use my tray table but couldn’t. At the end of the flight, I was so frustrated that I literally started crying an hour before we landed. It was the most uncomfortable flight I’ve ever taken.
Anything else looks the same. From Cancun to Zurich poor quality of food and choices from Zurich to Athens if you need water you have to pay extra.

Cancelled! Offered a new booking 7 hours later with change in Munich for a scheduled new arrival time around 22! Which not even is about 9 hours later as planned but also force you to make a stop in Germany instead of a direct flight. Rules of the airline are very clear that if a flight for whatever reason a flight is cancelled, they have to offer you the Same alternative. At the counter they tell you it’s not possible, they are all booked! Well, let’s raise the tone and remind them about their obligations towards their clients. I did it started a heavy discussion and, suddenly 2 places are available for a departure at 17! This is completely unacceptable and shows the way how they try to treat people. Ok! I will Not let it sit quiet like that. That’s why I’m first writing that review here, and will escalate it tomorrow, on Monday. Worst is they tried to send us via Munich, when they know that they have big strikes going on in Germany. Really! What a poor behavior, a poor customer service, a non existing hot line, a stupid chat bot and of course, no one available for direct contact. Definitely not the best way to keep customers. It was the first time, I could try to accept or understand it. But sadly all my latest flights were with problems. Since Lufthansa bought Swiss, it’s just becoming a garbage airline just oriented on profit with a complete lack of customer service or support. So this flight was definitely my last attempt to support and fly with a home company. There are many others to choose from.
Seat comfort was excellent. Unfortunately there was no meal in the economy class, but there was a bottle of water and chocolate.

Flight was good and on time. Flight Attendant friendly, skilled and at top level. Only negative point is the quantity of the food they serve. ZRH-BUD they should serve a hot meal or at least more food. But the quality of food is very good. The wines I did not try but usually Swiss is not known for higher quality wines in Business Class.

This was our first try at Business Class at SWISS. Our experience in economy had been average and unfortunately the business class did not impress either! Seats are narrow and especially the couple's seat by the window has next to no working/storage area! Unless you spend the extra $300/seat for the "Throne" seats I think the remaining seats are just considerably below any major airline we have flown. The shoulder seat belt cuts right at your neck as even the FA admitted the issue! The "noise cancelling" headphones are JUST headphones it offered Zero noise cancelling quality. Food selection was average. As any major airline's business class the wine offering was adequate. The 2-2-1 and 2-1-2 seating arrangement is the most compacted and congested BC seating format we have experienced compared to other BC's we have flown (KLM, AF, BA , UA, AA and ITA). I will say however that SWISS is still the best choice to fly between US and Switzerland. Sharing some feedback with the FA's, they agreed that they can not wait for the A350's to replace these 777's as many people complain about the seats and other issues.
It’s rather full flight and relatively short trip (just a bit more than a hour flight) but they made everyone feeling attended and cared for.

5 mn before landing in London, the plane turns back to Geneva due to a technical failure. Upon disembarking, no one is present to guide the passengers towards alternative solutions. They simply dropped all the passengers in the C departure lounge. It turns out they booked us on - not even - the next flight to London, not even the same destination (City) but Heathrow, 5 and a half hours after the original departure time. It turns out there were several possibilities beforehand, with Swiss or other companies (requiring that we exit the lounge, God knows how). ABSOLUTELY NO INFORMATION ABOUT OUR RIGHTS (compensation, meal, go for another company…). Icing on the calendar: the newly booked flight is delayed by 40 minutes. This an utter disgrace.

I had a very bad experience with that. You book a flight online with a suitcase of 23 kg and hand luggage of 10 kg. Nothing special. It is also stated in your confirmation and on your ticket. Only if you change planes in Zurich does this 10 kg of hand luggage suddenly change to 8 kg. You are not allowed to take more with you. My hand luggage was refused. The ground staff was curt and very unfriendly. Customer service also does not respond to this remarkable action. Unprofessional! So you are expected to give away 2 kg of allowance when you arrive in Europe. Once but never again with Swiss Air.

However, in February 2023 at Frankfurt, when the power was accidentally cut to Lufthansa systems, our problems seemed to start. The day it happened we were flying from LHR to GVA. When we tried to make the return journey, our booking had disappeared from the system. We had to pay for new seats to get home. My wife suffers from mild claustrophobia, so I always book and pay for specific seats near the front. Since then almost every booking has been changed, without notice, at least three or four times. Every time when I query, the same reason is given; “a plane change”. The problem with this is the type of plane does not change; the seat plan / format does not change, therefore our seats should not change? The airline has a seating policy, which basically says you can play for your seat but we will decide where you eventually sit. For example, on one flight I booked row 7; the system moved us to row 9 to 11 to 19. Same seat plan, no explanation, no apology. Twelve months later, the call centre staff are admitting they don’t know why the system is doing this and they have no control over it. Still no explanation and no apology.

After much research, we ended up booking tickets through Swiss Air. Booking the flight was quick and easy. Our first flight was from Valencia to Zurich, Switzerland on Swiss Air flight LX2143. After being able to spend a day in Zurich, we caught our next flight, on their sister airline, Edelweiss Air flight LX8414 from Zurich to Tivat, Montenegro. Both airlines were great, but Edelweiss Air was a much better experience, especially when traveling with children. Check in was smooth, as was boarding the plane. Everyone we encountered from the people at check in, to the crew on board, were all very friendly and welcoming. Great customer service! A little bit after take off they gave our daughter a cute drawstring backpack filled with goodies! An activity book, colored pencils, and a game! It was very unexpected and so thoughtful. It was a short flight but we were still offered drinks and given these delicious chocolate chip buns, and a piece of Swiss chocolate. We have flown on a lot of planes, and this was one of the best experiences we’ve had as a family. We will definitely be flying Edelweiss Air again!

A321 NEO and A220 which both are really good and comfortable. Everything was on time, cabin crew are really professional and polite. The only big disappointment is that meal service from Cairo to Zurich (4 hours) nothing was served. Not even a snack which I believe a huge mistake and they are not even aligned with the Lufthansa group -I flew Austrian earlier and they do provide meal service.

This was incorrect. When trying to refund the unnecessary cabin bag fee (only the ski fee should apply) Swiss airline support hung up multiple times apparently they’re having system problems. Ground stuff were also disorganised, but cabin crew were friendly. Overall terrible airline to be avoided.

The plane was an older 330, but the First class part was well appointed. Very personal welcome both by the FA, purser; also the captain came to see and greet the passengers in First. On this flight Swiss did change the usual Champagne by Cuvée Louise of the house Pommery, a good surprise. The food was extremely good and the service outstanding during the entire long flight to Miami. A pijama by a high level Swiss brand and a Bally amenity bag were also pleasant. One minor fact : there is only one extrely narrow restroom in the First on an A330 and therefore I cannot give a 10. In Miami assistance by a very friendly lady for collecting the luggage, When waiting for the luggage the captain - also waiting - inquired if everything was ok during our flight.

Singapore Airlines conveyed us from Sydney to Singapore and return. We purchased our our seats in January for our October/November travel. Luggage was at destinations, flights on time, meals were more than adequate, crew were friendly and helpful, and planes clean and quite new. There were a couple of times when flight times were changed slightly and information from Swiss was excellent as well as pre flight details a couple of weeks before leaving. The 777 economy seating looked cramped but because we booked early we were able to chose 2 seat rows up the back of the plane. After reading negative comments throughout the year we were worried we made the wrong choice, however our flights and everything associated with them were hassle free and without any concerns. We also had the added bonus of having around 20 passengers on our Ljubljana to Zurich flight. It was hard to compare Swiss, the first time we have flown with this airline, with Singapore as both airlines offered very similar service quality which we enjoyed on our flights

The economy class cabin was only a third full but the flight still operated as usual, so we had even more attention than usual from the cabin crew. Smooth flight which was on time. Definitely my first choice of airline when flying to Switzerland.

Extremely deceived, both legs late, but explanation given on first leg and nothing on second leg. Swiss German spoken instead of German, could not understand anything. Staff absolutely not motivated by the job. Poor service.

They changed my seats without telling me then get onto the flight and they were not the seats I paid for! Tried to claim a refund for them as paid for a service I did not receive and Swiss Air refused. Luckily I can do a credit card charge back. Welcome to Swiss Air fraud.

The primary issue revolved around a triple charge for a flight change, an ordeal that persisted for almost two weeks. Despite diligently following the advice provided and using the company's contact form, my attempts to address the matter were met with a prolonged silence. This lack of response left me with the impression that the experiences and feedback of customers may not be as valued as one would expect. The absence of a proper apology for the inconveniences and troubles I endured further compounded my frustration. Upon reaching the airport for my Lufthansa flights, I discovered that my ticket had supposedly been changed, yet no ticket had been issued. The information and instructions provided by the airline were often confusing and unclear, making the entire experience needlessly distressing. The airline's lackluster customer service, refusal to offer compensation, and the absence of formal apologies intensified my disappointment. In addition, the prolonged holding of my funds without clarity and the incomplete information provided during the resolution process only served to deepen my confusion and frustration.
Friendly service, and felt relaxed. Just a bottle of water and chocolate offered, but a good solid product. Impressed.
Airlines refused to give information over the phone about gate and were nasty to me. Airline staff was very bizarre and unprofessional.

The experience is one of a low-cost carrier at a premium price. They assign seats during check-in which you can change at the price of 35 CHF with an Economy Light ticket.  Why can seat backs be lowered in this cramped airplane? No one needs that on a short flight and it only means leg space is even more limited for the passenger behind.

I paid extra on an upgrade bid. Premium Economy is 3 rows in front of Economy, no separate area. Amenities kit is very poor and looks so cheap (made of recycled material). Seats are very uncomfortable, there are wider than economy but they recline very little so you ending sleeping with a back-pain. Seat photo looks great but in reality they are not. Service on the ATH-ZRH flight was a joke, plane was an A320, at least it was not an A220 that they sometimes use on the route. Service on B777 was professional but not friendly. Food was good on china plates. They distribute menu and welcome drink, there were 2 options of meal. Head phone were on an excellent quality. There was great selection of drinks. After dinner, during flight you could go to galley at the rear of plane for some snacks. IFE was good but selection of movies very standard, limited selection of Asian/Indian movies. One hour before landing there was the second service, just before landing they distribute chocolates.

First there was a delayed departure time then it was cancelled. We missed our connecting flight. They put us in a hotel over night and said they would send us notification of new travel itinerary for the and would pay the cost of transfer back to the airport. We never received an email or details of the reimbursement process. We had to contact our travel agent to find out what flight we were to get. Swiss just left us high and dry and have had no follow up communication with us.

We always enjoy flying with Swiss because (unlike Lufthansa), the staff consistently across as warm and friendly. Another nice touch is the bar of chocolate and bottle of water supplied on every flight. Check-in staff member at Hanover processed our bags efficiently, checked that we had the right visa for our ultimate destination but without grilling us. Both our flights were slightly behind in time in departing but made up the time, so that we arrived on schedule.

review_header: "I found SWISS to be very disappointing"
review_text: At Marseille, we went to the business class lounge and an attendant poked their head out of a crack in the entrance door and stated "full". Nothing else, the door was blocked, and he repeated in French "complet". Clearly SWISS do not worry about selling business class features that are not delivered. Onboard service was quick and very curt with the snack tray and drink served, but nothing close to a smile from any of the crew. Zurich transfer was easy and a pleasant SWISS lounge D is close to the boarding gate. As our boarding passes were scanned, staff handed us a slip of paper and stated "seat changed". They then pushed us away and would say nothing else. The second flight was onboard an airBaltic A220. The same snack plus a slice of cheese was served - adequate but it seems they have just 1 meal across every European flight? The airBaltic staff were much better and far more more friendly compared to the grumpy SWISS crew on the previous flight. Overall, for a short haul business class trip I found SWISS to be very disappointing, and not a patch on their standards of 5-10 years ago. No USB / charging sockets onboard, no WiFi service underlines how poor they have become. Aside from obvious cost cutting, SWISS staff service was very poor in the air and on the ground.

Zurich - Frankfurt on SWISS, with an onward connection to Rijeka on Lufthansa. As is nearly always my experience with SWISS, the flight left late, 90 minutes after the scheduled departure time. Due to the delay, many passengers - including myself - missed connections. (This was despite the fact that I had booked flights with a two hour layover in Frankfurt to avoid this kind of situation.) No effort was made to assist arriving passengers who had extremely short connections at the arrival gate. We were left to run to gates or deal with incredibly long customer service lines. After first being told I would have to travel the next day (thanks for the wrong information, customer service!), I did my own research and asked to fly to Rijeka via Munich in the evening. More stress again when the Frankfurt - Munich flight was very late and I had to run to make my connection to Rijeka before the gate closed. I arrived over seven hours late and didn't receive my baggage. I could have driven to Croatia in this time and at least have had my baggage with me. An utterly incompetent airline.

SWISS is the most unpunctual airline I know, chronically late. This is a good case in point. The flight took off over two hours late. No assistance was provided, not even a food or beverage voucher required per European regulation 261. An airline to be avoided if one has a choice.

Unlike easyjet, it is not possible to rebook a flight to another first name / same surname for an additional fee. This even as my wife could not fly because of health reasons. If you go to their headquarters at Paradeplatz, they come up with the lame excuse this would be international ticket trade, but it is rather financial greed as they are willing to resell the same ticket for almost 800 CHF instead of 200 CHF(economy from Zurich to Madrid).

Food in Business Class good but too small portions and not warm. On a 2h flight in Business I expect a full lunch service. Swiss in about 90% of my flights is changing my pre selected seats, which is annoying. Wine in Swiss Business is too cheap. From a self proclaimed Premium carrier like Swiss, I expect a better wine choice.

My recent experience was incredibly frustrating. A significant flight delay caused me to miss my connecting flight, which forced me to spend an unplanned night in Zurich. To make matters worse, when I requested access to my luggage, it was denied, leaving me without my personal essentials. At the airport service counter, I was promised reimbursement for the inconvenience and expenses incurred. However, my optimism was short-lived. Now, after reaching out to customer service, I've received a message stating that I will not be compensated for the toiletries. This lack of accountability and follow-through has left me deeply disappointed with Swiss Air's customer service and their handling of this situation.

Once known for its quality, punctuality and reliability, now it is simply a cheap (in quality, not in price) Easyjet. And it just keeps getting worse. Me and my husband as well as our families travel often and it is hard to remember now when was the last time Swiss was not delayed (I wonder how Swiss people feel about such airline representing their country). Today, last flight from London to Zurich, 1 hour delay. What means for evening flights, you get home not just 1 hour but much later, as public transport/taxi connections become limited. There was a man on the flight saying to the crew that he will not be able to get to Luzern as trains there stop running at 23.45. The response from Swiss crew member was that they are not responsible for Swiss railways. Well, this situation would not have happened if Swiss (again!) wasnt late. Now its almost 1 am, we are not yet home (even though we live in Zurich itself) - and tomorrow need to wake up at 5 am for work. These constant delays come on top of cramped (although clean) planes without any entertainment on european flights and outdated on long haul flights, no snacks/food, only small bottle of water and chocolate on the flights, frequent flyer program with constant "technical errors" and quite random bad seats to change which i need to pay 35 chf each for 1h 10 mins flight? Flight attendants and pilots are quite good though. But overall takeover is still killing the "good old Swiss".

The legroom was equal with low-cost carriers. The complimentary in-flight service simply does not exist in SWISS. The crew handed out one piece of super small chocolate. That should not be a standard in a traditional carrier like a SWISS, that in my opinion should be tagged as a super expensive low-cost airlines. Cabin crew were rude. The flight was delayed. As a FTL im Miles&More I am simply avoiding SWISS due to their horrendous cost cutting. Flying with SWISS in no longer a pleasure.

That is Swiss. Services of a low-cost at a premium price. They charge you for everything, but have old planes, even the seats are paid only or they will always get you the worst one ever possible. Yes, they have good amount of flight schedules, but you will always feel robbed after the flight… You just have to really work to make Swiss Air THAT BAD… applause to the management

review_header: "one of the most cramped economy 777 cabins"
review_text: Swiss have a similar seat pitch to most other 777 operators, but having flown Qatar, Eva Air and Egyptair 777s in the past few months (the latter has the rare, 9 abreast configuration), there is noticeably less legroom (or knee room to be more precise!) in the Swiss 777; pretty awful to experience on long haul. The seat recline seems much greater than on other airlines so if you have a selfish passenger in front of you who reclines fully, the experience becomes utterly miserable and the screen and tray table become effective unusable and trying to get out of your seat is fun and games. I was also glad that I hadn’t upgraded to Premium Economy as there are only a few PE rows tacked onto the front of the economy cabin and the seats and space looked decidedly non-premium compared to other 777 operators offerings. Even business class looked pretty basic, especially the ‘pairs’ of seats on the sides of the cabin (every other row) where it looked as if the window seat occupant would have to climb over their fellow passenger to reach the aisle. This was an 11 hour flight and we were well fed and watered throughout; there is a snack area in the middle section of the economy cabins and this isn’t just about snacks; we were treated to repeatedly stocked good quality sandwiches, amazing chocolate chip cookies, Swiss chocolate, nuts, crisps, drinks and Swiss Ricola sweets. It really was like going back 30 years to the way long haul economy used to be! Two decent meals, ice cream three hours out from Zurich and Swiss chocolate before landing-nice! The crew were superb; very friendly, went out of their way to help & genuinely seemed to be enjoying their jobs; so good to see and made a massive difference to the enjoyment of a long flight in a sardine can-feel cabin. I have never flown Swiss long haul before, so I may have just got lucky with this crew, but if all crews are like this, then Swiss are doing something right, that's for sure. Toilets were kept clean throughout and drinks were always on hand from flight attendants walking up and down the aisles. Boarding was shambolic; for some reason Swiss boarded economy from the front of the cabin first, working backwards by ‘group’. No surprise then that boarding took an age for those of us sat at the back of the cabin, as we waited for those at the front of economy (who boarded first) to sit down and stow bags. Why Swiss board economy from the front is beyond me; makes no sense at all, but just slows down the whole boarding process and it took almost 10 minutes from boarding to get to my seat (47G). Unimpressed to see single use earphones supplied, especially given the amount of sustainability propaganda fed to us on the IFE system (and particularly so on my next short haul flight from Zurich to Heathrow); hardy sustainable Swiss! Were it not for the dreadfully cramped Swiss 777 cabin, I would be actively seeking out Swiss for long haul travel given the great crew/service, but if I can get on an A380 or a 9 abreast 777 I would always opt for that, as these 10 abreast 777 cabins are just too cramped & the Swiss cabin has to be has to be one of the most cramped economy 777 cabins out there, so I would actively avoid it in future.

review_header: "incompetence in training or a lack of care"
review_text: The airline accommodated us on a much later flight with a different airline, arriving 5h 55m later than planned on timetable and 6h 10m in actual. On my return I contacted Customer Services and claimed for EU/261/2004. This seems a pretty clear case of delayed arrival resulting from operational issues. To my surprise I got a reply from the airline telling me I must contact the operating airline for this. As far as I am aware I was seated in an A321neo owned and operated by the airline. When I queried twice their definition of operating airline I first received a bland automatic response, hoping to welcome me back in the near future and second an email informing me the case was closed. Extremely disappointed by their customer services case handling, probably even more so than the delay, as it contains incorrect flight numbers and dates and shows incompetence in training or a lack of care in responding. Unfortunately I am a Gold card holder within the Group's FFP and have many future bookings with the airline. It just demonstrates how confidence in the brand can so easily be eroded by one mishandled incident.

I carry 7 kgs of luggage. No hold luggage through choice. Can you imagine my dismay when I see people with literally 3 or 4 bags, large rolling cases with more luggage on top and when it comes time to find a space it's a nightmare. I'm pleased about the laid back approach but I found this to be abused my many many people. Food this time I found OK. First meal was fine and apart from the starter which consisted of some rice thing. My second meal was a form of pad Thai which basically was noodles swimming in oil and unappetising. Seat was hard, very uncomfortable to say the least but it did recline. Entertainment was a total disappointment. Very little in movie choice and no game channel I could find. Cabin crew attentiveness was lacking I thought.

Boarding seemed a mess. Don't know if any airline gets this right after all these years. My seat didn't recline properly and no help. My screen didn't work. Just 1 screen page. I asked for help 3 times but nothing done. Just we will try to reboot.  First meal was OK but the rushed service before landing at Bangkok was dismal. The scrambled eggs didn't look  appealing. The seat is one of the hardest I've sat on in a long time. I am really disappointed in this product. Long haul is hard enough in economy but this seemed like overkill. Not looking forward to the return.

Seat very old and noisy. They are upgrading them but in 2 years approx. Food was not first class, ok at best. Wine was very good. A flight attendant was quite rude. Not insulting but it made us feel not at ease. Definitely not trained to work in first class - the airlines is not bespoke in first class. It has their processes and cannot even consider go around them. My experience from Air France or BA (to compare within European airlines) is a lot better and more worth it. You can feel it is a small airline without much investment.

There was a group of people in the waiting area so we joined them. They didn’t do or say anything to indicate that they were closing the gate. Apparently, all of the other passengers had boarded the plane but we didn’t know as there were people in the waiting area. They closed the gate without doing a final call or calling our names. They marked us as no shows even though we had gone through security and had checked in our luggage. They refused to refund us and made us pay significantly more than our the original cost of our tickets to rebook for later in the day.

That along with travelling with a new airline via a stopover in a place I've never been added to my enthusiasm for this journey. Getting to Dubai was relatively stress free, except for the wallet busting food prices in Zurich. Note to transit passengers passing through Zurich, pack your own food or pay exceptional amounts for staple foods you take for granted back for home. Coming back from Dubai where things got interesting. Boarded the plane at Dubai as normal, then we were informed the place had developed a technical fault, resulting in the planes computers needed to be reset. All power to the plane turned off. Then we were told there was an issue with the GPS and the airline not having the relevant clearance to enter specific countries airspace en route to Zurich. Periodic updates occurred during the nearly 3 hrs they kept us on the plane, on the runway and still in Dubai. Finally after 3 hours, they announced the flight was cancelled and we were to contact the transfer desk. The queue was long but somebody prompted me to check my emails where i saw Swiss had rebooked me on another flight with Emirates, flying to Geneva and then on to Zurich. So I had to take 3 flights instead of two. Waiting to obtain a new boarding pass and rechecking my luggage with Emirates was stressful as queues were long and chaotic with no order to anything. As with these sorts of situations, it is those that shout loudest that get things done. No visible or practical support from any swiss air staff only an email. They merely dumped their passengers onto other airlines to sort. Eventually got to Zurich where i tried to reason with the SWISS staff if I could be booked on to an earlier London flight at no cost due as a gesture of goodwill for the additional time i was made to wait in Dubai. They were not having it and ended up waiting in Zurich for my next day London flight. A new situation for me but the support from SWISS could've been so much better. I would only use SWISS again as a last resort for any transcontinental journeys.

The most recent incident was last March when I flew out of Athens and arrived in Singapore where I received a damaged suitcase. I filed a claim and was advised that the suitcase would be picked up from my hotel and repaired. I pointed out that Singapore was the first stop of a Far East trip with 6 stops, so my suitcase was badly needed in 4 days when I would take off again to continue. The suitcase was picked up from the hotel 2 days later, only to be returned in 20 minutes advising that they did not have the necessary parts to repair it. The local claims handling agency told me that they would not be further involved and I needed to sort this out with Swiss directly. As I needed to continue my trip I was forced to buy a new suitcase and throw out the damaged one. I tried to find as close a match to my original suitcase in size, make and quality. The replacement cost was SGD 329 or roughly 230 Euro. Having kept pictures I took the matter up upon my return with Swiss, filing a follow up claim. They re-directed me to another claims handling agency who, 2 months and numerous reminders later advised they would compensate me with 40 Euro! Alternatively they offered to pay for the repair cost but I advised them that the suitcase had been disposed as I could not carry it along on all my subsequent flights. They then increased their offer to €61.98. Bottom line is that my bag arrived broken and Swiss was unable to either repair it or provide an alternative for me to continue my trip. I was forced to buy another suitcase and realize that a discount would be reasonable but 73% I believe is insulting. I was forced by Swiss' inability to provide alternatives to dispose of the broken bag and buy a new one so I find it unreasonable that I have to bear that cost.

It was indicated in the booking and e-ticket that seat reservations were included in the fare. Outbound all went well. However when I asked Swiss customer service whether it would be possible to change the seat for my inbound flight, they canceled the seat reservations and told me that I had to pay for them. I have exchanged numerous emails with Swiss customer service whose only response is that all seat reservations are payable, completely ignoring the information I sent them (copy of e-ticket, screenshots). The last email I received stated that free seat reservations are only available for Star Alliance Gold status. I happen to have this status, it is reflected in the booking and may be the reason why I could reserve the seats for free in the first place. However, it was sent to my as an explanation why I still have to pay for the seats rather than an explanation that Swiss kindly made the reservations. It seems that even supposedly human customer service staff has been robotized. "Service" also seems to have dropped. The saga therefore continues.

Short hop from LHR was delayed about 50mins due to ATC restrictions and the Captain explained this over the intercom from the front of the plane which I thought was a good personal touch. Caught up much of the time anyway on quick flight to Zurich with excellent cabin staff and service. Transferred to satellite terminal at Zurich and had about an hour in the impressive Senator lounge before quick priority boarding onto aircraft. Once settled in seat staff offered pre-flight welcome drinks and distributed menus. Flight pushed back on time. Inflight service was efficient and good throughout and food and wines were excellent. Seat was pretty comfortable and flat bed coped with my 6ft frame enabling me to get a decent amount of sleep. IFE had a decent selection of films. My only complaint was the cabin temperature was on the warm side for me. Arrived BKK on time but then had to wait 15 minutes for a gate to clear of a Thai Airways plane which was irritating given availability of other gates but hardly Swissair’s fault. We had a connection on Bangkok Air down to Phuket which we made with ease. Very satisfied with the fare and my experience of Swiss.

They provided a flight for the next day at dawn, I arrived at the airport there was no open door to eat, I was hungry and sleepy. Swiss having caused this horrible situation was not even able to serve anything free to eat, and even so the second flight was delayed by 1 hour, the flight was now at 4 am and not at 3 am. On the plane as well as at the airport I couldn't sleep at all and after a day of the trip I'm still feeling bad and with severe headaches. Being horribly cold, the company didn't even have a blanket for the passengers. The worst flight I've ever had in my life.

We had an 8.5 hour flight which was delayed by 50 minutes. We did not have any sound on our in flight entertainment and the closed captions was not working. We travel with 6 other friends, 4 of the 6 had neither picture nor sound on their in flight entertainment. My husband was verbally reprimanded for organizing our food containers by the stewardess, who said, “ I wish you hadn’t done that, you only made my job harder.” My husband and I are small and we had absolutely no room in the middle rows. Our flight from The USA to Europe with Delta was more comfortable by far.

However, when the plane reached SP, we were told we had to get off the plane and go over the security check all over again. The flight had the same number and the same aircraft was used. However, for Swiss, the flight from SP to Buenos Aires was treated as if it were an entirely new flight. People got off and on in SP (so, it was not just a "fuel stop" as advertised). When I was at SP, I heard my name on the PA. I went to the counter and was informed there was a better seat available for me for the rest of the trip. That I could change to a seat with more legroom in the first row of the Economy cabin. Of course, I agreed, as this was an upgrade. Many other passengers were being offered upgrades even to better cabins. To my surprise, when I re-boarded the plane, my seat had been changed to a middle seat in the second row (I had been seated at an aisle seat from Zurich) which had been allegedly changed for a better seat. I told a crew member and he was completely rude and sarcastic, saying he couldn't do anything, that I should ask the woman sitting next to me (who had been flying from Zurich as well). When I contacted customer service asking for compensation, they gave me an "empty" apology and said they couldn't do anything. This route is misleadingly advertised. Don't pay what is costs. The so-called "fuel stop" is an actual stop, where people get on an off the plane. Don't count on having the same seat you had at check-in. And don't accept any upgrades. They just need you to empty your seat because someone else paid for it at SP.

I went on board and everything was lovely! The economy seats were comfortable and we even got pillows and blankets the screen was responsive and the seat was very clean and had a lot of legroom for my height! I really liked this flight but there was just one slight thing that concerned me. The service, I’ll be brutally honest about this. The service was terrible so first thing that concerned me was that when the flight attendant was handing out the food I asked for a vegetarian meal since I can’t eat non halal chicken pasta. They said in a kind of impolite voice that they didn’t have any more vegetarian meals I kindly asked if they had any options without chicken or meat, and they were like “we don’t have anything vegetarian deal with it” so I was very disappointed with this first part. I just ordered the chicken pasta and removed the chicken and everything close to it. The food came a bit cold for me but I don’t blame it on them it’s probably because I was at the literal back of the plane. Second thing is that when I wanted to use the restroom in the middle of the flight the same guy was handing out drinks to passengers he was basically at the beginning of the row so I kindly asked if he could move just 2 steps back so I could get into the restrooms and he pointed to my seat and shook his head? I kindly asked for him to move literally 2 steps which would take him less that 10 seconds!

Like most comments here state, the flights can be delayed, the staff seems to be hit or miss, or too friendly or too rude. They overbook their flights, so you will see a lot of people being denied boarding. Most carry ons will not fit the bins and will be checked at the door delaying the flight even more. The A220 planes are brand new and well kept, the A320 are old. Only a free bottle of water and a chocolate at economy, for the price they ask, not worth flying Swiss in economy to be honest.

review_header: "my wife's and my bags did not arrive"
review_text: No so happy when both my wife's and my bags did not arrive. We lodged the report as advised. This is with a separate company as Swiss do not deal with customers for the first 5 days. We were told the bags likely missed the connecting flight from Zurich and would arrive the next flight. That didn't happen. 24 hours after our arrival we found out, by me initiating contact, that my bag had been found but we would have to pick it up at the airport, at our cost, as it was too late to deliver. That was the first 2 examples of poor service. We picked my bag up and saw the huge number of missing bags they had. Some seemed to have contact details but we still in the lost area. How they managed to lose both our bags, to obviously different locations, is quite remarkable. They provided a website to tell us the status of the lost bags. Over the next few days we checked regularly but nothing changed. It still showed my bag as awaiting pickup which was wrong. Numbers that we were given to ring either didn't answer or were wrong. Customer support was useless, they only care about bookings. The best offer we had was to get a number in America to ring (we are Australians in Europe.) No use at all. Eventually we left it with our cruise director on the Viking ship we were on. They were chasing other bags as well. After a week we were told the bag was being flown to Frankfurt and would be sent to the ship from there. That never happened. I suspect it was sent, sat there and then returned. The next update was it was going to Munich. We had no further advice about it. After Viking eventually confirmed it was there they dispatched a driver to pick it up and bring it back to the closest port. They then put it on a ship that would meet us in Vienna. After 14 days my wife got her bag, no thanks to Swiss air. I lost track of the number of calls and emails we and Viking made trying to get the bag. At on stage Viking spent over 4 hours on the phone trying to get answer. They we just totally unresponsive to nearly all calls and emails and the website updates were appalling and mostly non-existent. If not for Viking sending a car to Munich we would not have received the bag at all. We had our emails on our bag tags but that was no help. How hard would it have been for someone, once the knew it was unclaimed, to open the tag flap, see the email and let us know where the bag was and find out where we needed it sent. If you have got this far here are our tips Photograph your suitcase because you will have to describe it if lost Photograph the contents because you will have to describe that too Get an electronic tracking tag If they give you a number to call check it will be answered before you leave. Don't take anything they say on face value. Get it in writing that once located they will have the bag delivered to you, wherever you are. They did pay compensation for items purchased but there is a limit on that of $100. Not a lot for a 14 day delay.

The customer service could not help and we had to pay everything ourself and got no help from Swiss to get back home. A month later Swiss will not take responsibility for this and we are still arguing to get back our money. 9643 NOK refund for rebooking and 800 EURO as a compensation. The customer service actually hang up on us and no-one can help you. I will never travel with Swiss ever again, because this is a bad way to treat customers.
After I filled out the form and I got a refund for my expenses.

2 days prior to my supposed arrival time, there was a fire in Catania airport and the flight had to be diverted to a different city. They sent us to a random city, not in any way the closest possible to Catania, not even in Sicily, did not arrange any form of transportation to Catania, and there was about a 5 hour train ride to get to where we needed to go. I understand that a fire is an extraordinary circumstance, but arranging some form of bus (free or paid) would have been a better solution than dropping everyone in a random city and telling them to have fun.

I regret to say that my recent experience with the airline, which was once considered a top-tier airline, left much to be desired. Despite the hefty price tag, the overall service fell short of expectations, leading to a disappointing journey. Initially drawn in by the airline's prestigious reputation and high-end image, I expected a level of service commensurate with the cost. However, my experience quickly took a downturn when I encountered various issues throughout my trip. Flight delays became an all-too-common occurrence, leading to inconvenient disruptions to my travel plans. Additionally, the seating arrangement was far from comfortable, lacking the expected space and amenities that one would expect from a premium airline. Moreover, the in-flight services were underwhelming, failing to meet the standards I had come to associate with top-tier carriers. The lacklustre customer service only exacerbated the situation, as staff seemed disinterested and unresponsive to passengers' needs. Sadly, it appears that the airline's emphasis on providing a low-cost service came at the expense of maintaining the high-quality experience they were once known for. As a result, the company's reputation seemed to have declined, and many passengers, like myself, began seeking alternatives from more competitive and value-driven airlines. It's disheartening to witness the downfall of what was once a leading player in the aviation industry. I sincerely hope that Swiss takes these criticisms constructively and endeavours to reinstate the excellence it was once celebrated for. Striking a balance between affordability and premium service is crucial for their revival in the highly competitive market. In conclusion, while the airline may still bear the vestiges of its former glory, the current experience leaves much to be desired. For travelers seeking a seamless and premium journey, there are better options available in the market today.

Delays, rude staff especially customer service. Missed connection in Zurich because of delays . Waited 7 hours with a 20euros voucher for a meal. Missed the ride at destination. On the way back delayed luggage, customer service rude and inefficient. 36 hours late I finally got my luggage at 5:40am. When I wrote a complaint I was basically told we are not part of EU so we don’t care about your complaint!- Seriously never again!

From start to finish, the entire journey was plagued with issues and setbacks. First and foremost, the customer service was abysmal. The staff seemed disinterested and unhelpful, displaying a lack of professionalism that I found extremely frustrating. Furthermore, the flight itself was far from satisfactory. The seats were uncomfortable, leaving me feeling cramped and restless throughout the entire duration of the flight. The lack of legroom was particularly unbearable, making it nearly impossible to find a comfortable position to sit in. Additionally, the in-flight entertainment was severely lacking, with a limited selection of outdated movies and TV shows. It felt like a step back in time rather than a modern travel experience. To make matters worse, the food served onboard was tasteless and unappetizing. The meals lacked variety and were of subpar quality. I was left feeling unsatisfied and hungry, which only added to my overall dissatisfaction with the airline. Lastly, the airline's punctuality was highly questionable. My flight experienced a significant delay, causing me to miss an important connection. This lack of punctuality and disregard for passengers' time is simply unacceptable. All in all, my experience with SWISS airlines was marred by poor customer service, uncomfortable seating, lackluster entertainment options, unappetizing food, and significant delays. I would strongly advise against choosing this airline if you value a pleasant and hassle-free travel experience. There are much better options available that provide superior service and comfort."

review_header: "worst airline I have ever flown with"
review_text: They have deleted my return ticket because I asked for a date change without my permission and didn't even inform me. I called them a few days before my original return date to see if I could change my return flight to 2 days earlier than planned, they said yes and went ahead and changed my ticket as well as sent me a confirmation email with the new dates. AA few hours later I received an email saying that my credit card used for rebooking charge didn't process. I gave them another call and this time the customer service rep said that I actually can't change my ticket and I would need to fly back during the original return date. A day before the original return flight I couldn't login to see my booking using the reference number so I called them again to learn that my return ticket was 'deleted'. They said because I asked for a change and it was not possible there were two booking under my name and they cancelled both. They robbed me off the return flight that I payed months in advance. I was told by the customer service rep this time that I could rebook my deleted return flight with a penalty and the fare difference if I preferred ... it is unbelievable but this is what they told me. When I got frustrated I was told by the customer service rep that maybe I should 'go away and think a little bit'. I ended but buying an entirely different one way ticket home that cost me over $1,000 in addition to the $1,900 roundtrip ticket that I already paid for with Swiss. T Worst airline, worst customer service.

First check in staff at the airport were unprofessional and poorly trained. Then flight kept getting delayed and delayed without any information then they told us that the aircraft is "weight restricted" so they deboard 10-15 passengers. Finally got into the plane only to be told after waiting for another hour that the flight was wrongly loaded. Please spend some extra money and fly with reputed airlines.
They promised to refund me, but until today, I haven't gotten my money back. If you have the option of choosing other flights, please do not use this airline (Swiss).

Canceled flights, delayed flights, poor service. The Swiss does not even reach the level of a Ryanair. Total disaster, finally ended the tragedy and stampeded this airline.  Sowas wie die Swiss braucht kein Mensch. Annullierte Flüge, verspätete Flüge, schlechter Service. Nicht mal das Niveau einer Ryanair erreicht die Swiss. Totales Desaster, beendet das Trauerspiel endlich und stampft diese "Airline" ein.

3 days later airline has no updates and still cannot located our bags. Our entire trip is ruined due to this. Customers service is non existent. Aircraft is worn, bathrooms not cleaned, terrible food and the flight attendants not attentive at all. Absolutely horrible experience would not recommend nor would I ever fly this line again.

Start in Chicago was a bit disappointing. While check-in was good, security check and lounge at Terminal 5 were bad. Security check had no line for Business class passengers and the whole area was overcrowded with long waiting times. I was allowed to use the SAS lounge, which was very basic. There were no restrooms or showers, seating is limited, food and drinks (except wine) a big disappointment. The "highlight" was cold noodle salad. On board experience was much better. The cabin crew was welcoming and attentive. Service started with a drink (Champagne), later the menu was handed out. But there was no hot towel service and the amenity kit was very basic. Dinner service started shortly after take off, but while the presentation was good, the food (I had the vegetarian option) was only average. Unfortunately I’ve chosen a Swiss white wine, which was awful. My seat (12 G) was comfortable and offered enough storage space, but keep in mind that other business seats are different and offer smaller space. Entertainment system was good with an adequate screen and a great selection of movies and music. Before landing a cold breakfast was offered which you had to pre-order. My flight landed late in Zurich, but I made the connection within 30 minutes. The short connection flight on Helvetic was uneventful, the friendly cabin crew offered a small snack and drinks.

I had to speak with 3 different people regarding an issue with my ticket. Each person told me something different and the last person literally refused to let me speak with a supervisor. They ended up cancelling my ticket and I had to book a new flight 2 days before I was supposed to leave. They did nothing to rectify the situation. The absolute worst customer service I’ve ever received.
Staff was rude to me. When we show faulty seats they didn’t bother to listen and adjust. Service was awful and I would not recommend anyone using this Swiss airlines.

The airline cancelled our flight and we have been emailing and contacting them to fix it for weeks with no response. No the airline rescheduled our flight and now only the day before our flight, we got rescheduled to another flight with no baggage allowed. We paid so much money for luggage and now we are told we have to pay again for bags with no guarantee of a refund. We did not budget for this and the airline has given us such poor service in assisting with the process! We do not recommend this airline to anyone, Emirates and even Qatar has provided us with excellent service for years and would never leave us with such an inconvenience! The service is poor and the additional expenses should not be our responsibility!

review_header: "Swiss First is one of the best"
review_text: Nevertheless the overall product Swiss First is one of the best. Seat and bed are very comfortable, Cabin interior is airy, elegant and beautifully designed. The suits offer enough privacy when wanted, but they offers as well a table for two travelers to dine together. The cheese fondue - on offer in wintertime - high above the clouds is one of the unforgettable culinary highlights in the sky. Food and wine on offer are changing each month. I had the special seafood Month, and the seafood starter and the seafood pasta were just amazing, as the rest of the dishes, which I choose from the regular menu. Worth mentioning the cheese plate as another highlight for cheese lovers. For breakfast I choose the Quiche, which was one of the best dishes I enjoyed on all my flights. The dining experience with very knowledgable and friendly staff was fantastic. Entertainment system was good, but not really exciting, especially the music section (classical music!) was rather mediocre. Getting to and from the plane is made smoothly and without the crowds: amongst others by private car and separate security control. Overall an exciting flight experience from check-in Zurich to arrival in Singapore with no problem.

However, I just had the best flight ever on Swiss. Zurich to Chicago, seat 23k, first row econ+, bulkhead, window. The plane was empty because Swiss just added a 2nd daily flight two hours before the normal daily flight, so this flight was sparsely booked. And, the fare was $250 for this leg of the flight.  Normal price has been $750. In econ+ section of 50 seats, only 4 were occupied.  Staff was very attentive. Food? I stopped eating on Swiss flights years ago because it was consistently: Chicken or pasta. Instead I buy Spanish ham and a good cheese and a pastry at the deli at Zurich airport to carry on. However, what a surprise when I accepted only the salad and the dessert, and both were excellent. Previously served salad had been chopped iceberg lettuce, and dessert months old grapes. Swiss is beginning to treat the passengers better?

Manchester to Zurich going out, very good, transfer to Singapore flight could not have been easier, no security etc, literally took no more than five minutes from getting off one plane to to being seated on another. Flight delayed for about 30 minutes for late arrivals. Flights to and from Singapore ok, decent food, seats good for economy and good service. It then all turned into a complete shambles. We arrived bang on time, 6:14am. No particular problem getting off the plane. This time, no easy transfer. The 55min transfer time was looking shaky as we had a long to transfer from E to D by train followed by another long walk to security. Decent sized queue but didn't look too bad. Got through without too much of a delay only to find the Manchester flight had departed. Swiss had given a transfer time impossible to meet this time. I went to the transfer desk where they rebooked me on a flight eleven hours later and gave me a meal voucher that didn't cover the cost of a burger and fries. When I checked my emails, Swiss had sent me an email at 7:19 stating the flight had been cancelled and I had been rebooked on the later flight. Swiss had not cancelled my flight, it departed 7:24 as I tracked it over to Manchester. They lied to me and left me and several others stuck in Zurich airport for eleven long hours. I would not trust this airline again after their blatant lying.

Travelling with a 2 month baby, 2 years old child, wife and elderly mum, we find out that SWISS family dedicated desks are closed despite several automatic marketing emails reminding us of this service.
