We then entered a queue for Fast Bag Drop. After 15 min, the ground crew employee filtering the queue entrance requested us to leave the crew, because we first needed to print out the luggage tags! We then needed to start the queue again without fast track despite their mistake to let us in the queue at the first place! 2x piece stroller was refused to be dropped at the gate so we needed to check that in and forced to rent an airport stroller ! Despite the mistakes and the crew witnessing our struggle, their where most unfriendly, no empathy whatsoever and arrogant. I feel ashamed of being Swiss myself after that experience. Some low cost airlines are much more friendly and family oriented than this ! Kudos to the cabin crew that operated our flight, they where marvellous. Customer experience does not start at the door of the plane, but as from the booking onwards.

It started with a massive waiting time at security control at Zurich airport. The flight was delayed. The flight as such was outsourced to Air Baltic. There was trash under my seat and the back of the seat in front of me was spilled with coffee. Clearly the plane had nit been cleaned properly. If you want to change your seat at check-in, one now has to pay Eur 30. A complete rip-off.
Feels like flying easyJet every so often. Also paid exit seat was changed. I fly Swiss a lot and in my opinion it is very similar to the experience at Wizz Air / Ryanair.

Also there was no announcement as they said Venice airport is silent airport but next day announcement was done on the same airport (new flight booked at run time). Even we reached for boarding almost 10 minutes before the flight take off they denied boarding with 1 liner boarding time is finished, they could have allow if they wanted to do so. Very bad experience.

Both flights were more than 2 hours delayed. We missed both connecting flights on different days when the weather conditions were absolutely fine. Got stuck at the airport twice for 4 hours. Received nothing but cheap  meal vouchers that could be used only at 4 fast food chains. Tried to use them at starbucks and only one worked. Also, they gave us last rows near the restroom both times for a new flight.

The 14hr flight was just unpleasant. The seats were tiny, the entertainment years out of date. The service was unhelpful and the stewards were strangely aggressive to requests such as getting water on a long haul flight and continually bumping you in your seat. I literally had to beg them for food when they skipped out rows during service. The food quality was very poor. Then they rebook your connecting flight and lose your luggage and make no effort to redress the situation. Even if you call their contact line there is no response except to redirect you to a useless online form. About 7 people on the same flight have lost their luggage and nothing from Swiss.
For a Swiss carrier there is a lot of work to be done to compete at international level. I would rather pay extra and travel with other airlines.

This flight and service a nightmare. 30 mins late leaving BKK for one reason or another but made up of time to Zurich. Got to Zurich then had to go across airport to get connecting flight to London, with short turn around. Getting ready to board when announced last minute technical problem slight delay, technical problem then turned out to be crew member felt sick and didn't want to fly. So no replacement crew at airport so had to wait 1 1/2 hours delay, which meant I would miss last train to my home from London. Swiss staff not bothered or concern and told me to fill out forms? They had a chance of putting me on another flight to London from Zurich but failed to inform me of this. This meant I would be stranded at LHR overnight, so had a choice of paying 350 for Taxi to get home to prepare for work next day or pay 250 for Hotel room and miss a day's work. No Swiss Air reps or UK numbers available. Stay away from this cowboy outfit.

5 + 2h flight in economy from Asia to Europe. As many others have pointed out, the hard product that the Swiss cabin offers is extremely dated and badly in need of a makeover, however on our flight the soft product provided by the warm touch of the cabin crew made up for it. Legroom was dismal and I was unable to stretch my legs out fully as I have been previously able to on many other long-haul airlines even in economy. On the highly fuel-inefficient A340 it was also evident that the cabin pressurisation features is far lagging the newer B787s and A350s and one could really feel the difference stepping off the plane. That being said, everything else worked just fine with regards to the IFE, meal service and punctuality. In a way I am glad our bid of €1500 (each) for business class was declined and saved us some money, since it seems like the seats in business wasn’t a massive step-up from what we got. Would like to specially mention Sophie on the flight from HKG-ZRH on 26 April who was really sweet, cheerful and polite and made everyone’s experience a little better.

Not a good experience at all. The Business Class on the 777-300 is extremely dated and not state of the art at all compared to the Business Class Seats of other airlines. Seats are extremely uncomfortable and narrow and sleeping felt like sleeping on a concrete floor. The pillow Swiss gives you in Business Class is a complete joke. Impossible to sleep on that. In flight catering is very poor. The starter consisted of two asparagus with some sauce and a piece of bread. No salad whatsoever. It was followed by a tiny portion of meat with carrots etc. as a main course. No more separate cheese service neither. The desert was absolutely tiny too - a piece of tasteless cake probably 1,5 time 6 cm. Prior to landing, there was a choice of a tiny sweat potato salad or gnocchi. It was ok but again far to little. The absolute shocker was the fact that after a 12 hours flight they do not even give you a wet towel in business class. Overall, not a good experience at all. It felt like a very dated product combined with a flavor of endless cost cutting/savings. If you fly on Swiss Business Class, definitely bring a pillow to sleep and some extra food.

Very friendly staff, comfortable seats and smooth transfer in Zürich with first class passport control and security. The  lounge in Delhi (Air India) must be one of the worst airline lounges I ever visited with limited choice of food and drinks. The on-board catering (food) in Swiss is also rather poor for a first class cabin. Onboard wifi was also poor (only 50MB which is quickly consumed whereas other airlines even offer free wifi in business class). I would therefore rate it an average first class product. Swiss has work to do to improve its catering/food offer where other airlines offer a superior product in first class. First class passengers should also be offered unlimited free wifi.

We are travelling under one booking, 3 adults and one child of 7 years. They assign a separate seat to the child, far away from any of us. The check in people say to ask the gate, the gate people could not care less and say you should have asked at check in. Phoning the Swiss HON service and they say lots of nonsense (like you should have done one grouped booking, which I did etc). We get in the plane and find another family with the same problem. I honestly thing there are better alternatives for a better service. A shame because the flying attendants are very helpful.

FA were extremely friendly and very attentive. For the first time since a longtime I received hot towels on a flight. The dinner was also very good including the signature dish in Swiss First the balik salmon. The wine selection had a very good choice of Swiss wines as well as great red Bordeaux and a rather special dessert wine from Sauternes area. Breakfast had several options as well including eggs and a sausage. Passengers did receive a pyjama from a rather expensive Swiss brand and an amenity bag by Bally however not in leather. Unfortunately the 2 restrooms for first are rather small and there was a lack of nice toilet amenities. Transfers were done at Zurich airport by premium cars and the First class lounge had a lot to offer.

Over 50 percent of my Swiss flights have been delayed, sometimes in excess of 90 minutes. The situation on the current flight LX52 on 04/13/23 involves an 80 minute delay on the tarmac. The stated reason keeps evolving from late connecting passengers to the flight log requiring an update to no further explanation after the most recent delay extension.

No drinks or food offered. Coffee priced at 4Chf and some awful sandwiches at 11 Chf. Only 1 toilet in economy with a full plane you spent most of the time standing in the back of the plane. Worst airline ever

On the flights between ZRH and STR I was surprised now seeing only sandwiches served in a paper bag similar as the ones handed out free to Economy passengers in the past. Only water, coffee or tea is now served on flights between ZRH and STR. On the flights between ZRH and BRU champagne is no longer served in business class but you can get some cheap sparkling wine instead or buy real champagne from the onboard sales menu. The only positive note on these flights was an extremely helpful flight attendant. Also when having Senator status you have access to the Alpine lounge at Zürich airport which is really nice, never crowded and with nice views over the airport and the runways

I have been trying to reserve seats for a week now. They keep getting canceled. I spoke to 9 agents today trying to reserve the seats. I finally reserved 2 seats at $35 each and 2 seats at $14 each. They charged me $168 instead of the correct amount of $98. Now they are lying about the price even though I have the receipt which they sent via email. I have asked several times to speak to a supervisor which they REFUSE! I have never had an issue with other airlines. They are so incompetent. Three agents hung up on me. I also got disconnected a couple of times. They never called back or asked for a call-back number. I am furious. I am leaving in less than a week and issue still isn't resolved. I can't call them back one more time. They are HORRIBLE! I will never travel with them again. I have spoke to over 10 agents just to reserve seats and still don't have any seats. They even tried to tell me that I don't have any tickets even though I have confirmation emails. They also removed me from my connecting flight and never notified me. I accidently found out by looking at the United app. They are despicable and so unprofessional. What kind of company doesn't allow you to speak to a supervisor? I'm disgusted to say the least!

The check-in was very fast and we enjoy very nice Swiss Lounge at airport. The seat was nice and spacious (for us). The food was OK but not good taste as we expected. The service by cabin staff was excellent. We enjoy some good sleep.

The check-in was smooth and the flight was a little delay. The seat was very nice and we enjoy our privacy and comfort. Their service by cabin attendants was excellent and the food was good. We also enjoy Swiss Air's snack service for all premium and economy class passengers with sandwich, chocolate bar, mineral water etc. We also tried cabin WIFI service which is OK but not cheap. The flight was smooth and we arrived Zurich only 10 minutes late.

12. On Feb 14, Swiss canceled my flight, offering return bookings that would extend my 10-hour journey to 24 hours, including overnight at Zurich Airport. I decided just to postpone my return for a day in order to get proper flights, and was charged an extra £250. So I was away a day longer than I wanted and, with (with hotel charges) was down £500. You can't get a boarding pass online for Cairo, so by the time I navigated the airport, my Swiss flight was closed. I begged and was allowed to board, but never again. Swiss uses a narrow-body aircraft with no in-flight entertainment or sockets for the inter-continental flight, with just the empty middle seat you see in business for short-haul flights in business. Swiss has substituted cheap sparkling wine for Champagne in business, but did allow me to pay for the Champagne that they sell in economy. I've been a huge fan of Swiss, but it appears to have sunk below British Airways now, so I don't see any need to fly Swiss again. Oh, and when I did arrive in Zurich, the business-class lounge was closed, without explanation. The same thing happened the last time I flew into Zurich with Swiss. And my flight was delayed. (On a separate note, I would never book Budget Air again. The airlines refer queries/problems to Budget Air, which doesn't have a telephone helpline.)

They were fantastic. But Swiss has taken to serving cheap sparkling wine instead of Champagne. I read online that this is a temporary supply issue rather than an economy measure. Why, then, are they selling champagne alongside the almost-half-price sparkling wine in economy? This whole trip with Swiss was a bit of a disaster -- the Champagne issue is a minor sideshow -- but more in another review. After being a cheer leader for Swiss, I can no longer recommend the airline.

A330 is now showing its age and cabins are in need of refurbishment. The inflight entertainment system is ancient, device charging set up, Wi-Fi is poor. A positive note is that Swiss has efficient, professional and friendly flight crew. The food beverage and service in Business Class is only average, Bistro arrival meals were limited and served as if it was fast food. The amenities kit was flimsy and not of value. Not what we had hoped for in business, but since Swiss Air, Austrian are controlled by Lufthansa it’s about what you expect. The Business class lounge at Zurich Airport is well designed, however the food offerings for morning departures was limited. Swiss clearly needs to invest in improving its Business Class product.

No food provided and water after 8 hours of waiting.  I needed to call the office in Zurich to get the new booking and finally get to our destination since out connecting flight was ruined as well. After 20 mins on the call  we finally got the flight on Finnair airlines departing in 3 days. They did not respond on twitter or Facebook even though in their web they encouraged to write there. Neither bot chat was working, just general answers and ‘We are sorry your flight is cancelled’. And then they we’re dropping us from the chat.

they rebooked my flight with a layover and now I will be missing a tour I planned for my limited stay in Zurich. Oh and no refunds on the tour since it's the same day. That aside, the foot room is horrible. I sit in the last row, to my left, is the door to the restroom. Every time someone opens it, I can see inside and sniff something. My row on the aisle seat also doesn't have enough space for my backpack. The space allocated to me is half the size of my backpack because of the placement of the support for the seats in front of me. Avoid SWISS.

S. While Swiss has been my favorite non-U.S. carrier, both flights were awful relative to aircraft and service. A few lowlights: Seats are very uncomfortable and do not lie flat. Cushions are weak and they are too narrow. Some aisle seats have no sides. Window seats with 2 seat configurations are difficult to enter or leave. Controls for seat positions are few and placed near where you easily can press one by accident. Storage near or under seats is very limited, it was hard to find a place for shoes or a purse nearby. The SIN-ZRH 777 plane was not very clean and smelt. The other 777 aircraft seemed very new, and was clean, but my seat did not adjust downward as much as my companion’s seat, poor construction and quality checking. Washrooms were like in Economy. Meals and beverages reflected cost-cutting, and I’ve flown Swiss business for decades. Cheap new plastic trays are used, limited refills were offered, galley snacks on these long-flights were popcorn or crisps in small bags and a few small candy bars. Wines and liquors appeared downgraded, as were the menus. Meat was tough. Deserts were ordinary. Service was abysmal. First meal on a 10 hour flight was served three hours after departure. Service on the Singapore flight didn’t offer nuts or anything on the side with drinks. My companion ordered sorbet from a menu, but was given ice cream even though both were on the menu. When she asked to exchange, the attendant told her there was no sorbet left. However, I was served 10 minutes later, inexcusable for a couple sitting together. I then received sorbet from a different attendant. I, however, had asked for ice cream but I was told now there was no ice cream. Yet later I saw two other persons receiving ice cream. Sorbet or ice cream is no big deal. But due to the contradictions either or both flight attendants lied or were too lazy to care. Neither is excusable and both cross lines. Cabin crew was not friendly, but the ZRH ground crew wins a bad conduct prize. As the couple in front of us were boarding, the gate attendant turned to a colleague, rolled her eyes and said disparagingly to her colleague “Americans”. I don’t believe she knew we heard her. ﻿

Originally, a Boeing 777-300 ER was to be used for the flight. Which was a little disappointing for me. This flight was my first intercontinental flight with this company in business class. I was pleasantly surprised by the comfort of seat 8A and the surrounding space. I found the business class configuration economical compared to companies like Singapore airlines. The food served was tasty and nicely styled. The staff was very attentive during the flight and fulfilled any requests. The interior showed the older age of the aircraft. Entertainment was sufficient. The flight went smoothly, we arrived in Hong Kong on time.

Starting off with the good things: The 2-3 layout of the airbus A220 makes people traveling alone in economy substantially more convenient than other offerings in the A320s or the 737s with the ability to sit on the 2 side so you are only next to one other person. The seat was relatively new, there was a complimentary bottle of water and a little chocolate was offered (see photo). Now the downsides, as a full carrier charging full carrier prices and in a somewhat new aircraft, the lack of in-seat power points of USB ports was disappointing. Other competitors on this route all offer some kind of in-seat charging options (even on AF's old A319s) so it's a big downside for Swiss. Furthermore, the drink options was limited to only a bottle of water, nothing else. It would be fair to expect some more options offered by the crew in addition to just a bottle of water, especially for a morning flight like this one. Overall if you are business traveller, although not being one of the best, Swissair still remains one of the more solid options out there.

I found out that you can submit a bid for an upgrade with SWISS. I wanted a lay flat seat but I've had no experience with international travel until now so I didn't know which seats would do that. I saw that I could bid for an upgrade to premium economy. My wife and I were both flying and the minimum bid for the upgrade for 2 seats was about $700 USD. Before I submitted my bid I called their customer service line to see if those seats lay flat. The customer service agent put me on hold to verify if they do or do not. When she came back on the line she said “yes they do”. I reverified with her by saying just to confirm, the premium economy seat lay all the way back, they lay flat, and she said the premium economy seats lay flat. I thanked her for her time and submitted my bid. I found out on the flight that the seats do not lay flat. I submitted a complaint to their customer service and asked for a refund for the upgrade since I was lied to and since the lay flat seats, which I did not get, were my sole purpose for upgrading. They refused to refund the $700 USD. This is completely unacceptable. This was my first and last time I will ever fly Swiss Air.
Don’t waste your money on seat reservations, it might be a waste of money. I was 22 seats back further with only a 50 minute transfer window for my next flight.

In business, welcome aboard with Champagne or soft drinks - FA were very friendly. You must get used to the single seat in business - I was surprised Swiss did not offer a hot towel anymore. There were decent choice of food for the evening meal accompanied by a decent but not luxurious wine selection. Swiss is still giving cheese and dessert that was served after the tray was removed followed by coffee or tea with some Swiss after dinner drinks and chocolates . Nothing wrong with the quality of the meal. You are requested to fill in your order for breakfast what was continental, prior arrival at Zurich. A very good however not spectacular experience and very friendly FA .

review_header: "the worst long haul flight experiences of my life"
review_text: If it’s avoidable I will never fly Swiss again, and I fly a lot. First of all, the app does not work correctly. You cannot even check in on the app, or choose seats, or add baggage. I had to use the Lufthansa app to check in and choose seats on my way to Brazil. On the way back not even that worked. The website also gives you an error when you check in. On my way back I had to check in with LATAM because I flew Rio to São Paulo on a LATAM partner flight to start the trip, but they would only let me check in for the first flight, so I had to recheck-in at the counter on my 2 hour layover - so I got a terrible seat for my long haul flights. Also the seats on the South Africa to Zurich and back flights are insanely tiny for an 11 hour flight, the smallest worst seats I’ve maybe ever had in a plane. To make it even worse the window seats have a 15 cm gap between them and the wall/window so you can’t lean on the wall (the whole point of a window seat). Worst food I’ve ever been served on an airplane, and that includes cheap African and Asian airlines. On top of that, they overbooked the SP to Zurich flight, and begged me to volunteer for compensation. I said no at first but told them I might consider it. They approached me after and really pushed me to say yes because they didn’t have enough volunteers. Then after taking my seat and boarding everyone else, announced my name on the loud speaker and told me actually I needed to get on the flight. At that point I had already asked a friend to come get me from the airport so we could spend the evening together and I had to call them off. They gave me a middle emergency row seat with no seat in front, so there was no place to put anything, no book, no headphones etc. Because I was the last person on the plane the overhead bins were full (they didn’t keep space for the emergency row people). The flight attendant told me I had to put my bag in business class. I told her I need access to it if I cannot have anything out of the bag for take off per the emergency exit rules, plus no seat in front of me. She started yelling at me she didn’t want to be on the flight and was tired of moving peoples bags around and it wasn’t her problem. She literally said to me “I don’t even want to be on this flight so you having access to your things is not my problem.” I was kind of in shock, and then another passenger volunteered to have move their bag to under the seat in front of them.
Water and chocolates handed out. Very comfortable and efficient.

We were supposed to have a layover in Zurich for 20 hours where we booked accommodations and had to forfeit the cost because we were rerouted to Singapore for a later flight. This meant we now had to wait at the Male Airport for 12 hours before our next flight! I tried to call Swiss Airlines multiple time, but waited for 2 hours and still no answer. Since a phone call was useless, I wrote at least 4 different complaints on their site and only received 1 email a month later which basically said you're out of luck.

Seat not comfortable and no duvet for overnight flight, only one extremely uncomfortable pillow and blanket supplied. Poor food with few options, no wine list offered. Waited 40 minutes from first course salad to my main dish arriving. Staff not attentive. Small restrooms with no space for changing into night clothes. Laughably basic amenities kit (socks and toothbrush). Poor choice of IFE. Brand suggests quality but fails to provide it. EVA Air is head and shoulders above Swiss on this route. Would not recommend

review_header: "you pay more but you get low cost treatment"
review_text: Flight was in time and inflight service was only a bottle of water. The ZRH-ATH was on A320 plane in good condition, departed on time. There was no IFE. There was no inflight service, than a bottle of water and a small chocolate. There was a buy MENU option. You could not change your seat at e-check-in, unless you pay for it. I cannot see the difference with low cost companies. On LH you pay more but you get low cost treatment.

We spent the entire day trying to get a hold of someone to rebook, we were told eventually that the only way we were getting on another flight is if we paid $400 extra per person. We finally went down to the airport (2 hours away) and waited for the desk to open so we could speak to someone in person. We were rebooked on a flight 2 days later. Instead of having 1 layover we were going to have 2. So our first flight is fine but then the 2nd flight is delayed which causes us to miss our 3rd flight. We were then stuck in Zurich to wait in line at that airport for someone to rebook us on another flight. Which then ended up in 2 more flights! We finally get to Budapest only to wait 2 more hours for our luggage which never showed up! We file a missing luggage report and don't end up receiving our luggage at all during our Christmas vacation. We ended up having to buy a bunch of clothes and toiletries which we have still not been reimbursed for. We didn't get our luggage back til more than 30 days later. When it arrived it looked as though someone dragged it through the dirt and, it went to my neighbors house down the street, not even my own house! We haven't been reimbursed for anything! Not even the $150 luggage fee when they lost our  luggage!
At the gate they run around with a scale to find cabin luggage with more than 8 kg and charge you 70€ for it. Worse experience than with other low cost airlines!

It took me 2 hours to talk to someone who was in a call centre with little knowledge about the airline. I asked to be called back if call dropped, which it obviously did and then no one called back. I dialled back and talked to someone who told me he couldn’t call back if it dropped. Call dropped again. I call back to talk to someone who took 45 mins to assess whether I could change my ticket. Long story short, they forced me to do an extra leg for nothing (thank you for the planet). I eventually gave up as the person was so unqualified. Horrible business class experience. I fly more than 100 flights a year for work and this is one of my worst experience. I used to Air France’s well qualified business class customer service who speaks English and actually cares about the company and its customer. I wish I could attach the recording of the call as it was just embarrassing the questions I was asked. The flight is a bit old and the service is low cost. Food is not good. Really not at par with other international company. I used to love Swiss, but this is my 3rd bad experience with Swiss business class in less than a year. If you travel business: avoid the company as there is no way to discuss with someone well qualified, and you have to wait 2 hours on the phone like any low cost economy tickets.

In the aftermath, the seats I got were in rows 28 and 32. At the check-in counter in Chicago however, they changed my seat for second flight to row 23, where legroom was spacious. Food in flight was bland for both flights. IFE was functioning, watched Top Gun series on both flights. There is a lot of room for improvement in terms of food and catering service. Other than that, it is a decent airline, but needs a lot of changes. Also got miles on my United mileage plus account.

No rebooking options were provided, and I will miss a crucial part of my business visit. The chatbot was entirely useless and no human showed up in the chat box to discuss options. No information was given about refunds. They have zero respect for customers. I had previous bad experiences with them but the flight connection from LCY was too convenient to ignore. Don't make the same mistake.

review_header: "they can't see any mistake from their side"
review_text: Unfortunately, my experience with my last booking to the US clearly clouded my opinion. As always, I booked my flight to Chicago via the Swiss Smartphone App on August 30, 2022 to visit my fiancé. I wanted to take the opportunity right away to bring our two cats over. I knew that this is easily possible with Swiss and that I simply had to call the hotline after booking to reserve the places for the cats in the luggage compartment. When I received the booking confirmation, I found that the flight was operated by United Airlines, which was unfortunately hardly visible in the app. However, I figured if Swiss partners with United Airlines, the policies and services will be the same. I then called United Airlines to reserve the space for the cats in the luggage compartment. I was quite disappointed to find out that United Airlines no longer takes cats in the luggage compartment. My disappointment was enormous because I had booked a flight that is of no use to me. I then called the Swiss hotline and I had to book a new outbound flight with Swiss with additional rebooking costs of around CHF 270. About a week later I call again to make sure the cats are booked and they tell me they are on the Chicago to Zurich flight, which was wrong! After several calls i finally managed it to have them booked on the flight from Zurich to Chicago and not vice versa. The day before departure I went to the pet store to buy a suitable transport box for the cats and called the Swiss Hotline from the shop to make sure I was buying the right transport box. The person on the hotline assured me that soft transport boxes with a steel frame are also permitted for cats. So I chose a model for CHF 120. When I checked in the next day at Zurich Airport, I was told that these boxes were not permitted and I had to buy a new one for CHF 140.00 on the spot and had no other choice than throw the other one away. I had additional costs totaling CHF 530 for this trip, which I could have avoided if Swiss had communicated correctly and the information on the app were more visible. Afterwards I have filed a complaint and i got a short and impersonal answer back that they can't see any mistake from their side. Partnerships with other airlines are legitimate, but it must be clearly stated that the policies and services are not the same. every time I called the hotline, I agreed to be recorded, so they should be able to find out about their misinformation, shouldn't they?

review_header: "My seat was changed from bulkhead aisle to middle"
review_text: No option to change back was offered. I later switched to an aisle farther back in the plane. No refund of the upgrade was offered. Boarding was delayed and not by group. Departure was delayed.

review_header: "I am very happy they repaid quickly"
review_text: On both legs the extra legroom wasn't allocated and the partner airlines gave a couldn't care less attitude about it and Swiss just sent automated reply when I complained by email. On returning home I requested a refund from Swiss and I'm happy to say that two weeks later we have been fully reimbursed. So whilst initially being very annoyed with their service and their partner airlines c.

They made me, my fiancée and 9 year old fly from London to Zurich knowing that we would have missed our connecting flights and that there were no others to Brazil the next day. We tried speaking to everyone, including over the phone only to be told that it couldn’t be sorted in the UK. No flights were arranged when we arrived in Zurich and we were put in a hotel and told to share a double bed! Nobody called us to advise and I accidentally found out we had been put in a flight by logging on the APP. After calling twice and being told I was not on that flight but on one later in the day (which did not exist) the advisor said I should go to the airport to ask there as he was not sure. Indeed we were going via Milan and I almost missed it because of their incompetence. We had no bags as we were told it was safer for them to keep them. After 3 different employees checking the bags were on the flight to Milan and following to Brazil, we arrived without them. They arrived 38 hours later. No compensation given and I was told by them they are not liable. Terrible service. Tight flight. Food not great. Worth paying more and flying with another airline.

I then asked for a seat reservation as I was unable to do it online as it was blocked for some reason, their website is a mess, I was hung up on another 2 times until I again was able to call and reach some who was able to reserve the seats with extra leg room in economy, I asked to be to the front of the plane as possible and they did the reservation for me and they charged my card more by $75 dollars than what was stated on their disaster of a website. I asked them to send me the new seat reservation and questioned them on why they charged me more than what was stated they said this is the way it is, and they refused to send me the new seat assignment on email saying they can only say it on the phone, what a mess, I must have spent two days on this story. I then called again to ask about how much an extra bag would be and they told me $120 dollars and I said no I will think about it and the next day I find a charge for $170 dollars on my credit card, what a scam of a company and I called again and was hung up on another 3 times until again I was able to reach someone and they said that if I cancel all is non refundable. I gave up and I can tell you I will never ever in my life use Swiss Air or Expedia both are disgusting and have zero notion on Customer Excellence. I do not recommend anyone to use both companies they are a disaster!

Board personell actively hid from passengers to avoid requests or questions. Every single order I placed came back widely incorrect but instead of just fixing it, the stewardess decided to blame me for the error. The catering from DEL is a major disaster.

review_header: "no better than any low cost flight"
review_text: The plane is very old. Thin and uncomfortable seats. The food was horrible and it would be better if it wasn't served at all. A flight no better than any low cost flight. A big disappointment from a company with a good name without a decent value for the price of the ticket.

review_header: "seats were shifted on the day of boarding"
review_text: I wanted to change my return ticket from Zurich and they forfeited my air ticket instead. I called to demand a refund since it’s their own system error and I shouldn’t be paying for it. They replied that there’s nothing they can do about the system Nor the refund at all. I called 3 different times and all 3 agents gave me mixed answers about my ticket status. Not only, I was told to send an email to rectify only to be five. A wrong email. So you’ll be spending time to dig the correct email. When I finally got there, they didn’t respond but attached a totally different booking reference to it. It’s as if you’re talking to the wall. I thought that’s the end of my drama to find out that my seats were shifted on the day of boarding. I think this is one of the worst airline ever.

At first Swiss sent me SMS when I was already on my way to airport, offering me to move flight as they overbooked. I did not opted for this as my family already waited for me for planned family trip. First they denied me check in at the airport and then they sent me to Swiss office where they issued me ticket for flight 6 hours later. No voucher of any kind offered and then when I contacted them, after one month they said that basically everything was my own fault (!) and that they are not willing to compensate me. I would never ever recommend such terrible service to anyone.

review_header: "not the Swiss Air I used to know"
review_text: From the crew to the ground staff very contemptuous in dealing with the traveler. The ground staff in Buenos Aires did not even speak English. Horrible food, the plane with broken seat upholstery. My seat was broken (it would not recline) and the cabin crew refused to give me another seat. The little time I was able to sleep I was constantly bothered by staff who kept hitting me as she passed. This is not the Swiss Air I used to know.

London City usually means cramped aircraft and limited service, but this was fully in line with flights into Heathrow. The service was attentive, the seat was comfortable and there was a decent choice of drinks, including Champagne.

review_header: "This to me was the final straw"
review_text: This to me was the final straw. I use the airline often to travel and I was not very happy with the services especially for long haul flights however today the services were below acceptable. We were offered the minimum compensation and the inconvenience is just too much. Never again. I truly believe that Swiss is probably the worst European airline that is not low budget.

We travelled from Oslo to Milan, tur-retour, in both cases with stop in Zurich. We bought tickets from ticket.no (not right from Swiss). We didn't chose the seats, but the company gave us seats to be together.  We could take care about our child together. We got water and chocolate and our child got toys (they tried also to give to him sweets but we refused). The plane was clean and the staff showed us respect. In Milan we had to wait like 5min close to the plane to get our baby trolley. The shuttle bus was waiting for us. The crew got out from the plane and they tried to help to find it. They felt frustrated because we had to wait so much (and the bus full with passengers was waiting for us) and they apologized. Back in Oslo, I found out that my luggage got a little damage. In the airport, I spoke with them from customer service (baggage service) and they apologized and gave me the chance to chose (from a website) a new suitcase for free. In my opinion, their focus is on the customer. It was a nice experience and for sure we will travel again with them.

They don't offer aperitif with a drink run and nuts or nibbles before dinner. Dinner is served on one tray with all courses coming together at the same time. That's not business class and once you have finished the starter, the main dish is cold. Also no choice of breads and just two bites of cheese with no crackers. It seemed that cabin crew wanted to get the service done as quickly as possible, but it's an 11 hour flight departing at 6pm, so no need to rush or getting people to sleep soon. The breakfast service on Swiss is decent with many options to choose from. I ended up with hardly any sleep, partly because of quite a bumpy flight (that's not Swiss' fault of course), but also the seats are not well designed, quite narrow and uncomfortable to sleep on. Connection to Amsterdam is on European business class, i.e. narrow seat pitch, hard backrest and just a small snack to eat. Lounge in Zurich was incredibly crowded around 11am, I could not find a place to sit down and left again after having only a glass of water standing in the corner like many other travellers.

I moved from Costa Rica to Berlin in the 21st of July, my 2 suitcases did not arrive at the airport. I spent hours trying to put a complain the same day. After a week I got back one suitcase, but he other one is still missing, it's about 3 months. Today is October 10th. I have tried to called them several times, there is no solution. I have written around 5 complains, no answer and no refund. I am moving from one country to the other, I really need my belongings. 15 days ago I received like a message from CLS express saying that they have found my suitcase and that they will bring it to my address. Wondering what happen? It never came. There is no way to contact them or the delivery agency. I was also told that visiting the airport will be helpless.

I will never fly Swiss again. My first-class seatback was broken (2A). They offered me a voucher for 50MB of free Wi-Fi on the flight (a $20 value), but the credit expired after watching just one TikTok video. The worst was the total absence of ground service, car transportation, priority boarding, first-class lounge with bathroom at JFK and Geneva Airport. Swiss is definitely going down.

review_header: "never fly Lufthansa or Swiss Air again"
review_text: No one informed me when I booked wheelchair assistance for my mom at the time of booking our ticket, that she could not sit in the row with extra legroom and receive wheelchair assistance through the airport. The Swiss Air employees at LAX refused her wheelchair assistance, so my 82 year old mom who had back surgery earlier this year, had to walk all the way through LAX to our gate.  Swiss Air sent me 3 emails during our trip, changing our seats each time, due to "equipment changes." We purchased our tickets 3 months in advance, in order to ensure that we had one aisle and one window seat with extra legroom for each flight, due to her history of blood clots in the legs. And without any thought, they removed us from our seats and stuck us in middle seats with no legroom. I spent approximately 3+ hours on the phone, of which I was disconnected 5 times. Swiss Air told me they could not help me with my seats and that I would have to deal with Lufthansa. I called Lufthansa and they said they would NOT help me because I purchased the tickets on Swiss Air so I would have to deal with Swiss Air. A continuous loop of BS and unaccountability. No one would help us with our ever-changing seat assignments. We even asked if we could change flights for our return back to LAX, and they said the fare difference would be $1350 per ticket. The day before our return flight back to Los Angeles, we received yet another email stating that my mom had no seat on the flight, AT ALL. When I called, I was subjected to one rude Swiss Air rep after another, all saying "sorry for the inconvenience, but there is nothing they can do" and that we would have to wait until we got to the airport in Milan. Swiss Air said that extra legroom fees are non refundable and they would not be able to refund the money from the seats that we originally purchased and were REPEATEDLY STOLEN from us. So let me get this straight. We paid WAYYYY too much money in the first place to purchase our original tickets 3 months in advance on through Swiss Air's website, paying extra for each segment in order to have extra legroom. Then Swiss Air changes our seat assignments 3 times, each time to a middle seat with no extra legroom.  And to top it off, Swiss Air tells us we have to go through Lufthansa and Lufthansa tells us we HAVE to go through Swiss Air. I was so disgusted with both Swiss Air and Lufthansa  that we finally gave up and purchased one-way tickets home on Emirates, which was the airline we should have flown to begin with. I will never fly Lufthansa or Swiss Air again.

One bag arrived 5 days late the other never got to our destination, but was shipped back home to Denver. We never got reimbursed for more than $500 worth of clothes that we had to buy in order to continue our travels. All the forms and emails we filed and wrote led us to nowhere.

review_header: "new low for a unjustified Premium price"
review_text: Unfortunately I got rebooked from ANA to LX because of flight cancellation. I avoid LH and LX on long distances because they offer much worse service than Asian carriers. So Swiss was always know to not be on par with ANA. But now they seem to have hit a new low. Flying premium economy with ANA gives you certain advantages. Lounge access, free choice of seats and a wide selection of on-board services. Swiss doesn't provide any of those. Their online a Check-in also didn't work. So my wife and I had to sit separately because we where only able to check in shortly before the flight. No assistance was offered. In flight their service is the worst. Rude CAs, cut Snack services and the Meals not available in Premium Economy. I understand covid has been hard on airlines. But the current state is new low for a unjustified Premium price.

They served me a piece of cheese and a dry rice cracker for breakfast. Looks like they combine all meals together, gluten free and lactose free. Everybody else got yogurt at least. Dinner was horrible, dry rice and chicken. Seats are not comfortable, our butts were hurting.

I tried about 6 times in 6 weeks to make my seat selection for this flight by phone. Each time I gave my credit card number to pay and the seat selected would show up for a couple days on both the Swiss Air and United websites and then disappear. My credit card was never billed. Then the final time my credit card was billed and I was assured everything was okay. When I got to the Geneva airport my seat was not available and I had to take another seat. Also on the phone I was assured that my luggage would be sent through to Dublin and that in Geneva I would be given a boarding pass for the LHR-DUB leg on Air Lingus. Neither of these happened. In LHR we had to technically leave the UK and enter again. Many times I could not reach a Swiss Air agent by phone and had to get a United agent to connect me! No way to run and airline.

review_header: "cannot comply with your request for a compensation"
review_text: SWISS does offer goodwill, however, we have been subjected to numerous limitations. Hence, I regret that SWISS cannot comply with your request for a compensation."

A flight attendant could've been less rude in telling me we were not supposed to plug into the charging station on the retractable TV stand prior to take-off. He came over and practically yanked out my USB phone charging cord with contempt. I could let that go as I'm sure he sees it all the time - not that I knew. But then halfway through the trip, I realized the padding on my seat was doing me no favors. My bum was sore and there was nothing much to do about it except sit on the pillow provided; the rest of the flight was full so I couldn't just move to a different seat. I didn't bother with any of the in flight entertainment but the food was forgettable. I suppose I have always associated the Swiss with high quality but that confidence has been shaken after this trip.

Boarded the plane and my colleague on the other aisle beside me was served champagne by an air steward and I asked for the same but he said I have to wait for the steward on my side to serve me. Very inflexible. When I asked the steward on my side, he said they ran out without offering me any alternative. Felt like a sub par economy class service here. When my main meal was served , it came all in one plate all at once, again like an economy class meal. During breakfast , they ran out of cheese spread for my colleague and she had to take mine. Very disappointed with SWISS for their on board service.

review_header: "the worst customer service I have ever experienced"
review_text: They changed the flight times and then gave me the option to change the booking dates, but said I needed to call. The airline said I was entitled to a full refund. They told me to wait and I would receive all the money back and could re-book. I told them that the terms and conditions stated I can't get a refund, but they assured me that there was a change in times so I would. I then only received 100CHF from the 2000CHF flights. They even admitted that I was provided the wrong information but said 'the operator has been disciplined, however we will not give you any more of your money back'. They ignored emails, letters and phone calls. Did not care. I spoke to friends and this seems to be a common occurrence with Swiss Arline's. I had wrong info given by Easyjet in the past and received a voucher instantly. This company is awful. if you book flights with them, just hope there isn't a change or any mistake in the booking because you will never recover money if they make a mistake with your booking. It is not worth the risk, use any other Airline aside from this one.

review_header: "I am so shocked by this treatment"
review_text: I only received about 1/3 of the amount I paid. I have been calling and emailing Swiss Air for the past 3 months. Emails are useless no one answers. As for phone calls, I called the UK line (+44 345 601 0956) and was on the phone with an agent. He was extremely rude and didn’t want to bother with the issue saying I should go to “swiss.com”. When I wanted to double check that everything was in order and my case was sent to the investigation team and when I asked to repeat and make sure, he said and I quote “am I speaking to a child?”. I asked to be transferred to someone else on the phone but he didn’t. I am so shocked by this treatment and the people working in customer service should really know how to speak and be respectful!

One of the female cabin crew was particularly poor. She failed to reset the video entertainment properly and when asked to do so again she asked if she was actually expected to walk through the aircraft to do it again. She was resentful and arrogant in the way she spoke to passengers.  There is also a problem with the dreadful design of the premium economy seats. There’s no foot rest and it’s a sliding shell seat which doesn’t actually work. Not worth the money. Economy looked like a nightmare. The food in premium was very good. Seemed to be the same as business just served on a single tray. Swiss is clearly a low cost carrier now but they need to upgrade their staff with new cabin crew who are up to the task.

In the end, I found out they charged double (8 x 330 CHF). Exactly the same amount for the small flight and one for the longer flight. They say they don't release any communication and there is nothing I could do. Never seen such a non caring airline. On top of that, our luggage was not transferred in Zurich and we arrived without it in Greece. Would not fly again with Swiss, there are plenty of alternatives luckily.

Originally the flight was scheduled at 9:35 in the morning, but they were not able to onboard due to a booking issue on Swiss Air's side. I accompanied them to the booking counter, where they had to wait for about an hour before someone helped us. A new booking had to be issued, and flying was not possible until 15:00. The new flights had then both delays - and my family finally landed in Bordeaux at 00:30 on July 15th, whereas the arrival was originally planned at 14:05 the day before. There is a compensation for these kind of cases, named "EC261-2004". Therefore I reported the issue to Swiss Air on their website. I only got an answer 2 weeks later, stating that the problem was not Swiss Air's fault, but occurred because of air traffic controller regulation. But it DOES qualify as a situation covered by EC261-2004. The booking was changed at the last minute by the company AND the flights had delays. Therefore I responded asking for a better answer, but the lady keeps turning me down. I then decided to call the customer service directly as it should be easier to clarify things over the phone, right ? So. I called and had to wait for more than 1 hour 10 minutes, with the worst voicemail I've ever heard. It really sounds like they are trying to discourage people! So, after 1 hour 10 minutes I finally got to speak to a lady and explained the whole story. I was quite angry at this point, and she recognized that we should receive a compensation. She then told me she was not responsible for this (seriously?) and gave me another e-mail address which I should contact. I sent an e-mail to this other address, more than 2 weeks ago (on August 29th), and all I got so far was an automatic response. There was a link in this mail, that should redirect to the contact list of Lufthansa's support. Guess what happens when clicking on the link ? I get this lovely message : "You don't have permission to access this resource on the server." This has got really tiring at this point. I feel like I have to fight for something that Swiss Air is deliberately ignoring because they don't want to take responsibility. This is a very bad customer experience, and I would definitely recommend not flying with them, because it just shows how much they don't care about their customers, let alone their poor support staff which is completely under water.

However, my flight was disappointing from start to finish. Beginning with their mobile app, I was not able to link my flight to it or even check in on their website, even though I had had no problems with these functions with other airlines just a week previously. Then I received an email the day before that my seat had been changed, though the email did not give a reason and there was no link to find out what my new seat was. I arrived at the Florence airport early because I couldn't check in online and it was then (only a few hours before) that I found out that my flight was delayed, first by 15 minutes, then by an hour and 15 minutes, with no explanation and no clear indication of the gate until after the original flight time. When I realized that I would miss my connecting flight in Zurich, I went to the Swiss Air clerk to ask what could be done and she told me that I had already been rescheduled for a new flight (for which I had not received an email). After asking more than once how I would board my new connecting flight without a correct boarding pass, she printed one for me. Our flight from Florence to Zurich finally left, 1.5 hours late. The only explanation given was that the previous Swiss Air plane had been delayed. After arriving in Zurich, most of the food shops were closed and I had to walk all the way to the other end of the airport for my next gate. The 10:35 pm flight was again delayed until 10:50 pm and we didn't actually take off until 11:15 pm. Once again, no explanations were given. And when we finally boarded, the clerk forced me to check my bag as being too large even though that had not been a problem on the previous flight, and even though I saw at least 2 other passengers with bags the same size as mine, who were not forced to check their bags. I had decided to limit my belongings to a carry-on bag and not check a bag so that I wouldn't need to wait at baggage claim. Because I was forced to do this, I was delayed and had to wait 30 minutes for my bus home. I did not arrive home until almost 1:00 am. I should have been home by around 10:15 pm. I hope never to fly Swiss Air again. It was a long series of disappointments.
My flight has been canceled. And I am still waiting my refund. It has been nearly 2 months and I want my money back. I don't recommend this company.

Flying on SWISS is like taking a crowded bus, with perhaps even poorer customer service. I had reserved and paid CHF 30 for an emergency exit seat so as to have more legroom. However, as is nearly always the case with SWISS before a flight, I received an annoying email, brightly titled ‘Your seat had changed!’ saying that the airline had ‘done its utmost to assign me an appropriate seat’.  Despite having paid for an emergency exit seat, I was assigned a regular seat far back, from what I could tell. I called the online check-in service for assistance, but one would be hard pressed to find a more clueless agent. Terms such as ‘emergency exit row’, ‘aircraft type’ and ‘seating configuration’ were completely foreign to him. I tried to explain them to him, but was met with utter incomprehension. I then called the regular call centre number, but hung up after 20 minutes of being told my call would be answered ‘shortly’. I finally went in person to the city ticketing office, where they confirmed that ‘having done their utmost to assign me an appropriate seat’, SWISS had decided to assign the emergency exit row to business class. Even Edelweiss, Switzerland’s leisure airline, offers you a snack, but not SWISS that is ostensibly a full-service airline. Paying close to CHF 500 for a short-haul economy class flight still doesn’t entitle you to a bite to eat. The only saving grace was that we landed on time – quite a feat given that every single one of my SWISS flights over the last few months has been considerably delayed, regardless of the time of day.

No SWISS staff or any official representative to provide an explanations. When arrive to Zurich we lost our connection flight. On ground There was no reasonable support. We had to run and find and guess what we need to do by ourself. When we  found the SWISS transfer desk they treat us in a rude and way. All the alternative solution she offered were poor. We spend hours at the SWISS counter there but they didn't offer us any food or drink vouchers. Later we had to locate our baggage by ourself.  I will never fly with them again.

Almost missed my connecting flight due to a delay of the first flight. Even though I made it, my baggage never arrived. I will never ever book Swiss Air again! My suitcase got lost and even after filling out all the forms at the lost and found counter it did not arrive.

The worst airline I have ever experienced. Gross incompetence. I was due to fly with Swiss to Geneva. I was flying with 2 cats so expected them to care. They cancelled my flight whilst at the gate. No Swiss representative arrived for 20 minutes. The ground crew were outsourced and didn’t have a clue. Swiss had rebooked everyone on a flight to Zurich but failed to tell anyone. They then couldn’t find taxis for anyone and told people to “find their own way home” (against the law). When requesting compensation they claimed that an fault with the aircraft is an act of god and they cannot accept the refund. Awful, awful, awful. They lied and lied. Eventually got us on a flight to Zurich (which was delayed) so we missed the connecting flight. Got the train instead. They promised a call back from a manager the next day. 2 weeks later still waiting for a call.

Ground staff is rude and condescending, not willing to help. People have to hand in their carry-on luggage as Swiss only allows 1 item per passenger. One item might be your handbag or laptop bag. Flight was full, seat OK. They brag about their food and beverage service which sadly is very expensive. There is one small bottle of water free for each passenger. Staff is condescending and makes you feel you don't deserve better treatment because you just travel economy class, something I have witnessed on several Swiss flights and never so much on other airlines. The airline markets itself as premium but there is nothing premium about the experience on board. Will not hesitate to book other airlines if available.

Both aircraft appeared new, clean and well-maintained. Services on both legs was water and a small chocolate bar. Both legs of my journey were delayed by storm activity, but handled really well. Many of us had tight connections in Zurich, and the crew made a point of reading out all gate numbers for those with short connections, as well as confirming that all connections would be honoured - a huge relief. Their app even confirmed to me that my bag had made the short connection. We landed in Florence during a storm where ground handling operations had been suspended. The captain came out to reassure everyone of our safety, made sure we got fed and watered, and invited children to visit the cockpit while we waited. Brilliant service, highly recommended.

Swiss cancelled my return flight from Sylt and I had to fly back a day later. They were kind enough to find me a hotel, but now expect me to accept compensation, less than the cost of the accommodation organised by them and less than EU law specifies. They keep telling me I am a valued frequent flyer, but this is not the impression I get from their customer service.

We found the gate agent to be very rude when asked about checked luggage and this attitude seemed to be reflected in the dismissive manner in which the flight crew interacted with passengers. We were seated in the first row (row 22) just behind the bulkhead dividing business class. During the entire 10-hour flight the flight attendants made “appearances” less than 4 times. We left the gate at Zurich at 9:30 AM local time. Within 1 hour of takeoff to provide and initial beverage (only a small cup, would not leave a full soda); then 2.5 hours after takeoff back to serve “lunch” although they failed to serve my wife any meal. Assuming that they may have been serving “special” meals first, we patiently waited. After 30 minutes and in looking around seeing all other passengers had been served, I pressed the flight attendant “call button” and it remained on for no less than 45 minutes without any sort of response! I turned it off after this time as it was clear I was not important. It was 2 hoursS after our neighboring passengers had been served, two flight attendants showed up to clear away the meal trays which by now littered the cabin floors and other areas as passengers had gotten frustrated with having no outlet for their trays and garbage. Once the flight attendants returned, I asked, “When will we receive our meals?” and was told they didn’t have anything available, but they would check…he returned with two vegan meals. 4 hours into the flight, we were flying with the sun the entire flight, the flight attendants failed to advise the coach passengers to lower their window shades…as they advised all passengers in the business class cabin to do (I could hear as I was the first row in coach) …so, it was next to impossible to get any rest in the bright sunshine. 6 hours into the flight the flight attendant returned to finally clear our meal trays and offer another cup full of soda or water. 8 hours into the flight was the last time we experienced the flight attendant where they handed out a silver dollar sized “breakfast pizza” and a US Customs form (with no pen). We landed in Chicago and deplaned at 12:20 PM local time. Baggage claim was #23 at O’Hare, we arrived at baggage claim at 12:45 PM (after passing through US Customs), the first bag to come down the conveyor belt occurred at 1:15 PM and about three bags would come out, then there would be a 5-10 minute gap before the next set of 3-4 bags would come off, and this baggage flow continued for the next 2.5 hours! It was 3:45 PM before we retrieved our two bags and 40% of the passengers were still waiting at the time we had left baggage claim. This was completely unnecessary and unacceptable service.
People press down in front and you have no room. Uncomfortable, too. Bagel with Philadelphia for breakfast, or banana. For the money we paid? Nice staff though.

First leg, no snack or refreshments except for a bottle of water and then a small bar of chocolate at the end. Long haul flight, hot supper not interesting at all. Breakfast, cold, box with a mini stale croissant and a Yoghurt. Would think it's a kids' box. Entertainment nothing to write home about. Very disappointed with the airline really. However, staff was absolutely excellent on both legs.

But nothing prepared for for when they lost my luggage and left me hanging: it's been 4 days and  nobody is helping, and I don't know if my luggage is lost, stolen, on its way, or maybe it is already here. Called Swiss and they had me on hold for 25 minutes trying to get me a phone number I got myself online in 15 seconds, only to find out they don't handle lost luggage. Called again and got another number which again doesn't handle lost luggage. Called again and got an email which does not exist. To summarize: lost my luggage, zero service, nobody cares.

review_header: "going downhill in terms of service quality"
review_text: On my most recent trip, while the flight and in-flight service were fine, the situation with luggage was completely different. After paying $70 per piece of luggage (fair enough - I did book an economy light fare which does not include luggage allowance,) one of our suitcases got stuck in Zurich. I have placed Apple AirTags in all my luggage, because I simply do not trust the airlines. When I filed the claim, I was able to show the airport staff the exact location of the missing suitcase (based on the aforementioned AirTag) - however in their system they had no information and they refused to note down any details. It took 6 days before the luggage was finally delivered. In that time I bought a few items to be able to make it through the 6 days with my family of 5 - but the airline refuses to reimburse beyond 100 EUR - and refuses to refund the fee for the service not rendered. (I am not bitter about paying and it was transparently disclosed by the airline - I am bitter for paying for something which I did not receive.) Additionally, my efforts to contact customer service were ignored (daily email to the provided email address requesting updates), unanswered (literally nobody answered the phone number provided), and when I finally did get through to an agent they ended up hanging up on me. This is by far the worst experience I have had with Swiss - and despite this, I would still recommend them, but they are clearly going downhill in terms of service quality.

review_header: "suitcases were delivered to us 3 days later"
review_text: And indeed, our suitcases (which had colorful coverings which made them extremely recognizable) were on an airport trolley right by the airplane. And at that moment, the captain announced: "Cabin crew, arm the slides". Almost immediately we observed the workers on the airfield starting to cover the trolleys with our suitcases with some kind of fabric. I rushed to the flight attendant: "These are definitely our suitcases there right by the airplane. Would we not load them into the airplane?" The flight attendant promised to check with the captain and went to the cockpit at once. Returning back, the flight attendant  replied: "We are sorry. These are your suitcases, yes. We were given a time window to take off now and we don't have time to load your luggage into the airplane". Two other flight attendants  witnessed our situation of total helplessness. We merely had to observe our luggage staying behind and comforting our child the way we could. Throughout the flight, I kept asking myself these questions: *It is minus 22 at our destination, and our child's warm clothes are not coming with us. Do they think that treatment of the passengers is normal?  I am the organizer of my father's funeral in a few days upon arrival, and my clothes for the ceremony are left behind as well. Upon landing, there were around 15 families in total including us who did not receive their luggage, apparently all from the trolleys we observed being left behind. Of our 3 suitcases we registered for the flight, 2 were left behind. Each of these families had to spend additional 2 hours registering the lost baggage, most of them with children like us, already in the late hour. At some point, we observed the whole crew of the Swiss flight just passing by. They had their suitcases with them, so why should they at all care? Fast forward, after numerous phone calls to the airport to check the status of our luggage, the suitcases were delivered to us 3 days later at 2 a.m. in the night. That was the earliest time they could deliver our luggage, but I agreed on that and spent the sleepless night, because my father's funeral was next morning and I desperately needed the contents of my suitcase by then. As a conclusion from our side, we are not using Swiss these days for our summer vacation. Having passed through that experience of ours, we are confident in our decision to not use Swiss ever again at all.

I checked in my case to Geneva, my end point. The Milan departure was late (maybe 30 mins) to board; as was the Zurich flight was late to board - approx. 45 mins - and we then sat for close to 75 mins on the tarmac. A series of refuelling and other delays causing them to lose their allotted slots. Not great but these things do happen. After asking specifically for an isle seat, I ended up in the last row, middle seat, blank wall, no window. Jammed in while we sat on the tarmac (I'm 6 foot 3).  I arrived in Geneva to discover my case had not arrived. To arrive in Geneva and wait around aimlessly for almost an hour at the carousel is a trying experience for anyone - but particularly so in my case, as this occurred after a cumulative 36 hours of travel from Sydney. No Swiss rep to engage with. No one to help. Then the long queues at the lost baggage office. This caused huge inconvenience as I had all my hiking gear in my suitcase. I was over in Geneva / Chamonix only for less than 6 days – so the loss was both very costly and very inconvenient. The case finally arrived back in Sydney 2 weeks later. But no home delivery - I had to go to the airport to collect it. No contact from Swiss; no apology. But the real frustration is that Swiss has:  no reliable 'push updates' on its website regarding the status of your bag and its expected time of arrival (ETA) - nothing - simply a void of information after receiving a call a week earlier to say the bag had bene found. After that a complete vacuum of information. No accessible channels to complain though - no email, no landline / helpline, and nonsensical/unworkable website, and  no accessible channel to submit and arrange a refund. Quite clearly this is an airline that doesn't want to be contacted. Their website makes it impossible to lodge claims – it feels almost deliberate – or at worst a terrible user experience, and their chatbot doesn’t work.I am not a happy customer and Swiss Air has not covered themselves in glory by any stretch. So much for Swiss punctuality and efficiency.

review_header: "luggage has been at the Zurich airport for 5 days"
review_text: I am medically compromised and need my additional medication in my luggage or I have to fly home. No one has responded to me despite 5 days of phone calls and emails. I have an air tracker in my bag and it hasn’t moved from the Zurich airport.

We were packed like sardines. I couldn’t even recline my seat because the knees of the passenger behind me were jammed into it, and prevented me from moving my seat back. There was very little leg room due to some structure under the seat in front of me. I’m short and couldn’t stretch out my legs. It was a night flight and I spent a very uncomfortable night for 10 hours on that plane. The flight was late and had to wait for a runway to take off also , 2 extra hours on that plane.

review_header: "didn’t get our second piece of luggage"
review_text: We had a 1 hour delay for our flight from Tel Aviv to Switzerland. We purposefully took only carry on luggage so that we wouldn’t have to risk losing our luggage or being delayed on our vacation. By the time we got on the plane, there was no room for carry on luggage. instead of telling people to put their backpacks and smaller luggage under the seat, the overhead bins were full of small bags so we couldn’t put our carry on suitcase there. The stewardess pressured us to send one of our suitcases with the bigger luggage and promised us it will get to our destination. We get to the second plane from Switzerland to Palma de Mallorca and they take our second carry on and reassure us that there is nothing to worry about. By the time we got to PMI, our suitcases were nowhere to be found. We were at the airport for another 4 hours and left empty handed, and there was no way  to reach them! We got one piece of luggage at 12 o’clock at night and we still didn’t get our second piece of luggage. I’ve called 6 different numbers connected to Swiss airlines, one of them didn’t even work and the other two ended in representatives telling us with no hesitation: “this is not our problem have a nice day” and hung up.

I HAD another flight today, in which to visit family, and had to cancel due to this inconvenience (not having my things and being told to purchase replacements for a “potential” reimbursement). We have received little to no help and I am aggravated. I tried calling and when I finally got through was hung up on, redirected to someone who redirects me again, or given a number to call that does not work. Please for the sake of your sanity and enjoyment of your trip think twice about Swiss, I don’t think it’s worth it.

No issue at all, seating was a bit tight but comfortable for the 1.10hr flight. Check in experience was positive and staff was of good standard. Returned with same type of aircraft and the service was good as well (probably better than first leg) but both of good standard. Airplane was full both ways but cabin crew managed really well. I bought from the shop and no issue there. There are areas to improve but for the short flight, it was a positive experience. Will definitely use it again.

review_header: "force to check in your carryon luggage"
review_text: I kept giving it a try, it’s been 4 times now and it’s been consistently terrible. Possibly worst airline and that includes budget airlines. Most understaffed; worst, rudest staff when it’s present to assist; they force to check in your carryon luggage even when there’s plenty of space on board; you can’t check in online to USA and have to wait endless lines (today was over 2 hours) at the airport (each airport I’ve flown through with Swiss - they have 2-3 staff at check in max). Even if you have only carryon you have to wait those lines and then they force you to check it. I never have issues with my carryon except for Swiss. The most stressful experience each time, save yourself some sanity. Never again, I really hate them.

review_header: "business class cabin was such a throwback"
review_text: There was zero privacy, and only small TV screens. I paid about £150 extra for a crown seat, with plenty of space, but I was perturbed to be able to look straight across the aisle at my neighbours. The flight leaves at 5:25am, and I missed the first meal service. I asked for a snack later and was served a not-very-nice chicken pastie. The "wine list" offered a choice of only two whites and two reds, with no mention of Champagne. I ordered a Swiss white, which was so nastily acidic, I couldn't drink it. (That's a first for me: I normally glug down whatever is on offer, even with Ryanair.) The breakfast was very poor. Service was OK, I suppose. I'd only fly Swiss long haul again if the price were very competitive. Oh, and the lounge at Zurich was closed. Oddly, the flight on to Heathrow was good, as were my two previous short-haul flights with Swiss.

review_header: "bags didn't show up during our 10 days"
review_text: Little did we know. First, because of a technical problem we departed Geneva almost 3 hours late and missed our connection in Athens. We then had to wait 7 hours to have seats on another flight and, when we arrived in Mykonos, our bags didn't follow despite confirming 3 times in Athens that it would be the case. But things got even worse: our bags didn't show up during our 10 days in Mykonos and we had to spend our holiday with only a few clothes and toiletries we bought there. We had no one to talk to and tried vain to contact them numerous times by phone and at the airport (the local agent). Our holiday ended up stressful and frustrating and was totally ruined. Now we are back home and one suitcase has still not been located three weeks later! To add insult to the injury, Swiss customer service (outsourced wherever in Africa and not deserving the name of "customer service") told us they won't pay an indemnity for the 7 hours delay as it was caused by a technical fault, and offered EUR 100 for the expenses, even though we spent our entire holiday without any personal effects! They have no longer anything "Premium" or "Swiss", despite their aspirations. Do yourself a favour and book Easy Jet: you will pay 4 times less and be treated better.

review_header: "the contract is for them to get me to my destination"
review_text: It was 11.45 pm and with small kids in the family we had to spend the entire night at the airport. This happened because any Swiss Air airline personnel we asked gladly passed the buck saying the next personnel we speak to will know how to help us. No one helped at the departure gate, the flight crew, at the arrival gate, and the counter at Athens was closed for the night. After spending around 7 hours once the counter opened we were able to get onto a flight. To those who say I am wrong about complaining because I should have read some unknown terms where the airlines is a point to point connection, let me ask them if they read their entire apple or microsoft contract or read terms for most of the products they buy. If I have purchased flights from an airline the contract is for them to get me to my destination and not leave me stranded. Sadly that's what Swiss Air did. There isn’t any way for me to get my money back or complain a different way I simply have my opinion and I intend on using it fully.

review_header: "worst airline I have ever flown with"
review_text: When we showed up to the airport, we found out they attempted to book us on a full flight, we’re denied, and we were never informed. Then the service person at the desk told us we have to call Swiss for help while they chuckled and scoffed. Once we called I was on the phone for over an hour trying to find a flight that was anywhere close to the one I booked. They wanted to take us from a direct flight to a flight that would take over 14 hours to go from Spain to Germany. After being hung up on twice and placed on an eternal hold we were met with attitude and told we would not be compensated for the hotel, the extra charge for my parked car, and our pet sitter. I made sure to moderate my frustration as much as possible, since it wasn’t the fault of the person on the phone. This is by far the worst airline I have ever flown with, and I will never fly with them again. I suggest no one reading this does either.  Stay away from Swiss airlines.

review_header: "not giving me my cancelled tickets refund"
review_text: And when I do so (within 24 hrs) they are not giving me my cancelled tickets refund.

review_header: "Refused to refund even a fraction of the ticket"
review_text: Forced to sit in coach because they were overbooked. Refused to refund even a fraction of the ticket price, not a penny. Literally fraudulent.

I arrived two hours before takeover to discover Swiss Air had five desks for all their flights. I was on a midday flight to London. After two hours queueing, and one protest visit to the front of the queue (to be told by an unhelpful desk clerk), I was told my flight had closed. A couple to my left were told the same and were incandescent. Desk clerks couldn’t care less. Told me to go to the sale stand for Swiss Air who offered me a flight in the evening. Had to book easyJet home, far better organised check in took 10 minutes. Swiss refused me a refund. I spent an hour waiting on the phone got through to a Swiss Air agent and the line went dead. The airline is run like Ryanair not a scheduled air carrier. Fly with anyone else and don’t waste your hard earned money with this sham of an organisation.
