To start, I have only paid $130 euro promo fare for one way ticket to Montreal. For the price, I get a lot more what I could have imagined. CDG to Zurich, flight was on-time, boarding went smooth, plane was spotless. My only complain about swiss would be that as other regional airlines like Air France etc, they do not provide any complimentary coffee tea on their European routes, nevertheless, we were given a bottle of water and small bite-size swiss chocolate. Zurich to Montreal, on time flight, spotless plane, I get to choose a seat with extra legroom, free of charge. Bottle of water, then followed by little snack and soft drinks service then after an hour in the air, lunch was served, 2 choices and I went for Thai rice, the meal was amazing, warm bread roll, fresh salad and creamy caramel mousse with cheese and butter. An hour before landing, cheese snack with ice cream and choice of drink was offered which is more than what you expect on any transatlantic route. Over all, I am so impressed by Swiss and will defiantly fly with them again!

Used to be that the slightly higher pricing was worth it for the higher than average service, however now it's clear the staff are stretched beyond thin (not their own fault), there are new convoluted classes and policies that are borderline predatory and seating refits to smaller, less comfortable seating for long haul routes (this last 12hr leg was a seat I would have expected on a max 3hr route). It seems likely this airline is in a death spiral as it's not better than a no frills, yet they're still charging as if nothing has changed. On my last trip, I was force downgraded due to overbooking, given "compensation" that was nowhere near the cost difference and then, in more words, told to shove it in follow up by customer service, as they're not subject to regulatory oversight for ch-non EU routes. At this point I'm actually hoping they go bankrupt so ZRH is forced to support alternative carriers.

review_header: "Few years ago SWISS used to have much better meals"
review_text: I booked a flight almost one month in advance, via "GotoGate" website. Paid a full price and got a confirmation. Than I arrived to luggage delivery in the airport two hours prior to my flight, I was informed that I don't have a seat as the flight is overbooked. Why me and not some other person? It's a really bad experience: I was on the "standby" list sitting in the airport and worrying, until the last moment not knowing if I'll get back home on time or be stuck in Zurich. They tried to look for volunteers to switch to another flight and get 400 eur compensation. I got lucky that someone didn't show up in the last moment, so I got a seat just at the last minute. Also, the quantity and quality of food went down. Few years ago SWISS used to have much better meals. Now you get few spoons of cold pasta, small cheese, small piece of ham, one bun and tiny cake. I remember the time it was twice the size.

I had originally booked to fly two weeks previously but had been informed that the flight had been cancelled a couple of weeks before departure. The rebooking process had been pretty stressful due to extremely long wait times when calling the airline's customer service center in Tokyo. I was on hold for at least 40 minutes. After rescheduling I noticed that the ticket was printed with my name in the wrong order which was partially my fault as I had booked the ticket on the Japanese site and in Japan they put names in the opposite order. I called up customer service again, was on hold again for 30 plus minutes again and spoke to a very unhelpful person. I was told that I would need to pay 3500 yen (about $30) to change this. The woman on the phone was rude and unhelpful. I was on the phone for an hour in total. This was not a free phone number so not only did I have to pay to change the ticket but also for a 2 long phone calls. The flight was scheduled to leave Narita at 11am and when I woke in the morning I had received a message saying the flight would be departing 40 minutes late. Check in was smooth and quick and the ground staff were efficient and polite. The plane was perhaps 60% full. Due to the closure of Russian airspace the plane flew east over Alaska which means the journey to Zurich was about 15 hours long. The seat was comfortable. Full complimentary drink service was offered with pretzel bites. The first meal was one of the better economy meals. I chose the Japanese chicken and rice, the rice was well cooked and not dry and the chicken was flavorsome. This was accompanied by cold soba noodles, a matcha dessert and roll and cheese. The second meal was pretty terrible, a veggie bake thing which resembled a split white sauce with some random veggies (one bite was enough). This was served with a carrot and lentil salad and some fresh fruit both were tasty. Snacks were available in the galley through out the flight. The flight attendants were friendly and polite. The entertainment system was easy to use and had an adequate selection. After a 4 hour hour layover in Zurich I took the fight to Johannesburg. Much the same experience. Friendly service and decent food. The main meal was rosti potatoes with chicken in a tasty sauce with a salad, caramel mousse and bread and cheese. Breakfast was small but fine, a croissant with jam, a piece of cheese and a yoghurt. Both flights were smooth, the food was decent, the staff were friendly, the cabin was clean and the entertainment system was adequate and easy to use.

review_header: "Not an airline I will use again"
review_text: Flight was operated by Edelweiss Air. Swiss allows 2 checked bags on this trip AYT/ZRH/CUN. At check in in Antalya the agent stated only one bag allowed, I had to argue with him and supervisor told him 2 bags ok. When check in agent stated only one bag allowed he first said $ 50 each extra bag. Then changed it to 75 Euro. Suggested cash payment before credit card. Gave me a boarding pass only to ZRH, When I questioned about the ZRH/CUN boarding pass he lied and stated the boarding pass was valid for both legs. It was only the small receipt, not an entire boarding pass and I had to get a boarding pass for the ZRH/CUN in Zurich. The flight I booked for the ZRH/CUN leg was a direct flight (LX8024), instead it was changed to LX8026 with a stop in Havana Cuba. Food was awful. Not an airline I will use again

Unfortunately, the first flight was delayed and I haven't been able to catch my second flight. I had to go to the transfer desk (no one on the flight crew help me to find it) and after one hour of waiting the desk person told me that all flights to Nice were fully booked until Monday (it was Friday). So I had to ask him if I could fly to Marseille, and probably rent a car to go to Nice, but the first available flight was the next day. So I had to stay for the night at the Movenpick hotel, next to the airport. I paid for an Airbnb that I haven't been able to use and the Swiss airline refused to pay for it. At the Movenpick, the TV was not working and the internet was barely working. I haven't been able to get my luggage, so get a refreshment kit. Concerning the food coupon, no one told me that it was limited to 20 CHF, so I ended up paying an extra 45 CHF. On my way back from Nice to Zurich, I experienced a lot of issues with your airline: - Issue with the electronics on the plane, forcing the plane to come back to the gate in order to reboot the plane. -Last-minute changes forced to renew the flight documents.  Last-minute changes forced us to add fuel to the plane. When we landed in Zurich, the group staff was late, forcing us to wait on the plane. The result has been to miss my connexion plane, again. The entire experience before, during had after the flights has been awful, and I recommend people to not use this airline.

I mean it when I say this was the absolute worse experience we’ve ever had with an airline and people couldn’t have been less helpful if they tried. Due to a delay by the airline we missed our connecting flight. These things happen and I understand that sometimes flights don’t depart as planned. When we arrived in Zurich we were given a 20 Franken voucher to redeem at restaurants. The text messages directed us to a link from which we are were able to choose from over 20 restaurants at their airport. The fact that we had to wait over four hours was acceptable given we had now time to grab something to do. We went from restaurant to restaurant that told us there is a mistake and they don’t accept these vouchers and after the fifth attempt of trying to redeem our voucher, we finally got lucky. Unfortunately as it turns out the vouchers didn’t work and we had to line up for another 30 minutes at the check-in as unfortunately the information desk was not able to provide any help. Besides, the flight itself was average. It’s not worth saving $200.

We landed 10 minutes before the next flight departs. I inform the stewardess and she does nothing. We ran and didn’t catch the flight. They give us boarding for next day and 20 Swiss francs for dinner, which is a joke, food here in Zurich is expensive. On top of that, we cannot find the luggage which has my medication on it! Service is a joke, I paid a lot to have such bad service and ridiculous organization

Even the Swiss Airlines bag tracker website I was told to check has no record the bag arrived. Once I figured out about my bag, and the Zurich Airport staff said: your bag is still in Amsterdam. Rubbish, expenses again and again.

The flight had a delay of 30 minutes, but boarding was smooth. I really like SWISS' modern product on the A220. The seats are very comfortable for short-haul economy and the large overhead bins facilitate finding a place for your carry-on luggage and thus speed up boarding. The flight itself was short and uneventful. There was no meal service, but passengers could order small snacks. I had a very tasty pulled beef sandwich. Though it wasn't exactly cheap, the prices are comparable to what you would pay on the ground in a Swiss airport. Passengers were also distributed free water and chocolate. The crew were very friendly and efficient. All in all a great short flight.

No offer of assistance in doing so at Frankfurt and Zurich airports. Legroom is minimal compared to Singapore and Thai. No variety on the food offered - one choice is all you get. On our flight back, Checking in night before, we discovered our VCE to ZUR flight leg was cancelled. No email notification, just relied on me checking my booking details on the website. Arranged a flight the next day, no offer of hotel accom. Went to VCE airport as well to ask for hotel accom, the check in desk told us to take it up with Swiss via email and keep receipts! Terrible. Get on our rearranged flight the next day, only to find the VIE to BKK leg was delayed so that we now miss connecting flight to Sydney. No one at Vienna airport seemed interested to help, they said 'sort it out at Bangkok'. Called Swiss via phone, and they said that they can't do anything. I pointed out to Austrian / Swiss that we can't leave Bangkok airport as we don't have the necessary Covid related pass. The Austrian Airlines person seemed completely indifferent. So now I'm wondering when I will actually get home to Sydney. And not one offer from Swiss (or their codeshare Austrian) for any compensation, even for a simple sandwich. Their customer service is completely apathetic at best, and abhorrent in their indifference at worst. Pay the extra money and go with another airline

Customer service is a mess. Usually you'll be dropped out the waiting line 3-4 times before you can talk to someone. Waiting 30-60 minutes. They even cancelled one ticket because service hotline and other business lines do not communicate well. They reimbursed me only less than 100 CHF despite I have paid a lot more despite they have mad an error. Online Interface is a mess for booking and nearly no process are digitally. In short the worst airline since corona. I did 10-15 short haul flights. I'm sure they'll be bankrupt soon - again.

review_header: "business class was not worth the extra cost"
review_text: Booked business class due to the long 8 hour flight time. The business class was not worth the extra cost in terms of seat size or comfort. However worst of all is that this flight was the start of our honeymoon. Our first day of our honeymoon would coincide with my wife’s birthday and would be spent in Rome Italy. This Swiss flight was so badly managed that we were 90min delayed and we missed our connection from Zurich to Rome. Instead of spending a beautiful day in Rome, we had to divert through Frankfurt and only arrive at our accommodation in Rome by 4pm and half the day was gone. I will never fly with this airline again. To top it all off, their wifi service was advertised all over the cabin however there was zero wifi and no attempt to fix this. This meant we could not inform our hosts in Rome that our flight had been delayed and we were charged double for the two trips they had to make to the airport.

Of course she had a ticket, booked 3 months earlier through Flight Center. Then instead of offering her a choice, they made an once-off offer to compensate her financially but said that if she refuses the offer she will go on standby and if after being on standby there still is no seat availability she will be stranded in Johannesburg without any assistance from the airline. This is absolutely unacceptable.  Needless to say, my wife was totally distraught and didn't know what to do. She messaged me and after at least 10 phone calls I managed to secure a seat for her on the plane.

Proof of ex Philippine citizenship, like a passport needs to be shown. Upon check-in, I was told I would need a visa for a stay of 2 months in the Philippines. I argued that I've done this trip many times before and enjoyed up to a 1 year visa-free stay. I pulled up immigration information from the web, published by the Philippine Embassy in Paris. I showed old passport stamps of Philippine arrival wherein my date of arrival (and maximum date allowed to stay) are clearly indicated on the stamp (like I said, 1 year visa-free). But the check in staff were not convinced. I had to rebook an earlier return within the 30 day limit. I was angry but I thought I would be able to resolve the issue later. Several times that morning, I was told to remove myself from the vicinity of the check-in counter to allow them to serve other passengers. I was the only Business Class passenger in the counter as far as I knew, all the rest were lining up in the economy queue. The station manager  made me feel like a piece of dirt. Upon arrival in MNL, I was given the usual 1 year visa-free stay. I wrote Swiss Customer Service, described the whole debacle, scanned the passport arrival stamp with proof that I did not need a visa to stay up to a year, and asked them to reinstate my original return flight for June. Customer service agent for premium passengers just forwards my complaint to the NCE check in agents to once again stated that I was in the wrong (even with my 1 year visa free stamp on my passport). The customer service continued to say via email, that it was my responsibility to ensure I had the right visas and paperwork when travelling, and that Swiss was not liable for any lapses in my judgement.  To call Swiss reservation lines, you are on hold for about an hour, and if you get through, one in two calls will be disconnected. Swiss has an excellent onboard product and I've flown them many times on business and lately for holidays to Asia (in business class). But this last experience has left a very sour taste in my mouth.  After this last incident, I am decided to move my business elsewhere.

Despite the inferior ”Euro” style business configuration, flights were good. Easy transfer (separate bus for biz class) and friendly efficient service on both flights. Decent snack into Zurich and good lunch into Lisbon. No complaints. On time, good and friendly service and luggage delivery efficient in Lisbon.

I was in Norway, but got COVID there, even after recovery, was no longer allowed to enter the UK because I still tested positive. I called Swiss Air to switch my flight from Oslo to SFO since I paid extra to change my flights, and they happily did so for $65- no problem! Then I get a charge for $900, and I asked the rep why is there a $900 charge? He said I submitted a $900 bid to upgrade to business class, and I informed him I did not. He said I should email them to cancel it and it would be no problem. I emailed them to get that canceled, but it was chaos from then on. The airline said I was not allowed to receive a refund because I submitted that upgrade request, but I reminded them that I was the one to inform them they request was wrongly submitted and cancel that upgrade that I never submitted or received (I only received an economy seat) but they refused to refund it. Over the next two months, I had to argue with Swiss Air every day over the phone and email to cancel that $900 business class upgrade that I never submitted, but they refused to cancel and were continuously rude over it. I had to report them as fraud and my bank refunded me the $900.

review_header: "decent meal for such a short flight"
review_text: Unfortunately this caused a delay of some 25 minutes. Good service, decent meal for such a short flight and friendly crew, the captain even did his welcome in front of the passengers.

For such a short flight the service was very good - a cold breakfast with ample choice of drinks - including Champagne and of course some Swiss cheese. Only feeling sorry that in Zurich a lot of planes are not parked at a gate and transfers were done by coach - FA were very friendly. Swiss is still one of the best in Europe in business.

I always select my seats in advance, for which I am being charged £ 30. I don't mind, because that gives me the opportunity to select the seat that I want. On at least 5 out of the 25 flights I was told either at the check-in or at the gate and once on the plane itself that my seat has been changed 'for operational' reasons, only to see somebody else seated in the seat that I have selected and paid for. I complained in writing that they should not charge me £30 for a seat that I did not select and not want and asked for a refund. Swiss refused a refund, although very clearly, I was paying for a service which they did not provide. I was assigned a seat by Swiss but I was being charged for 'selecting' a seat. I have had enough. I have made my last flight on Swiss.

review_header: "two small pieces of cottage cheese as lunch"
review_text: We had requested Asian Vegetarian meals. At lunch time, they gave us two small pieces of cottage cheese as lunch, nothing else. As I am a diabetic and need proper meals I asked for some bread and butter. Even that was not given. All these while other passengers were given meals.  On complaining to the airline after reaching Zurich, they offered me 50$ as travel voucher to be redeemed in our next flight booked with them. It was meagre and insulting. I rejected the offer. They did not even offer to streamline their procedure, not even vague promise if being more careful in future.. Their seats sucks. Once in sleeping position, your legs from knee downwards gets fully locked under the front seat and you cannot move your legs even an inch.
Arrived at destination my baggage missing (some others 20 people too). They brought my baggage 5 days later. After complaining, they will offer me 45 Euros as refund.

review_header: "cabin crew were grumpy and unwilling to serve the passengers"
review_text: The reasons given were: organisational but the 20 Francs for the reservation were not refunded. This is fraud in my view. The cabin crew were grumpy and unwilling to serve the passengers.

I boarded and check my bag in Milan. Once I landed in Newark and I was waiting for my bag, I was informed the bag was delayed and I had to submit a claim. After submitting the claim and after 4 days had already passed they supposedly found my bag in Cyprus. I called Customer Services in multiple occasions, sometimes they answer and sometimes they don't -- left 2 voice messages and they never return my calls. The information they give me when I call contradicts what the tracing systems shows. This is just a tiresome situation. One week has passed since my international flight and I still do not have my bag with me. I called customer service to inquire about reimbursement for expenses incurred and they indicated since I was in my permanent address they will not cover the expenses. I will not be using their service in the future. It's unpleasant and terribly inconvenient in general.

I asked the attendant if after take off could I move to the unoccupied section for more room. She said that because that plane was not full, the section was closed to balance the plane. They just did not want to give the customers a more pleasant flight by letting them spread out. My suitcase was damaged. just try and get anywhere on getting some compensation or repair for it. I have to say that the attendants on the flight were particularly wonderful. I should have gotten their names.
It was a quiet flight with about fifty people so no need for group boarding. They didn't do this on the way out from Zurich yet they did it from Brussels. I just find Swiss app and website poor.

Only problem is we could only do so via the phone line, which was constantly busy. When it came time to rebook we had to travel in a few days, I called numerous times to no avail, to the point I had to book a whole new ticket with another airline. I keep getting a generic email that they will not refund me the full fees, just a nominal amount. I have raised a formal complaint after sending at least 4 emails refusing the outcome .

A330 from Dubai to Zurich about 50% load factor, A321 from Zurich to Berlin less than 10%, therefore, plenty of space which made it tolerable, but would have certainly be different, i.e. cramped, if it were full. Catering on Swiss longhaul is above average for economy these days, a light snack after departure and breakfast before arrival, a cold one though, and also several drink rounds. Flight attendants professional, but somewhat reserved and robotic. Haven't used IFE as it was overnight, but from a brief glimpse, content was not overwhelming and the system quite old with a rather small screen. Easy transfer in Zurich. European flights have gone to Buy On Board, only a small bottle of water and a piece of chocolate for free. Prices for drinks and sandwiches seem insane, even for Swiss standards 11 CHF for a sandwich is an impertinence.
I congratulate the airline a wonderful experience flying with you, I will definitely recommend Swiss.

Too many redundant, repetitive checks in Mumbai throughout the process which were time consuming. They checked all the documents while checking in then they repeated checking the names with passports again before entering the gates and they made an X-ray and metal detector checks right after entering the gates which were already done by security. All a total waste of time and with only one boarding gate open and they don’t accept our personal masks.

I use Swiss since years, but only if I have no other choice (I'm Swiss living in Ireland). They have the worst website of all airlines I ever used. It ends up most of the time that I actually have to ring them and book and fight for not having to pay extra because I could not book online. It is hard for me to accept that in 2022 Swiss still do not have a proper working website. I can book a flight with all European airlines in 10 min, but it takes 30 min and 3-4 attempts with Swiss still I just give up again.

I was provided with no tracking number for the delivery and the DHL courier managing the delivery forced me indoor expecting my luggage for four days (dec 26,27,28,29). After complaining with Swiss, they offered me only a 50% refund of the cloths I had to buy, amounting to 65 euro, which is even less than the 85 euro (100USD) maximum refund I was entitled to according to their website. This is ridiculous given the exceptional inconvenience of not having the luggage plus being forced indoors and that the flight ticket cost 830 euro.

After I booked my flight online, I noticed that my name was misspelled. But the system was so badly developed that this simple mistake couldn't be easily corrected. I called several times to notify this. At first I was told that it's not possible at all, then after having been put on hold for many hours and finally, by calling different numbers someone assured me that the spelling of my name had finally been corrected. All this calling and waiting time added up to almost 10 hours in total. The day before my flight I noticed that I still didn't receive any e-ticket in my mailbox as I should have. When I called the airline and asked about this, a Swiss Air representative said she could not see my booking in the system at all. I was alarmed and decided to drive the 80 kms to Geneva airport, hoping to settle things. There, a representative who introduced herself as a supervisor, gave me a print-out and assured me that she had finally corrected and solved my problem. On the next day as my wife and I went to check in our luggage (about two hours before boarding time), the man behind the counter told me that he has no record of my booking in the system. The absurdity of the whole situation was unbelievable! After my wife pleaded with this man, he sent me to look for another colleague of his across the hall and told us that everything will have to be corrected "over there". When we got to the said counter, I was sent yet to another representative again. No one seemed to care or know what was going on. In short, the incompetency of these people was just unbelievable! My wife and I have flown with many airlines in our life time (some of them from the third-world countries) and we had much better experiences than this.

I test myself quite frequently because I am a caregiver but my final test result did not come in time for my flight. I was greeted by 2 unfriendly desk associates, showed them my documents and asked for help. I eventually spoke with someone and Wow the incredible customer service provided for me led to to write this. He told me to come back tomorrow morning to rebook for another flight and to not worry. Of course I worried! But when I arrived the next morning I was again greeted by a very rude attendant but I saw the same staff at the service desk and as he was quickly and calmly smoothing over other customer issues he helped me rebook my flight. Very polite, very professional, very kind, and quick to solve problems! Amazing! 9/10 because of the incredibly rude service before getting to the person who actually solved the issues at hand.

There is no monitors for the kids and very small narrow airplane. Everything is for money (food, drink). They mentioned food and beverage included but when you board they ask you its for extra money. So flying for 4 hours and they don't give you anything and the flight is not cheap compared to others. Also they declined my boarding on my way back asking for transit visa while the embassy confirmed no transit visa needed. They just made me lose my ticket and time and they were very rude at Cairo airport. I'll never travel with them again.

The European flights are no frills, but the transatlantic flights are top notch: good food, open bar during the whole flight, friendly attendants, good IFE. SWISS is my go-to airline for transatlantic travel.

Management should be ashamed. You cannot change your own flight on many flights - they ask you call to optimize penalties or ensure they profit maximize on price differences. Every time you call you get a different number - each person need to check with back office - on everything. Anyway - well done Swiss Air. You are now my airline of last resort.

The meals were the best I have  had on a flight, and the SWISS chocolate the crew handed out was fantastic.  I recommend everyone to fly SWISS, especially long haul. Tickets were cheapest for the route as well.

Returning. The ground staff had no capability of assisting passengers in showing PCR tests. In fact they were rude in the handling of this matter. There was no facility for business class in boarding. The plane was not equipped with business class seating. Couples were not seated next to one another. The seats were normal economy class with economy spacing apart for the center seat of three being vacant. There was no entertainment provision, only the small economy television used for announcements. The food was disgusting. The attendants were very apologetic and did their best under the circumstances. They recommended that we write to customer feedback services, which I did. Your "consultant" in Customer Feedback Services talks of the pleasure to welcome us on future flights. or wishes us "better luck next time"

When we have taken the flight LX139 from HKG to ZUR. We haven't received any cancelled notice when we have departed in Hong Kong, until we were landing in ZUR for transit to MAN, we have looked on the transit board, then we known that our flight to MAN, LX 390 flight from ZUR to MAN has been cancelled without any further notice of Swiss Air. There have had no one at the Transit desk of Swiss Air. Until around 9am 21 Dec 2020, someone was at the Transit Desk of Swiss Air and we have queued up, until our turn and we have been told that our flight has been cancelled, due to Swiss government has been banned all UK flights to Switzerland because of COVID-19, and it have had no current reschedule time. Then we would like to pass the border to go to Switzerland and book a hotel room, but because COVID-19, I could not pass, because I'm holding Hong Kong SAR passport, and my husband couldn't leave me alone. And we told that all to Swiss Air. On the first day, Swiss Air still has provided us coupons for meals and drinks, sleeping area. From the 2nd day, my husband also couldn't pass the border, because Swiss Government did not allow UK passport holder to go into Switzerland. However, they have stopped to provide us food, drinks coupons and sleeping area, no compensations until we have flights to leave ZUR due to the reason that they have only recommended us to go back to Hong Kong, because they think we bought return tickets, and we have refused. Because the thing is, our final destination was Manchester UK, and we just only bought one way ticket. Swiss Air stopped providing us everything, but we just only can stay in the transit area. Luckily, we met some people they gave us their food coupons to us. Swiss Air had provided a flight from ZUR to Turkey, then transit to MAN, but, the earliest flight was on 27th Dec 2020. We still have had no choice to stay there, and keep asking Swiss Air if there have any flights. In the afternoon, they told us, they will have flight to LHR (London Heathrow Airport) on 24 Dec 2020 morning, they didn't told us other flights. At that moment, our mental and physical status were collapsed, so we agreed. Finally, we have made it to London Heathrow. However, one of our luggages was lost and we reported to the airline desk immediately. But there has only to fill the form on a computer, we have had no choice except to submit, and we did it. When we arrived Manchester, we emailed to Swiss Air that we would like to claim the train tickets and the extra fee in ZUR and the luggage delayed. But they replied only claim 40 EUROS, we absolutely cannot accept that offer. Until 29th Dec we got our luggage back, but it's damaged already. Swiss Air haven't taken the full responsibility.

review_header: "quality of the service and politeness of the staff is nowhere near fine"
review_text: They attacked me almost the whole flight due to the mask-wearing. Almost every minute a crew member was coming to me saying that the mask is not properly worn. When tried to explain that I can't drink with the mask, they said that I can't drink for so long. By which right do they decide on how long I drink or how I wear the mask?! The overall impression is like spending time in prison with preoccupied wardens. The funniest thing is when I've left the plane in Moscow, almost no one around was in a mask. Crazy kindergarten in the plane, never again! And no food provided. The quality of the service and politeness of the staff is nowhere near fine. Only adepts of the disinfection church may enjoy this!

review_header: "a day trying to contact customer service"
review_text: 07.2021 tried to buy Prague-Zurich ticket. Got to payment, Visa confirmation message, after this the screen became blank and there was nothing I could do. Checking my CC account - the payment was there. I spent a day trying to contact customer service, without success. Filled about 3 inquiry/complaint forms - no replay. After this I resolved to buy the same ticket through a booking company and it was a snap. Anyway it cost me a day of anxiety, irritation etc. As I am obliged to use Swiss due to luck of alternatives and in about 30% of cases I had problems with payments, web page problems and lamentable customer service. Have been flying swiss for about 35 years.

The good: the flights were pretty much on time. The bad: We paid extra to select premium seats. Did not make a difference as we got moved around sometimes not even sitting together. This would have only gotten me to remove one star except to enter Switzerland and Spain we needed to get Covid Healthforms with Q-codes. These forms needed seat numbers. As Swiss Air was playing musical chairs with our seating assignments they invalidated all our healthforms. This forced us to run around the day of the flights to edit Swiss and Spainish online forms and get new Q-codes issued. As our AirBnB did not have a printer I was running up and down the street trying to get a merchant to print out the new forms.

Since the work with clients at this airport is awful and no one explained to me where the exit to international lines is, I could not immediately find my gate and missed the plane. My suitcase flew to Zurich, where I had a change plan. After a long time figuring out how to rebook my ticket and return my luggage, I was helped to solve all these issues quickly and easily. I am very grateful to the manager for this help, which relieved stress immediately. Please note his competence and willingness to solve the client's problem politely and quickly.

At check in counter, agent was super friendly and checked my luggage without any extra charge to make my travel and transit at Zurich a bit more easier. Boarding and departure was on time. There was no "Welcome on board" greeting and smile but thats ok. Plane was clean except under the IFE tv screen, there was this thick layer of dust which I ended up wiping out. Right after the take off, crew gave out little snack of olive crackers and a whole can of soda, I asked for diet sprite and i was told straight up that only coke zero is available, still ok. Within an hour of take off, dinner was served, main portion was really small (two thin layers of beef and carrots and mashed potatoes), ample amount of salad, small dessert and two rounds of bread roll and drinks. Coffee or tea was served after dinner and then crew just disappeared. One particular crew member seems like she was forced to do this job, her attitude was very up-tight (take it or leave it), rest of the crew also seems like not really interested in doing their job. I was surprised when breakfast was served, it was just a muffin and a coffee, didn't expect that from swiss. Anyhow not a really impressive airline as I imagined (Air France and KLM are my only European airline choice from now on and lets not compare Swiss with Qatar Airways).

review_header: "the way they handled my delayed baggage situation was absolute trash"
review_text: Staff in Newark were friendly. Boarding in Newark was on time, however departure was delayed because some cargo from the inbound flight spilled on the tarmac and needed to be cleaned before the flight could depart. Really? Why not send the flight out on time and clean up the mess after, so people can make their connecting flight? Crew on board was lovely and food was good. Arrived to Zurich 40 minutes late, this left me with 20 minutes to make it to the flight to Kyiv. Luckily, the flight to Kyiv was delayed 20 minutes, so this gave me 40 minutes total to transfer. I felt relieved and was sure all was well. Boy, was I wrong! In Kyiv I received an SMS that my luggage was left in Zurich! How is it that I was able to make it to my connecting flight, but my luggage was not? Zurich is not even that big of an airport. The bag was put on the flight to Kyiv the next day, and I was told they'd set up a delivery for me. Another day passes and no word of my luggage being delivered to me. I contacted Swiss customer service in Ukraine, and was told that it is not their responsibility. So you mean to tell me, I fly with your airline but the luggage that you transported for me is not your responsibility? I finally had enough and went to Kyiv airport myself to get my luggage. While the service on the ground and in the air were excellent, the way they handled my delayed baggage situation was absolute trash. I highly do not recommend Swiss to anyone.

review_header: "This airline has the worst customer service I have encountered in a long time"
review_text: I flew with Swiss Air on Aug 4 from Tel Aviv to San Francisco via Zurich. Since I was dreading the possibility of sitting in a center seat flanked by two strangers during the COVID pandemic, I purchased reserved seating to ensure an aisle seat on both flights. The reservation, for which I paid 70 US dollars, was made already in May. Shortly before the flight Swiss sent me an email informing me that they changed my seat assignment. They did not disclose the position of the reassigned seat, but wrote that they have done their “utmost to assign an adequate seat”. When I boarded the plane, I discovered that they had placed me in a center seat, flanked by two strangers who did not keep their masks on – exactly the scenario I was trying to avoid. On the official SWISS airlines website I see the following: Might SWISS change the seat I reserve in advance, later on? If SWISS has to change your seat reservation, e.g. due to a short-notice change to the aircraft type used, SWISS will do its best to automatically reserve you a new seat in the seat category you have booked. If it is not possible to reserve an equal seat for you, you may apply to receive a Refund of the charge online. Upon arriving to my destination, I filed a request for a refund. I was answered 11 days later by a customer feedback consultant, she flatly refused my claim. When I politely pointed to her that the official website states that I am entitled to a refund she gave this rude answer: “SWISS has responded adequately in your case. I therefore trust in your understanding that this message reflects our final position and that this file is now considered closed.” I was shocked by her response, and asked her for contact information for her supervisor, which she completely ignored. I then tried calling the US customer service phone number. I tried twice, but gave up after waiting for 60 minutes each time. This airline has the worst customer service I have encountered in a long time.

A good airline tries to make allowances for this, exercising their discretion to be generous. Swiss International is NOT such an airline. I originally booked a light economy ticket leaving on 5/8/21 and needed to change my dates. I couldn't get through on the internet and tried to do so via phone. The person I spoke to on the phone gave me incorrect information. They said the money had not yet been taken for the first ticket, so I could just cancel it and should buy a new ticket. I thought that what they said was correct. I later found that the money for the first ticket had been taken, that I was given the wrong information. That person even suggested I keep both tickets in case the first flights were cancelled. Eventually, just before I flew, I panicked and just asked to have the taxes refunded, not the whole ticket. When I tried to have the issue reconsidered, I was told that no refund would be forthcoming. I am very disappointed in Swiss International and hope that I can use my usual airline for travel to Switzerland, Easyjet, for all future trips. I would advise others to keep away from this airline.

review_header: "none of my emails are being answered"
review_text: I can’t get through to anyone when I try and call and none of my emails are being answered. They are stealing from customers - don’t use!

The seat is good, although very narrow for Business Class, but very private. The airplane has been retrofitted to the new design, so it looked very nice. I liked the design of the small business cabin in front of the galley, but the when but put into flat-bed, the seat was more like a coffin. The pillows are small, and you do not get a comforter or a seat topper like on most other airlines. The service was distant, and the food just OK (I used to work in my younger years as a Swissair Flight Attendant, so I know what to expect and this was a huge let-down). Swissair was proud of having a multilingual crew, but now is was reduced to 2 languages. The crew was not trained in wine-pairing, and had no idea of food allergies!
Friendly FAs, good choice of movies, great service.

This flight was just myself travelling CPH/ZRH/FLR/ZRH/CPH in Business Class. The service onboard has gone down hill, now there is only one cabin member serving Business Class. Furthermore, the procedures have changed now their complete every passenger with meal, drinks, top up etc before moving down the cabin. This means that the last rows are lucky to even get served on a short route. Final leg I had 15 minutes before arrival. I noticed the seat pockets in front of me had not been cleaned but rubbish had been left from the previous passengers. But anyway, here is the absolute shocking experience happened upon arrival. My bag (and the bag of several others) did not arrive. Our flight was over 2 hrs delayed and all onward connections were lost. When I found out that my bag was not onboard, I went to the handling agent (Aviator CPH) desk - empty. No bell to ring, neighbouring desk also empty. So, I had to leave the Airport with no report. Since then I have tried to phone Aviators - no reply. Emailed Swiss in ZRH, no reply. Wrote to the on FB - got a reply to say please fill out this form. However the system says unable to complete this form if you boarded on a self service airport. I didn't self service, I was checked in at the Business Class desk. I give up now, I consider the bag lost - I donate it to CPH Airport. Enjoy. I for one will never fly Swiss again, all these nice words about service are easy but in real life I have a very bad experience. Sad and Bad.
Very modern brand new B777 aircraft.
1 year is more than enough time to manage it. I am very disappointed.

review_header: "responsibility to make sure all documents are valid"
review_text: I prepared all documents needed to travel prior my flight and when checking in NY JFK I was told that all documents are correct (pcr test) and the dates were valid, as soon as I get to Zurich to catch the Pegasus Airlines  flight to Istanbul I am surprised by the agent notifying me and my friend traveling with me that our PCR tests dates are invalid and that we will miss the original booked flight and unfortunately we did miss the flight and were told we have an option to be booked back to NY which was totally unprofessional and unacceptable. So in order for us to resolve our situation on our own with absolutely horrible assistance from Swiss to find a reasonable solution we had to pay $165 each for a PCR test done in Zurich which results arrive after 5 hours and  we had to book separate tickets to Istanbul $400 by Turkish airlines which happened to be the only flight available that day in order for us to arrive on time for our booked medical operation in Istanbul. So overall the worst experience for me in an airline and unreasonable judgment from Swiss airlines for PCR testing dates which is impossible to get prior the flight, note in US testing centers have a 2-3 business day time frame to get results and our flight was on Sunday (Saturday &sunday are weekends). I contacted the customer service and asked them that we would like as a courtesy for this experience to get a reimbursement for the additional expenses, and their response was it’s the traveler responsibility to make sure all documents are valid, even though they let us travel from JFK to Zurich and they have the final destination and could have told us that our PCR won’t be valid when i get to zurich. MY ADVICE don’t ever travel with this cheap airline. Thank you
Cancelled my flight booked for 29 May 2021, now lying about refunding. No point cancelling flight if you don’t then want to refund people back when you fail to provide the service.

The seat does afford extra privacy but the whole cabin was nice. Service was outstanding, all the staff clearly wanted us all to have a good experience. I found the amenity kit excellent because I liked the little Victorinox tin that the products were presented in. Food was delicious. got a good sleep on the trip over Atlantic, I have read some people suggesting the bed is firm, I thought it was great. I cannot think of a Business Class experience I liked more than this... I highly recommend Swiss Intl Airlines and am looking forward to my flight to Tokyo in July!

However the flights were cancelled due to lockdown and I was provided with option to re-book the flight ticket within Jan 2021. I decided to book it now and I have tried to contact them online and they used to reply only after 12 hours with huge price differences. So I called them to re-book. I was told that it would cost 1600 DKK extra. (Which is 50% extra to my previous payment). I checked their website and the same dates and the prices listed in the website are less than the price I have paid already. I asked them why they are charging extra than the price listed for the dates in their own website. They have me 3 different answers in 2 minutes time. First they told me that I have booked in tariff S last time so I have to re-book in the same tariff even though there are cheaper tariffs available. I was stunned with that answer. Then she recalculated it and told that their "goodwill" rebook policy allowed her to charge me the lowest tariff available and I need to pay only 1200 DKK. I said they charge me whatever they want just because I didn't have other option so they are scamming me. She got furious and told me to go with cancellation and book again in the website instead. She knew that I can't do that so she literally blackmailed me. At last I was forced to pay 1000 DKK extra just for rebooking in total which cost way more than the live price in their own website.

It was full of backpacks which usually must be placed under the seat but the cabin staff didnt bother to remove any of the backpacks and a stewardess was trying to explain to me that space for cabin luggage is not as per the standards. I had seat at row 25 and finally they found a space above seat 1 which is not acceptable since upon landing I had to walk against the other passengers in order to collect my cabin luggage or to wait all passengers to leave the aircraft. Unfortunately this is the only airline which you can use for local flights in Bulgaria. Poor quality service and unreasonably high air tickets.

review_header: "better to pay a little bit more"
review_text: 07.24 after many many attempts I have finally got to speak to Bulgaria Air representative regarding an issue with the booking of my checking luggage. Turn it out I have not made the booking for luggage for my return flight. In order to make that extra booking, I was sent a link to make a payment via email. Payment was made I received my receipt and I went along with my journey! As I was attempting to Check in my luggage before my flight back on the 20.07.24, I was surprised to find out that the luggage was not included on my boarding pass, So I had to pay again because the airport staff did not recognise nor accept the receipt I have received for my payment! Now a day after my flight after near 50 attempts, I’m still unable to contact Bulgaria Air on their phone number! I would recommend for everybody to stay away from that company unless absolutely necessary. Sometimes it’s better to pay a little bit more but have a nice flight and have everything arranged.

I had a flight booked originally on the 2nd of February 2022. I asked a few days before the flight if it was going to happen they said yes. It was cancelled and they offered my money back or to reschedule the flight for the 05/02/2022 to which I said yes re-schedule it. I receive an email with my ticket. On the day of the flight they said I was in the system but not on the plane - after which they told me to go and ask a help desk located in the airport. They said i cannot board the plane, and that the only way for me to fly on the day is to buy a new ticket, and the money to the newly bought ticket would be returned. I sent e-mails pictures of boarding passes and they said it would take them 2 months to process my issue. 10 months later I did not receive any answer so I emailed them. They returned the money for the first flight which was 150lev cheaper. The money I got refunded was not even the full amount! People are struggling to make ends meet and they don’t even bother to fix your issue and in the end they return not even the full amount of money. Absolutely unbelievable! I would never recommend flying with them, super unprofessional!

Will never fly with them again and would recommend avoiding. Incredibly unprofessional agents. They made a mistake boarding after a delay that resulted in further delay and missing our connection (for which we had a 3 hour layover). Since it wasn’t over three hours they claim to owe us nothing. Their mistake resulted in a partially missed trip and over $800 additional travel expenses. Worst airline ever. I sincerely hope the gate agent for that flight was fired after her behavior. It was appalling.

Anyway, I was seated in row 9; row 10 was an exit row so I was invited to sit there since it was empty and was willing/able to assist in case of an emergency. Te leg room is excellent, and I measure 183cm. The staff were professional and courteous. Bags came out quickly. We were given water upon boarding, then a chocolate bar, then a croissant filled with chocolate sauce (worth the calories) and finally a small drink.

One flight they told me at the check in that the strollers they do not put in bags and I was suppose to know that which I didnt so my stroller came broken in the us. Very unprofessional and the team is the same. They have wonderful flights with great connections and prices but because I had so many times struggle with them I will not book a flight with them. And I am Bulgarian!

I was told I'm no longer on the flight less than 24 hours before departure. I emailed on the 22nd of April asking if I can receive a refund for my flight, which I did not receive. I was given alternative options such as rebooking my flight for a future date, but not once was I told that my flight would be or has been cancelled for me, only to find out myself a few hours before the flight. The woman I spoke to on the phone was very rude and unprofessional, ignoring my emails and ending the call on me several times. This flight was important for me to take as I had a connecting flight after, and I was told that the only way I could take the flight is if I upgrade and pay 400 levs. I paid for my original ticket, and for it to be cancelled for me without any notice is absurd, any other airline would at least email me or let me know? I have been on many flights and I have never encountered something like this.

I will never fly with this airline again. The most undereducated, complete even lack of try to understand arguments. My children 7 and 10 are flying today unattended by an adult with flight attendant. According to UK Government rules children under 11 do not need Covid test. I tried to reason with the check-in agent who wouldn't even hear what I had to say. Their tickets were detained by the airline staff and I had to pay GBP 420 so they could come home
We were promised a refund but never heard more and Air Bulgaria stopped responding to emails.

After 30 days of waiting for rescue flight back to Europe, finally I was able to go home. Rescue flight was operated by British Airways and they flew from Lima to London. Since I can't enter UK without visa, I had to buy ticket out of London asap as I land. There were no flights on the same day, but there was a flight on the next one operating by Bulgaria Air from London to Sofia. I purchased that ticket. I was about to wait 24 hours at the airport and I was fine with it. Meanwhile, Bulgaria Air canceled that flight and rescheduled for the next day. That was not fine for me as I can't spend 2 days at the airport waiting for the flight. I purchased another, more expensive flight through different city and went back home. It's almost a year and Bulgaria Air still didn't refund me my money. I tried to explain them that since they didn't operate the flight I purchased ticket for, they have no rights to keep my money. They give me some lame explanations that it takes them longer time to return money or that I can reschedule that ticket for another flight. Which one, I am asking, when whole Europe is locked at the moment. I don't want to travel, I just want my 200 euros back.

We had booked tickets in and out of Croatia via London. We thought we had paid for baggage both ways. When we checked in they told us we only had paid for baggage on the return trip. It was supposed to be 30-40 euros extra for a bag but at the counter they told us it would be 150 euros for the first bag and 75 for the second unless we paid on the Croatia air website, which wasn’t working. So we paid the 225 and submitted a claim when we got home. They asked for proof we took the flight, receipts and my banking information to process our refund. All of which I provided. Then after not getting paid for months I followed up. They decided they wanted me to courier the receipts to them in Croatia… so I did. Still nothing for months. Then they decided they needed a screenshot of the website not working… which I could not provide. So was ultimately denied after initially being told I would get a refund. As it should’ve been 30 euros online or 40 at the counter. They never answered why their staff charged 150 and 75 at the counter.

What followed however was diabolical. Staff on ground had no idea what to do. Sat around for 5 hours then transferred to hotel 1.5 hours away from airport for basically a 3 hour sleep as the next flight scheduled at 6am next day. Got to airport at 4.30 am only for the rescheduled flight to be cancelled 30 minutes before boarding. Next flight schedule 8 hours later, with no support while we sat around the airport. Arrived 40 hours late and missed our international connection. Have written 18 times now to the Croatia Airline and applied as per their website for compensation which is applicable under EU law. Not a single response.

My wife and I flew from Milan (MXP) to Split (SPU) on September 22, and my bag never arrived. We were upset but followed the procedure, filed a PIR report with Split Lost and Found, and were told the luggage would likely arrive the next day. We naively thought, "Okay, let’s try to enjoy the trip, and tomorrow we’ll have our things." How wrong we were. Once you deal with their customer service, you realize no one cares enough to help. They just say, "It’s not in our hands; contact Lost and Found." Lost and Found, in turn, says it’s up to the airline. The lack of communication and cooperation is shocking. The situation got worse when I was told my bag wouldn’t be sent to Split until September 26—four days later. So, we were at a beach destination without proper clothing. We had to buy essentials and file a report in the hope of reimbursement, though reviews suggest that’s unlikely. Imagine spending hours of a short vacation shopping for clothes. It may not sound like a big deal, but try finding beachwear at the end of September when stores are only selling autumn clothes. And all the while, we were calling and emailing Croatia Airlines and Lost and Found every day, only to get little to no response. By September 26, the day they originally said the bag would be sent to Split, we were no longer in Split. I had already asked two days earlier for the bag to be sent to Madrid, our next destination. Yet, on September 27, to my shock, they sent it to Split despite my clear instructions that we wouldn’t be there. I continued calling and emailing anyone I could find, but no one replied with any useful information. It doesn’t matter who you contact, even the CEO—no one responds. They are utterly incompetent. I got more help from Iberia (who wasn’t responsible for the lost bag) using the PIR number than from Croatia Airlines. Finally, on September 28, my bag arrived at Madrid Barajas Airport at 12:30 AM on an Iberia flight (they’re the heroes of this story). I was told I’d be contacted for delivery once it arrived, but that call never came. I spent my last day in Madrid calling Croatia Airlines—no answer. I sent countless emails—no response. It was Saturday, so I guess they were resting without a care in the world. On September 29, the day of my return flight, I went to the airport early to try and find my bag. Still no word from Croatia Airlines -- it was Sunday, probably still resting with complete peace of mind. At the airport information desk, they let me into the arrivals area where Lost and Found is located. Since the bag was sent on an Iberia flight, I went to their desk. The staff there was surprised at my bag’s journey: Milan, Vienna, Split, Zagreb, and finally Madrid. After some patience and tracking, they finally found it. After an entire trip without my belongings, I got the bag just before checking in to fly back home. My vacation was ruined, and even if I’m reimbursed a few hundred dollars for clothes, I spent far more on flights and hotels only to waste my time dealing with Croatia Airlines' incompetence. Be warned: if you fly with Croatia Airlines and encounter an issue (lost bags, delays, etc.), you’ll get no help. They’ll make minimal effort, if any, on your behalf.

We paid around 950 Euro for a 1h hour flight. There were no other options when booking. Later discovered there is a monopoly to use only this airline from Split Airport. Others on the plane paid more. To make things worse, seat selection was useless despite paying for extra leg room. They made us move to the back of the plane to balance the weight. We were not allowed to take our carry on luggage as the plane was a small propeller old clunky dirty piece of junk. To make it worse the overhead storage cabinets were mostly empty. We were only given water. The staff were great but Croatia Airlines are an absolute rip off. We learnt the hard way. Will NEVER fly with this airline ever again.
Changes of gate without proper information. Exhausted air crew, no space for backpack overhead.

They have truly terrible customer service and do not care about customers, nor do their italian counterparts in the bag retrieval department. My bag was lost on a direct flight. How does that happen, well it does on Croatia airlines, it ended up somehow in Germany and it took them 3 days to find it. Woman clerk at split airport mentioned my partner's name several times on a long call while we waited to check our bags, and when we asked what it was about she said had nothing to do with us, weird. Then bags were mistagged and his bag was tagged as mine and mine tagged as his went missing. Trying to find anything out was awful with their baggage tracking was offloaded to a company that literally hung up the phone on me repeatedly. Then they once again handed responsibility off to another company to deliver the bags, with no ability to find out what time or day it would arrive. We were traveling and had days activities planned, well forget that, we had to literally not leave our apartment in case they showed up, which driver came at 830pm, and he said he had been working for 24 hours straight delivering lost bags. I believe it! No apology, no compensation, no concern. Avoid if you can!

They were on time within 15 minutes for both flights. You drop your bag on the tarmac and they load it into the belly of the plane. And then you pick it up directly from the tarmac after the flight, so there is very little chance for lost luggage which I like. They allow a smaller carry-one bag as well. They did not weigh our bag or try to charge us for anything extra. We were allowed to pick our seats for no charge. The seats are standard and comparable to Southwest airlines for leg room and space. We were served water and drinks on both flights. For the price we paid, it was a great deal. Some people might be nervous about flying a propeller plane, but it was a very smooth flight in both directions with almost zero turbulence and a very smooth landing. If you had to fault them for one thing, it would be nice to have some in flight entertainment. Other than that, it was a perfect flight. Definitely recommend.

2nd leg Zagreb to Split by Croatia Airlines. Once I arrived in Zagreb I found that was flight was cancelled, which can happen. I was rebooked at flight 5 hours later and provided with lounge access to overcome 4 hours. However, they did not let me in, over unfriendly staff and they just let hang around their clients and spend money in the bars. This was a one time experience.

The staff appeared disinterested, unhelpful, and lacked basic courtesy. Passengers were treated as inconveniences rather than customers. The flight was uncomfortable, but it was the shocking attitude of the airline's personnel that truly made this trip unforgettable for all the wrong reasons I strongly advise looking for alternatives to Croatia Airlines.

I am by all means not a difficult or needy person, and generally don't have the need for posts like this. But my limits have truly been pushed! We travelled to Croatia on July 15th, when my daughters luggage didn't arrive. We filed a report after waiting in line for God knows how long with a baby and a 2 year old. Long story short, I still didn't receive the luggage or any form of payment from Croatia Airlines as it is now their responsibility to do so. I had to scramble and buy clothes, diapers, formula and other things necessary for my 4 month old at the time. Definitely not the expense I had intension of having. The airline is very slow at getting back to me about any information at all times. The phone numbers listed on their website, are all out of service when you try to call at any time of day/night. I have filed numerous complaints and sent emails with detailed amounts of things and their cost in the luggage. Emails were sent to any form of contact I was able to receive. Still no word of location of the luggage or pay-outs of any sort. Unfortunately, we have no desire to go or suggest to anyone to go and visit this country, due to rude and short tempered staff you have to deal with no matter what the problem might be.

review_header: "need to do more about overall organisation"
review_text: Cabin personnel - overall rate - referring to uniforms are very rustic. Meaning that cabin crew need to have fresh look, tided hair and clean uniforms. Informing passengers for delay of flight - 30 minutes we were waiting just for answer when we can expect our flight. On top of that no service personnel on gate 16 at all / not even from Company responsible staff to explain. Believe that this company need to do more about overall organisation and staff.

review_header: "I was treated in a disgusting and childish way"
review_text: I was asked to place my carry on luggage under my feet and advised the female crew member that I would like to leave my pack in the overhead luggage due to having long legs. There was plenty of space in the compartments surround me so it shouldn’t have been an issue. The crew member was quite nasty but eventually agreed, late on in the flight I fell asleep and my knee was slightly out in the aisle but certainly not enough to prevent the drinks trolley from passing me without incident. I was woken quite suddenly by a sharp pain in my knee only to find the trolley had slammed into it. I said to the flight attendant that she could have woken me to ask me to move it only to have been given a very ride look and her muttering obscenities under her breath, which I chose to ignore. Later in the flight when she was collecting rubbish, she took all the empty cups from the passengers around me but totally ignored me and refused to take my empty cup. Other passengers obviously noticed this rudeness as they had witnessed the other events earlier. One even asked me to make a complaint but I chose not to as it wasn’t worth the trouble. Basically I was treated in a disgusting and childish way and even ended up having a large bruise on my knee. Disgraceful behavior to say the least.

However, that is a lie, and there was sufficient visibility. All the other flights for Sarajevo successfully landed. We have received no option but to go with the bus for some 6-7 hours drive. We have received 0.25 bottles of water (number of bottles was insufficient to cover all passengers). We did not even depart at the time when we were supposed to be in Sarajevo already. Very unpleasant Croatia Airlines staff verbally fought with passengers and rejected to provide their ID number or any kind of accreditation. Worst experience ever.

Boarding was done with bus at very remote location. The aircraft a little overused. Seats were standard Euro Business that had better days. Safety presentation was done with dropdown screens; the first row left screen was not operating. Welcome was professional but not friendly. After departure service started which was consisted of a box with local produced packed products. There was a selection of drinks and sparkling wine. At the end coffee was offered which were 2 spoons of coffee and hot water – nothing special. No IFE app. At Dubrovnik had to bus transfer to the terminal had to pass through passport control, print your boarding pass and go through screening again. No connecting passengers’ service. Lounge at DBV was small and selection of food was 3 different kinds of sandwiches. Boarding to DH4 was done by bus but this time crew was much friendlier. Service was much better, asked if wanted second round of drinks and same coffee was presented perfect. Pity that the airline doesn’t have consistency.

During the flight they were quite rude and after, I had to contact them for some information and they took more than a week to reply and they asked about the flight info 3 times. The service was terrible!

While the communication was fast, we were only given a choice of a ridiculously long layover for the first flight and a two days delayed return flight which was not acceptable. It didn't seem like they actually tried to help us and were not particularly friendly.

This is after I had already provided the booking and the proof of payment to Aegean ahead of my flight, as I could not see them reflected at the time of online check in. I wanted to avoid being charged twice for something I had already paid for and spent significant time sharing all proofs with the customer service team. Yet on July 27, I was asked to pay an extra 70 EUROS for 2 luggages. I have been trying to contact the customer service team, I have filed a formal refund request, and today was denied it. .
I was told baggage would be delivered by 2-3 pm but not delivered until 7pm. Phone support service offered no help or additional information.

I am an ardent believer of Aegean being the best airline in Europe, in terms of on-board service. They still provide soft/alcoholic drinks free of charge, as well as a meal in economy, which is a genuine rarity these days. They also offer Wi-Fi free of charge, though it does not work very well in most flights. I enjoy flying with them.  I have yet to be on an Aegean flight during the summer that does not leave at least 1 hour later than the scheduled time. My flight from Larnaca to Athens was delayed by 1 hour, and my flight from Athens to Tirana was delayed by  1 hour and 45 minutes. I think the staff need to be more attentive with their behaviour, as on all my recent flights with Aegean, when boarding and de-boarding, they have their backs turned on passengers and are chatting amongst themselves. Anyways - the shortcomings i have mentioned above, are ones I believe many airlines have, and for which Aegean compensate with their onboard service and the perks that they offer even in economy. I will certainly fly with them again.

Firstly, the staff member clearly wasn’t reading my emails, as they kept calling me ‘Mr’, when I continually signed my emails as ‘Miss’, and they only corrected themselves when I called them out on it. Over the course of one week, I flew two flights Aegean. And from those two flights, I lost three expensive locks from my checked in baggage. When I reported this to the customer service staff online, I did not ask for reimbursement, I just wanted an explanation as to how this could have happened. At this stage I had been travelling around Europe for 5 weeks with many different airlines, and not once did I lose a single lock. Then, I flew with Aegean twice and lost three locks?  The locks were also very expensive, strong locks that I have also used on other overseas trips, and not once did one get broken off or lost. The customer service team were completely useless, and I am still disgusted by their responses, or lack there of. No matter what I said, especially when simply asking how this could have occurred, and how could I know for sure that a staff member / unauthorised person hadn’t broken into my bag (considering there was no damage to the bag to indicate they were broken off by accident), the customer service representative continually stated the same thing over and over again, speaking as a robot. This was their response every time: ‘Based on our previous communication, we assume no liability for specific types of damage, including broken/missing lockers. Therefore, we count on your understanding that we are not able to respond favorably to your request’. The only other statement they provided was: ‘your baggages when you travel are absolutely safe with our colleagues’. Even thought they could/would not confirm how the bags are supposedly safe when the locks that are meant to protect the bags and it’s contents were removed? I was not asking for compensation (despite them being expensive locks), I just wanted to know what happened, and got nothing back. There is no way it is just a coincidence that I lost three locks with their airline; one lock lost I would understand, but not three.  It is completely unacceptable.

On the return, instead of being in the upfront seat that I have paid, the put us at the end of the plane. Aegean said that they were fully booked and they couldn't give us our seats! The offered to reimburse and give 1500 miles. They confirm that the miles are credited and I am sending them a proof that they are not.

They were quite rude, especially during the meal distribution. Some passengers who were not fluent in English needed the food options to be repeated or clarified, but the flight attendants were clearly impatient and impolite in their responses. Their facial expressions also showed visible discomfort and irritation, which created a tense atmosphere for the passengers. While walking down the aisle, if a flight attendant was coming from the opposite direction, they wouldn’t even look at you or make space — it was as if you didn’t exist, and you were the one who had to move aside. Finally, when we were leaving the aircraft and saying goodbye, they didn’t even acknowledge us, as they were too busy talking among themselves. When we arrived in Yerevan, only one of my suitcases arrived — the other was left behind in Athens. It was only sent the next day.
Breakfast served right after departure. Coffee and drink with chocolate was offered after breakfast. Flight was on time and there was WiFi offered throughout the flight.

You will pay for a flight and maybe get on it because they overbook every flight and put 6-8 people on standby. WHY would I pay for a flight, holiday etc. to MAYBE get there? Whole process was rubbish and staff unfriendly, don't get a boarding pass because you're technically not on the flight (you paid for) so even checking in a bag is a nightmare and they just send you to the help desk. NEVER flying with this airline again.

The level of service is consistently outstanding: professional, warm, and authentically Greek. Flights are punctual, aircraft are well-maintained, and even short routes offer thoughtful in-flight service and comfort.  Aegean stands out for its attention to detail, hospitality, and reliability.

We called a month in advance to say we would miss the first leg of our flight but wanted to get on for our second leg. They told us it was fine but when we showed up in Athens they canceled our flight and made us buy new tickets and pay for bags again. They were rude and lied to us in order to get more money. Avoid them at all costs!
All the rest service excellent with good punctuality .
Cabin was very clean and quiet. Crew were very baby-friendly. Food was disappointing. Drinks were fine. Check in was smooth and so boarding and disembarking.

I was on row 20 and legroom was tight. Crew was friendly offered candy on boarding and midflight sandwiches with drinks. Free wifi is offered but most of the time was not operating (maybe due flyhing over sea)

Aegean run the second leg of a Lufthansa route. Came to check in and Aegean have reallocated our seats from our pre-booked, pre-paid row at the front to the back of the plane with no notification - we only discovered the issue the day before travelling. Despite repeated attempts to resolve the issue by us over the phone and online and by Expedia (Aegean hung up on the supervisor) Aegean have failed to provide any justification or apology. Lufthansa, who run the route, are similarly disinterested - they have no say or control it seems. All we have been told is that the change is due to operational reasons. Unfortunately this is not the first time they have had an issue with us travelling with our child - during our last flight they took away the seat we had booked for him. Oh, and no one knows where the refund for the money we paid to book at the front of the plane will come from! Aegean’s customer service is shocking. If they don’t want to discuss the issue they will simply hang up. There’s no point complaining, they will simply ignore any communication and not reply. We’ll not be using them again - once can be forgiven, twice is inexcusable.
There is not enough space to place cabin bag and they are picked up at entrance. Crew makes no effort to place luggage.

review_header: "have to pay a name change fee"
review_text: Aegean charged me a name change fee to correct the letter I spelled wrong on my name. I mistyped a letter. They spoke to a supervisor who insisted I have to pay a name change fee to correct that letter on my name, as per policy. Aegean want to make money off my little spelling error.

I am afraid of airplanes and they helped me calm down and relax. Special thanks to Maria for being there whenever I need her. The best flight attendant!! Her customer service was super. She was there to help and make me feel comfortable!

I had the chance to fly business on this trip and was pleasantly surprised by the food assortments and wine, but rather disappointed by the seating and overall feeling of lesser luxury. It is a shame that the seats offer a lesser premium feel and lesser comfort and appearance, especially for business class, as they operate some beautiful new A320neo aircraft. Wi-Fi on board has never worked in my case, but this could be an isolated issue. Business class does not offer many inflight entertainment options apart from magazines but as a short haul airline this has never been the largest inconvenience. The cabin crew is always a delight, and boarding happens almost always at a gate with minimal delays (although this is not always on the airline).  I have definitely flown a lot worse, but also have flown better. My score is for my most recent business class trip, and I note that it would be slightly lower if I were rating for my experience in economy class. Improved seating, cabin appearence and economy offerings would make my next review score higher.

review_header: “Hope not to use their services in the future”
review_text: All the other details were done correctly. So when yesterday I went to the airport the person at the bag drop told me that I had to contact with the customer service of the airline company to do the necessary because of the mistake with my surname. I called them and unfortunately for my surprise the responsible of the company informed me that I had to pay AGAIN a NEW TICKET at the price of 73,80€ just to rewrite correct my surname meanwhile my name, birthday, visa number and all the other were correct. It was really funny that at the same flight an employee of the company offered 250€ cash, one free ticket and a ticket to fly from Rhodes to Athens with the flight of 20:15 to a girl just because it had happened a "problem" with another customer of their company who flew to Athens. I wonder if there is in Europe somebody to explain to us the customers of Aegean Airlines why the company asked me to pay twice the price of my ticket just because of an error that happened probably not only to me but maybe also had happened to others. The policy of this company is at least unreasonable with the only motive how to steal money from their customers. Imagine that I have a member card of this company. The way they punish a mistake is at least ridiculous. Probably they think that we leave in the '80s where there was not the information we can all of us have. Hope not to use their services in the future just because of the way they think they can treat to their card members.

And when we asked for compensation for the delay they regarded it bad weather although the delay was obviously logistical. Also the plane got crowded, the seats are too close, they might cancel tickets and rebook them away from each other, and you easily catch a flu from how close the seats are together. Other airlines were much much better, this was my worst experience.

Indicated at the counter. The handling was done very well. We arrived on the next flight and were taken directly to our address. Super! The entire flight also went great. Friendly professional staff. Flying with Aegean is a relief. Bij aankomst op Rhodos was er een koffer vertraagd. Bij de balie aangegeven. De afhandeling is super gedaan.
