Checking in was also the most painful check in of my life we had to rush to make our flight. A solid three people were working to check us in and they were zero help. They wouldn’t give us our TSA pre check which we have never had an issue with before. Their covid protocols were non-existent as well. After all that, they printed out several wrong boarding passes. The flight attendants were so rude because we were the last ones on the plane.

review_header: "She did absolutely nothing to resolve my issue"
review_text: 62 on Monday, April 05, 2021, and called to cancel on April 06, 2021, due to one of my family members I have been in contact with getting COVID. I purchased for an extra $50 the flight insurance that Jetblue offers that advertise "Get your cancellation fee waived and refunded 100% of your flight". I would like to add that there is no additional information about this insurance or any disclosures provided. They also say I can cancel online, but my option to do so was greyed out. So, I called JetBlue customer support. I waited 45 minutes for the representative to be rude and not empathetic. She had informed me that the insurance they offer is actually through a third party called Allianz and said that I would have to file a claim with them to see if I am eligible for a refund. I did this which took a lot of time. Allianz denied my claim and said they will not be refunding me. They advised me to contact JetBlue for a refund. I once again waited 45 minutes to speak with a JetBlue representative for her to tell me that there is some DLT rule where they can't refund me. She did not tell me where I could find this information, I requested proof of this and she would not provide it to me. I requested to speak to a supervisor. I waited another 10 minutes to speak with the supervisor. I told her that I would like my money refunded and not as a travel bank credit because I do not want to use their services anymore. She was the rudest supervisor I have ever spoken to. She did not empathize with me nor did she care that I was unsatisfied. She did absolutely nothing to resolve my issue. This is the second time I have had a terrible experience like this with JetBlue. I feel like I have been scammed and robbed. I feel like they would rather I fly with the possibility of giving 50 people COVID than to cancel and refund my flight.

review_header: "My family and I were anxious and uncomfortable the entire trip"
review_text: Although the flight attendants continuously reminded passengers of this regulation they were unable to control the non compliance. My family and I were anxious and uncomfortable the entire trip. These passengers should not be permitted to jeopardize the health of those around them. Hopefully we do not get sick after this flight.

Worst being a digital marketer who was willing to do everything online but I couldn't finish the online process due to a reservation mistake, and then not having assistance at the airport after asking to 4 different agents who asked me to wait to forget me. If I would not have time management or if I would not be an experienced traveler I would easily lose my flight.

Jet Blue has recently partnered with American Airlines, something I only discovered when I made a reservation in March via the Jet Blue website and discovered that I was actually flying American both both going and coming. And it was fine. No complications. I needed to return to Chicago for Easter weekend and booked through Jet Blue again. I booked my tickets from New York to Chicago via the Jet Blue website. (I never use sites such as Priceline etc.) My ticket going from New York to Chicago was a Jet Blue flight, and the return flight is an American Airlines flight. Now here is the kicker, and the reason I will not be using Jet Blue in the future: I was *not* able to check in online 24 hours before my first flight from New York to Chicago. I repeatedly received an error message stating that the check-in could not be completed and that I should CONTACT A CREW MEMBER. I phoned Jet Blue three times on the day before my flight and asked three reps about why I could not check in. All three indicated that my ticket was in good order, confirmed, with no problems. The second service person offered to give me a seat assignment, for which I thanked her. All three told me to chrck in at an airport kiosk. And that's what I tried to do, when I arrived at the chaotically busy Jet Blue area of JFK 2 hours before my flight. I could not check in at the kiosk. I received the same error message and was instructed to locate a crew member. So I went to the Jet Blue kiosk help desk, which was extremely busy. I waited in line and finally had my turn. The woman at the service desk could not check me in. There was some kind of error with the ticket, the nature of which I was never able to discover. She said she had to call someone and asked me to step to one side while she assisted other people. Twenty minutes passed, and the forty minutes. I still had to go through security, and I was becoming worried about missing my flight. I tried to ask the woman at the desk if she would put a note on my record stating that I had arrived for my flight in case I missed my flight and had to rebook. She snapped that she was doing me a favor by making that call for me, because she could have sent me to another service desk. In her defense, that Jet Blue area was pandemonium. Finally, at 8:30 a.m., a half hour from my 9:00 a.m. flight, she handed me a boarding pass. I made it through security and arrived at the gate as the last group was boarding. I was just in time, after having arrived TWO HOURS EARLY for a domestic flight. And now, today, I am trying to check in for my return flight from Chicago to LaGuardia, and neither the Jet Blue website nor the American Airlines (partner) website recognizes my record locator or ticket number. Thus, I am yet again unableto check in for my return flight. And I am once again on hold with Jet Blue, listening once again to the worst possible hold music (c'mon Jet Blue, really?), and I've yet again been on hold for over 40 minutes.  Good bye JetBlue.

It started in the airport, where the two attendants handling check in sniped at every customer in front of me, complained my bag was almost overweight (it was 49.5 lbs, but to be fair limit is 50), and made the entire preboarding experience incredibly stressful. The plane was then 40 minutes late, without announcement, update or apology from staff. When boarding began, the woman at the gate got on the speaker and shouted during Mosaic boarding that she would cease all boarding entirely if people did not “clear the boarding area”. Presumably she was referring to the usual crowd milling in the hallway waiting for their zones to be called. Nobody, however, was blocking the lane whatsoever, and the single mosaic member had already boarded without any problem. When we all got on the plane, it was boiling hot and completely full- no empty seats for COVID at all. The staff was rude and unaccommodating throughout the flight. They were out of headsets entirely, and of course you can’t use modern headphones with their entertainment set up. They freely let passengers remove their masks, yet would not serve any alcohol due to the pandemic (the latter is understandable, if the former was enforced). When we arrived, they yelled again at passengers disembarking the plane. Just generally a terrible experience, and if possible I will not be flying with them again.

Wanted to be socially distant so did not want to be in coach due to COVID. My seat 3A had a passenger sitting next to me. When he boarded the plane his mask was under his nose. The attendants said nothing. He then proceeded to cough the entire trip, his mask was never on and no one said anything. I could not eat because I could not remove my mask due to his constant coughing. In addition, he was coughing next to my drink and therefore could not even drink the water. Again his mask was either below his nose or not on at all. When i complained to the staff, they did nothing as they reported to me that he is a frequent flier (so what!) Also no hand sanitizer any where on the plane, and no sanitizing wipes. Food was served uncovered, it was as if COVID was over. To end this terrible flight, my suitcase was the last to come out from baggage. I had been under the impression a MINT tag assured baggage would come out first. I will now quarantine at home and get tested in 4 days. I have a feeling many of us on the flight could now be COVID positive.

review_header: "I will lose money recouping my credit"
review_text: Five passengers were booked on one reservation with Jet Blue . My Son, Nephew and husband all had Covid and we had to quarantine past our trip. I called the Priceline and informed them about our test and we cancelled the flights. I was informed we will get a credit to use in the future before Dec 12th 2021. I called to reschedule the flights and I was shocked about the prices I was told. How does the price rise almost 5 times with a month? I looked on line and I am seeing the very same ticket for $250-$300. This a pure scam. I will lose money recouping my credit than booking another flight and just forfeit the credit.

I booked JetBlue vacations because they were able to get me the flight and car rental all together which I thought would be less work for me but I was wrong. To start my flight was changed numerous times, then when my flight got in late (after 11pm) there was car rental because they had closed for the night and they were supposed to be notified to keep someone past normal hours. Then I had to spend $140 to Uber to a family members house then back to the airport in the morning with a 6 month baby. Then because they changed my flight from returning Friday to returning Saturday I had to pay an extra day on top of losing the money for the first day when I came in late! Absolutely terrible I would never recommend JetBlue to anyone.

review_header: "6 hr delay for a 2 hr flight"
review_text: 3 young kids. Having to sit on the ground of a dirty nasty airport. We’re told to not be upset about the delay cause at least we would get compensated for it. Of course no more mention of it during the flight so when we land at the doorway I ask the pilot and flight attendants about the compensation, do we have to call in and they said don’t worry just check your email we will send it within a week. Time passed, called 3 times, last time got a supervisor that was quick to tell me no compensation and as I was trying to explain took a few seconds to realize I had been hung up on. Worst part of all the pilot lied to my face. Way to go. Anyway never again. All the other bad reviews on here are right on point, I myself experienced things that others had. Not about the money cause it wouldn’t be much anyway, it’s about the point.

Refused to allow my infant to stay in his car seat despite not having anyone in the seat by my husband and I. Approached me aggressively when my son wouldn’t stop crying due to exhaustion but couldn’t sleep due to not being in his seat while moving. This airline has absolutely no respect or regard for the comfort and safety of small children. All they care about is getting their money out of you. I’ve used every airline that flies in my state with the exception of Alaskan airlines, and JetBlue takes the first place ribbon for worst airline. The cabin was dirty, staff is awful, COVID restrictions are nonexistent, representatives in customer service don’t know what the hell is going on and give you false information about COVID-probably to cover their asses if someone gets it on their plane. Overall, don’t fly JetBlue. Fly Delta, American, Southwest etc. anything but JetBlue.

The first time, they cancelled my flight due to "weather". But by the time it was too late, they decided to activate the flight. So, ended up wasting a day. Now, completely clear skies, and the flight was delayed 2 hours, but claimed we'd arrive at the same time. Now we're past the 2 hour delay and still not boarding. No offer for any compensation for lost time. Who knows when we're actually going to leave / arrive.
I couldn’t believe the response. My friend and I started to discuss what just happened and she came back over and threatened to have me thrown off the plane. Unnecessary. Complete power trip.

review_header: "4 minutes late and so I couldn't board"
review_text: I was 4 minutes late and so I couldn't board and the attendant was rude in dealing with the situation and simply told me to look at my board pass, just didn't pay any attention and neither didn't even try to help or talk about. Now I’m waiting for 4hrs for the next flight and they don’t even offer water.

review_header: "never step foot on another JetBlue flight again"
review_text: I was also separated from my family as two of my family members made our flight. My vacation is ruined. I will never step foot on another JetBlue flight again!

It was their mistake and I call customer services for the credit then they said that it was a weather issue, so we cannot do anything about it but actually it was different. In the flight, attendant announce that due to a technical issue behind the aircraft we are not able to fly. I would not recommend flying with this airline.

I had a $1400 credit. Today I was told that $600 of my credit expired and there was nothing that they would or could do about it. The 6 months leading up to the expiration date, people were encouraged not to travel. This is a horrible way to treat your customers!

First our plane had a dead battery. Then they said it needed a part and the part for the plane wouldn’t arrive for 5 hours and there is no guarantee this flight would even take off today. Zero connecting flight options or other flights to fort Myers. I had to drive to Newark NJ to fly to fort Myers. And this flight was delayed as well, (due to weather conditions so not entirely their fault) but then we get to fort Myers and had to wait to get off the plane for 30 minutes bc another JetBlue aircraft was in our gate?. Absolutely horrible day. Otherwise love the services available on the plane and wifi. JetBlue plz don’t do this to me again or you will lose me as a customer.
We arrived at Miami we add to wait 1/2 hour on the plane at 2am for parking. It’s bad
You are no different than any other airline! And now you want to charge people for carry-on bags during a pandemic! Well that’s brilliant.

With covid situation going on they should put families together not separate them and seat them with strangers. Unbelievable, coming and yelling to us if u don’t seat in your seats we gone take you out of the plane.

review_header: "I would have to pay a $100 cancelation fee"
review_text: I heard good things about them and so I wanted to give them a shot. When I couldn't make my flight, I tried to refund. They said I would have to pay a $100 cancelation fee and they wouldn't let me reschedule.

review_header: "fight with them to get a full refund"
review_text: I booked my flight and the next day they cancelled the flight out of Newark and shifted me to another flight on another day. The new date would not work for me so I went on the app to cancel but it was going to charge me a $100 cancellation fee. So, I called and after 20 minutes on hold a person came on who was just miserable. I had to argue and fight with them to get a full refund (the flight was three months away, by the way) so that I could book with another airline. If they had just let me cancel without a fight I wouldn’t have held a grudge but the fact that they made me fight and get angry with them on the phone has caused me to decide never to bother with Jetblue again. I’d rather book another airline that doesn’t make things as difficult as possible for it’s customers.

I was with 2 others without armrest because the guy next to me hogged my space while my daughter was with another stranger. She had 12 B and I had 11E How does that make any sense without any COVID precautions whatsoever! I will make sure I will let everyone know and not use JetBlue ever again.

We canceled our flight, because of the pandemic, at first we got credit till January 26, but when we asked for a refund, they denied it. This company stole our money, we never ever will buy tickets again from this airlines.

review_header: "full flight back and forth to Cancun"
review_text: First they did not block middle seats, just did for a short period of time, well, still decide to give them a shot, and booked an international flight with my family. They said airplanes will be no more than 75% capacity, they lie, full flight back and forth to Cancun. Also the plane was very old/dated, the screens without movies just TV, on an international flight!, and food, forget it, but I already know that. Will try to avoid at all costs, this airline, too bad, now only choice is Delta, that really care about passengers health and is the only airline who still blocked middle seats.

We fly a lot, but not often on Jetblue, due to routes. Your service and planes put other airlines to shame. I absolutely hate flying with your competitors but have to because of certain routing. We have plenty of options from Richmond, Virginia to head north or south and LOVE that you've added 2 Western direct destinations (Vegas and LA). Would love to see future direct flights to Colorado and Utah. Our return flight was delayed an hour but we knew about the delay the day before when we checked in. Delays happen and really appreciated Jetblue being proactive and notifying of us early. That's great service! Please add Salt Lake City and Denver to your direct schedule from Richmond, pretty please?

There was a $30 hidden daily fee for the hotel in Orlando that was never disclosed and when I called Jetblue customer service they told me it's because the used a 3rd party vender for their website and the fee wasn't disclosed properly and they will not refund my money. I also got charged $45 for a small carry on item and they wouldn't refund that money either. Very poor service, please watch out for this airline.

Yesterday’s flight changed all of that. My partner and I, who have been socially distancing and extremely cautious and only exposed to each other, were placed in middle seats in 2 separate rows, both seated next to strangers. There was no social distancing on the flight, nor any cautionary measures like disinfecting and cleaning during the flight. We had asked to be seated next to each other at least, a request that was ignored 3 times. And after all of that, when I called customer service to complain, after 2 hours on hold waiting for the supervisor, I was told that Jetblue’s only responsibility was, and I quote, “to get customers from A to B, that’s it.” In other words, customer comfort and safety is of no concern to the supervisor. I am extremely disappointed in Jetblue and their handling of customer safety during a pandemic.

The gentleman next to me offered to buy my drink and the flight attendant denied the request. Very unprofessional as I rarely drink and look forward to a cocktail on my flights to be able to relax and sleep. Very disappointed. Will not be using United again because my flight to Chicago 2 days prior with American Airlines was a very different experience with good customer service. It is a shame because I was very polite with the flight attendant woman on my United Airlines flight. Very very disappointed with this behavior. There’s no reason a flight attendant should be delivering whether or not a grown adult can recieve a drink from another customer as I am almost 40 years old and the gentleman had a card on file and was willing to help.

We sprinted down the concourse — exhausted but hopeful — only to find the gate still occupied and the plane still there. No attendant in sight. When one finally appeared, we said, “We’re here!” Her response? “We waited long enough. The door is closed.” And that was it. No effort. No empathy. Just a generic card and “call customer service.” Then things got worse. At baggage claim — no bags. Turns out United managed to get our luggage on the flight, even though they refused to let us board. No more flights that night. We were left stranded in Denver with: No bags No support And no way to reach our destination We paid out of pocket for hotel, meals, and essentials. When we contacted United’s Customer Service to request reimbursement for these unexpected expenses? Their response: “It was a weather delay. We owe you nothing.” Even though they shut us out, sent our luggage without us, and abandoned us with no recourse. This isn’t just about a missed flight — it’s about a total lack of accountability and basic human decency. United had every opportunity to make things right — and chose not to. Passengers deserve better.

12 hour flight from Korea to San Francisco and seats just suck. Price gouging to sit in half a seat with the seat in front of you in your lap just sucks. Food was gross definitely the breakfast sandwich. The flight from San Francisco to Austin the flight attendants were the most annoying I have dealt with … or maybe that’s just from the 10 hour lay over from options that United offered. Essentially you can use spirit and have a very similar experience.

I have never been fussy about food and there is no way, that a sausage and scrambled eggs could have been so horrible. The meal prior, my chicken was so horrible. I would rather never fly them ever again or pack my own meals. Please fire whoever is in charge of their food preparation and selection.

Then we sat for approximately one hour and when we thought we were departing Vancouver the plane stopped to load additional baggage. Arrived in Chicago where we should have had plenty of overlay time but missed our flight to New Orleans. Now I am sitting in the airport waiting on a flight for 12 hours. Missed an important family event and not even one offer from the airline to make a thing right. Extra meals for the family and eating at an airport on top of the missed time and event at home. Not one offer for a food voucher or a rebate -just eat it. Waited on stand by for a potential opening for an earlier flight but that flight was overbooked. One individual working the terminal. I attempted to speak to a supervisor resulted in me waiting at a desk for 30 minutes with no one showing up. Because of the crowded Chicago airport we asked to sit in the united lounge since we would be here all day -nope, not a club member. Was told I could speak to a supervisor and no one was available. It’s unacceptable.

On plane, you can see that they took the screens out for entertainment. Meanwhile they say that they give us free entertainment. This only applies to your phone or tablet, with nothing to to hold your device but your hand. I have flown United for years and now I believe I have flown my last time, willingly.

I get that weather delays happen due to weather. I missed my connection. I was surprised when I landed There was no rebooking information. No new boarding pass for the next day. No nothing. Then I was surprised to find out they don’t even have a customer service desk in Denver. Apparently they closed it because people were getting hassled? I was on hold for over an hour to call center. Got no answer. Couldn’t find anyone to help me, considering I have status with star alliance and this was a first class ticket. This is absolutely abysmal customer service - my preferred carrier is Air Canada and I can tell you if this had been Air Canada, I would’ve had a rebooking. Finally got some help three hours later to find out that they couldn’t rebook me because somehow they boarded me and said that my trip was complete ..absolute rubbish. Considering the amount of money I paid for that ticket atrocious.

The title Customer Service Representative is a disgrace to the type of services and demeanor of employees to include their supervisor. BWI CSR know nothing about customer service. I believe their goal is just to push their customers through without providing personable experiences and ensure the customer is well taken care of. I had issue with my reservation and instead of trying to assist me to resolve the problem. They just pushed me aside and said they couldn’t do it. After speaking to other CSR’s the supervisor in the CSR that was assisting me could have easily assisted with the problem, but instead they pushed me aside and said they couldn’t do anything.

I flew with my 79-year-old father—a Vietnam veteran with Alzheimer’s and Parkinson’s, who requires full physical and cognitive support. Despite requesting wheelchair assistance when booking (clearly noted on his ticket), United failed to provide it at every stage of our trip. At the gate, I was openly condescended to and accused of lying by a gate agent, who only believed me after she bothered to check the system—where she saw the assistance request I’d made weeks earlier. No apology. No accountability. Just indifference. My husband and I were forced to physically support my father to board the plane after being falsely assured assistance would meet us at the gate. Upon landing, no wheelchair was waiting. My father, who urgently needed the restroom, had to go without one. While waiting, a woman walked off with the unattended wheelchair brought over (and abandoned) by a staff member, putting her child in it, as multiple United employees stood silently watching. I had to yell at the woman myself to get it back—while United’s staff just looked on. In the end, I pushed my father myself through the airport while carrying all of our luggage. Not one United employee lifted a hand to help. This was my father’s final flight, as we were relocating him permanently due to declining health. United turned what should’ve been a manageable, respectful experience into something exhausting, humiliating, and dangerous for him and for us. United does not care about disabled passengers or their caregivers. Their staff are untrained, unprofessional, and apathetic. The only person who showed basic human decency was a single flight attendant who apologized and offered compensation. Once I use the miles I was given, I’ll never fly United again. And I strongly recommend you don’t either.

We all have radar apps and can clearly see the weather now, so they lied to us. Due to the cancellation of our flight we had a 25 hour layover in Chicago. The hotel attached to the airport is the Hilton. We paid $450 for one night! I called United Airlines and they refused to compensate me for the room. Their website is vague on what to do in this situation. Their app says nothing about hotel vouchers or what to do. They purposely bury the necessary information. I had to do a google search to find any information and then once found it doesn't spell out what to do or how to get a hotel voucher. I called their "customer care team" and they refused to compensate or help me with the cost of the room. They told me I can leave a review that will be processed on their website for help. Which I did. But it wouldn't take my comments and kept telling me to try again later. They do not care about their passengers or the disruptions to your life.

Flight attendant Lu went above and beyond to make sure we had a comfortable flight. Even when I got up to use the lavatory and she returned me to my seat, she did it in a professional and kind manner. When it was ok to use the lavatory, she was kind enough to go tell me that it was now ok to get up.The flight was delayed getting out due to a maintenance issue. I am ok with that. I appreciated the due diligence to keep us all safe.
Seats are basic comfortable. Wifi is strong. Seats are okay. Red eye flight was okay. Flight was pretty basic.

Instructed my uber driver to turn around to head back home. 10-min later, UA sent me another text indicating my flight back to original departing time. Great. Told the uber driver to turn around again toward EWR. Extra 30-min and $30. Not too bad. Wandering around for 2-hrs inside the terminal waiting for boarding announcement. Instead, the gate agent announced that the flight now delayed to 11:30-pm. How disconnected can UA get? Unbelievable. 10-min later, the agent announced the flight now scheduled to depart at 9:20-pm. This begs a question - how UA, with latest available technologies like fast internet/5G, powerful data server assisted by AI, is unable to get right information to customers promptly and consistently? Unless UA is still using last century technology…

I gave the American food 4 stars because it was not as good as the Asian food. I ate less, so I gave it 3 stars. My mother and I asked for water a second time from an male flight attendant who had an unhappy expression. Peanut-flavoured crackers were placed in the deep recess of the bathroom changing table, which was very slippery and dirty, with lots of paper on the floor and the trash can full—no one cleaned it. When a passenger’s pillow fell on the floor, the flight attendant kicked it aside with his foot.

The seats were comfortable, the legroom was comfortable enough and the crew were really warm and helpful. Really appreciated the entertainment available which was perfect for the approx 3 hour flight. Organised boarding and deplaning. It would have been nice to have a larger snack instead of just a small packet of crisps but other than that, really nothing to complain about.

M. for my flight that was supposed to leave at 1:20 P.M. and arrive at 3:04 P.M. to Manchester. The plane that was supposed to depart from Albany to Dulles kept being delayed. According to the gate staff the plane had mechanical issues and never arrived to fly us to Manchester. At 6 P.M. The flight was canceled. Gate staff rebooked me for a flight leaving Regan airport for midnight on American Airlines. It was immediately canceled after booking. By this time I was told the best plan of action was to return to the terminal to speak to the United support desk. The support staff tried to put me on a flight to Providence, RI at 10:20 P.M. but had to call American Airlines to unseat me. American Airlines would not pick up the phone so they asked me to walk to the American Airline help desk and walk back to United after they processed the request. Around 8 P.M. I had to go through TSA check in a second time to go to my gate for my third scheduled flight. By 10:30 P.M. the flight to Providence was delayed. Gate staff claimed and we saw the plane had arrived but they could not find a second pilot and were waiting for one to fly in by 12:30 A.M. After 11 P.M. all the United staff at the gate left us and no one was there to answer questions or give updates to our flight. By midnight we were told we had a gate change and had to walk a half a mile through the terminal. By 12:30 A.M right when we arrived at the new gate our flight was announced canceled. There was no staff in sight for the next 20 minutes and many customers were in a frenzy. When help did come only 1 staff member was available to assist us. The next flight that was leaving for the Manchester, Portland, Boston, Providence area was 6/20 after 5:00 P.M. There was no point for me to even go on my trip since my return flight back to IAD was early in the afternoon and I would arrive in Manchester by 8 P.M. Just to spend 1 day there. I left the terminal to walk back to my car and arrived home by 2:15 A.M.

United Airlines denied issuing me a new seat to get to my final destination to RSW stating they can’t find my etirinary despite I gave them my Eticket issued by original airport and gave them my confirmation no and booking ref on virtual agent. When I called customer service he told me since my ticket was basic economy that for him to issue me a new seat I need to buy first class in amount of $1,080. When I refused to buy first class ticket he hung up on me and I was never connected again. I ended up getting a new flight under Delta to get to my final destination which cost me $545.00.

I planned to bring my bag as a carry-on—like I’ve done with other airlines without issue—but United decided to play gatekeeper and deny it at the last minute. I informed them of my military retiree status, expecting at least some level of respect or understanding. Their response? “We don’t honor veterans or retirees with baggage benefits.” The customer service was cold and robotic, and it was made very clear: “Unless you’re active duty, we don’t care.” No flexibility.  Just another reminder that corporate greed trumps basic respect. If you’re a veteran, retiree, or just someone who values companies with integrity, avoid United Airlines.
The personnel we encountered (check-in, lounge, on-board) were very professional, friendly and attentive. Very good service on-board; enjoyed meals, entertainment. Seat comfort was okay.

It was surprising how well United handled a plane load of passengers and their luggage and finding alternative flights and arrangements. There were at least five different orderly areas in the terminal which helped passengers book alternative flights and assist with room reservations. Everyone was polite and helpful. Thanks United - you've scored some points with clients. The flight attendents and ground staff were calm and professional.

Got delayed twice before even leaving. Finally got a new plane to head to Denver for a connecting flight. Due some made up bullshit about weather we were rerouted to Colorado Springs. Then told another lie about how they couldn’t get the fuel cap open. Watched 3 maintenance workers stand around out side my window for 2 hours. Worst airline ever.

review_header: "seat that I had booked given to somebody else"
review_text: I had to cancel my day train trip to San Diego due to track maintenance and ticketing issues so decided to just fly home straight from LA. I got to LAX earlier than my original flight from SAN and explained to United staff when checking in my luggage that I wasn't going to be on the SAN-LA leg and was just going on the LA-Syd leg. I reconfirmed this with United staff at the Polaris Lounge at LAX. When it came time to board I was informed to wait in the tunnel outside the aircraft. When I got there I was told that the window seat that I had booked months ago had been given to somebody else as they assumed I wasn't going on the flight as I hadn't boarded in SAN and would I accept a sub-optimal seat instead. I said no and that I wanted my original seat and the staff member went off to ask the person in my seat if they would like to move and they said no. I said that this was not acceptable and explained my circumstances and there must be communications issues within United as I had already told United staff on two occasions that I would be flying out from LAX. The Captain was called and he told me my only options were to take the sub-optimal seat or take a flight the next day! I had a connecting flight in Sydney so had to take the other seat. Staff also lied to me by saying that if I were to take my original seat I would be splitting up a parent from their child. In fact the person who took my seat left there child as I saw them together and his child was in the seat in front of my replacement seat. The parent just wanted the window seat several rows back! The ground service also varied from surly to just okay.

Our flight out of Houston to Brussels via Washington/Dulles was delayed for 5 hours 28 minutes due to multiple problems (including the crew timing out). After we sat on the runway for an hour with no explanation from the cockpit, we had to deplane and were rerouted to another flight to Brussels via Munich. Although we went out of our way to request that our bags be pulled from the original delayed flight and transferred to our rebooked flight, it was never done. No bags at Brussels. Our delayed bags were supposed to be delivered to our lodging in Antwerp but that was never done, either. We instead found out (from the air tag in our bag) that they had arrived at Brussels airport but were about to be shipped back to Houston. After frantic calls, we were told that our only option was to come get our bags ourselves before they were shipped back to the US. Since we were scheduled to travel through Europe for almost a month, we HAD to get our bags back so we Ubered back to Brussels airport from Bruges (where we were) to intercept it and retrieve our bags ourselves. It cost us 500 Euros on the Uber round-trip, but United Airlines refused to compensate us for it on the grounds that United only compensates for clothing and toiletry, not transportation costs (never mind we incurred that cost because of United Airlines' delay and bag mishandling at both ends of our itinerary). When we were rebooked to a different international flight, we lost our Business Class seats and flew Economy but United refused to pay us back for the fare differential. So my advice to everyone is: Be prepared to dish out 500 Euros to get your delayed bags before they get shipped back to the US instead of being delivered to you: Book in and pay for Business Class seats but fly in Economy class (when your original flight was delayed almost 6 hours and you get rerouted to your destination) but don't expect to get your money back for the forefeited Business Class seats.

After checking in and being issued a ticket with my service dogs, I was told To wait while the agent helped 2 other customers - only to tell me I cannot fly with both pets unless I purchase another ticket. She then tells me she cannot sell me another ticket because they do not sell tickets. I asked why then did you issue me a ticket? Her response was she didn’t know I had two animals even though I handed her two DOT applications. When asking to speak to a manger she said I am the manager”.

Flight was in July 24, I booked the flights in March 24. I went in and tried to use the flight credits last month for an upcoming trip and was told that my tickets had expired. Apparently, the tickets are good for 1 year from when you book the flights, not from when the flight was. I tried numerous times for hours on the phone back and forth trying to get the credit extended so I could use them. Denied! First class tickets to Hawaii cost me 11k. That is correct, eleven thousand dollars gone, lost.
I would never recommend them nor fly here ever again even. Spirit airlines had planes flying out.

I spent over FIVE HOURS trapped in their chat system, an HOUR on the phone, and made TWO pointless trips to the airport, all in a desperate attempt to resolve an outrageous issue with checked baggage fees. The United app displayed a misleading “deal” with the regular fees crossed out and the first checked bag fee listed as a laughable $3 each way for my round trip from Prescott, AZ (PRC) to Denver, CO (DEN). Naturally, I thought I’d take advantage of this apparent bargain—how naive of me! However, when I proceeded to add the fees to my cart and pay, the total magically ballooned to $70! That’s right—United has the audacity to advertise one price, lure you in, and then slap you with a fee that’s over 1,000% higher than advertised. When I contacted their “customer service” to address this blatant bait-and-switch tactic, they refused to honor the $3 fee shown in the app. Refused! After hours of wasted time and effort, including two airport visits, I was left with no resolution and a deep sense of betrayal. This is not just poor service; it’s deceptive, unethical, and a shameless attempt to exploit travelers. United Airlines has lost all credibility with me. I strongly advise anyone considering flying with them to think twice—unless you enjoy being overcharged, ignored, and treated with utter disrespect. I will be taking my business elsewhere and encouraging others to do the same. United, you owe your customers transparency and accountability—something you clearly lack.

They want to be “premium” but they’re just incapable. Boston to LA delayed by storms: fair enough. Sun goes down, stars come out, got lined up to board hours late—yay! After half an hour of standing there, as the clock edges towards the middle of the night, the pilots stalk off the plane leaving the gate agents to tell all the now-stranded passengers that the pilots just “quit” (the flight, I suppose, not their jobs). The official explanation later on had to do with mandated rest, though we’d been assured earlier the crew was fresh and there was no risk of them timing out. Whatever the case, nothing else is leaving Boston that night. No worries, they tell everyone, we’ll email you hotel and meal vouchers. Nearly an hour later as I was checking into the airport Hilton on my own arrangement (thanks travel insurance!) the promised vouchers arrived. We were in Boston, remember; yet every single hotel United had arranged for was, yes, in Los Angeles. At this point I imagine 150 people still waiting in the gate area experienced either rage or despair but I wasn’t there to take part. We did finally get to LA, though 15 hours late. My overall experience of United is that when everything goes perfectly they’re just about ok; when anything goes wrong it’s as if they never could have anticipated such a thing and they are helpless in the face of adversity. So: fly United on new aircraft, not in the evenings, and on days with perfect weather across the whole system, and you’ll probably be fine. Oh, and don’t go through Newark; but that’s a different story.

The food served to me on board was spoiled  Furthermore, despite having paid a significant amount for our tickets, when we checked in, both for the outbound and return flights, our seats were not available. We were forced to pay hefty additional fees just to get seats.

Delay, delay. They wait until 5 minutes before boarding starts and then delay the flight due to flight crew hours, which should have been anticipated since the night before. My last two flights out of San Juan with them, same deal. I had to rebook my connection and had to pay $51 on top so I could secure one of three seats left, otherwise I would be on standby. No effort to get you a seat for free for your troubles. But I got the $15 food voucher; how lucky can I be. If flying out of San Juan do yourself a favor and don’t fly United. The fare is the cheapest of the major airlines, but you pay the difference and more the day of flying.

The return flight was first from Korean Air and landed in Seoul. The United flight to San Francisco left a little past time but then had to return to the airport in Seoul. We were told the plane was out of balance, but there were other problems. They placed us on the skybridge with no food or drinks. No place to sit either. Finally back in the air and landed in San Francisco. Missed my connecting flight to Raleigh and had to wait another 13 hours for another flight. Asked the ticket agents and they just blew it off and laughed. No vouchers or compensation offered. Finally arrived in Raleigh and my luggage was lost. Filed a claim and the agent did not even know United had a flight come in that morning. Several phone calls to the luggage claims line and a customer service agent laughed about it. They did offer a measly credit but I refused because it only works on United flights. I do not recommend flying United Airlines. Very bad customer service and the flight delay was unreasonable.
The phone bot was clunky but once I got through to an agent they were able to reschedule my reservation even though it was a basic economy ticket. That’s what I call customer service!

I flew out of Cebu to Seoul. I made the connection and United took off close to the time scheduled. The pilot announced about 1 1/2 hours into the flight we had to return to Seoul because of a problem with the distribution of the weight on the plane. They placed us on the Skybridge, no food or drinks, nowhere to sit, and we finally took off again later. The attendants were not very friendly and unprofessional. We finally arrived in San Francisco and I missed my connecting flight. I had to wait another 13 hours for another flight. No meal vouchers or hotel vouchers while waiting a long time for another flight. I finally landed in Raleigh Durham and then United had lost my luggage. I had to file a claim with United and the agent did not even know they had a flight coming in that morning. I had to spend a lot of time calling and trying to find out about my luggage. The customer service representative laughed about it on the phone. I actually inquired about my luggage when arriving in San Francisco and also about the missed connection and the customer service representative laughed about it. It took another week to finally get my luggage back from United Airlines.

The standard response to anything you say to or ask them seems to be "Uh-huh". There's plenty of eye-rolling in response to service requests. Food in Polaris is usually decent, but not this time. We were delayed out of IAD nearly two hours due to a mechanical issue with the nose wheel. I like the fact that it is nonstop overnight to W. Africa, but the crew really need an attitude check pronto.

They will charge you a $150+ fee on top of the difference in fare when you can book it on their app and just pay the difference. And they could care less! Unfortunately, I was in distress from missing my flight from Panama City to Houston thanks to my late driver and insane traffic, and listened to the agents at the United counters in PTY when they told me to call and have the reservation changed. I could have saved about $350 by completing the changes myself on the app. The reservation rep then booked the wrong day causing me to pay an additional cost to rebook again. I’m done with this airline! I’m now sitting here waiting to drop my bags and check in but there are no agents or kiosks. On the flight to Panama (a 4-hour flight), there was no inflight entertainment on the flight unless you used the app and if they didn’t offer earphones therefore you could not listen if you wanted to. They ran out of warm food and then said I had no miles to pay for the food when my miles were clearly listed and available to use on their app. Never again!

All flights on time. Seat, bedding and entertainment are good. Staff very professional and food service was very quick. Food is edible, but certainly not like the meals on Singapore Airlines or Emirates. The food at the EVA lounge United uses in TPE is mediocre at best, and the lounges at SFO are incredibly crowded to the point of being ridiculous and uncomfortable. All in all competent but not especially glamorous experience. I would have given this a "9" or "10" if the lounges weren't so crowded.

The attendants are not very professional nor friendly. The return flight was even worse.  The flight from Seoul (ICN) was the biggest issue. The flight boarded and took off but had to return to the airport for a technical issue. The flight attendant said the plane was out of balance. This was after 1 1/2 hours into the flight. Then we were put on the Skybridge while the problems, more than just the weight distribution were fixed. One point to consider was I had a 7 hour layover in Seoul. We finally took off again after a long wait. Upon arriving in San Francisco (SFO), the connecting flight had taken off an hour earlier. I was supposed to have a 3 hour layover in SFO. I had to wait another 13 hours for another flight. no meal voucher, no hotel room, no compensation. After finally arriving in Raleigh (RDU) my luggage was not present. So I had to file a claim for lost luggage. No compensation or any concern about it. The Luggage claims desk did not even know there was a flight arriving that morning. I had to make numerous phone calls, one representative actually laughed about it. I have not received any compensation from United for their lack of professionalism, and availability to conduct a flight operation within a reasonable schedule.

The voucher they gave me was worth significantly less than the difference in fare. We also waited 90 minutes for our bags before clearing customs, which added even more stress to our international flight home. In addition, no one would even try to help us figure out why this happened. I will never fly United again.

Our flight attendant Jay was incredible! His demeanour was cheerful and friendly and I truly wish every attendant was like him. From the moment you got on the plane he had a positive energy and was respectful and helpful of all the guests. Love United and kudos for such a great team!

Everything was the same on the way, and I don't have much to say. But what got my attention is that the food is the same thing I had last year when flying from Brussels to Chicago. The food tasted great but was familiar to me, and I hope I didn't feel deja vu.

review_header: “food did not standard for Economy Class”
review_text: The ground crew was good and helped me board the flight according to standard procedures. The seating was pretty good; even though it was Economy Class, I was sitting in Economy Plus, the same seating as Economy Class but with more legroom. The cabin crew were all friendly people, even though we had moderate turbulence that made everyone anxious. However, my only issue is that the food did not meet today's standard for Economy Class. The entree portion was too small, and they didn't notify the mobile app for a last-minute change. I thought I would have a chicken entree because I had reviewed it via United's mobile app. But instead, when I was onboard, I had beef, which confused me. Therefore, I recommend that United improve its Economy Class meal service to provide nicer, better portioned, and more options for all customers.

Tried to use United Status Match, as a Million Mile Delta flyer. Got the run-around for 2 months (seriously). Finally got the documentation they required (Delta card with barcode), and was told the last step was to take a United flight. Took United flight, and followed up with them about status. They told me it took 5-7 days to review. Followed up multiple times and told it was in que, and would be ready in 24-48 hours. Followed up day of flight, told it wasn't approved. Took outbound flight and paid over $300 in baggage fees, and sat in back of plane. Called them multiple times from Hawaii. Was told they had a glitch in system, and it was not picking up my qualifying flight. Told it would take another 24-48 hours to approve. Boarded flight back home, still didn't get status, and paid another $300 plus in baggage fees. Status match is a farce! They don't know what they're doing and wasted my time and money. Fool me once, never again. These guys are awful!

Overall, it was a positive experience. The Polaris lounge at SFO is superb and a great start. The product on United is among the best. The seat is comfortable and the entertainment options plentiful. Both crews were pleasant and accommodating. The main downfall was the food. The menus were uninspired and the presentation was subpar for a business class service. The taste was ok but compared to the competition, they fell well below the mark. For instance, the breakfast had a bowl of cut up fruit that was less interesting that what I make at home. We were fed but with little originality or style. If they could improve this offering, they would truly rate with some of the best. Too bad.

I guess partially retrofitted. Cabin service was great. What I didn’t like - mismanagement at the time of boarding with cabin luggages that delayed departure - boarding bridge customer service - food for purchase only on a 6 hours flight. Never knew United has become a budget airline? I wouldn’t recommend the airline based on Food is only available for purchase. And delayed departure due to their own mismanagement with cabin luggage of certain passengers

Hours before the flight I was told that I could upgrade my seat if I purchased some miles. I did so and then the agent said it would take 24 to 48 hours to process and so he actually couldn't process the upgrade. He told me to call when I landed and they'd issue a refund. I purchased the upgrade with cash instead. I called when I landed and the agent assured me it would take 7 to 10 business days to process the refund but to send an email to customer service with information he provided and to call back in 48 hours to ask them to expedite it. I emailed in the information and patiently waited the 7 to 10 business days. At 10 days I had not received the refund so I called the airline and was told they had no idea and had no record about the refund request. They said they'd refer it to their refund department and I'd receive a call the next day. I did not receive a call. I called back the next business day and explained the entire situation to customer service again since there was no record of the call. They told me that it was not refundable. I protested. They escalated the call and put me on hold. 36 minutes into the call another agent answered the call who had no idea what was happening and so I explained it all over again. She submitted the request and gave me a refund number. The full call was 56 minutes and I was told it'll be up to two weeks for a reply. The entire team is ill-equipped and misinformed.
I am so thankful for them and this was the best airline experience I’ve ever had!!

review_header: “said there was nothing they could do”
review_text: There was never enough time to make the flight. We had to rent a $350 dollar car to drive home. We are retiring this year and plan on a lot of vacations but none will be on United Airlines. They said there was nothing they could do.

The poor thing about ground service was that his sister missed her connecting flight from Denver to Fairbanks and had to fly with Alaska Airlines instead and had to stay at the airport for a night due to weather conditions in Denver and once they reached Fairbanks, they found out that their baggage is still in Denver and had to be without clothes for 1-2 days. In-flight service was still good for example, crew was friendly, food/beverages were tasty, there was free wifi onboard, movie choices were spectacular, value for money was very low due to baggage loss, seat/legroom was comfy and spacious. Although the in-flight service was good, they are still going to avoid flying with United Airlines in the future!

review_header: "give me my bag and money back"
review_text: For the second time Southwest has come through. And I can’t get my bag?! Staff at Hayden airport needs to check her attitude. You take out money can’t come through and make us jump ridiculous hoops to get it back. Flight delayed and missed, just give me my bag and my money back. Good news is I’ve already changed my future flight from United so no more bad service.

She didn’t care at all about the needs of any of us. That’s the kind of person who sometimes gives a bad impression of the American airline industry. As passengers, we should not have to deal with this kind of behavior.

The flight attendants were professional and attentive to the passengers. Seats are comfortable, but not more. Portions of food are smaller than few years ago. Inflight Entertainment system is excellent and the choice of movies is good with versions in many languages.

Just when you think Frontier and Spirit set the bar low you realize that they are leaders in the industry. United Airlines arbitrarily canceled our reservation then we paid for an upgrade to be able to carry-on bags and then we were forced to check our bags. United Airlines is indignant and uncourteous.

I paid $500.00 more than economy for the ticket. When I got onto the airplane, there were dozens of economy seats available. I think that the App did not show the economy seats. I was steamed. I did not sit in the Economy Premium seat, and sat in an economy seat. When I wrote the company for a refund of my $500.00, they ignored my request, and stated that I flew in Economy Premium.
I was notified by the other person at the time the credits expired. United refused to extend my credit given their mistake and essentially stole $400 from me.

review_header: "truly seems to have upped their game"
review_text: The buffet was ok.Once underway I tried to stay awake for the Sundae but passed out. The crew was wonderful and made the long flight truly survivable. The The seat was very comfortable and the bedding was wonderful. Feet were a little tight but other than that no complaints. Snacks were available throughout the flight although I was able to get in a good 6/7 hours rest. United truly seems to have upped their game and I would no longer hesitate to fly them long haul international.

On time boarding and departure and a very friendly proactive crew that tried hard to please with efficiency. Mediocre food, of course but that’s to be expected on domestic services that are considered medium haul. Lately United seems to have upped their game or I have gotten lucky.A very decent experience.

Flight #1 - United crew mandated that I check my carry on because the cabin was full. It was not even close to being full. I received an apology and a gift certificate so was happy to try United again; this was a mistake. Flight #2. After scanning our documents into their ‘Ready to Fly’ app we were advised we were all set to travel but then 1 member of my groups was denied boarding because he was missing a visa to transit through the US. United’s response; ‘that is your responsibility’. While I agree that it is each passengers responsibility to meet travel requirements; United incorrectly sending us the ‘you are all set’ message was an undeniable factor (it only took 3 hours to obtain the visa online, something we set out to do until the incorrect guidance). That there has been zero remorse or mention of intention to fix the system sending out false information is inexcusable. Flight #3 - That member of my group needed to rebook for the next day. After originally paying for Premium Economy (which was given to another passenger) and then emphasizing the need for more legroom due to a post operative leg brace (I was charged $1,900 for a one way seat and assured it had extra leg room), he was given a middle seat in normal economy; he had to sit through 16 hours of pain. After reaching out to customer service multiple times, United has not even acknowledged this issue in their replies. This is intolerable, we will not be giving our business to an incompetent organization that ignores customers this way until this issue has been addressed.

We did everything right. We got to the Rochester airport 3 hours ahead of time, cleared TSA security with no issue, had our bags checked. When we boarded the flight we sat on the tarmac for what seemed like forever. Finally the pilot made an announcement that despite calling ahead from Dulles and requesting the plane be de-iced in Rochester no staff was available. When the flight finally took off and landed back at Dulles we again were stuck on the plane because there was no staff to take the stairs down for us to deplane. By the time we finally got off we missed our connecting flight to Geneva and consequently lost my money for our first night’s hotel reservation in Geneva. It was non refundable by the hotel rules. My daughter and I preceded to fill out form after form, call after call asking to be refunded for our missed night in the hotel. This was not a weather issue. This was not a mechanical issue. This was a staffing issue both times. I received an email today from United Customer Service: I am appalled at the “Customer Service” from United and will never fly that airline again. I responded to their email asking that this claim be escalated. Use your judgement when booking your next flight.

The wifi was not working half the flight. The flight don't give you food, they only serve you one bag of chips on a 5 hour flight. The wifi didn't work and there is no live tv so you are limited to just tv shows and 6 video games. The one flight attendant was nice and we talked but I would recommend flying with Hawaiian airlines.

S. airline like United Airlines. I have been flying on United all my life, and the service has changed and improved. It does not matter whether you sit in First Class, Business Class, Premium Economy Class, or Economy Class; everyone deserves a top level of service and support, which is the case for this flight. I was sitting in Polaris Business Class with comfortable blankets, pillows, pajamas, and a mattress cushion that made me sleep well. The inflight entertainment system was terrific, with great films and an interactive air map. The meal service was pretty good, and the cabin crew was fantastic. I always look forward to continuing to fly the friendly skies.
If it wasn't for family we would have been stranded.

Rio de Janeiro to Houston Premium Plus 'upgrade' was nominally better than steerage, but not at the price. No under seat storage of personal items, the seats for this overnight flight not conducive to getting any sleep. The 'food' was abysmal. The crew was great. Houston to Boston: upgrade to 'first class' was essentially a repeat of aforementioned Premium Plus. No possibility for sleeping. Again, the crew was great, food better. Not necessarily worth the cost. Research what upgrades actually mean. Make no assumptions about them. Don't get scammed by verbiage used to entice.

review_header: "I will never fly with United again"
review_text: We were so delayed we missed our connecting flight in Dulles airport, VA. Huge scramble to get rescheduled because no United representative would help us at the airport, phone or online. We finally got rescheduled for 3 hours later, then that new flight got delayed, didn’t get to our destination (Fort Lauderdale, FL) til 10 pm that night. Missed all of our plans because of it. Coming home: we arrive at the Fort Lauderdale Airport, FL hours early and are greeted with a disorganized mess. TSA agents were fighting with each other, half of United’s ticket machines were down for maintenance, got yelled at by a United agent to tag my own suitcase after I asked her for help tagging it, then after she was mad that I tagged it wrong and she had to redo it, same with the people behind me. Everyone was incredibly rude at that airport. We get to our flight boarding area, and it’s delayed again. We depart and arrive at Dulles Airport, VA. United kept delaying our flight over and over and over again. They called 5 times for a United representative to come to the front desk to update us, no one would come. The staff with yellow vests that direct the airplanes on the runaway had to keep coming in to try to update us. Excuses they gave: we don’t know where the plane is, the plane is here but needs unloaded and checked, the knots of the wind are too strong, the crew deck isn’t here, next is crew deck arrived but they are now over their time schedule to be able to fly, there is not enough runaway for all the planes. Then like 8pm at night (we were supposed to leave at 5 pm) they tell us we’re rescheduled for 7 am the following day, literally could have told us that 2 hours prior so we would have had time to make arrangements. If we want our overnight bags, it would take them 3-4 hours. Then they refuse to cover our food and hotel because it wasn’t cancelled it was ‘delayed.’ Everyone starts screaming at the staff and they then change their mind after 10 minutes and decide to cover the hotel, food and “free shuttle.” We call nonstop to get ahold of the shuttle, no one answered and all the Ubers are busy. It takes an hour in the cold freezing weather waiting for the shuttle to get to the hotel. 3-4 hours of sleep, get to the airport really early the next day, my meal vouchers didn’t work and the new flight is delayed. The United staff that morning say it’s computer issues, next they say we need to do maintenance on the plane, next luggage needs loaded, then it was too many planes are taking off at that time. Finally get boarded and get to the state college airport. They lost the luggage from 2 full planes from Dulles airport to State College. United App tracking is all wrong for everyone so no one knows where the luggage is. We wait 1-2 hours to get to talk to someone at the United Front Desk and have our luggage shipped to our house…when they find it. You can’t get through to do anything on the United App or the phone line either. I have never had this happen like this on an airline before and after this experience I will never fly with United again. They refuse to offer any compensation for any trouble except $100 United airline voucher, like we would ever fly with them again.
Professional flight attendants Good food and inflight entertainment. Except for the toilets cleanliness who need more attention, the quality of the service was excellent.

Unfortunately, the experience was far from satisfactory. While they say there is no weight restriction, not even a small dog can travel comfortably with these carrier dimensions. During my flight returning to Panama, one of the counter personnel remarked, “I feel sorry for the poor dog.” While I appreciated the empathy it made me as the owner that I was doing something wrong or being abusive towards my dog. But it actually highlights the frustration with the airline’s rigid pet policies. If these unnecessary rules were reconsidered, we could all travel responsibly with our pets, allowing them to feel more comfortable without being confined to a carrier for the entire journey. A more flexible, pet-friendly approach would greatly enhance the experience for both passengers and their furry companions. My dog’s whole journey was more expensive than mine, still I want to always be able to travel with me but these policies gotta go. I would never want to make my pet feel uncomfortable.

Takes off 45 minutes late from an empty airport. Arrives an hour late, and the same United Airlines wouldn’t hold the connecting flight for 5 minutes! Apparently they don’t care, because they don’t have to care. This is not the first time they’ve shown their disregard for the passengers, our first class flight from Houston to Hawaii was 8 hours of rude, obnoxious flight attendants who were openly disrespectful the entire flight. Im not impressed with unprofessional behavior, and they have been repeatedly under performing with their “I don’t care attitude“.

My seat was 1L on a full business class fare. Boarding was on-time, but we had to wait on the plane for another 30 minutes or so because there were passengers arriving a bit late. It still did arrive in Frankfurt on time so that was good. The flight itself was uneventful, and the seat was comfortable and fully functional. The entertainment options, unfortunately, were extensive and varied, keeping me up for almost the entire duration of the flight and I arrived in Frankfurt... groggy and tired. Every time I fly on United, the amenity kits keep changing. This time, it was the bright red Wrexham AFC container. Nothing spectacular inside though. Dining options consisted of: Romaine kale salad Appetizer: chilled ginger beef or sliced watermelon radish. Dinner: pork cutlet, chicken fricassee, seared cod, or roasted balsamic butter cauliflower. I had the chicken fricassee and it was great, but I was already full from United's Polaris Lounge in Chicago. Dessert: ice cream sundae, lemon berry cheesecake, and assorted cheese plate. I had the lemon berry cheesecake, it was fantastic!

review_header: "I will never fly with them again"
review_text: What should have been a routine trip turned into a nightmare I wouldn’t wish on anyone. The flight was diverted due to a medical emergency, which I understand is unpredictable. However, the way United handled the situation was appalling. We were stranded at a small airport for 12 hours with no access to food and limited restroom facilities. The lack of communication and care from the airline was astonishing. United offered me a $15 meal voucher—barely enough to buy a drink at the establishment they directed me to, where meals cost around $30. When I asked about further compensation, I was met with indifference. United’s complete disregard for basic human decency, equitable treatment, and adequate passenger support ensures one thing: I will never fly with them again.

Ground crew inability to properly connect sky-way. Disgruntled employees struggling to be positive. Passengers sardined in small, uncomfortable seats. Seats double booked. Excessive charges for both checked and carry-on bags. A 3 out of 10 star review is generous. Textbook example of 21st century wealth transfer or how corporate greed benefits rich stockholders at the expense of middle class employees and customers. CEO Scott Kirby’s $18,600,000 “compensation” in 2023 ensures class separation and promotes capitalism’s bad reputation. Cannot say anything good about United Airlines.

I paid $316.00 for a one way ticket and did not want to spend an additional $33.00 plus to "pick my seat," some of which were $45.00. I was jammed in the way back in seats as crammed as Spirit Airlines and Frontier, except I paid an exceptional price. Spirit and Frontier would've cost approximately $135.00, but I thought I would have a better flight experience with United. What a profound waste of money. I flew to Newark on Delta, economy class, really comfortable seat and a movie screen where I could pick the movie for $188.00. Delta was not available for me to come back. I am truly amazed that United thinks treating their customers in this manner is good business. Both of my seat mates promised me they would NEVER fly United again. Since we were practically sitting on top of each other, we got friendly. If you want to be jammed on a plant, fly Spirit or Frontier, it's way less expensive and you won't feel so bad about being crammed into the back of a plane. Shame on United; a serious lack of respect and competition. Why would I ever subject myself to this flying experience again?

This made me miss, and have to reschedule my flights. Instead of getting to my destination at 3pm, it was 10pm. Already a HORRIBLE delay. I was assured that my checked bags would be taken off the plane and would arrive WITH ME at my destination. Of course that was not true. Not only did it go to Houston, but I was told by the United app that it would be arriving at 11:30pm and I could collect my luggage at the carousel. I waited, even though I was dead tired after 17 hours of being in airports but then at midnight, it still had not arrived. There was no one to talk to at the airport, the phone number directed me to the app or to chat, which both directed me to the phone number. Needless to say, I was pissed at this point. I drove an hour from the airport to the place I was staying. The next morning I was finally able to get a live person on the phone, who told me that my luggage would surely arrive by noon at the airport. That was another two hour round trip to pickup my luggage. I am more than upset, not only was I lied to about my luggage but my new flight was 'economy plus' instead of first class and I got no compensation for it. I sat in the airport for over 6 hours in Denver due to the later flight and had to suffer thru second rate seats because the smaller plane didn't even have first class.

00 a piece for first class tickets. We could not board until almost everyone else boarded due to some kind of issue. We understand issues but then we got on the flight and we were offered no service. I was thirsty and went to the cabin asking for a bottled water that was on the table. I was told “sorry that’s for the pilots”. So I asked, will we be offered anything before take off? The stewardess said, “no, we don’t have time, we’re figuring out the meals right now”. My husband and I have flown United for 35 years. We are changing to American Airlines.

We had one connection. Our first flight had mechanical delays for over 90 minutes. Before boarding we asked the gate agent about getting put on a later connecting flight. She told us there was only one seat available, despite the United app showing more. Our flight arrived with 6 minutes till the departure of our connecting flight. There was another passenger also making the same connection. The flight attendant assured us they would hold the door for us as it was a known mechanical delay with multiple passengers making the same connection. So we ran with our baby and got to the gate at 4:04 for a 4:04 departure time. There was no one at the gate, but the plane was still docked on the jetway. We ran to the nearest gate with an agent, who told us they boarded early and never gave a last call for any passengers. So we missed out flight home. We were forced to use the United app phone service to try and find a way home. This service should still be in alpha. The audio in both direction cut out constantly, it only played on speaker despite my phone being connected to Bluetooth headphones, and the agents were completely unsympathetic. The first agent we had hung up on us after the second time the audio cut out. The second agent said that we could get rerouted with seats not together, but assured us that the gate agent would make adjustments so we could. We went to the gate agent who flatly and unsympathetically denied any ability to make accommodations for us to sit together despite flying with a lap infant. So we got back on the app phone system and we were denied hotel accommodations, because an "equivalent" option was offered. We booked and paid for premium seating, and were offered middle seats in coach that were several rows apart. That is not equivalent by any definition. When we were put on a flight with seats together the next day, it was still not in premium despite numerous premium seats being open. United did offer us a couple $15 food vouchers, but no hotel vouchers and did not offer us seats together in the cabin we paid for. The entire experience reinforced a previous extremely poor experience with United leading me to share this with others. I would love to hear from United how being offered middle seats several rows apart in coach is equivalent to seats together in premium especially when traveling with a lap infant. We would have, and did accept seats together in coach in order to get home, but not once were we offered a refund for our upgraded seats by any of the 3 phone or 2 gate agents we spoke with. We were told we could do it ourselves online.

I actually try to be extra intentional with reminding myself to write good reviews about experiences and places. But after flying numerous times over the years with just slight hiccups, I finally ended up in a situation where United Airlines customer service was needed and they were not supportive at all. The snow storm in Denver created chaos on flight itineraries for most all airliness, which I understand. Weather is out of our control. But after 5 hours of consistent delays leaving San Diego and attempting to leave my connecting flight in San Francisco, I would have finally ended up at my final destination the following morning. Which would have put me there too late for the wedding event I was leaving for, so I opted to cut my unfortunate loss and go back home. After spending my entire day either on a plane or in an airport, United Airlines wouldn’t even re route my flight back home despite being way closer than my final destination. So I spent 14 hours getting back to original destination and not only would they not provide any compensation for original flight, I had to come out of pocket to book the last minute flight back. I won’t be flying with this airline again.

Upfront at premium price for a cup of coffee and a (modest) bag of cookies on a two hour flight on an early (7am) morning flight. Why is a breakfast not possible to serve? The most questionable was the lavatory, probably the most disgusting thing I have seen on a plane: dirty, old, and outworn. Comparisons would be here out of line, simply it was disgusting. It was a shame!

I had a really bad experience. The flight took off without even boarding me. I flew from Richmond to Newark, In Newark they announced a flight delay and asked us to wait for an hour. We all were in an assumption that we will get a flight in an hour. but this didn't happen. Once all the passengers stepped aside to go use the restrooms as there was a wait, flight all of sudden started boarding the passengers and takes off leaving lot many people behind. When I asked how did they do it. they pointed that it was your fault.  I enquired with my husband and asked him to book another flight as I didn't have anytime and need to be at school the very next day. It was almost 11pm in Newark airport they had no flights. I had to drive back to Baltimore and board another flight to Kentucky early in the morning 5am. After all of these situations the airline is not ready to give my refund back, they are just asking me to reach out to a team who don't reply to your emails or calls.

Dawn T, international purser, and her crew of Patti, Sandra and Lisa all provided excellent service and attention. Dawn and Patti went above and beyond in everything and were such a delight. Once Dawn found out it was our honeymoon she even created a hand written card for us. We cannot say enough good things. The food was delicious and hot and always served with a smile. Thank you for making our honeymoon trip to Australia the beginning of what will be a fabulous trip. This was my first time flying with United and they won me over.

I reported the situation to the information desk and was instructed to go straight to the United office, where they said someone would quickly be sent to retrieve the bag. When I arrived at the United office, which has a glass wall, I encountered two female employees—one younger and one older, who seemed to be the supervisor. The younger employee said that she couldn't help, as everyone was busy with their assignments. I explained that the restrooms were empty when I left my bag and that it contained my eyeglasses, medicine, and valuable items, then she handed me a pass and told me to go back to retrieve the bag myself. Exhausted from walking for about 20 minutes, I struggled since I am a senior and hadn’t taken my medication, compounded by the stress from the 2-hour flight delay. One reason I left my bag in the first place was the distraction of family members calling to ask about the delay. Despite the inconvenience and suffering I experienced from not having my glasses or medicine, the indifference of these two employees remains shocking, and I still haven’t received any proper response about their behavior.

I was supposed to fly from Jacksonville, to Houston, then Seattle. Was supposed to leave at 5am. 1st flight delayed, got 9n 1st flight 3hrs later and was on plane for an hour. Told to get off plane because of an issue. Was then told we had to go get our luggage and check back in. They list our luggage and had to wait for 3 more hrs. Got a different flight to Washington which was also delayed and finally got to Washington which because it was delayed I missed my flight to Seattle. Had to wait 4 more hrs and got a flight to Denver. That flight got delayed another 4hrs. Got to Denver and missed that flight because of the delayed. Waited another4hrs and got a flight to Seattle. Spend over 30 hrs in airports that day. Missed my rent a car and hotel and activities. Spend over 200 dollars in food at over price airport. United refuse to do anything about all this at the airport and i was told that it was not United fault. Wrote in and they offer a 100 voucher which i still have not got but they said i would.
