Overall very bad experience and the customer service sucks.

review_header: "had to check my bag at the gate"
review_text: Got on the plane and there was tons of space. Absolutely inconvenient given my time crunch when I land.

review_header: “turned into a living 3 days of HELL”
review_text: There was a flight to San Francisco and a connection to Tahiti from SF, 22 hours of commute without the hour taxi, checkin, security. The flight to San Francisco was to be delayed by an hour. The agent in Seoul told me that I could try to get the initial flight anyways and if I don't get it, I'm booked from San francisco to Los Angeles and I would go to Tahiti from there. It would add more than 10 hours of travel when I don't have time. No seats upgrade. I talked to some online agents and they told me that it's my only option and that I am booked, abruptly ending the conversation. When I arrived in San Francisco the flight was too late for me to get the connection. I ran to the gate still and the agents told me that the flight left as if it was my fault. I explained the situation and they said that I have to go to LA and then to Tahiti but there was a problem with the 2nd flight. They gave me again the customer service card before saying that they are busy. My dad had been told that when he'd die, he might just fall asleep. I learned later that my dad tried to stay awake that night. I called the customer service and they assured me that I am booked. I didn't trust it to I went out to the reception desk and they printed my boarding pass to LA, assuring me that I had a seat for the flight to Tahiti, they just couldn't print the boarding pass. I insisted, are you sure I am booked? They told me "yeah don't worry I see it here". When I arrived in LA I got out of the security zone to talk to Air tahiti so they could print my boarding pass. They told me that no seat was booked. That they tried to reserve it but they didn't book it. I cannot take the plane. They blamed me for using United airline. I talked to the online customer service again and they told me that I have a booking. I told them that I needed a booking number or something. They told me that they canot do more, to call Alaska airline before abruptly, once again ending the conversation. By this point I was so emotional that tears started flowing as I was explanning that 3 people from united airline told me that I was on that flight. They let me use the landline to call the United airline customer service. I talked to someone that didn't seem to understand what was happening, put me on hold for 40 min and hang up. I told them that I NEEDED to leave tonight to see my dying father. By this time it was too late to take any flight to Tahiti that day. I had to call my sister to ask her to book another expensive flight to Tahiti ASAP. I decided to book a hotel and take the flight the next day. If I din't fly with them and took 30 hours options I would have arrived sooner. I they didn't tell me that I was booked on that flight I might have been able to buy myself a ticket. It was supposed to be a 22 hours commute. It turned into a living 3 day of HELL. I asked for a refund. I wish to have back the time I should have been with my family. However they took it from me and cannot give me back the precious time with my familly.
United finally returned to its course-by-course process; thank goodness I didn't have to experience the way it happened during COVID-19. A great crew and meal service.
Never recommend this company

There was no way to control the air from our seats, asked three different people to please raise the temperature on plane but nothing was ever done. It was freezing which made a 9 and half hour flight torture. Everyone had heavy jackets and blankets on. United please respect we are purchasing a flight and this should have been a easy problem to correct.

At check in no seats were available together - and only middle row seats available. Called the united agent to ask what we could do and they advised not to worry and that they would ask the staff at check in to seat us together. The following morning we got to the airport early wanting to ensure our seats but the agents at the boarding gate said there was nothing that could be done and “this is America!” - having seen our British passports. I don’t know what “America” has to do with extremely poor customer service. For reference, I was also happy to upgrade our tickets to ensure we could be sat together. After arguing with the staff for some time, they finally called someone to ask if they’d swap with us. Other passengers who were listening said they too would be willing to swap but the staff evidently had no interest in helping us without us making it known that we were unhappy. We shouldn’t have to escalate it to this level for staff to help!

review_header: “United did not do a good job”
review_text: Chose United because of price and availability. Small carry on. No checked bags. Using app, was offered to choose seat locations. Seemed silly to be charged for choosing a location. I had four planes on this trip. Each one seated me on a window seat with no window. I was also in the back of the plane. I realized that “you get what you pay for”, but is that phrase true when you get those things free on Southwest?! I called to see if I could change my return flight to a flight two hours earlier. They had the ability, but wanted me to pay $300. Again, something done as a courtesy on Southwest. United did not do a good job trying to win over a new loyal customer. Sorry for cheating on you Southwest, please forgive me?!

review_header: "I will never fly with them again"
review_text: The flight was 2 hours delay getting to Jamaica. At out layover in New York, The flight attendants where not helpful or organized when it came to the passengers to the point I got into a altercation with another passenger all due to flight attendants making an announcement about allowing people who have connecting flights to get off first because we arrived late to our layover. But passengers didn't listen and the flight attendants did nothing about it. So me and my sister was stuck on the plane for 20mins. No alerted us telling us the once we got our luggage from baggage claim that we would have to go back thru TSA again. We were just told to pick up and drop them off back at the check in and that was it. Our layover tickets was for a different gate. And no one once again alert us letting us know that our flight numbers changed or the gate for boarding changed. We rushed to the first gate and we wasn't allowed on cause the doors were closed. We asked the boarding worker when will the next flight go out to Milwaukee she stated in the morning. Of course at this point we was very upset. She then stated there was another gate boarding for Milwaukee and we had 15mins to get to the other side of the airport. Again we ran to make that boarding just right before the doors were closing. Once on the plane I heard another passenger say did anyone get the alert that our luggage is on a different flight. Once again we never got the alert. I contacted united airlines about this. A bad first time flight experience and all they did was apologize and offer me a $50 certificate. It was a slap in the face to fly with a terrible experience and then get offered a $50 certificate to solve the problem. United is a horrible airline to fly with. I will never fly with them again.

Why? Because Arturo level of kindness, compassion, and customer service has rendered me statue-like. I can not move. My flight arrived at midnight; I got home, opened my bag, and discovered that I left my MacBook on the plane. I panicked and completed a United lost item report but could not sleep. I returned to a busy airport at 5 AM. After listening to a few angry passengers, I was reluctant to voice my situation, wondering how these United agents remained professional all day. I stepped to Arturo, and immediately he went to work. We walked downstairs and back upstairs, and he made several phone calls - I stared at his determination in disbelief. “Wait right here. This will take me about 15 minutes.” My situation had a new owner. I waited near the ticket counter, listening to United agents’ attempts to turn frowns into smiles. “Nice try, but next.” 13 minutes later, Arturo, wearing a smile as big as the airport and carrying my MacBook, “mission accomplished” walk humbled me. I don’t know if anyone will read my long, convoluted story, but to experience this level of kindness was chilling. Many thanks, Arturo. I offered Arturo $100 to show my appreciation. “No, no, absolutely not,” he said, and he was off to help another customer. I took a moment to stare at him, representing more than United. I was representing the Toala Brand. I’m still sitting in the garage.

WRONG ! Apart from a slightly bigger seat, we got absolutely nothing else. In fact even being in the third row from the front, they could not supply a decent meal, and we had to accept a sandwich from the economy cabin. No room in the cabin for our carry on bags and they had to be put in the economy cabin. Flight attendance service was non existent apart from the same service of a meal (or should I say Sandwich) brought to us. No drinks offered before take off, no TV at our seats, and we paid an extra $2,000 over and above the economy tickets. We will not be flying United again, and advise other travellers to think carefully, before selecting this airline.

I have yet to find out if I will be charged for using the tv service. I have phone service through T Mobile so the first hour was supposed to be free. The connecting flight did not go well. I was supposed to have over 45 minutes to make my connecting flight. Even though I had text and e mail for the entire flight, I never got notice of the gate change. Since the gate on my ticket was across the airport and the flight status screens were no where to be seen, I barely made it to my gate only to find out they changed the gate to back where I started. I now have to spend the night in the airport waiting for the next flight to Philly

Upon arriving in Chicago from Barcelona on United plane,on September 25th my family and I discovered that our four bags were missing. At the United counter, I was informed that I needed to submit a claim for the missing bags at my final destination, Lincoln, NE. Unfortunately, our flight was delayed, and we arrived in Lincoln at 11:30 PM instead of 9 PM. I went straight to the United desk before the shift was over at midnight. At the United desk, I provided detailed information about the bags and received a claim number, reassured by the United rep that they would be found. I tracked two of the bags with GPS and saw they were still in Barcelona. Over the next four days, I called the United Airlines Baggage Unit, and they assured me they were taking full responsibility for locating my bags, but can't find them yet despite me informing them of their whereabouts. They claimed that Eurowings had not moved the bags to the United area in Barcelona and that Eurowings was not responding. On day four, I was told my bags were arriving in Lincoln. However, when I went to pick them up, only three of the four bags were there. A United representative marked them as "delivered." Upon bringing the bags home, I called United about the fourth bag, and they insisted it was also delivered. I rushed back to the airport, but discovered that the mistake was made during scanning or "checking" arrived bags and the bag tags got mixed up thus telling the bag I was missing has arrived. I asked for a correction, I was assured it would get corrected. On day five, I called United again to trace the last bag. They maintained it was delivered, but I kept correcting them regarding the situation. I also inquired if they had received anything from Eurowings, to which they replied no and suggested I contact Eurowings myself. However, Eurowings' website would not accept my delayed bag claim because five days had passed. I reached out to Eurowings' headquarters in Germany and learned that claims could only be filed online or in person at their airport counter, and the five-day limit applied. I asked friends in Germany to help but found out that even at the counter, claims had to be filed within five days of the flight. If I knew the incompetence of the employees, I would contact Eurowings myself earlier. I continued to call United, growing increasingly frustrated with their repeated assertions of the wrong info. I provided a description of the missing bag (light dirty pink, 28 inches, hard shell) and its contents via email on October 2 (day 7). Despite my efforts, I was met with old information each time I called. On October 4, I finally spoke to a supervisor who told me they found a bag matching my description and it would arrive in Lincoln on October 5. On that day, a United representative called at 11 PM to say the bag had arrived. However, when I drove across town to collect it, it was not my bag and did not match my description at all—it was a black soft shell carry-on. The United representative was concerned, and we reviewed my claim, discovering that the original employee had incorrectly marked my bags as "two reds and two blues" and described the contents vaguely, the delivered bag's tag number got mixed up with missing bag number and was still not corrected. Still missing my bag, DAY 13!

Food was slop that I wouldn't feed farm animals. I am not sure why United thinks that everyone flying to India wants to eat Indian food. There was zero choice of a Western option. Seats uncomfortable with no leg room. Bathrooms were disgusting and appear to have never been cleaned during the flight. I couldn't get off the plane fast enough and have cancelled my ticket home next week with United.

My flight could not have been better. Very comfortable seats, great service with a smile. We left on time and arrived 40 minutes early. Everything was great from beginning to end, even the luggage came out very quickly.

review_header: "scam us into paying more for our checked bags"
review_text: The airport itself has a weighing scale, where our bags were within the weight limit of 50 pounds. The United Airline check-in kiosk stated that our bags were a little overweight, which was suspicious. The funnier thing was that we rearranged the items in the two bags and the carry-on bags to make it fit their 'distorted' limits, but upon going to the main desk for dropping off the now labelled bags, their scale once again showed that the bags were overweight. The United staff were also very dismissive, arrogant-sounding, and not at all courteous of the passengers. It would be one thing if these were domestic travelers. But these are international travelers who have saved up for a vacation, and this is how United staff are representing the United States of America. It is a little disgusting to be honest, to have such little consideration for their own public image. Valuable lesson learned. I would rather pay a few hundred dollars more for a similar flight operated by a different airline.

We were delayed 36 hours due to 2 different planes having "maintenance issues". They refuse to compensate us $300 in total for 2 people's expenses over that period. The CEO does not respond to a complaint. He apparently believes in leading his team, as has been reported on internet sites, so I can only presume he is happy that his staff do not ever respond on his behalf to a personal email, direct to him. Absolutely dreadful. Customer Services pass to refund team, who say there is no facility to refund a customer, only a travel credit to be used within a year. As we reside in UK, we will not use the credit in that time. In fact, after this experience, we will never fly United Airlines again and tell our friends and family of our negative experience.

review_header: "wouldn’t even offer us to use their club"
review_text: We were supposed to arrive in Denver before our next fight at 11:15 am to make it home in Albuquerque by 12:30 pm. Due to what the pilot and airlines reps stated was a small hydraulics leak. We stayed on the plane on the tarmac for at least 1.5 hours. We then did not make it to Denver Airport until 11:07 approximately and the airline had already given our First-Class ticket seats away and expected us to be delayed at the airport 10.5 hours. The time given was now almost 9 pm at night. First off, I was injured with a boot on my left leg. This required me to receive wheelchair support. When we landed no agent was there to provide me with a wheelchair. Secondly when a 3rd party wheelchair company named: G2 Secure Staff, they didn’t even want to push me around to get help to make arrangements for an earlier flight home. No United Airlines agent could tell me where my luggage was and what my options were other than the delayed 10.5 hours at the airport. The third-party employee tried to get us a rental not informing us that he would take us out of the secure location requiring us go through security all over again. Since I had a boot on this was a long tedious process. We had to beg the third-party company to leave us with a different wheelchair to get around the airport while waiting. After sitting for two hours on the phone with an agent. I asked her to put us on the standby list and we finally got on a flight 3:45 pm. We were still 4.5 to 5 hours late getting a flight. We didn’t get home until almost 5:30 pm. Keep in mind Fargo North Dakota is 1 hour ahead of us, so we are waiting even longer with our time stuck on the first plane with mechanical issues. In addition, we were placed in economy when we paid for First Class and a refund was not automatically issued. They told us that we would have to fill out a refund request online and wait for a refund which could take weeks to get. We received a limited amount of support from United Airline Agents the whole time we were stuck at the airport. I feel if an airline causes you to miss your flight, they need to make arrangements to get you around to your next gate and on a new flight comparable to your first purchase. If they can’t do this, they should pay to put you on another airline or pay for a rental car and hotel. They wouldn’t even offer us to use their club to sit and rest in. All we were offered was 20.00 each for a meal voucher. Which is a joke at an airport. We also had to pay more for parking for a vehicle. Lastly, again I was told nothing could be done to help us until after we got home and filed a claim. This is how they take care of First-Class Customers and let’s just say no customer should be treated this way. Did I mention all we were offered on the ride home was a glass of water. They stated due to turbulence that’s all they could accommodate us all with a tiny bag of pretzels and some customers didn’t even get this. I will say, to be fair, the turbulence was pretty bad but why not hand out the pretzels as we walk on the plane like they do hand sanitizer wipes.
This time my flight got delayed by 5 hrs. What gets me is the gate agents attitude, they are unhelpful and not very accommodating. United is an unreliable travel partner.
She went above and beyond to assist me on the flight. Because of her kind hospitality, I will continue to fly with United Airlines.

review_header: “gate agents not willing to be helpful”
review_text: When this happened there was minimal to no accommodations for the flight. The gate agents were not willing to be helpful. Furthermore, they were scheduled off and so they were just trying to hand out cards to have people call customer service and reschedule. When I called customer service they continued to transfer me to three different people resulting in being hung up on. At the counter, as the passenger, I had to contact another airline and they were able to assist even though it was not their issue. The lady that was initially helping us was more concerned about whether or not she had clocked back in. To add, the customer service line that they opened had closed in the middle of trying to arrange our new flights. The supervisor on duty told us that the line was still open, and made zero efforts to try and open that line. As the customer I had to research the phone number to talk to reservations. The guy who was trying to switch the flights was getting very frustrated and visibly angry. As a customer we felt the same emotions but we needed the support from the airline in order to make our trip happen. To sum this up, United got us a flight on delta airlines. This flight was not properly confirmed when we got to the delta agent. The delta agent then was able to switch us to the flight that we originally wanted, making our travel day 20 hours rather than 36. United took over three hours to make accommodations and this would not of happened without me as the customer contracting both United and delta. I will never be flying United again because of how terrible this experience was. If I could leave a no star I would.

review_header: "beware of this companies lack of care"
review_text: Minor inconvenience so I spent the day in NYC to kill time. Upon returning to the airport for my rebooked flight, all passengers were told to debark due to mechanical issues. Still not the biggest problem, but now there is not rebooking. The gate agent was extremely volatile with multiple customers. United did not issue any hotel, rental, bus, train, or food compensation for this inconvenience. I called the customer service line and that got me nowhere. I asked to speak to a supervisor and was told they are not answering the call. I was trapped in the Newark airport for over a day with no help from United. I eventually booked an Amtrak train ticket to make a deadline I had at work the next day since I hadn't arrived home on the scheduled day 7/15/2024. Buyer beware of this companies lack of care for their customers time and money since the services were not completed.

review_header: "continues to deny our request to reimburse us"
review_text: They cancelled the first leg of our flight from Appleton to Chicago so we drove to Chicago to get on the flight from there. They then continued to delay our flight continuously until they cancelled it at 1 am. It’s was then too late for us to get on a different flight to Seattle. We missed our cruise embarkation because of them. We were able to book another flight on Alaskan airlines two days later in Juneau, Alaska to catch up with our cruise in that port. United continues to deny our request to reimburse us for that airline ticket. We tried to book something thru them but they had no flights going into Alaska. We fly United on a regular basis but we will no longer be using their airline because of this. If they had cancelled our flight earlier we would have been able to book another flight to catch our cruise. Instead they delayed us 5 times and even had us on the plane for two hours and then deplaned us and delayed us repeatedly before cancelling. The whole situation is totally ridiculous. They were 100% at fault and offered no remedy or reimbursement.

We've tried webchat, calling and email. No replies and just automated messages. Do not expect to be treated fair if anything goes wrong. Did not even get on my flight as they delayed and cancelled and then had me flying out from somewhere else with no connection to it - they refuse to refund as they say we have used this flight ticket (that got rebooked departing wrong destination). Ground staff had no clue and gave no help.

Once we boarded plane, literally sat on plane for 45 minutes, pilots said nothing over the intercom the entire time. Once they backed us out the gate, sat on runway for another 1/2 hour. Nothing for airline to blame it on, weather was great, etc. Pilots provided passengers nothing, what a lack of respect for their customers

They canceled our flights saying due to weather but we seen 5 planes take off and someone over heard them say they are short staff but telling people it’s “weather” did not put us in a hotel, did not help with food, very careless the people that work here have no clue about anything at all. Idk how this airline is still open they need to shut it down. We’ve been waiting for another flights for 14 hrs now had to sleep at ohare airport with my kids just a terrible experience they’ll never get a penny from me again! I thought Spirit was bad but no United is truly the worst airline ever!

These people have no business running an Airline. We arrived at ORD from an overseas trip. The departure time was changed 5 times. We boarded twice and had to disembark twice because lack of crew. Instead of taking off at 8:10OM we were asked to leave the plane at 2:20AM because of crew issue. No hotel voucher were given because they rescheduled the flight for 9:30AM. According to the agent we don’t have enough time to sleep and come back. No meal vouchers. We were told it will emailed, which it was not. We were told to go to another terminal near the day flight and cots will be provided. Very few cots weee there, not enough, and the cots are provided by the city of Chicago not US. I can write a book about the miserable experience provided by this miserable and poor excuse for an airline. Their staff was incompetent, lacking knowledge and unhelpful. They lied just to get rid of us. It turned out they knew they had a staffing problem with several flights, judging by the number of folks sleeping on the floor. They delayed announcing it in order to save money. It is 3:22AM and still no email, no text message and no vouchers. Flying United is a one-way ticket to hell. I will never fly them again.

United will never get another penny from me connecting through Guam first United didn’t share that we had to meet in front of a specific door and only had eight minutes to do this so me and multiple other passengers, missed the open door and got trapped in the concourse for over two hours broke my bag. This is still an issue.

We had booked the flight for 7:30am and online it said 7:30 departure. I received a text at 3:14 am, (I was sound asleep, not expecting to get up until 5:20am) saying my flight was leaving at 6:14am. When I woke up at 5:20, I received a reminder text stating my plane was boarding at 5:37am. We rushed out the door and made it to the airport by 5:50am. I was unaware that United airlines did not require a boarding pass and so I could have went through TSA with only my ID. But because I could not find a kiosk to print my boarding pass, I went to the front counter to try to get a boarding pass. I have never flown united airlines before this so I was unaware of their new ID only policy. When I got to the front counter the lady was on both her cell phone and the landline. She did not look up at me. She did not even acknowledge. I was standing there. About 10 minutes later she asked me for my name, then told me that I was missing my flight. Another man walked up, and my brother and sister came at the same time. We told the man That my flight was supposed to leave at 7:30 not 6:14, He looked it up and saw that we were telling the truth. But he said they hadn't had a flight to san Francisco that leaves at 7:30am for 2 months. Their system never updated that information. So now if you go online and book your flight out for 7:30, it is incorrect, but you won't find out until 3am on the day of your departure by text message. It seems like a scam. We feel cheated and upset that we had to go through so much stress. The woman on the phone was very rude and did not even acknowledge us or apologize. When we ask her to apologize she responded with "stop yelling at me" Which none of us were yelling. Her supervisor also defended her and acted as though we were wrong. It felt like narcissistic abuse. I will never book another flight on united airlines.
I believe the management should review the staff working on this flight, address their attitude, and ensure they receive proper training on how to treat clients with respect.

We arrived in New Jersey at around 8:10pm and did not exit the plane until 8:50pm due to arriving earlier than scheduled, traffic, and the gate was changed. The upsetting part is that there are children, elderly, people with health issues, and pregnant women on board. We were told to stay in our seats but those who got up to use the washroom were yelled at very rudely by the air flight attendant. When some of us went to the washroom she yelled out “make it quick!”, making people look around and then she proceeded to use the microphone to yell out “the aircraft won’t move unless everyone is seated” but children and mothers and elderly still got up during the wait. The airplane was not in motion during the whole time it was landed. This flight attendant also made us feel unwelcome during the flight. She would stare and look us people up and down without any greetings or smile as the flight attendants normally do. It was a terrible flight simply for the way she treated us and made people feel ashamed for having to use the washroom during such a lengthy wait to the gate. A young person who flew for their first time even mentioned “there is a way to speak to people, but that is not the way she should have explained the situation, she could have kindly reminded everyone to remain seated”. I feel bad for this new flyer since this is her first impression of flight attendants. I can’t imagine talking to anyone to “make it quick!”

I very rarely travel because it is often difficult and painful, but my mom is sick so me and my son are tying to fly down to see her. Our flight was delayed for 6 hrs yesterday, then canceled and rescheduled for 6am. We arrived at 5am as requested, only to be delayed another 4 hours by 530. Now as I sit here head pounding, fighting tears and trying to ignore the spreading pain, I am listening to announcements offering $500 travel vouchers for anyone willing to take later flight than the one currently boarding. Really? I don't understand, or appreciate being forced to wait hour after hour, day after day for a single fight that keeps getting pushed off while they are happily paying people to wait while their planes leave on time. Further more while the staff I have had contact with have been super kind, it is obvious to me that this airline could care less how inconvenient their overpriced flights are or how stressful, expensive, and plain frustrating these delays are to their customers. For goodness sake, you have to pay extra to bring a carry-on, to check even 1 bag, to have any space on the plane, or even to be able to sit next to your child, yet they leave you stranded in the terminal where water cost $5 bucks for hours, and now days in a row! I for one will NEVER make the mistake of flying United Airlines again.

I had a flight with UA from West Palm Beach - Newark - Fra. Well the first flight was totally a hell, the flight from PBI- Newark was delayed for 5 hours! I ended up arriving at Newark after 5 hours! After the original time, I was supposed to take a flight to Germany FRA and because they were super delayed I missed the flight to Germany, I arrived at New Jersey around 11:45 pm at that time there was no more available flights to Germany, well I had to wait until next day to get another flight to Germany, I went to the UA airport counter, the employees were so rude, they said they couldn’t give me another flight because the flight was operated by Lufthansa, I went to Lufthansa and they told me that United Airlines had to do it, I went back to UA counter and one of the employees told me she cannot help me and told me to call the customer service phone line. Let me tell you their customer service is the most ugliest and horrible customer service I ever experienced in my whole life. To begin with this endless nightmare, they kept me on hold for 3 hours on the phone , 3 hours! I even screenshot the reordered phone calls with these idiots!! At the end of the phone call the customer service agent told me that she refuses to give me a hotel voucher. Yeah alright after their flight being delayed for 5 hours. I arrived so late at Newark airport. The second thing that made me explode was that after 3 hour phone call the agent told me to go back to the UA airport counter and ask for the alternative flight for my missed flight, at this point my blood was boiling! She said she couldn’t help me and that I had to go to the counter again. I spent the whole night at Newark airport walking around, sitting around because this airport is so dangerous, lots of homeless people walking around trying to do something bad to others. Then the next morning again I went to the UA counter, again they refused to help me again. They told me to go to Lufthansa because the flight was operated by Lufthansa.  At this point I was crying because no airline wanted to help me, I felt so helpless, then I went and looked for a manager of the UA, he said that he was gonna take a look to my reservation, again he told me to go to Lufthansa , I told him that I been bounced like 7 times already back and forth between those 2 airlines, he came with me to Lufthansa counter and spoke to the Lufthansa staff, they looked at my ticket number and said that the ticket number did not exist. Then the UA manager told me to give him 2 hours to figure this out, after 2 hours I came to the UA counter and he said to me that he is sorry that him and his staff crew didn’t type the numbers of the ticket or reservation code correctly on their computers.  They have complete fools working at this airlines, these people gave me a hell because they are so incompetent and stupid to even know what they are doing? And on top of everything their staff was so rude. Finally after 16 hours I got my flight to Germany. The nightmare doesn’t end here. My returning flights from this horrible airline were messed up and disorganized, I must said this airline is extremely unreliable. I had to run like in a marathon throughout the airport of Holland to not miss my flight to America. Their damn flight was again delayed for 2 hour.  Never again UA.

The main meals are better left alone, but throughout the flight they did serve snacks that were pretty good. Given my average size and height, the legroom and seat width were completely acceptable (tip: you gain a LOT of feet space by stowing carry-ons in the overhead bins rather than under the seat in front of you). That said, the recline was awful. Compared to other overseas carriers like Air France or Lufthansa, they barely recline at ALL.

Had heard decent things before, and wow....I could not have been more disappointed. To start with, they have a "phone stand" attached to the seat for your "own personal entertainment station". A set up as low quality as a dollar store phone stand. And the in-flight food both to AND from our destination was FROZEN. The chicken was absolutely disgusting (And frozen), and when I asked the flight attendant if she could possibly heat the chicken, she just repepated no over and over with a deer in headlights smile, (will post her name later) till I finally got fed up with her absolute lack of care and told her to take the lunchable style brown bag excuse they'd tried to paddle off as food. The seats are a huge downgrade from other flights on the same aircraft, and when I wasn't being nickel and dimed for everything from bags to drinks the pilot was upselling items. This seriously feels like the dollar store knockoff of a real flight. What an absolute embarrassment.

They canceled our flight and didn’t offer any new flight, no meals, no transportation, no hotel rooms nothing. They won’t even refund our money for the original flight. Then when you ask for help they tell you to go the website and fill out a form. My sister in law had this exact thing happen two months ago no call back no email no refund.  Do not waste your time or money. I would have rather walked.

Instead, it turned into a nightmare. The flight was delayed six times due to weather conditions, which is understandable, but the way United handled it was terrible. After each delay, we were asked to line up and prepare for boarding, only to be told to wait more. Eventually, after hours of waiting and false hope, they canceled the flight. If they had just canceled it earlier, my mother and I wouldn't have wasted our entire day at the airport. To make matters worse, when the cancellation was announced, we were told to stand in two lines—one for international travelers. My mother and I stood in line for 2 hours, only to be cut off by someone who had already been served but didn’t like the hotel they were given. Despite Assistant Maria already talking to me, she decided to help this person instead. Then, another assistant, Nina, ignored me and left while I was still waiting. When we went "upstairs" to United's main kiosk to get new reservations, it was another disaster. Unlike everyone else who was in line "downstairs," I was told I couldn't be reimbursed, with the excuse that the system wouldn’t allow it. This left me to cover additional costs for transportation, accommodation, and food—all over my budget. To top it off, when I reached out to United’s customer service about this, I received a lazy, dismissive response: "Unfortunately, I'm unable to reimburse your costs as the flight interruption was outside of our control." This reply was both upsetting and offensive. It feels incredibly unfair and ridiculous that I was left standing out, almost like I was being discriminated against. My mother went through all of this with me, standing and waiting without any proper support from United. Now, after saying my goodbyes, I have to spend more money just to get home. I’m extremely disappointed with how United Airlines handled this situation. I want to be reimbursed, but even more than that, I want to be heard. United Airlines, you've lost a customer for good—I’m switching to Delta.

They can’t time the trash pick up properly. They distributed snack and drinks, followed immediately by a meal. So when they came around with the drink cart and asked if we wanted a drink, I wanted to say I can’t because my tray is full. Then at snack time, they came with the trash cart 10 mins after we got our food. And it’s been another 10+ minutes and they haven’t made their rounds yet. Food is really bad too.

Got to Denver (layover) another delay 1/2 hr, 2nd delay another 1/2 hr, start boarding, de board -flat tire -then 2 flat tires. Landed 9:45 pm in San Francisco vs 7:15 days gone - so much for paying for flight with good landing times. Return flight San Francisco to Appleton - loaded late then a 1/2 hr delay, while in plane another delay of 1 and a half hours. Scheduled flight 12:55pm new fly time was 2:55! Denver was layover had weather while flying - airport was a mess BUT most flights were back to being on time - not United. My flight was delayed for 6 hrs 8:45 pm leaving vs landing in Appleton at 9:15pm - landing time changed to 12:15 am. Was able to change flights and land at Madison at 11pm. To conclude -9 delays involving 4 planes totals for 1 trip. Fun fact : 3 different airports never did go to the airport that I booked out of. Way to go United - take the $$ the leave it to the customers to do your job and juggle numerous flights to complete their trip!! Will say their staff was nice but assuming they have to be since the actual purpose of United is to fly people and they fail at that!

Every single flight I’ve had over the last 10 years has been delayed, cancelled or rerouted. All this while getting less room, no meals, barely any snacks and higher prices. I love waking up at 5:30am for a flight they’ve delayed for 6.5 hours and then getting kicked off the tarmac because they forgot a food cart causing the flight to be flat out cancelled. Absolutely disgraceful that they’re allowed to run a company like this.

Waiting 3 days in Washing DC for baggage delivery to hotel however no new, no email, call them 1000 times no answer. I need to flight To Seattle as flight had booked in advance. When reached Seattle try to call 1000 times they either no pick up or don't have information . Have to go to airport and register again after 6 days i got my bag with total damages, and open. Second baggage was no new. Call them day by day , today 08/11 my second bag still in Washington DC without transfer to my address. What is worst customer service they have. No email , non phone call : no apology / staff are clueless for what happening.

Our family experienced with one of our cousins a terrible accident. When we called United and expressed concern regarding our family member traveling with mental and physical health issues, United with little questions after initial disclosure refunded the flight cost to our family credit card. The agent on August 9, 2024  was polite, sensitive, and efficient. There was no playing games with needing to go to a supervisor. And since our family member who called was and is experiencing PTS because of observing the accident, this aware service agent eased our family pain. Thank you United. We will use the refund to have another family member fly soon. You have our business because of this sensitivity of your agent.
Overhead reading light didn't work and it was a long flight from Newark to Portland. The seat was uncomfortable, and my bags were lost and will be returned today. What a mess this flight was!

The outgoing flight from Little Rock to Denver was delayed by an hour 4 hrs before the departure time. Ended up being 2hrs late. Because of this we missed our flight out of Denver causing us (me and 2 small children) to book the next flight which was 12 hours later. Meaning I could either sleep in the airport with small kids or pick from the very limited hotels. The hotel they booked is had bugs in the lobby, but was fine otherwise. The flight on the way home was fine except they put my checked bags on a different plane, so we drove the hour home with no bags. They were supposed to be delivered today, 7/7/24, but they haven't moved since 1pm according to the app and I cannot get ahold of anyone via phone. Flight attendants were the highlight on all flights. All very nice.

Their customer service is rude and condescending. The flight was cancelled because of a mechanic issue which led to waiting until the bad weather came in. If they were not delayed by the 2 hours for mechanical issues we would have made it to the destination before thunderstorm started. They are unable to rebook people for 2-3 days because they overbook the flights. There was no compensation for food or hotels. They would not allow anyone to have their luggage even though some people completely cancelled their plans because of the long delay. They were not at all helpful. There is not 1 good thing I can say about them.

Everything went well, all attendants were so nice, and it was a great experience! I especially want to think the crew of flight 567. What a wonderful bunch of stewards and stewardesses were on that flight! They went above and beyond for me!

Our vacation was over and we were flying back home on Saturday, August 3, 2024. Unfortunately, our flight home to Newark Liberty Airport from New Orleans was cancelled about two hours prior to scheduled departure. United Airlines employees put extra effort in to making a nightmare experience into a tolerable one. First, on Saturday afternoon, they helped us out through the entire process of rebooking our flight for 6 am the next day, taking care of hotel accomodations, airport transfers, meal vouchers, and reassuring us throughout the process that we will be well taken care of. They guided us on how to get our checked luggage back and what we needed to do the next day. On early Sunday morning around 3:30 AM, another United Airlines employee, helped my two children to get their bags retagged, as the kiosk would not print out updated luggage tags. They also helped all three of us to get Gate passes we needed, since our boarding pass said delayed flight and we were already checked in yesterday. She also rebooked my children's tickets to make sure that sat next to each other. This was something we did not even ask her to do. Thanks to both.

Arrived at checkin with 3 hrs to spare at Raleigh-Durham. Our agent gave us etickets. Tried to checkin on line but got message "proceed to checkin counter". The lady at the counter could not find us on the passenger list for quite some time. Finally she says. OH you just have etickets. Yes, that's what we showed her. She said the flight is fully booked, I don't have room. I said we are connecting with an international flight and United is the carrier. She looked some more and found seats, apart, but at least we were on board. Come boarding time, we get are in group 3 and get told no more room for carry on. We explained to staff we had a stop over in New Zealand and needed what we had. Our cabin bag weighed less than 5kg each. She suggested we condense into 1 bag not over 7kg. Thankful for her suggestion we did that. One cabin bag was then checked through all the way to Australia. Go to step onboard the aircraft to have a flight attendant step forward and scream at top of her voice to us .. I have no more room, get off, go back and check the bag in. We explained what had just transpired during boarding and proceeded to find out seats. She gets on the PA and screams down the isle .. no more room for baggage, means no more room. Other passengers said to us how rude they found her too. When my husband reached his seat, he was holding the cabin bag while checking the nearby overhead lockers. Again she gets on PA and screams .. Sir, you can not stand there holding you bag. He wasn't holding anyone up in the isle at all. A male attendant came along and said .. come with me Sir, there is room down the back of the plane. My husband said there were 2 empty overhead bins still. While all this was going on I was watching other passengers get on with 2 pieces of cabin luggage each. The female Head Attendant was rude and abrupt during the flight to others, which thankfully was a short flight. We have travelled extensively and never been spoken to in such a rude demeaning manner. United Airlines should enfirce the rule 1 carryon piece each passenger so there is room for everyone's luggage. We will never travel with United Airlines again, which unfortunately means we won't travel to visit family in USA on Air New Zealand with United being their carrier. Obviously United Airlines is quite affluent because it does not need repeat customers. Extremely disappointed in that staff member and the lack of luggage space onboard for a passenger transiting to an international flight when we arrived 3 hours before departure time.

They cancelled that flight and booked us on a connecting flight. We were ok with that. But then while boarding and waiting an hour on the plane in Orlando we noticed they had cancelled our connecting flight to Newark and they did not rebook us. Then as we were trying to get information they gave us a card and basically said fend for yourself! We had to take a 40 minute Uber from IAD Dulles international airport to Newark Penn Station and then take an UBER home from there!

Airplane legroom was quite tight and was not comfortable, Flight attendant were not responsible, nor polite and didn't care for any request. It was my first flight with United Airlines and it'll be my last one with them. I wont recommend this airline to anybody else. Flight had more than 4 hours delay, that was announced each half an hour, so no body could even have an idea when can ask their family to pick them up at YVR. Ultimately, after provide a $ 15 dinner voucher, too late to use, so we paid almost $ 80 to buy a brief dinner together with my wife and I didn't apply the voucher at all. I don't have any idea how they dared to provide $15 dinner voucher after this more than 4 hours delay. Ultimately our landing was changed from 10.30 PM to 2.30 AM, that ruined our day after, too, since we reached home in Port Moody around 4.30 AM. I regret to choose United Airline and for sure it'll be the last time to choose United Airlines. Worst experience with an airline.

Bad weather expected so we moved the flight up to a 9 AM flight. That was canceled. No reason for us back to our original flight without having business class. Delayed because of rest. Got to Washington and missed flight by four minutes. They didn’t wait for us. We were told that they needed four empty seats. got put on a flight several hours later to Frankfurt. That flight was late and they waited for people for this flight. Now don’t know if we’ll even make our next flight. Going to miss at least one or more of our days in Athens. Tickets that were bought cannot be refunded. Fail every way.

This caused a major disruption to an extended family vacation involving delay and cancellation for several family groups. There were no other flights available the same day and United sent a rescheduled flight that was to a different destination on a different day. This was ridiculous and unacceptable. I cannot describe how poorly and nonchalantly we were treated. I will never fly United again.

We got rerouted to another airport because running out of fuel and once landed there, sat on tarmac for another few hours. This was all due to thunderstorms around the destination. This is all well and good as nature happens, but when I tried to contact customer service to get on another flight, I never got a response back and I waited on the phone for 41 minutes on hold. Customer service sorely lacking.

. is that a policy or just randomly seat people wherever? These questions I would like to get an answer for. I don't want to get into all the details but typically a child with a disability is seated next to a parent. Why they would seat them separate is bizarre to me. I got lots of attitude when I had asked them nicely about the seating. I got rude and snappy remarks and they just escalated the situation further while I remained calm the whole time. United is by far the worst airline I have traveled on and worst experience in my entire travelling history.

review_header: “the human touch makes all the difference”
review_text: We boarded Flight UA52 from Washington DC to Zurich, on July 18th at 8 pm instead of 6 pm. Our flight was delayed due to some parts that needed to be replaced by two hours. Our connecting flight from Zurich to Mumbai had a window of two hours. The United Airline personnel reassured us we will not miss our connecting flight as the pilot will make up time and the connecting flight was at the same terminal as our landing terminal. Once we boarded, I spoke to the crew who was servicing us of our situation. We were flying to my brother's funeral and his son, who was traveling with me, needed to make the connection as he had to do the last rites. The pilot made up one and half hours. We had only 30 minutes in hand. The crew were so helpful and understanding. They moved us to business class for the last 10 minutes before landing so we were the first ones to deboard. I cannot thank the crew enough for their support and for making this happen. We made our connecting flight with 10 minutes to spare. And we made it to Mumbai. Thank you to the crew of Flight UA52. I wish I remembered your names. It is the human touch that makes all the difference.

Unfortunately my mother passed and I had to cancel my trip. United Airlines didn't care, wouldn't refund anything except my seat fare and they even upgraded my ticket without asking and charged me more money for the upgrade. I just can't believe that I have the death certificate and everything to give them and I can't get my money for the ticket refunded they gave me a voucher that's only good for a year and I'm not a frequent flyer and will never use the voucher because I'll never fly with United again.

On my recent flight to Newark NJ I experienced a 1 plus hour delay in addition to a freezing cabin temperature. Then on our flight home we were again delayed 1 hour due to no pilot available! I mean really. The flight prior to ours was delayed coming in and I honestly believe the “missing pilot “ excuse was just a cover for their inability to get their flights on time. So in addition after waiting the extra hour and paying extra to have priority boarding, I was told I had to check my carry on at the gate due to they had reached the maximum amount of luggage. Yet when I boarded the plane I found numerous over head bins completely empty. So I get seated in my seat and watch as the passengers board the plane only to notice that after awhile people were entering the plane and able to use the overhead bins. I'm utterly disgusted with the service of United and after years of flying I am over their sub par services and over charges. Delta is going to be my choice from now on.

Despite the app telling us Wifi was available on the flight, it does not appear to be offered on this class of plane in the fleet (specifically the 737s used in the Pacific). United routes in Micronesia use planes that have not been updated since the routes were flown by Continental Micronesia, and the cabin is showing its age. Seats barely holding together, no power outlets, no real entertainment selections since the entertainment system is just a screen and buttons to change channels to see continuously-looped content. If you want to know what it was like to fly United in 2002, this is a good way to experience it, but ultimately the inflight experience was not worth half the fare paid.

They advertise free checked bags and carry on for active duty military. But this is dependent on the type of ticket purchased. If you must purchase an expensive ticket to get the bags this is not offering a service for US military. Deceiving practice.

review_header: "the last time I fly United Airlines"
review_text: Purchasing the ticket was a nightmare. I had to change my flight and I payed a penalty (which is ok) But the agent 1 told me I would have a credit to purchase my next ticket. Agent 2 said I would have a refund on my credit card but 3 weeks later the refund wasn’t done. I had to talk with a manager to have that corrected (after hours on the phone) Arrived to destination my luggage got lost. No help to cover was offered at all. I had to purchase shoes, shorts and more. To be compensated it really seems to be a nightmare. One week later the luggage was found and sent but all the content was wet. They sent my luggage to my first destination but too late as I had to leave to the next city for work. On the FOUR flights I had separated seats from my wife and the boarding was so messy that nobody wanted to change seats. This is the last time I fly United Airlines.
Still would not recondited to travel issues, but even with a problem this time. Worth it because of the service!

We had to sit 5 hours in the plane! All Americans in the plane just acted like it's all good and just another day. I missed my connection to Dallas because of this. Getting a new flight, apparently goes through their app only. Nobody in person that you can help at a desk. Even though there was a direct flight available (from United) the app did not give the possibility to rebook this flight. Instead they offered an indirect flight through Houston. The only way to contact them is by phone. Nobody really helping you to get as soon as possible to your destination. I can't believe Americans take this kind of low service level. In a 'consumer oriented' society like the US I expected people to be more assertive. The service United delivers is dehumanized. In total it took me 14 hours to get to Dallas! I think it's totally unacceptable. Even though a mechanical failure can happen, getting you another flight to get you asap to your destination is a minimum in such a situation. After this experience I think I will never fly United again.

I was supposed to arrive to my destination but due to the global outage my partner and I could not make it in the time we were supposed to (not our fault. Once we were redirected they had transfered our luggage to another state and we did not even board that flight. Not sure how it was flown over to the state when the flight was cancelled. Not only did we not get our luggage for 3 days, once we did land to our destination, the zipper on my luggage had been broken off. When we did arrive to the destination we were told to leave our keys so they can check for anything during customs and then once we got the luggage they would be returned to us. My luggage was complete destroyed. I am on vacation I paid for my time and I decided to call them once I got back with that broken luggage and now I am being told it was over 7 days they cant do anything about it. I find that extremely messed up. Not only did I miss my time to decompress due to the global outage, it is what it is, but, I also had no luggage for 3 days when we arrived and had to buy clothes. I decided to take it easy and call once I got back and on Friday late night, I decided to call Monday (working days) just to be told cant do anything about it. So not only did I miss a couple of days of no luggage bought clothes out of pocket, then to have a damage luggage to bring back and to now be told oh wells sorry cant do anything about it. That's absolutely disgusting. People spend thousands of dollars to travel and save up for that and then some. To be treated like it's nothing is so rude. I will never travel United again, it was not only the most dirtiest flight but the staff was extremely unwelcoming. Customer care was not helpful at all. I've never had to call an airline more than 2 times, I think I have called United at least 8 times in the matter of a week just to connect with someone. I suggest you guys do better with how you show empathy. It's all a money grab for you guys. Absolutely disgusted with how things were handled.

I am upset because I am a memeber and have 18K worth miles plus $2K of flight money or i guess cash due to me, and all I wanted was to use my miles the same way i do on the plane and get snacks, but this time for my daughter who is visiting from college, and I bought her ticket through my account. But they refuse do do that. You are the only one who can use it. They owe me money after getting off a flight so others could travel because plane was to heavy, and I was first to say yes. And they still treat me this way.

My bag fit easily into the carry-on size box. I bought a ticket with hand luggage. But they refused to put me on the plane until I paid for my hand luggage as baggage. Why did they create the measuring box? If it doesn't make sense. I showed a screenshot from their corporate website, where the dimensions of hand luggage were indicated. But the company employees didn’t care about the site.

Our flight was scheduled for 5:45 am, and we arrived at the airport on time. However, the check-in process was unusually slow, taking much longer than expected. After finally getting through check-in, we proceeded to security, but we were stopped by the employee who checked us in. They realized there was an issue with my boarding pass and spent another 15 minutes verifying it. Once we reached security, we encountered another problem: the TSA agent noticed a discrepancy between my boarding pass and passport. This required us to go back to the check-in counter, where it took them another 10 minutes to identify that my birthdate was entered incorrectly. By the time everything was sorted out and we returned to the security checkpoint, there was a lengthy queue. Despite rushing through security, we arrived at the gate just 5 minutes late, only to be informed that we had missed our boarding window. The airline staff instructed us to reschedule our flight due to the delay caused by these issues. Which where all caused by United Airlines.

review_header: "told us we have to check in our carry ons"
review_text: We had a connection in New York. They let first people to take three bags and they told us we have to check in our carry ons. They were absolutely rude and not professional. They threatened us with police. We had computers and learning books for our medical conference in Geneva. This is absurd This is the first and last time we flying United.

As usual my United flight was overbooked and was delayed so bad (due to technical issues and needing a new plane, that a Delta flight with a Layover would have been better. This seems to happen every time I give an airline other than Delta a try. I have said I’ll never use United again more than once. Maybe they will eventually get one right.

The worst part was, we were on the tarmac when they told us the flight had been delayed. And the flight on this review is my second ever flight with United trying to get from Boston to Corpus with a connection in Houston. Once again, they waited until the very last second to inform me of a 1hr and 5 minute delay (as of the time of writing this review). With their track record, I’m not that optimistic they will successfully take off at the new time, either. The gate changed twice, and they didn’t inform me of the delayed time until boarding was supposed to have ended. The flight was supposed to leave at 12:15pm, and the flight time wasn’t changed until 12:00pm. According to their information, it was a scheduling error, and I’ve honestly had such a horrible experience with getting anywhere on time with them, I will be doing my absolute best to never fly with them again.

The inflight entertainment was broken, for a 13 hour flight. A mobility aid was lost on arrival, due to incorrect tagging by the staff in San Francisco - a surly check-in member who did not smile once. They broke a suitcase on top of all that, which they refuse to fix. Avoid this disaster of an airline. They do not care about passengers.

The company assured me that the entire reservation was canceled and provided a cancellation email. After realizing no refund was received I dispute my credit card which United fought back stating it as a valid charge. I called to speak to United in May. I found out that they only canceled 1 person off and currently 3 people are still active on their end. After understanding the error that occurred the agent said to go on their dispute site and submit refund and documents, which were submitted on 5/27, Jun 3, and Jul 17 with no answer. Today I spoke with the agent to understand the issue, only to find out that they are refusing the refund. I spoke with the refund department and she said “sorry, unfortunately there is nothing that can be done for this reservation. I asked her, how did my daughter disappear off the reservation? And if her cancellation was valid why did United never refunded the charge for her and kept the full amount and applied to the remaining 3 tickets? I told her the entire reservation was canceled and for some reason 1 person got canceled so please issue a refund as this is large amount and in today's economy every dollar is important. The initial reservation was for 4 people in excess of $4000+.

I usually travel via spirit due to it being inexpensive and like to save money to have a little better of stay where ever I am going. Unfortunately to fly to Grand Rapids you can not fly spirit so we chose united thinking well it cannot be worse (we were wrong). I don't expect luxury when I fly I expect to make it to my destination and if it is weather delayed that is okay but when 3 planes aren't working that's a huge issue. My girlfriend and I were stuck in Denver forever away from home (Indiana) for almost 9 hours and we knew we would be there for at least an hour cause Denver was a connecting flight so i couldn't imagine what getting there early would have been. Our flight was after 7 hours cancelled and we were there another 2 hours trying to get things figured out. By the time we made it to our hotel it was 5am our home time. We were told by someone at the Denver airport he has been there "30 years" we could get a flight two days later from our original flight date. So we had to get a rental to get to our destination and has been the most insane time trying to get our rental reimbursed. Everyone on customer support speaks minimal English and can't help us well. The airport workers are no help they all just pass out cards with a QR card and I had to use a phone to translate information to a Chinese speaker. This is unacceptable from an airline who claims to be one of the better airlines.

There was ample leg room in Economy Plus. Departure was on time. The flight overall was smooth except for bumpy patches which the pilot advised the passengers of before takeoff. ICE and messaging worked fine with no buffering watching a movie. Flight crew was very friendly and provided the usual service that all domestic airlines do (beverages and snacks) with food available for purchase.

review_header: " Never flying this airline ever again"
review_text: Never flying with this airline ever again, could be compared to Southwest at this point, maybe worse

The aircraft departed IAD with a closed lavatory near seat 9A in the fully occupied Polaris section of the cabin. This left one lavatory available near seat 9B and one near the cockpit. By mid-flight several passengers lined up to use the lavatory near 9B resulting in a very crowded situation. I decided to try to use the lavatory near the cockpit. As I approached the latter, I was stopped by a flight attendant and informed that it was unavailable because a pilot was about to use it. The FA told me to use the other lavatory in business. I explained that it was very crowded there and asked politely if I could wait in the aisle until the lavatory near the cockpit became available. At that point the FA became very hostile and angry and ordered me to leave that area of the cabin. I was stunned and appalled by his behavior. I am well aware of the security measures that have been in place since 9/11. The FA had only to tell me in a civil manner that I couldn’t wait in the aisle, and I would have complied without a problem. But his treatment of me was completely out of line. I understand that flight attendants are under a great deal of pressure and stress. Yet what I was subjected to was completely unacceptable. As a very loyal 1K customer of United, I am more than a little disappointed.

The airline's commitment to on-time performance and minimizing delays and cancellations. With a strong fleet and a focus on customer service, United Airlines has established itself as a trusted and reliable choice, making it difficult to find any hesitation in its overall performance.

When requested it to be fixed at the main counter, they referred us to get that done at the gate. When went to the gate and requested, the lady there was so obnoxious that ruined the whole experience. She just kept talking rudely stating “you had to get that done at the main desk”, “ you guys buy these non-refundable tickets and expect changes”, “why did you not call United in advance”, “rolled her eyes” etc. these all unnecessary, useless statements without giving me a chance to respond and kept talking over me. I guess they just find some these worst human beings on the planet to work of them or train them to be the worst when it comes down to the “customer services”. With this sort of attitude towards customer, the airline is doomed for failure. This was my first United flight experience and will never in my life fly or recommend United to anyone.

We cancelled a ticket and received residual flight credit. Several months later before we were planning to use the credit to book another trip, United's system magically deletes the credit. We've tried for months to contact someone in support but only getting redirected from department to department even after they ran a trace and verified what happened. I now know what it must have felt like to try to get something done in a soviet bureaucracy.

I had an extremely disappointing experience with this airline. Their customer service is terrible. They do not assist customers, provide solutions, or show any care for their passengers. Instead, they leave them stranded in airports without any help. I would never recommend this airline to anyone and will avoid flying with them in the future. Their behavior is unacceptable and they need to make serious improvements to how they treat their customers.

If a flight is delayed, they will not help you figure out how to reroute your connecting flight. I was returning to DEN and then on to another city. We were told the flight was delayed 1 hour then it was delayed 5 hours. I understand airlines have to do this and was not upset by the delay. But a 5 hour delay means a lot of people are going to miss connecting flights. As people began to line up at the counter to get help, the United staff announced that they are no longer able to access anything that would help us, but that there is an "app" that we all could use to reroute our connecting flights for ourselves. This shows United is trying to skimp and not train its people to be helpful, hoping that an automatized "app" can replace a real human being. It is the definition of an inhuman company. I tried the app, logging in on over 5 times. It asked if I wanted a phone call or message, I tried the options and every time it said that wait times were long, but then would log me out of the app before I could even see my options for re-routing my flight. I selected the option to have an agent call me. Then I received a text that an agent was ready to talk and I needed to return to the app. When I returned, it asked me to sign back in. Sure enough, when I signed back in, I was booted back to the last position in queue. There was no way to submit feedback, no contact number for United. United was basically telling me it did not care that I would miss my connecting flight. I spent a couple hours on this app, actually went to lunch while waiting for a callback, but never got a callback from United. So I went back to the counter and asked the United staff, the app is not working for me, how can I see my options so that I know which later connecting flight I can book? I suppose I made a big mistake, because I also took time to be kind to the United agent and told her that I understood this was stressful for her too and thanked her for her help. She said that she did have a seat on the 3:30 flight and could book me on that flight, but that I would get into Denver about 15 minutes before the connecting flight left and might miss that connection. I accepted that, because I would have to wait for a flight out of Denver either way. So I accepted the boarding pass she gave me and walked to the other terminal to wait for the 3:30 flight. Then as the flight was boarding, I looked down at the boarding pass and saw it was marked SBY, which means standby. Of course a bunch of others had been put on Standby as well, so there was no chance of getting a seat. The United staff at the other terminal was sub-professional and never made any kind of announcement of what we should do if we had a SBY ticket. People kept wandering up to the boarding line and asking if they should board, then the United boarding staff would rush over to the counter and the person at the counter would tell them they could not board. I don't understand why they could not make a single announcement for everyone, "go back, you should not have been sent here." I went back to the original terminal and told them I had not been told I was being put on standby, and had never even asked to be put on another flight, I just wanted to see how to get another connection. I could keep going, but the message from United is don't ever use them for a non direct flight. They will not help, you are literally on your own.

I didn't slelct a seat when I purchased the ticket. When it was time to check in on line none of the available seats were economy and all I could do was select 9a and pay more money to complete the check in. I chatted with customer service and demanded a credit. They said I could full out a form for refund review. Illegal and certainly not fair!

Flight was scheduled for 10:25am. 4 flight delays and finally they cancelled the flight at 3pm. The staff was clueless and could not give us any information. They were just there to quell the rising aggravation. They would not even announce the delays. Some of us got the info on our phones with text message but some of us didn't because the wi-fi at the Lisbon airport is spotty so we just shared the info with each other. When they finally cancelled the flight they instructed us to go to baggage claim to collect our checked bags but did not specify a carousel. I hoofed it over there, got to baggage claim, asked where my bags might show up, was told to go to the Lost and Found area to pull a ticket, wait for my number, claim my bag lost, collect it in carousel 9. Others showed up, confused, then we were told our bags would show up at carousel 11. So now I'm watching 2 carousels for my bag. After a nail-biting 20 minutes my bag shows up at carousel 11. What they could have done is have us wait at the gate for the carousel #, in the meantime pass out meal vouchers, hotel vouchers. Instead they gave us useless cards with the scan code for a website that's akin to robot customer service making you wait on hold to tell you they can't help you. I got a text for a flight the next day at 2pm. It quickly changed to 10:25am, delayed to 10:35. The next day it was delayed again to 11:35am. But finally we got on the plane. I'll give a star to the service on the flight and what was on offer there. But just the one. Never again United. Except for the travel voucher I was sent as a mea culpa for a measly $150.

review_header: "had to switch to a different airline"
review_text: I was set to fly out at 6:30 am and land in Newark for a connection around 11. I got the dreaded email that the flight was cancelled and it was rescheduled. They decided to rebook me for a flight at 6:30 pm, with an ELEVEN HOUR OVERNIGHT LAYOVER. With such short notice, there was no way of getting a hotel. I had to wait on hold between two airlines for over 3 hours to get this fixed. What was supposed to be a flight with one connection to Orlando has now turned into a 2 layover flight with a different airline. I’m genuinely baffled how it’s reasonable to schedule a 1-day travel to an 11 hour overnight layover with 5 hours notice? Never flying United again.

It was not eatable at all. Who eats boiled lentils and veggies for breakfast. I would not even serve this kind of food to my dog. It was slimy, wet, and so unappetizing. Better off bring my own food rather than eating this nonsense.

They rebooked us but when we got to airport our info on our app was not in their computer. The flight out of Munich was delayed so we missed flight to Cleveland. Had to get a room in Newark. I'm on a plane right now to Cleveland that was supposed to depart at 6:19 and it’s now 7:22 and still waiting. Maintenance issues. Maybe check for maintenance issues before you schedule a flight. Our awesome vacation in Italy is ending miserably due to united airlines. You’re a huge airline that used to be much better. Figure it out!

If United in Houston takes off only an hour late, you will be fortunate We have been sitting on the plane for an hour after being initially delayed for an hour and forty minutes. And the captain just anounced that the paperwork would take another 20 minutes or so. United sucks- it absolutely is a miserable experience. This is the last time.
We were 3 who traveled but one of us was separated on a different row which kind of sucks. United should put people in groups together. I would not fly with you again.
I had window seat snd they put me in the center. Worst service ever.

As an international business traveller it is unusual to not receive premium check in, security and boarding. They let the families, veterans, and members of the United frequent flyer programme board before first class Star alliance gold passengers. The Polaris lounge did not let me in despite my flight originating in Auckland. It’s unusual to fly business class or higher and not be entitled to lounge access. I had to rely on my frequent flyer status for entry into the less exclusive United club lounge which was pointless as I was hoping to access showers (only in Polaris) after a 12 hour business class flight on a Star alliance partner airline. My baggage at ORD was one of the last on the conveyor despite having clear tags identifying it as Star Alliance Priority Baggage. I wasn’t alone, other first class passengers commented to say “so much for priority baggage” While the plane was dirty, the food selection disappointing and the lack of entertainment provided on the flight, and still requiring first class passengers to pay additional for access to wifi (with no entertainment alternative) is bad. The above 3 points made me decide that beyond my return leg I won’t be booking United Airlines again, especially in higher cabin classes as the benefits really aren’t there at all.

review_header: “force you to check carry on at gate”
review_text: The issue with this is that they force you to tag and checkin your carry on at the gate regardless of whether there is space on the plan. They are also very rude about this and don't listen to anything you say. They would not allow me carry it on the plane and leave it incase it was full. I have back to back meeting in SFO and cannot afford the delay of waiting for luggage. So as expected there was a lot available on the plane and I was forced to check in my carry on.

I have to say that the experiences actually on board the flights, were wonderful. Some of the best flights I’ve had in 50 years of international travel; last night from SFO to SYD, especially so. I variously flew in Premium Plus, First and last night, Polaris Business. Great crews; great service, friendly, happy, with senses of humour. Even the food was very tasty! So far, so good. But the trip home from Anchorage to Sydney, was a nightmare. A tight connection in SFO, made it necessary to re-book onto the flight the following night. Counting from the time I arrived at ANC to check in for the flights to SYD, it took 25 hours just to get as far as SFO. In dealing with the phone Reservations staff, I got what I needed. I wasn’t freely offered a hotel in SFO, but when I asked nicely about it, it - along with several meal vouchers - was given. The first sector ANC/SFO was delayed 3 times, before it got cancelled entirely, with the operating crew having run out of legal duty hours. I was re-routed via Denver. The DEN/SFO flight was delayed once, and I was downgraded to Economy, having paid for First. In the Club lounge at Denver, I got myself put on a flight leaving only 30 min after the delayed flight. It still had First seats available, so I got bumped back up again. Happy days! Then my checked bag was only checked through to SFO. The lady at the desk said she’d now check it through to Sydney. Tapped away on her computer; DONE! Wonderful! But during the flight to SFO, I thought maybe I’d better Exit on arrival, and go down to the baggage carousels, just to make sure my bag wasn't there. Just as well I did, because there it was, tagged only to SFO. If I’d been trusting, I’d have arrived in Sydney, to find that my bag was still in San Francisco! So. United was both very good, and very bad. The flight crews are let down by the back-office functions. A great pity.
