They left my young children to sleep on the floor of EWR claiming they didn’t have hotels to put us in after 37 hours of delays and cancelling our flight with us on the plane at 2am. They never gave us food vouchers to eat in any of the 37 hours of delays, they didn’t rebook us, they did nothing just said there was nothing they could do and left myself and my 3 kids alone in NYC with absolutely zero help or guidance. Their supervisors laughed at me and said my kids would sleep find on the floor of the airport when I asked if we get a hotel because they cancelled our flights due to their crew scheduling issues.
I might get someone before then!

They offer a refund for the flight. They will refund none of the associated costs even though I have no chance of recovering those costs, which are substantially more than their flight. This company deserves all of the worst things in the world, including flying United Airlines.

My flight from SNA TO Newark was delayed due to the pilot. They didn’t have pilot! After 30 minutes delays that was not an issue for me it flew. My First class seat was nothing like first. The seat was small and my legs had no support, seats were not even half way reclined which was the most important point for me to book a first class ticket. Food was good and no claim regarding that. The worst part of my journey was the second ticket from Newark to SNA that was cancelled due to the Weather while other flights had no issue regarding that. I tried to call them, they put me on hold and no answer. I tried to book another ticket they all got booked in a minute. I had flight insurance that did not help me in this situation! The first available ticket was for two days later. Me and my sister had no place to stay since she was moving out of NYC and she returned her home keys. We had to book a hotel, move all of our stuff there. I had job interview that I lost that opportunity due to this cancellation. I was so lucky to get a new first class ticket from American Airlines and reach Orange County safely.

Our family has flown with UA the past 2 decades and this had to be one of the most shockingly bad customer services that we have ever received from an airline. Our flight UA441 was scheduled to depart from EWR at 11:07 am and arrive at FLL at 2:16 pm. Then it said on the screen that the flight was delayed 3 hours due to staff issues where it said there was no cabin crew or captain/pilot available for the flight. I understood about the issue carefully and listened to all communications from UA provided to customers. Our vacation to Florida, absolutely ruined due to the bad customer services we have received from United Airlines. We are currently searching for alternatives to make up for the cancelled flight. We will never fly United Airlines again.

My flight got cancelled because of weather. I tried to call them to reschedule my flight. They put me on hold for hours, at the same time I was trying to book a new flight online. There were some options but all others got booked while I was filling the online forms. I kept calling them for hours no answer! My sister had the first class ticket with the United Airlines at the same date and time. Same thing happened to her. We had no place to stay so we had to get taxi and book a hotel for two days. Moreover, we had to pay extra for each time using UBER and food. Finally we were able to book tickets with American Airlines. It means weather is not the reason for this chaotic situation. This was the last time our family book tickets with United Airlines. We will never trust this airline!

review_header: "United has lost a customer for life"
review_text: All of my flights were delayed (one was because they had no crew), apparently there is no in-flight entertainment offered anymore on United flights, no food offered other than a small bag of pretzels and a cup of water, I was forced to pay $10 for Wi-Fi service that didn't work, and now I've been told United apparently have a new policy in which they don't adjust fares for bereavement travel. When I called customer service, I was forced into using the text messaging option to try to resolve my concerns due to the waiting period to speak to a representative being over 90 minutes. The United representative that I texted with was not only not helpful, but their messages were full of poor grammar, no punctuation (they often wrote paragraphs with no commas or periods or anything...it was just a run-on, nonsensical way of communicating), and a complete lack of willingness to resolve my concern(s). United has lost a customer for life.

This two hour delay would have resulted in missing our connection and the international flight from LAX to MEL, but we found a flight out of CLT to LAX with absolutely no help from the AVL United employee (he gave us a phone number to call and sent us on our way, saying there was nothing he could do for us, even though he had just finished helping the couple in front of us with the same itinerary delays). Made it to LAX in time to catch the initial flight to MEL after booking the flight ourselves. Made it to our seats only to wind up sitting on the tarmac for two hours due to a flat tire caused by “running over a washer” (read: negligence) on the runway. By the time the tire was fixed, the crew was over their authorized hours, and the flight was canceled. We were told that we would be rebooked to our initial destination (Melbourne), but we were rebooked to Sydney, which is about 539 miles off our initial destination. In order to solve this, we were directed to another United customer service desk where we stood in line for an hour with 50+ United customers dealing with similar “rebooking” issues. It was 2:00 am by the time we were able to talk to a United customer service employee, and good god I wish we hadn’t. For two hours we stood at that counter and did not get a straight answer to our questions, ie.) He told us he booked tickets for our party of 4 on the same alternative route to Melbourne, but when we checked our itineraries, the flights were still destined for Sydney or, to our surprise, Brisbane. When we asked for the tickets to be printed, we were told there were only 2, even though all 4 of us at the counter repeatedly had to remind him there were 4 of us. On top of this, a customer that had been previously helped cut his way in line twice to commandeer Pax’s attention even though we requested he wait so we could have a chance to get our stuff sorted out as well. It was 4:30 am at this time, we were given a motel voucher by Pax, and told we had rooms booked for the night, but when we called the motel to verify, we were informed we had no bookings and there were no rooms available… Cots were eventually provided for customers that didn’t have any options other than spending the night in the airport, only to be collected about an hour and a half later… The United customer service line has been long and slow moving all day already, which indicates that these issues are still persisting, and United is not prioritizing the one thing it needs to: its customers.

First, you can't place the pet carrier under the seat due to the life saver box attached under the seat. Second, the flight attendants and the terminal crew member were extremely rude. They rather ask you to leave the plane than help you find better option or assist you. I never felt so humiliated. When I purchased the tickets for my dog, they should have warned me and I would have booked with different airline. I always fly with my pet, so this will be my last time flying with United. The Miami crew were not that rude compared to San Francisco crew.

I came here (Newark) on Saturday and was supposed to take the new flight to Miami the same day. The flight got delayed and after a long time cancelled. Then I was sent to a queue for customer service. I stood in line for over nine hours and when I got to the front all they gave me was stand by tickets. Therefore, on Sunday I want all over the airport and the flights I got was it's cancelled or fully booked. I got a ticket for West Palm beach on Monday late at night and I was promised a seat. On Monday when I got to the airport and was supposed to check my luggage in, I saw that the flight had been changed. Instead of having a promised seat they had changed me to a stand by to Miami. there was nothing I could do than to go to that gate and hope for the best. The flight was supposed to go by half eight pm but got delayed to nine pm then eleven pm then one am then three am and in the end the cancelled it and put me on stand by on a flight that was leaving seven am. That flight was fully booked and a long stand by waiting list so I decided to rent a car instead. I have spent three days here at the airport with no good help or any chance of getting out of here. My experience with United was very bad and I hope this makes you not want to take this company. This has been a very exhausting three days and also three days where I was supposed to be on vacation and having a good time, and not sitting waiting for flights just for them to be cancelled or not have a seat for me.

We had to get home so we ended up paying extra. No refunds, no vouchers. Guess what, that next flight was delayed 6 hours because they couldn't find a pilot. Never heard of that. We missed our connecting flight and got sent to Alaska airlines thankfully. So much better than United.  Please whatever you do avoid United at all costs, unless you want a pointless and expensive adventure.

They continually cancel and delay flights, then come around with very poor customer service. I have flown with United 7 times now and all 7 times I have had either a cancellation, delay of 5+ hours, or a lost bag. I am never flying with them again. Horrible airline.

Now I'm stuck in Denver with my wife and 11 month old, can't even get a rental car to drive home. Now I'm at the mercy of this airline who will not refund my ticket, comp my hotel or compensate me for the day of work I'll miss. I'll never fly United again. I'm livid with the situation and how the staff has treated my family and I! This is why I avoid flying at all costs! United is terrible and made a ton of customers very angry due to their negligence. This was not a weather issue it was a staffing issue. If you don't have the staff don't book the flights!

They delayed it 4 times each day before saying oh guess what your not going anywhere!!! So I didn't even get to go on my trip at all because of how utterly bad this airline is! I finally made a vacation and I didn't get to do anything except sit in an airport for hours upon hours upon hours just to be told they canceled my flight! Then first a refund thinking maybe I can book another flight out of a different town and still make it for one single day of "vacation", nope can't even do that because I wont get a refund for 2 weeks.
We had a lot of leg space, staff were very helpful and ground staff in Chicago the best, and landing was smooth.
Talked to the next morning who said we could have taken a connecting flight but they never told us until it was gone. Delayed our flight 3 times so far today.

I woke up a few minutes after the food cart passed me and requested the flight attendant to please have the food, she said ok, 20 minutes later I called the flight attendant again to ask but no one came, 15 minutes later and we already starting the landing process and this is how it ended, they basically ignored me. On top of that on the previous connection flight of 5 hours they didn't serve food, just a small snack.

This trip my flight out of Venice to Newark was canceled, but the second leg from Newark to New Orleans was not. This prevented me from rebooking my flight without waiting 2 hrs for an agent. I was booked two days later, costing over $400.00 euro in hotel costs, no options were offered by the agent. My 6 hr layover was also delayed. As of writing this review, I am still waiting on the second flight to be reassigned to another gate. The complete lack of assistance for the second time, first time luggage was missing for 5 days in 2021, I cannot recommend United foe international flights. I give them a rating of fail.

I did not reserve a wheelchair but when i arrived in Newark and saw 5+ wheelchairs unused by the gate I asked if I could use one. The United people declined my request. Then when I asked a United person wheeling an empty chair she also declined. For this I think United lacks kindness for handicap people.

Wonderful cabin crew, decent pre-ordered meal and okay recliner seats for a five hour trip. It seems some effort is being made to upgrade the experience. Flight left and arrived slightly early the cabin crew actually worked the cabin for the flight, not just for the meal service. You must have your own device with the United app downloaded in order to enjoy any entertainment but they made several announcements prior to leaving so we all knew.

The usual “technical’ delay (broken PA system) delayed us 30 minutes. Aircraft has 2-2-2 seating with flat bed style seats. The food was ok, the service, also ok and the entertainment was quite good. Luggage came quickly and in good shape. Seems like they are trying to improve.

We waited nearly an hour for a wheelchair to be brought to us to move throughout the Newark Airport one we landed. 20 of those minutes we were stuck on the ramp because there was no way to get him off the plane as even the isle chairs were unavailable. We finally got to the gate after an attendant retrieve an isle chair from who knows where. Due to the long wait my cousin needed to use the restroom, but the gate attendant refused as the isle chair is not for travel throughout the airport. I left after 10 minutes of arguing between the gate and flight attendants (who were helping us) to avoid a serious embarrassment. When we returned, no one was there anymore. Another gate attendant at a different gate made 4 separate calls for chairs not only for my disabled cousin, but another elderly lady also waiting an hour for assistance. We spoke to a manager about this absurd wait. She was apologetic and took our information. I am thankful we decided to fly in a day early for my cousin's medical trials, as this would have caused him to be late for his treatments otherwise.

On the morning of our scheduled departure, United told us that the Boston-Newark leg of our journey was delayed because of an earlier delay impacting our plane’s arrival, meaning we would not have sufficient time to make our Newark-Calgary connection. We spent over 2.5 hours on the phone with United trying to find an alternative flight, but were informed that the earliest available alternative was not for another two days on April 18th, 2023, even though we showed great flexibility e.g. we were willing to connect via a different city, split our family up so we flew on different airplanes, and / or accept a longer connection time. Despite this, United said there was absolutely no option for us to fly for another 2 days. They also confirmed that the reason for the earlier delay was boarding of the aircraft taking longer than expected, which was within their control. We looked ourselves into flying with another airline, but the cost of such last-minute tickets was thousands of dollars per passenger and therefore prohibitively expensive. This meant cancelling our United flights and getting a refund was not a feasible solution. United did NOT offer us the option of arranging a flight with a different airline carrier without additional expense, which is contrary to our rights under Canada's Air Passenger Protection Regulations (APPR). We therefore accepted the new United itinerary on April 18th. We were appalled that United was not able to re-schedule us for two full days.  Our destination city of Calgary is not a small town - it has a population of 1.45 million people and a very active international airport. We were stuck in Boston during the very busy Boston Marathon weekend, which forced us to stay at an expensive hotel 2 more nights than we planned as we could not find last minute accommodation elsewhere. We incurred additional meal costs and transportation costs to the airport. Our total additional expenses during our delay period WAS USD 1,110. We filed a detailed complaint with United Customer Care. It took them close to 2 months to reply to us, and when they did they vaguely blamed the weather (first time we heard of this excuse!) and refused to compensate us at all.

I prepaid for 2 suitcases at $30 a piece for a limit of 50 lbs. My wife's luggage was 58 lbs. I was forced to pay $100 for the extra 8 lbs. If I bought a second luggage, it would have been another $40. I fully understand that I have to pay a penalty for extra weight. However, this charge was totally unreasonable. I would expect an extra $25 to $30 for the excess 8 lbs. My wife needs special assistance and carries extra stuff. It looks like I wouldn't be flying "the friendly skies" anytime soon.

The first time my flight was canceled after 7 hours of prevaricating. I am still waiting to see what will become of my second flight, but I am not hopeful as boarding has been delayed 4 times and circumstances are repeating themselves with an almost eerie accuracy.
Terrible service, they leave you stranded. No effort to find an alternative flight. Never again.

The customer service was absolutely awful. We were two minutes late for our flight that was running 15 minutes behind schedule. We were not even directly told by the service representative that we were unable to get on before they just rebooked us for another flight. No one communicated with us that we could have still gotten on our plane if we didn’t check a car seat. Management was super disrespectful and again not communicative. We would not have minded being rescheduled if we had even been asked or told that it was happening before being handed a boarding pass for a flight four hours later. United airlines wants to stick to the policy that wasn’t on my booking, but has to be looked up on the website to find.

If your UA travel includes international partners and your fare includes advanced seat selection, know that you very well may not be able to select seats on those partner airlines without paying additional fees. UA does disclose this under their website's FAQ area (rather buried) but totally does not disclose this when the ticket is purchased. If traveling with others and sitting together is important, such as for long overseas flights, then know that for UA partner airlines you will probably have to pay more for advanced seat selection. A bit of a bait-and-switch, not getting what was advertised. Shame!

review_header: "promised a return of miles and money"
review_text: The cost for 2 was was $400 x 2 and 20000 miles X 2 for a May 31 flight. Paris to Washington DC no seats available. So, United promised a return of miles and money if not available. Never happened.

Then they canceled my return flight back a number of two times. I had to extend my stay, take off more days of work so I can get on the next plane which wasn’t until three days later. Three days before my return flight home they canceled that one and made it the next day. Meanwhile I had already booked accommodation for an extra three days. Therefore I had to cancel the whole return flight in total because the new date that they were flying out was the next day after the original. This airline will play around, making you spend more money than necessary, and I already made a vow not to ever fly with United. It’s cheaper to fly with quality airlines and pay 2k than to pay 1k with United, $200+ in extra hotels, and 2k on another ticket back home that’s not with United. Not to mention, the dinner served on overnight flights are nasty, and it’s impossible to sleep in economy, the only thing that was good was the Diet Coke. Other than that the flight attendants were nice

The flight from Chicago to Frankfurt was very disappointing. We were in a row near the end of the plane. Our first encounter with cabin staff was a flight attendant throwing the earbuds at us instead of passing them down. Staff barely stopped to hear a reply from customers when asking if we wanted water or beverages and no one stopped to take garbage before take-off. The most disappointing was the meal service. They prepared just enough meals for the entire flight but by the time they got to our rows near the back of the flight, they were only providing the vegetarian meal which was bland and featured a strange salad. I don't know when they ran out of other meal options but they served this to at least 50 or more passengers. The in-flight Wi-Fi worked at the beginning and end but was not available during the middle of the flight..

Service is mediocre at best. I took the flight from Chicago to Rome and Barcelona going back to Chicago, with a total mileage of 9,000+. United Airlines' MileagePlus gave me 4,000+ mileage. Not only do they suck at service and making the flight on time, they also choke their MileagePlus customer. Stay AWAY from United Airlines!

After long waiting united offered 2 options: to flight 2 days later with 1 transfer, or flight 1 day later with 2 transfers. They do not care about this delay and the fact we have to change flights. We had economy plus seats, they were unable to book us to this class again, we landed in economy class. Our travel has been delayed by 36 hours and did not get any compensation for the missed time, scheduled working days and the 3 flights instead of the direct flight. The service line did not do anything for us.
So I can't watch a movie & I can't use my phone for movies or games. Terrible

The flight is delayed one hour then it’s delayed two hours then it’s delayed three hours making me miss my connecting flight three times. I called the numbers. All they do is throw the ball at the other people nobody knows anything all they say is literally I don’t know anything every single time OK I pay the ticket $2000 they literally tell me they can’t reschedule me on a flight today even though they said that they could.

That was in December 2022 and it's now June 2023 and I still don't have a refund from United Airlines for the cancelled flights. My rewards agent has been trying to get the credit for a few months now and she's received a few different excuses why it hasn't been done yet. So my review isn't based on my flight, and I'll never fly United Airlines. It's based on how long my issue is mired in whatever miscommunications there are. Scores are the lowest I can provide on this review and in all fairness, I wasn't privy to anything experiences of the flight

Flight was delayed, gate changed three times within 15 min, suitcase was broken. Of course no compensation for our troubles. Just another person shuffled through like cattle at a slaughter house. How undignified and inhumane treatment of people. United needs to treat people better.

These airlines lie, treat you like sheep, bouncing around from one gate to another. Lost my first class upgrade on rebooking, didn't give me my plus points back. United's mileage plus program stinks, you cant get upgraded without using your plus points, paying cash or using your miles. Their food sucks, mostly vegan, their fleet is nearly the oldest. If you’re going to give your loyalty to an airlines do delta. They are more reliable. United treats the passengers terribly as well as their status customers.

2hr delay at security gate. Ran all the way to gate to be told gate was closing. Could not board! Agent was rude and said, not my fault, problem or nothing I can do about it! Paid for seats up front of plane, then when rebooked for some 3 hrs later flight, put in back of plane. No refund offered, not her fault! Sign said gate closes 10 minutes before flight we arrived 12 minutes and it was “ just closing.” Other passengers also told same thing, same tone of rudeness.

I have had the hardest time getting a hold of literally anyone to figure this out since December 2022. I finally get a resolution 3 weeks ago and get told you are only sending a check of $700 to compensate for everything that was lost and the long wait time. The check arrived today in the mail and went to deposit it in my account and I can't even deposit it because of issues with the check. Now after all day of trying to reach someone and I finally get a hold of someone I am told that you will void this check and so now have to wait another 30 days for a different check. We are currently in June and I'm still being dicked around for not even a quarter of the money for how much I have lost in December!
It is 2023, please upgrade your planes. I paid nearly $1k to sit on a plane with no chargers. No chargers, no screens, nothing. It’s criminal.

Their customer service is horrendous. If you need to clarify something before traveling, I'd recommend not actually asking anyone because that interaction will make it worse. I had reached out on my recent flight as a Star Alliance gold member to see if I had access to the United Lounges - this was pre-planning. I was told yes and planned accordingly. Then when I arrived at the first United Lounge, I was told no I didn't have access by the rudest agent I've ever spoken to. Fast forward then to after I went and got food, coffee and so on, I went to another lounge to clarify. This agent then confirmed I do get access. Quite literally, every person I spoke to gave me a different answer. This continues. I had reached out to customer service regarding my seat selection. I was told one thing, then when I went to confirm again, I was again told something else which left me frustrated. All of this leading up to traveling with a family just makes things unnecessarily stressful. I went to the desk to make my frustration known and was told by the most lifeless representative that I can use the QR code to contact customer support. That chat, and the one on the app, couldn't even load. All that said, it just boils down to United Airlines culture of not caring.

My husband had a medical issue related to pneumonia and shortness of breath. The stewardesses sent an announcement for a medical volunteer to assist. A nurse came forward and took vitals to make sure he was okay. She stayed with him until we needed to land. One of the stewardesses gave my husband an oxygen mask and took info from me. She coordinated with the nurse to provide needed aid. Don’t know the nurses name but want to thank her for being courageous in volunteering. Both the nurse and stewardess watched over my husband, stayed with him and secured a Paramedic team to escort him off the plane. The paramedics removed him from the aircraft while all passengers stayed seated until we could whisk him away. Thank you all for your patience and well wishes. He had to be intubated once they got him down to the ambulance. He was really grasping for air. My husband has been admitted to a local hospital and was diagnosed with pneumonia and put on a ventilator. 24 hours later he is stable and off the ventilator. I wanted to express my gratitude and appreciation for everyone on this United Airlines flight who tended to my husbands needs. The staff was very professional, trained to tackle medical needs and keep me calm in the process. Thank you!

After we were already aboard the plane, they proceeded to mess around for over an hour and eventually were not able to fix it, So at that point, we had to get off the plane with our luggage and then we had to wait nearly an HOUR AND A HALF for a replacement plane to be available. It was a ridiculous amount of delay and led to me missing my connecting flight altogether. I am so disgusted with United that I will never use them again if I can help it.

My first flight was cancelled and I was stranded in Norfolk for 24 hours. No hotel was provided. I arrived in London 27 hours late, no compensation was offered. The reason for first flight cancellation was weather-related, but there was no major weather alert ongoing (it was very rainy on the East cost with alert for small aircraft), and flights from Norfolk to New York of all other companies (American Airlines and Delta) were delayed but flying. Arriving 27 hours late with not even hotel/meal voucher is just not acceptable.

Very unfortunate, because Continental was among the best before the United/Continental merger. If you have another option, do yourself a favor and take it. My current gripe is after being stranded by them in Boston (not weather related) they want $109.00 to move to one of 20 empty seats (not first class) 15 minutes before departure. What would it cost them to be accommodating? It cost me $350 for a last minute hotel and Uber due to their poor performance.

I was assigned to United via Air Canada. I wasn't sure of the arrangement in the beginning but very glad I got the chance to fly United. Pros: 1) Friendly flight attendant - someone was sitting in my spot. A friendly flight attendant stepped in immediately and resolved the situations for me. 2) Good in flight service - full can of soda pop was offered to me. That was a treat. 3) Fast flight - we left the gate 5 minutes ahead of schedule and arrive 30 minutes early. 4) Speedy luggage retrieval - I got off the plain and my luggage was already at the carousel waiting for me. This is the fastest that I have ever seen. 5) Excellent value for the service and I will definitely fly United again. Cons: none.

We were in a position where we thought something wouldn’t be able to work out with our luggage, but they did everything they could to help us and in the end everything worked out beautifully all thanks to both of them. It was a kindness that was beyond their call of duty and we greatly appreciate it. Wishing them all the best.

While sitting there, none of the promised services were available and the in flight entertainment consisted of theee movies. Laughable. Problem 1: after getting off the plane we were exiting the terminal and the attendant was beyond rude. She acted like we were completely stupid for being confused and not knowing what to do. She never offered help. Problem 2: after thirty minutes of people sitting in the terminal and on the floor, they finally announced the flight would now be leaving in four hours.There are no concessions for anyone with a disability either. You are on your own. So to sum it up, spent $1000 to fly to Washington. United took that money and gave me the worst service I have ever experienced. Not only will I never consider a flight with this airline again.

review_header: "I need to check in My backpack"
review_text: I had a horrible experience when I checked in for my flight Tuesday morning May 30th at 4am in Portland PDX Airport. When I check in though Tuesday morning to my Flight at 4am the staff told me that I need to check in My backpack and pay $35 fee for it. I paid the fee and then she told me that I need to check in the bag. I didn't do that because that's why I travel light. So she told me that I need to consolidate my purse with backpack. I did that also at 4am my flight taking off at 5am. After I executed all her orders another United employee asked me if I wanted a refund for my $35 charges for backpack. I didn't got my money back. I been through all that at 4am in a strange state even though I didn't have a issue with my belongings when I flew in Friday May 26 but I had 5 days later on May 30th . I thing that what happened to me was ridiculous, I think that the employees should be trained properly, act respectful with customers because what happened to me was not a pleasant experience with United and I will try to not fly with you.

Compared to Qatar Business Class, Swiss Business Class, Even Aer Lingus Business Class, United really fails! The catering was absolutely terrible on United! The manner of the service is like coach class. The flight attendants were fine but look like being on board was the last place they wanted to be. This is in contrast to the genuinely happy, attentive and polite flight attendants on Qatar Airways. United has finally added a mattress pad to cover the seats which is common sense but UA did not offer this for a long time. Thus it was like sleeping on a bed that thousands of people had slept in. The food quality and service on plastic tray was classless! The worst being the food quality. Also, I a 6'1" slim but could not bend my knees up when on my side as the bed width was too narrow. I was really disappointed with United Polaris Business. They fall very short of the international competition. I will not be flying them again anytime soon!

Economy only allows no carryon and one personal item with ridiculously small size requirements. Connecting flight was overbooked and even those allowed “premium” carryons were forced to check bags as the plane was full. First flight was delayed by 5 hours, so we were forced to switch from our one-way to a flight with a layover. Will never fly United again, I suggest you don’t either.

An hour after takeoff the pilot announced we had to go back to Houston because of flight difficulties. We landed onboarded, and we got text messages that the flight would be pushed to 4:20 one hour and half - while having lunch flight is changed back to 3:55 and leaves me stranded in Houston airport. How do you go backwards in time after notifying customers there would be a delay. Customer service was horrible after the fact the girls that work there didn’t seem to care at all, didn’t even offer an apology or an explanation.

I picked it up, went to the hotel, noticed it, went back and then they told me that the only thing they could do is fix it and that would take like 2-3 weeks. A reimbursement would be the only acceptable thing, since the bag came with the next flight as well. Too much trouble for such a short flight.
5 flights, 5 issues. Don't preorder food, they don't check. Crew are rude when you ask about it too. If they didn't have stranglehold in Denver I would never fly them.

Flights were on time, everything was clean and had a great flight. Came back 10 days later and again everything was excellent. The seats are very comfortable and you can get a good sleep . The food could be better but its an airline so it was better then expected

Must now pay extra 59 per person to have poor food. Used to be included when you pay a lot more for the seat. Even the people in the lounge said it was not worth it. Customer service overall very bad. Ever wonder why most travelers are complaining. I will do my best to find alternatives, or at least give them less money if I feel the value or respect for customers are lacking. But they do not care.

review_header: "proves again to be the worst US airline"
review_text: Full international flight Buenos Aires to Newark; after everyone is boarded and sitting, they realize the engine is not working; for 4 hours, everyone is sitting on the plane without AC, the crew gives no guidance. At 1 am, Chicago finally decides that the flight cannot depart; they send all passengers home. As most don't have accommodations, they tell us to get any hotel, which will be reimbursed along with expenses. 24hs later, everyone is back with a day of our lives wasted to the rebooked version of the original flight. This time the door of the crew's bathroom isn't working. We wait again sitting in the plane for 3 hours.  I arrived home 48hs after I left in what should have been an 11hr flight. When contacting the airline, they tell us they actually will not honor the cost of our overnight stay due to the canceled flight but only 200$, a fraction of the cost of an additional day stranded abroad. No one responds, no one cares.

review_header: "making too much money to not care about passengers"
review_text: Got off first. Went to our baggage claim. Stood near the bag drop. 2.5 hour flight. We received one bag and the other is unknown. The system is garbage, and the staff are no help. This is obviously not a problem because you’re making too much money to not care about passengers.

United, 24 kilos is NOT 50 pounds. However our lovely check in lady was so pleasant and recognised this after I explained it to her. We were at just over 51 pounds for our 4 bags. The plane was fine, clean, nice seat, good storage and decent screen for IFE. The seriously bad issue was the food. Our starter was overcooked disgusting noodles served with an odd dressing. Left uneaten. Absolutely dreadful, mushed potatoes, dry tasteless chicken and worst of all rotten, mushed broccoli. I showed this to the nice stewardess. Mostly left uneaten. Dessert was a biscuit for a child. Left uneaten. Wines were mixed. Good and bad. No cheese, no proper dessert no proper salad. United, you need to have a serious word with your caterers.

They charged $35.00 per carry on when they say that in most of their flights they allow carry on free. The check in process is through machines and customer service is bad. All this process happened in Fort Lauderdale station.

However the situation was handled pretty well, albeit it could've been handled better. Check in at Honolulu airport was confusing, as a Star Gold member I was expecting to find a separate premier access line, turns out they herd all passengers into the same area and have a small sign at the end of the area saying "Premier access." Not very helpful considering I had to check in with a machine even though I could've checked in at the counter. The agent at the counter was very helpful and verified my ID before I went through security and to the HNL United club. As far as United clubs go, this one isn't too bad, with great views of the airport, hot and cold food on offer, and the highlight: a Dole whip soft serve machine. When I went to the face for boarding, I arrived just in time for group 1 boarding, and found a pillow and blanket on my premium plus seat for this red-eye flight. I had paid an extra $215 for this seat which I think is good value, especially for a red-eye. It was basically a narrow-body business class seat, a big lazy-boy if you will. The flight taxied out to the runway, made a turn on to the runway then turned off the runway. The first officer announced that they had an issue with the radio and they would try to troubleshoot it there, however we had to return to the gate as the pilots couldn't troubleshoot it. United messaged us a new departure time of 00:30 (originally 22:30). During the delay, the cabin crew walked up and down the aisles offering water to passengers. At 02:00, the pilots had gone over their duty time and they deplaned all passengers. At the baggage claim, hotel and food vouchers for the Hilton Hawaiian Village as well as taxi vouchers were offered, but they did not announce this and only passengers who came to the service desk got these. The new departure time was set at 12:30, and I went to rest at the Hilton. The food voucher however allowed for only $15 per meal, which got me an orange, coffee and a yoghurt for breakfast. Thankfully with my Gold status I could use the ANA lounge when I returned to the airport and got a full lunch there, however other passengers would've had to pay the excess for their meals. The departure time got pushed back again to 17:15, and we finally pushed back at 17:29. To United's credit, the service onboard from the cabin crew was fantastic. They were genuinely happy to serve passengers and were genuinely happy to be there. The selection of complimentary snacks and beverages was slightly limited but considering the price of the ticket I couldn't complain. I didn't book anything for San Francisco for the first day, so I didn't miss anything. However the new arrival time of 01:30 meant I missed the BART to the city centre and ended up having to pay for an Uber. The return flight on the 757 wasn't as great due to the old cabin. Initially at the check in counter I asked if I could get a seat in economy plus, to which the response was "$200." I asked again at the United club and they asked "is an aisle seat okay for you?" and got 10D without any extra charge. I think that the way United handled the delay relatively well in my case, although I believe my Thai Airways Gold status helped me stay fed during the delay. I wouldn't mind choosing United again, but I can't speak for all passengers on this incident.

review_header: "inform me that I was too late"
review_text: I had a flight to Houston booked for this morning. I showed up to the airport with ample time to check a bag, make it through security, and board my plane, as I have about twice a month with United over the past year. After I wasn't able to check in on the kiosk, I was directed to stand in line and check my bag in manually. Unfortunately, I am not a wealthy, first class customer, so the line I was directed to stand in did not move an inch while the first class line continuously flowed. Over an hour later, I reached a representative. Keep in mind my line was not long, less than 10 travelers total, but if anyone occupied the first class line, regardless of when he/she arrived, that was the priority. So after an hour of waiting and getting pretty antsy because it was getting pretty close to my flight time, I finally reached a representative who proceeded to inform me that I was too late and that she could not check a bag without 45 minutes notice before the flight departure time. So I got to the airport with more than enough time to complete all tasks that I do on a regular basis with United, but because I choose to forego extra leg room and comfier seat on this short flight, I was deprioritized and ultimately forced to miss my flight. Southwest had me booked on a flight leaving an hour and a half later, the check-in and bag drop process were seamless, and I thoroughly enjoyed my flight, despite the stress of missing a meeting because of United's poor customer service. I will be closing my United MileagePlus account, and Southwest will get all of my future business and referrals.

review_header: "UA does not care for its corporate customers"
review_text: When I arrived at the gate the staff made me wait, then they told me that because I used miles to upgrade and the plane was full, that they downgraded me from business to economy. I told them I have a confirmed paid seat through corporate travel and their points explanation was incorrect. So I pushed to get a seat. They then told me that they gave my seat to a UA pilot. I challenged them again and said the pilot should sit in economy, again as I have a confirmed corporate travel booking. Finally after 15 minutes they finally gave in and I was presented a seat in 1E, business class. No explanation was given so I asked. They said a "standby revenue customer" had taken my seat. This I felt was unacceptable that they wanted to bump a corporate travel guest to get more money out of a standby customer. The standby customer was moved after boarding, so no doubt they were disgruntled too, and I sat next to the 777 pilot who had been evacuated from Guam before the typhoon. What I don’t understand is that an airline is happy to downgrade its corporate customers to put a pilot in their seat, even though economy is available. I also think it’s greedy to downgrade a corporate customer to take a standby revenue customer, when I had paid through work the full airfare. My understanding is that UA does not care for its corporate customers, ironically likely the ones keeping them in the air! And I booked through a travel agent so I guess UA has total disregard for their travel industry partners. That aside, the staff onboard were nice and did their best with perhaps the worst set of 737s in APAC, old and run down with terrible out dated business class seats. Definitely fly JAL if/when they return or any other airline than UA from Japan to Guam.

review_header: "still sitting at the gate waiting for a wheelchair"
review_text: They acknowledge that. It has now been two hours and I am still sitting at the gate waiting for a wheelchair to be brought to me. I have asked for help from any United employee I see, they are few and far between. I am in my sixties and exhausted and in pain, this is the worst airline I have ever flown in my life. I am shocked at this situation and total disregard for a customer.
I must say out of ALL of my flying experiences, UNITED AIRLINES is emphatically, unequivocally, and categorically THE WORST! I’m beyond appalled by this experience! AND NONE OF THEM CARE! Wow!

After every flight was delayed, after repeatedly deplaning and missing connecting flights because of the constant delays, after every part of the trip turning into one 18-hour disaster after another, they gave my seat away to someone else and made me deplane again and wait another 12 hours to get on another flight. Never had such a multitude of disastrous experiences when I needed results most..

Inconveniencing almost 700 people to catch the 20 that didnt have it signed! They were also asking for people to check their carryon because the flight was full so I pushed a bunch of stuff into my backpack and tried to check it in only to be treated incredibly rudely and then told to get back in the passport line that I was just in for a half an hour. This, lets call her a lady, was rude and obnoxious to countless passengers and ruined my entire day. I was looking forward to this trip for our 30th anniversary! She soured it before we even left DC. I will never fly United again!

Flew Pittsburgh to Washington. Washington to Atlanta was delayed then canceled. Was offered a flight at 3 pm at another airport, that fell through. Then he said 5pm, again at the Reagan airport. I get a text saying I have a flight to New York the following morning though. What? So I call American airlines, they say my reservation United made for me was actually never made. I was given lift vouchers to go to and from that airport. Now I can't get to Atlanta til tomorrow and had to cancel my vacation.  What an absolute disappointment for my first trip in 6 years. Flying back home in 8 hours though. Lucky me to be stuck at Washington airport and to get screwed by united. What a waste.

review_header: "Fly United only as a last resort"
review_text: I was assured by both airlines that I could check my bag all he way to TLH. Everything was delayed and I arrived in ATL after all Delta flights to TLH had departed. After driving from Atlanta to Tallahassee, discovered my bag was still in ATL. I tried numerous times to get United to transfer the bag to Delta who agreed to fly it on to TLH, but they flatly refused. They even hung up on Delta when they spoke to the baggage department in ATL and asked if they could run it over to Delta baggage. As a former major airline pilot, I am familiar with the baggage process and I know it wouldn't have taken more than 10 minutes to handle the situation. Fly United only as a last resort!

Ground staff and cabin crew were very pleasant and approachable. Especially for the crew, nothing was too much trouble, very helpful and friendly. On the LHR flight, captain was even greeting passengers at the door himself, which was a lovely touch. Definitely one of the best cabin crew service experience, nowadays a lot of airlines do not have such a service, which is a shame. The food was very tasty on all sectors as well. Some flights were delayed but the staff did a great job constantly keeping us informed, including text msg alerts. Great selection of movies on the flights. It was a pleasure to fly with United, and we would use them again any day!

review_header: "Mileage Plus account is a rip off"
review_text: Highly disappointed. Joined thinking I could earn miles when purchasing tickets for family, but just flings out that even though I purchased the tickets for people who are elderly and don't travel, I have to lose the miles because I'm not actually the one flying. Tickets were purchased under my account and they can obviously tell. Then try to get me to apply for a credit card that still won't allow me to earn miles when I purchase for sometime else. So many other airlines with cheaper flights that I could've, and will in the future, opted for than this. I only flew with them for business, but I'll happily be taking the companies and my money somewhere else where I can earn when I spend money.

UA1536, LAX-IAH used a 753 on 05/10, leaving at around 1am local time, just a few minutes behind schedule. Boarding was done by zone and very orderly. Even though it was a full flight, thankfully not that many people were carrying multiple bags that will have to be checked in if there is no room in the overhead bins and might cause delay to the departure. The FAs were polite and efficient but they were not as personable and communicative as the ones we just met in our flights throughout Asia. They made one drink round and offered pretzels with the drinks, and then they were back to collect the trash. Very different experience in this 2.5 hours flight with this so-called full-service airline, compared to another 2.5 hours flight in Asia with another, real, full-service airline which served hot food and alcoholic drinks for free. Overall the flight was uneventful, and we land in IAH around 10 minutes early.

Boarding was quite organized, the plane left on time, there were no entertainment but for a short flight this is fine. The flight attendants are quite nice and cheerful, they even made a second round of drinks during the flight.
Not much of an improvement from spirit or frontier. Constant delays, terrible seats, old outdated planes, and not the nicest employees through the gate till the end. Look at other options
Always an attitude with everyone working there even if YOUR flight is cancelled and you are just asking what to do next.

In the middle of boarding Group 3, the gate staff started telling people that the overhead bins were full and that we had to check our bags and pick them up at the gate. I could see the frustration on the faces of many ahead of us as they asked questions and were told that checking their bags was mandatory. And this was, of course, an inconvenience to my husband and me as we had a tight deadline once our flight landed to get our rental car and head to a business meeting. However, we were patient and complied. As we walked down the hallway to drop off our carryons, a fellow passenger came out of the plane and asked the worker for his bag back because he was told by a flight attendant that there was space in the overhead bins for his bag. Puzzled, we continued to drop off our bags and board the plane. Long story short, we boarded the plane to find an abundance of space in the overhead bins, which showed that we were essentially lied to by flight staff. For what reason I have no clue. Maybe to inconvenience passengers in the hope that next time they will upgrade their ticket? It couldn't be because of weight because the bags go to the bottom of the plane when being checked. Whatever the reason, my husband and I were incredibly inconvenienced. Once we landed and walked to baggage claim, we waited 30 minutes for our bags to arrive. Thirty minutes that we did not have and could have been saved if we were not lied to and were allowed to place our carryons in two of the abundance of spaces available on the plane. This kind of treatment and purposeful inconveniencing of passengers is unacceptable.

My 10:40AM flight was delayed "10 or 20 minutes" for a "minor mechanical issue". Two hours later, we were told that they were flying in a new plane rather than fixing hours. Then the second plane was delayed for *another* mechanical issue. It was delayed again and again and has been pushed back to 6:45PM, and even the ticketing agents are saying that they doubt it'll show up anytime today.

I enjoyed the flight attendants however the workers at the airport ruined my vacation experience. No one speaks English, they're extremely unprofessional and the flight was delayed for 9 hours at the last minute. There's absolutely no structure with the check in process and it was pure chaos. I will never use this airline again in a million lifetimes.

No drinks while boarding, not even water. You spend the money for upgraded service and it's not better than coach! Very disappointed in united. Looks like delta for me. At least I get treated like I spent an extra 500 for first class.

review_header: "told that there could be no compensation"
review_text: UA had a mechanical delay with the plane that forced us to arrive 4 hours later than planned. Traveling with children, we arrived at approximately 2 am to our destination (2 hrs from our final house-destination). Due to our late arrival, our rental car company (newark airport) was closed. Told we could not sleep in the airport, we found the cheapest newark hotel we could ($155), arriving about 3am. The next morning, we returned to the car rental to a 2-hour line. By the time we were served, they had only one car left (the lot was empty) with pax behind us; I guess, out of luck. The only rental option was an upgrade (for the week rental) that would eventually cost us about $180 additional to the pre-arranged economy car fare we had booked weeks in advance. I talked them down to $190 or it would have been more. All told, we incurred about $350 in expenses, some of which we requested refunded by UA. Now, five months later, I am still trying to get the compensation (any compensation). Had this been a weather-related or similar issue, I'd accept the loss. But it was mechanical (the Pilot and the support staff at the gate had both announced to the cabin the reasons for the delay). Eventually, they promised $200 citing that as their maximum. Then I was told that there could be no compensation for us since we incurred the expenses at our point of arrival (destination) .. which is bizarre since that would often be (almost always) the site of incurring expenses for a delayed flight,  especially because our destination was not our home. I do not fault the airline and I am happy that they fixed the plane before flying but one should not have to work so hard over five months to get partial compensation.

I booked a flight for 2.30pm out of New Orleans to Louisville with a layover in Houston. My original flight was delayed for a total of an hour. Told twice it was only 20 more min. Due to a "technical" issue. Then when we finally took off, we landed as the connecting flight was leaving. We landed at 4.30 and was told the next available was 8.10. It is now 9.10 pm as I type this. Delayed 2 more times on the 8.10 flight...due to "Technical" issues then told to deplane and the next flight is 10.30 if they can find a plane. I knew I should have booked Southwest, but trying to save a few bucks and got this. United is terrible....I also have flight credit, I have tried to use 10 times and am told it's not valid for those dates...10 different dates and all are not valid? United will no longer get my business and you should avoid them as well.

review_header: "They do not keep you updated at all"
review_text: I have been stuck at Houston airport for over 28 hours due to flight delays and cancellations. If you are looking to fly choose anything but this airline. They do not keep you updated at all. They keep you waiting till the last minute then will cancel your flight. When we arrived in Houston the first time the plane landed we were pulling into the airport and the wing of our plane hit the back of a transit van. Save your money and do not fly United airlines.
Food was terrible, attendants were rude. Coming back home to USA from Tel-Aviv: 2 hours delay, food is bad and no choice, no one cleaned bathrooms, extra money for regular end seats.

Are you serious! So we fill up and finally make it to Newark 2 hours late but cannot park because another plane is using our terminal. We sit an additional hour in the plane. I obviously missed my connecting flight and was sent to customer service gate 91. I get there and the line is 50 people deep with only one representative. They rebook me to 0700 and put me in a hotel. I basically sleep one hour to be back to make this flight. Now my 0700 flight is cancelled too! I am currently sitting here praying I can make it to Boston. I’m rebooked again to leave at 2:38pm. Customer service is severely poor, they do not care and this is normal to them. They will get nasty with you if you are frustrated and bark back at you. I’ve flown with other airlines and at least they try to make you happy. We received $15 vouchers for food but airport food is expensive. I will never fly on this airline.

I had a leg from Boston to Newark. Boarding was terrible, seat very uncomfortable. I have recently flown Delta and Jet Blue and they're so much better. WiFi works and is free on other airlines. Seats are better and flight attendants much friendlier! If I was young and committing to airline for status United would be last on my list. I am 1K million miler and completely disgusted with this airline!
I could not be most disappointed in United Airlines. I have no idea when my flight will finally take off but my trust in this airline has greatly diminished.

Not only did their website overcharge me for the seats, sending multiple credit card authorizations to my bank, resulting in over $500 being tied up in authorizations for days, they then switched our seats last minute, pulling us from Economy Plus in the front of the plane and shoving us in the back of the plane. The flight itself was delayed over 12 hours, as they had mechanical troubles. Instead of re-routing us, they strung us along for hours with the promise of a fix. It was only 8 hours into the ordeal they admitted they were bringing in another plane to take us home. On top of everything else, I've now spent over an hour on the phone with their support trying to get our money back for the changed seats, inconvenience. I will never fly United again.

Was asked if wanted to rebook or get a refund. Asked for refund. Have spent 5 months trying to get over $1300 returned! I have heard pure lies about this whole frustrating deal. I and my family will never book United or any partners ever again. Disgusting way to do business. I’ve have contacted my credit card company and United says I have to prove the flight was cancelled. They have the info of that day and I can not get it!

Delay #2 mechanical issues another 1/2 an hour or so. Delay #3 claims of bad weather in Houston. Which all these delays put my flight to Houston 3+ hours late for my connection to Denver. Which they put on standby for the next 3 available flights, was able to get the 3rd one. In which put me in in 2 hours late for my final flight to Salinas and Hays. Refused to offer me a hotel voucher. Then booked me for the 2:30 pm flight to Salinas, so I had no choice but to spend over 15 hours at Denver Airport.
The customer service rep at the gate told me I could carry on the bags I had, before I board the plane I was charged $150. I will never fly United Airlines again.

When checking my bag, I was told my carry on can’t go above me it must go on the floor under my seat, which I was okay with. I get to the gate to check in and the guy immediately has an attitude! I literally told him to talk the attitude out of his voice because the way he was talking he was so rude! Immediately “I don’t know how you guys made it this far with these bags, they need to be checked and that’s going to be $65” so I try to explain to him that upstairs let us through and told me where my bag had to go! This guy had no patience. The staff do not communicate when I asked him to speak to the guy who let me in who caught an argument saying that guy wasn’t in charge! My friend had no problem, her bag was a duffel bag as mine was a smaller suitcase, her bag heals shoes and some of everything hanging out of it! He said absolutely nothing about her bag which was funny because they were the same size just different shaped. I will never fly through United again. This airline is a joke.  Communication is the key, customer skills is something you should have working with guest, and not surprising at all they lacked both.

We then waited there for two hours just for that flight to get canceled then they sent us to a hotel which they did pay for but we didn’t get there till 5 in the morning and had to pay for a 60$ Uber back to the airport the next day. I am not from this area so this was very inconvenient also the next day my flight to Minnesota got canceled again due to air traffic. So this then delayed me arriving to Minnesota two days late and resulted me into missing a day of work witch I had to lose money and spend another day wasting money in another state. I am very disappointed in United Airlines.

When I boarded with the first class group all of the overheads were already filled I presume either with people who boarded before I did or airline personnel. I feel that the personnel should make sure at least one spot is open for luggage for the first class customers. What is the point of paying twice the fare? Staff was not helpful in correcting the problem.

review_header: "Almost like what travel used to be like"
review_text: On time. With very attentive flight attendants. The lunch meal was the best economy meal I’ve had on United in years. Almost like what travel used to be like.

review_header: "I would fly United again for sure"
review_text: Our return flight was canceled. There were people readily available to assist in where to go and who to talk to. They were staff just walkng around the gate area waiting to lend help. I was given a card to scan to speak to a live person via chat. That person was on the line very quickly. They were not able to get me a direct flight that same day but directed me to the Customer Service gate area where I could see an agent in person. With about 10 people in line, I only waited abouit 10 minutes. They had 6 agents working to help. The agent I spoke to worked very quickly to find me a next day flight. (The flight cancellation was due to weather and affected other flights as well). My husband has cancer, is very weak, has PAD in his legs and can't fly multiple stop flights. Due to the medical problems as well as the fact we were flying first class due to my husband's health, the agent issued me a hotel voucher as well as food vouchers. The next day, we were told that the seat I was assigned to, had a loose and wobbly armrest and the seat could not be used. There was no other available seat in first class so I would have to fly economy. I let them know that I am my husband's caregiver and that is was necessary for me to be with him. The gate attendant assured me they would resolve the matter. They offered a generous travel voucher via the loudspeaker to any volunteer that would give up their seat to someone needing a seat due to medical reasons. Someone gave up their seat and we were able to sit together in first class for the flight. My husband had wheelchair service to the door of the plane and we were boarded first. When we got him into his seat, the rest of the passengers were allowed to board. The service from Vegas to Houston and back was great. The flight attendants were all friendly and helpful. Drink and food service was fast. The food was good ! The free direct TV in flight as well as the complimentary earbuds were great. The flights were on time and smooth. I would fly United again for sure. The response from all involved was fast and friendly.

They tell you there is enough room for bags and then make you check it as you’re boarding. Phone chargers in the seats don’t work. Moved to another seat and it was also broken. Customer service is pathetic and non existent. United says service is its priority behind safety which tells me I should be afraid on this flight. I will never, ever fly United again. Also, it’s my first, and last, flying United.

45 (RSW) with a face of disgust and a “who are you”? I’ve never had an airline great me this terribly. Secondly, I was told I wasn’t checked in, the lady was incorrect in stating this, I had checked in the morning of (online) and of course went to the podium to check in a bag. I went back to the main United Airlines Podium after denial to my flight and the agent mentioned I was indeed checked in for the flight, she didn’t understand why I was rejected entry. All of this caused a missed flight for a business related trip. Flying with United was a mistake, I will continue to fly with Delta moving forward to receive fair treatment, I don’t expect much but I won’t settle for the service I received with United.

They won’t help with anything, just tell you to go to their website. They put me and my family through hell. They are a disgrace to humanity. If United airlines went out of business tomorrow it would be a blessing. Let’s all hope they can somehow be put of business.

review_header: "I hope to never be forced to fly with United again"
review_text: We waited on the Customer Service line for 2 hours. During this time, I asked multiple agents at gates for help, and was told that I needed to wait in the understaffed customer service line. I was told by agents who were too busy on their personal cell phones that they couldn’t help me establish a connection. When I asked the second agent to ask a supervisor to send additional staff to customer service, she ignored me. I continued to ask what to do next and she just looked through me and resumed using her phone as if I didn’t exist. Most other airlines will offer assistance at the gate or counter. This would not us ever happened with an airline like Alaska. I hope to never be forced to fly with United again.

No waiver. No recourse. Pay or miss your flight. Insult to injury, they asked multiple time for volunteers to check bags free at the gate  Definitely get the top-down-corporate-vibe from employees they could care less about your business. I will never fly United again.
The attendants on both the outgoing and returning flight provided excellent service. I have not flown with United in years but this experience has made me want to book with United going forward.

Ok, it happens. I submitted a claim and United sent me a form to fill out, where I listed every little thing in the bags and painstakingly tracked down the required receipts. It came to just under $1000. After waiting about six weeks, I was informed by their agent that their “policy” does not cover reimbursement for many of the things in my bag, such as prescription glasses and computer hard drives (brand new, with receipts). They declared that they will pay me $314 for my $1000 worth of lost luggage as “full and final settlement”. I wrote back to let them know this was unacceptable, and was ignored. To sum up, I handed them a bag with $1000 worth of stuff, they lost it, and are now nickle-and-diming me for their mistake by hiding behind some asinine policy.

I didn’t even realize that was a scammy thing I had to watch out for when booking. I flew from Louisville to Newark and my connecting “flight” was a bus ride to Allentown. I’m already upset because the lady at the boarding counter was clearly not happy to be there and was reflecting that in everything she did. Now I’m stuck on this highway in traffic getting in 30 mins late because I am on a bus.

review_header: "always seem to have a problem with connection flights"
review_text: One excuse they have to stop for gas another excuse bad weather I am pleading with you people if you have to fly with United Airlines with a connecting flight, please do not do so. You will never make it on time.

The current plane has been here since yesterday and now, at 7 am, they find out that a maintenance of the plane is deemed to be the right thing to do. Never mind that over a 100 people paid to be at work by 9am. But boarding wouldn’t happen before 10:30am. In any other business this would be unacceptably unprofessional. It would also be more than enough reason to compensate the involved parties, but United keeps piling it on. “Safety is their priority and excuse to do whatever they do” Certainly, that was my last lesson to avoid them (United Airlines) at any rate in the future.

This airline needs to go out of business. I flew out of lax to Denver, once we got to Denver airport we circled it a few times and decided to go to grand junction for fuel instead of landing because of “weather”. The weather was nice and then the flight got canceled so we had to stay at grand junction, they got us a hotel and food vouchers witch was the only positive thing about this horrible trip, we had to get up and be on a shuttle by 6am, we go to the airport to fly, plane gets delayed. We get on the flight, plane is delayed from taking off, we finally start flying after a while and everything goes as normal, we get to Denver and me and my family wait for 9 hours, we get to our next flights gate, after those 9 hours sacrificed the flight gets canceled once again, no surprise this time. Now we are at customer support and writing this review.

Never again will I fly on this airline. I will make multiple stops elsewhere on another airline, even if United flies direct to our destination. We left Tahiti on United Airlines bound for San Francisco and then on to Baltimore Washington International. Departure from Tahiti was just shy of 90 minutes late while they waited for “late passengers.” Really? This our arrival to San Francisco as significantly late and when we arrived, there was no attendant for the Jetbridge, so we sat at the gate for somewhere between 10-15 minutes. Next was Customs which was awesome and then onto our connecting flight to Baltimore. Except we missed the 45 minute check-in requirement by 12 minutes! Therefore, we “missed” our flight to Baltimore. So then, we worked with a ticketing agent (very nice and helpful) who booked us on the next available flight, 15 hours later! We were originally booked in First Class which was not available on the re-booked flight. No problem, we just needed a ride home. So we were booked into Economy Coach at the same price we paid for First Class (same day bookings are much more expensive!). We were told at booking that we were in Emergency Exit row seats and would have to keep any onboard items stowed above (i.e. NOT under the seat in front of us). After placing a near empty backpack into the overhead bin, I was told it needed to stay under my seat until after take off. A conversation ensued about the discrepancy and I was told it was “that way for this flight.” When I challenged the Flight Attendant, I was informed that I was “a disruptive passenger and she outdated have to talk with the Captain.” Just for challenging safety regulations bout which I was informed prior to boarding? Next, the Ground Agent came to our seat to tell me that he was considering “having me removed from the flight because the Flight Crew feared for their safety.”  Just because I challenged the safety regulations which the ticketing agent stated? Ultimately, I was informed that I was “allowed to remain on the flight”, albeit with great embarrassment. The Flight Attendant responsible for this debacle was absolutely the rudest I have encountered on any flight to multiple destinations around the world. Our “consideration” for all of this was a $150 voucher each, which I ask the airline to donate to the charity of their choice. Finally, a side note. We had flown United to Hawaii a year earlier and encountered the very same “snarkiness” of the Flight Crew. Never, ever, will we fly on United Airlines again. At best, their culture is is really bad, and at worst, they just don’t care.

On time even early and no hick ups and early arrival. The boarding in Key West was OK even with the construction going on. Boarding, Flight and Crew just great, if only construction in Houston would have been better planned .. but that is not United

I strongly believe that restricting a boarding pass for those passengers without carry-on bags is not only unnecessary, but also punitive to those who choose to check-in at the kiosk instead of online. As someone who often travels on basic economy class, I already experience the lowest possible service that you offer. However, the added layers of unnecessary steps only make the experience even worse. It is disappointing to see that you are needlessly adding extra steps that make me think twice about choosing UAL whenever possible. The needless step of checking with your staff for examination because of your lack of trust shows that you do not care about your economy class customers. It is unfair to assume that just because a passenger chooses not to bring a carry-on bag, they must be scrutinized more. This sends a message that you do not trust your passengers, which is not the best way to build a strong relationship with them. I suggest that you figure out a better, less punitive way to treat your good basic economy class passengers. This will not only improve the overall customer experience, but it will also demonstrate that you value all of your passengers equally. Thank you for taking the time to read my concerns. I hope that you will take them into consideration and make the necessary changes to improve the customer experience for all passengers.

Did not think it was their problem to solve and there was broken linkage between Expedia and United. Aside from Air crew cabin tried to help but everyone else at the airport terminal was extremely rude and not helpful in any way. Refused to acknowledge that there is an operational gap. A brief Google shows that unless seat selection is done on United site, it will not get honored and you will not be notified. Staff refused to acknowledge that Expedia is a booking partner. It's known that United falls behind with service rating, but paid for seat selections that are not honored is pretty bad. Choose another airline with better rating if possible.

She was very rude and unprofessional. She didn’t go above and beyond to explain policies and procedures to customers.  I addressed her about the behavior and she didn’t care to listen to me and told me to do whatever I wanna do. Such people make me lose the love I have for United Airlines

Our flight was double booked and we called to cancel one. We got the confirmation for the flight we canceled but apparently the one we wanted was cancelled as well. We didn’t realize until we were looking for the return flight check in. We checked all emails we got the email confirmation for the cancellation for the one we wanted to to cancel for the double booking but no email about cancelling the second flight that we wanted. We also were able to fly on the incoming flight to our trip but not able to fly back and they try to say it wasn’t their fault but we never cancelled and they wouldn’t honor anything and wasn’t accommodating with anything. If I were able to give them 0 I would. Their solution was to pay 3k for new tickets. Originally was giving us a price 300 per person after going back and forth changed to thousands of dollars.

This is the second time I've encountered severely poor service from United airlines not only did I not make it to my destination today they tried to accommodate me to stay in a state that was not part of my itinerary nor my destination. I will never use this airline again and hopefully if anyone's reading this review you won't either.

Somehow between five years, the only times I utilized United to fly from Missouri to Palm Springs, my flights were delayed both times and the connecting flights were missed. The reason for this was “technical issues with the phones” and maintenance didn’t show up for 2 hours when we were originally told it would be 20 minutes. Absolutely horrible airline, never use this airline if you want to make your connecting flight.

We approached the desk and a “nice” lady greeted us with almost a slap in the face rather than a Hello. Things get worse, my son was thirsty and I ask for cup of water they sad we are about to take off no water. Ok I understand. No seatbelt sign went off and I waited 5 min for them to go in the back when I buzzed the bell they saw and ignore for 10min. After I start buzzing 15 time lady came with half glass and handed over like we were animals. She promptly ignored us all the trip skipped giving us drinks by turning her head around. Food was yelled at us instead of explaining. Unfortunately United was the only available option for this trip but for sure this will be my last time flying with this poor company. Oh by the way don’t try contacting their customer service ! It does not exist! Or at least after 1,5h that I was on the wait I decided to just give up! What a disgrace for an airline.

Usually on Delta but sometimes other airlines. Sometimes even in budget airlines. My HNL-ORD-BWI round trip was approximately a $1500 flight. On the long leg of this flight (over 9 hours) the outbound plane was likely over 20 years old. The seats were old and run down. The entertainment screen was not even nice enough to call mediocre. The return flight was worse. No screen. This plane was so old that it had no screen. On a long haul flight this has now become a necessity. On each of these flight we were served one meal. If you can call it that. My outbound meal was bread and butter, yogurt, and a fruit cup. Furthermore, on a flight that long drinks should be included. They were charging $10 per airline bottle for liquor and you could only purchase one at a time per airline policy. I paid for wifi to keep in contact. This service never worked. I recently had a 6 hour flight on Emirates that was under $700 round trip. We were served 2 amazing meals and a snack as well as free liquor and constant service from amazing flight attendants. I know Emirates is an amazing airline but the contrast is necessary to show how awful this experience was. I will never fly United again. They weren’t even the cheapest for this route. They were the most convenient as far as available times. Next time I will save the money and fly a better airline at the same time.
If you can't show up on time you shouldn't be allowed to cut the people that did.

Almost everything (main noodles, side grain salad, bread, cookie) was starch with only a few sad limp vegetables and literally 5 tiny pieces of lettuce. Bread was old and dry. Sauce was salty/sweet with no other flavor. It was inedible. Later turkey and cheese sandwich with squashed flat bread and no condiments. I would switch airlines to avoid that again.

On the day of my return flight which is today it really just got worse April 9th Easter. We arrive at the airport and stood there for 20 min waiting for someone to print out boarding passes and check our luggage in. The lady was just standing in front of us pretending to do something on her computer before finally another employee said something. Got on the flight first flight was fine then we arrived in Denver. We had about 45 min until our next flight to Chicago and when it was time to board we get on the plane and we sit and sit and finally the pilot comes on the intercom and says they were having a fuel issue. The people who were supposed to come fill up the plane were taking longer than expected it was 40 min at this point. But he assured we would make the time up and be ok after 45 min he says we are getting ready to take off and will be 20 min behind. My next flight was at 1:55 we wouldn’t be arriving at the gate until 1:40. So I’m already freaking out because our connecting gate was far! We had to go from C26 to C1.
