So I got my bf to contact the terminal and let them know to wait on us we wouldn’t be to late. They agreed. And said we will wait. We finally hear the pilot say flight attendants prepare for landing. Next thing you know we start going back up in the air again! We’re all like what is going on? The pilot comes on the intercom and says unfortunately we can’t land yet because there’s another plane on the runway so we have to make a couple circles. I knew at this point we were doomed. They took there time making there way to the gate when we landed and had us sit on the plan for another 15-20 min before then let us off. We ran so far and fast I almost passed out and I had my 11 year old kid with me. We get there and they are gone! No one’s there to help rebook my flight I go to the one beside c1 and they keep pointing me to a barcode that wouldn’t work. I go up to another desk and they say go to c7 I go to c7 they point me to b19 finally get to the desk they didn’t have any available flights until tomorrow so we had to get a hotel and stay in Chicago. Don’t have Any of our luggage and have no clue where it is. This airline is awful and do not care about their passengers.

The airline had us sitting on the taxi runway for over 30 min while they tried to clear one of their other planes from the terminal. Numerous ppl were going to miss their connecting flights and they knew that. Rather than either hold those planes for a short while so customers could make their flights or immediately rebook them at the landing terminal, they just told ppl to hurry. So I and others ran like crazy just to find out we missed our flights anyways. We get, a much later flight and 15 dollar lunch voucher. No apologies. No explanation. No acknowledgment of the need to improve. No real compensation for the trouble. Very poor airline. Won’t fly them for awhile.

review_header: "no screen on this flight of 5 hours"
review_text: My recent boarding was from Las Vegas to EWR. Disappointed to see no screen on this flight of 5 hours. The same was from LA to Hawaii before. No food, no service, no entertainment. United is not a low cost airline. I'd like to use others like Delta, Jetblue as possible, but no choice.

Also slow and not good at communicating for instance they didn't tell me till I boarded that for some odd reason they would have my seat blocked off so I have to sit away from my 3 year old! And let's not forget the people in front of me, 2 different people where given the same seat!

No information was provided, staff incompetent and lied about passenger rights in case of delay. Only flew with UA because Star Alliance partner Lufthansa transferred us. If I could give less than on star I would...

Exit row empty yet wanted me to pay $78 to move despite allowing a minimum 400 pound person to buy a single middle seat. All they could say is that they are not allowed to make people comfortable unless we charge them, we have no authority. Pretty sad that employees can not access a situation and use an easy solution to make people happy. I fly over 100 flights a year. None will be with United again.

review_header: "absolute and complete failure as a business"
review_text: From the point of entering these the United States, my experience with United Airlines was terrible. For some reason, customer service is not a value of this company, and I can actually say that it seems like this company values discourteous behavior. Once I arrived at the Dulles airport, I went to several United counters and each worker was rude and condescending. There were many workers at each station, but they were not helpful and I ended up going back and forth from various counters without getting any resolution to my problem. After about an hour, I was able to get a boarding pass. When it was time to board the plane, the lack of good customer service continued. The flight took off late. I was told this cannot be done and that cannot be done. I missed a connecting flight in Chicago. Finally, when I arrived in Milwaukee, my luggage was lost. The lady at the counter said that since it was 12:00 midnight her shift had ended and she walked away. I called the 1-800 number to report that my luggage was missing. Finally, on Monday, I received a call that my luggage was found. The guy on the phone wanted me to come to the airport to pick up my luggage. I have to say that this man was rude, too. Finally, United Airlines is an absolute and complete failure as a business, and the workers are useless.

Flight took off late, missed connection flight in Chicago, then UA after 2 hrs of a ca'nt do that and can't do this, they didn't get me to my destination. Then the refund process was even worse than the trip and then the just denied the refund. Apparently it wasn't their fault that they didn't get me to my destination. One of the worst experiences ever.

LA to Newark - checking in was very difficult and not helped by the extremely rude staff at the check in kiosks. This was however countered by the very bag drop staff member who was helpful and friendly. This was also the case in Newark when we reboarded for Barcelona. Check in was far more pleasant but boarding was delayed for over an hour while cleaners finished up. Also, at boarding some of the rudest service I have encountered. Told we couldn’t take carry on and then told ‘an announcement was made’ like it was our fault that we had carry on!  On both flights the staff were efficient but not overly friendly, except when you left the plane! The food is mediocre at best but then most airline’s economy fare is much the same - except for the middle eastern and Asian international carriers - they are often exceptional. Maybe United could do some exchange programs so their staff can see how it should be done! On the plus side, the aircraft are new and modern they are a bit cramped, which surprised me as the US is famously full of porky folks! The real plus is the entertainment - if you are a movie fan there is a fairly large choice of new and recent releases and classics in every genre! I was not bored. I would have a far better review if it wasn’t for such poor interactions we had a couple of staff. It’s amazing how a fairly decent experience can be so totally spoiled by a couple of rotten apples in the team. I remember a fairly important lesson I learned in my younger hospitality days based on research. It was shown that those that have a nice or great experience will share that experience with a few people, when a bad experience is had it will be shared with many many more. This was my bad experience and it is now being shared with many.

This business class cabin was particularly poorly served. Slovenly boarding was followed by nobody to great and guide to the seat. The cabin was full of burnt smoke. Passengers were still boarding when a flight attendant obstructed the isles with taking meal orders. I was immediately informed that my first choice meal may not be available in the 5th row. Certainly, no welcome drink or a hot towel were served before this 13-hour flight. Flight attendants appeared disorderly, indifferent and disorganized. Polaris business class passengers were the 4th group to board, following disabled, children (teenagers), uniformed military and other 1K passengers. What kind of premium services are we paying for? Stay away from this airline and do not even think of paying a penny for their anything “premium”.

review_header: "Used to be a loyal United customer"
review_text: Missed connection by 12 hours after scheduled arrival time. United still has not gotten bag back to me 2 days later. I used all online forms, texts and attempted to call: “bag is out for delivery” is the response to a Track. Used to be a loyal United customer. Will never fly United again. Evidently, they have systemic issues & problems with lack of maintenance, lack of United maintenance and horrible customer service. Let’s try a human please?

Not only were they rude, they only cared to talk amongst themselves and not care for their passengers. I had a toddler napping and all they did was chit chat and laugh loudly, and wake up my toddler on a trans pacific flight. Great job guys! Food choices and quality was terrible. I understand we booked economy, but the food was beyond bad. Choices were Chicken or Pasta. Then they ran out of chicken when they got to my row, so we had pasta. The pasta was bland and soggy. The "snacks" they had were turkey and cheese sandwiches which were dry and cold. Worst is they do not compensate anything for their fault. My flight was cancelled due to some mechanical error so they rebooked me for an outbound flight 2 days later. I had to stay an extra 2 days, and pay all my meals without any compensation when it's not my fault. Never will I fly with them again and I will advise anyone I know to not fly with them.

There I tried telling them I wasn’t paying for baggage and they kept insisting that my bag had to be paid, I know it’s a small bag permitted and fit in your box “allowed carry on without charge “ but they kept wanting to charge me. Finally got the clear and was able to board plane but not a good experience having your employees treat you disrespectfully and taking advantage of customers by lying and trying to get away with overcharging.

Due to an hour of avoidable delays on the tarmac after landing, and then sprinting through the terminal to arrive 2 minutes prior to scheduled take-off we were told rudely that the plane had already left and “there was nothing to do about it now” with an eye roll from the attendant. We were then told we could have a next-day flight to Norfolk leaving at 10:30, 3 hours AFTER my son’s graduation from A-school would happen. They didn’t care. They didn’t apologize. We were told by multiple passenger bystanders that Newark is always this bad with connections. United held us on the plane while other “more pressing connections” were prioritized over us. United didn’t offer a refund, a voucher, or anything else at ALL! We DROVE to Norfolk overnight in a rental. I ended up paying full price for driving 6.5 hours! United is horrible. Never EVER again!

I intentionally paid a premium price for an adequate layover time to transfer my handicapped elderly parent through the Denver airport. United months before the flight changed the timing to only allow only 40 minutes for a layover which is not enough time for my immobile parent. Mind you this was a booking for 9 people over $10,000. (Two seats were first class, one was for my mother) I spend 2 hours on the phone with them and there is nothing they can do for me and my group. So frustrated!

Customer service is a joke. I missed a flight on the way out, now I can't pre-check because they need to verify documents. No where to send these documents, I asked that yesterday. Seriously dissatisfied. The only thing I want to do is reserve a seat next to my son. Nope we don't have that option. Thumbs down.

This trip was to celebrate my birthday, on the 4th, and our 30th wedding anniversary, on the 6th. We were scheduled on a flight that left at 6:45AM and arrived pretty close to the time we needed to check our bags. Since there is a hard cut-off 45 minutes before the flight, we tried to go straight to the counter but a United employee insisted that we go to the kiosk first. She had trouble at the first kiosk and after a few minutes, went to a second kiosk, where she didn't seem to know what she was doing. We finally just ignored her and walked up to the counter. The gate agent helped us but because of the 5-10 delay minute caused by the first employee, we were TWO minutes past the hard cut-off to get our bags on the plane. That meant that we couldn't get on our original flight. She was able to book us on different flights but we ended up getting to Puerto Vallarta hours later than originally planned. We were scheduled to go to a highly recommended dinner/show cruise that evening but because of our late arrival we missed the show ($140.00 per person). Despite that initial mishap, the rest of our trip was great and we were looking forward to returning to Salt Lake on Saturday evening, the 4th, and then on Sunday, enjoying a 30th anniversary brunch planned by our four children and about twenty of our friends, neighbors & extended family. Unfortunately, our Saturday afternoon flight from Puerto Vallarta was delayed (no reason given) for several hours, causing us to miss our connecting flight in Denver. We arrived so late that there were no more flights on Saturday night but got booked us on a flight the next morning. The earliest we could leave was sometime around noon and we didn't arrive in Salt Lake until about 2:00, meaning we missed the 30th anniversary brunch our family had scheduled for us. We always try to be positive and make the best of bad situations. The incompetence of United Airlines caused us some major stress and grief, but we are focusing on the positive aspects of our trip and had a delayed celebration of our anniversary last weekend at our home with our kids and a few others. I prefer to put this whole incident behind us and chalk it up to experience, but for us and most of our family and friends, United is now on the same do not fly list with the other bottom feeders like Frontier. I reached out to United and got one of those 'thank you for your input, we won't do anything' form letters. What a joke this airline has become. No wonder they're rated at the bottom for almost everything.

They charge a lot but the service is unacceptable. This time London Heathrow to Denver. Expected delay 2,5 hours. New departure time 1:30pm instead 11:00AM. In addition a stop is planned in Boston for a crew change. Unbelievable, total amateurs. The absolute best joke is the self service machine you have to use to check in as Business guest.

But the company provided us the hotel, food voucher and the next day's flight. The next day, we checked in. And guess what? Still the over-weight issue. The plane is sitting at the gate now. Who exactly knows why the company cannot fix the same problem?

One day before the trip we tried to check in on line and learned that the flights were cancelled due to overbooking without any notification to us. We already paid for no-refundable fee for a week for a hotel in DC, which we lost, not to mention the fact that our family trip was completely ruined. The worst part was when I contacted the United Air customer service they simply refused to make any compensation for their wrongdoings. This is the true danger of M&A among airlines and the few surviving airlines no longer respect their customers. Nonetheless we would NEVER use this terrible airline.

First I booked me and my sons flight through Expedia and then on our return flight home they first said that I had to pay $511 for baggage and airfare (but I purchased round trip Tickets with Expedia) then after our flight was delayed an hour we got on a plane finally only to be stuck for another hour plus with a broken part!!! Never again will I use Expedia or United airline ever!

Employed are some of the rudest people I’ve ever met. Flights are always delayed. Our flight was delayed 4 hours, we missed our connecting flight then they booked us on a full flight. Will never fly United again.

review_header: "has become as cheap and low scale as Spirit Airlines"
review_text: Prepare to be inconvenienced and lots of angry passengers. They will charge for bags, charge if you have to check at the gate even if their overheads are full, charge for seats and explain nothing. They are now at the bottom of the list of airlines I would fly. United used to be equal to a Delta, American or Alaska, they are now several levels lowers.

1 hour flight from Manchester to Newark took 2.5 hours with 40 minutes sitting on tarmac with rude flight attendants barking that no one could get up to use the restroom or we would not proceed to the gate. Missed connection, waited an hour to reschedule flight, waited 4 hrs for flight then boarding was delayed again for an hour to wait for a team of clowns with a trash bag and a dirt devil to clean the plane for all of 5 minutes. What a joke, will never use this airline again. All in all a two hour trip took 9 hours.

The United site for check in is slow and disconnects, so re-entering flight information must be done several times. You struggle to get the seat map to display. This also takes several tries. I finally get a seat and try to get a seat for the Swiss flight to Zurich. That option is not available. Check in at the airport goes smoothly until the machine prints the boarding passes and I am assigned a Swiss seat but I did not get to pick it. I have no idea if I am window aisle or in the middle. Going to the United gate person is no help. He can only change the United flight seat and can do nothing with the Swiss seat. And these two airlines are supposed to partners? Partners in idiocy only.

There was no snow though when we got here, poor directions on where our bus would be, sowe spent 40 minutes trying to find it due to the fact the gave no directions and when we asked they kept pointing in different directions.
Extremely unreliable: cancellations and delays, I don't remember a single United airlines flight when I would not have a problem.

The interior on the 757-200 was new and very comfortable. The cabin crew was great, the only downside would be the noise on the inside of the aircraft above the wing, but being that my 757 was 28 years old, it was perfectly bearable for a short flight.
She was genuinely concerned for our wellbeing and ensured we had plenty of water to drink: Very professional and an asset to the company, thank you for making our long journey a little easier!

I'm an A.A. customer but was not getting the usual flights I desired, hence the reason for using UA. Huge mistake, I will never use United Airlines again. What was even worse they announced that complimentary check in would be given because of overhead space issue but because I hold a basic economy ticket I was made to pay - worst airline ever! Not to mention no beverage offered from Atlanta to Houston

I wish she was available when I arrived to SAT, maybe things would’ve turned out differently. She is exactly what all United ticket counter employees sure try and emulate. Attentive and in front of their computers instead of talking to employees away from the counter and avoiding eye contact with customers checking in. I would like to start this post by stating “I missed my flight”, no one else’s fault but mine. When I arrived 30 minutes prior to my flight the first ticket counter staff there was not helpful or empathetic to the start of my debacle. Stating I will not be able to fly out until tomorrow morning with many flights available which was not a possibility and needed to be at a work function in D.C area. After 2hrs and 30 minutes on the phone with my travel coordinator, I was able to get an earlier arrival flight with American Airlines and my United ticket was fully refundable. Thank you all for your help getting me to my destination.

I booked a direct Ft Myers to San Francisco flight on one of the newer routes is developing. I paid extra for this flight. However, due to mechanical issues after a five hour delay the flight was cancelled. Ultimately I arrived in San Francisco after a 12 hour inconvenience. Then on the flight home I opted to stay a day later to make up the lost day. As a result I had to be routed SFO-DEN-RSW. The SFO-DEN flight was delayed at the gate twenty minutes, but the flight crew was able to make up the time and we arrived the airport on time. Unfortunately, both of the 777 capable gates were occupied and so we got to wait on the taxiway for long enough time for me to miss my connection home. The next flight is tomorrow on standby at 935 or confirmed at 5:45pm. On the bright side I got a free room and night in Denver. I also was given a $150 travel credit. I wonder if it would just be cheaper to have flight operations and mechanics better paid and better managed? Also, the seats are miserable in coach. No elbow room and the seat pitch is murderous. Flight attendant staff were pleasant and professional on the triple seven. United can do better than this.

When I got to BWI for UA730 leaving 6:10am for SFO on March 5th, the usually deserted United desk was a teeming mass of panicked passengers. When I looked for the self-serve boarding pass kiosks (I only had carry-on), I was dismayed to find that they were all gone. After the experience of a colleague with making a confirmation and then missing the flight due to car trouble, I make a point of only confirming at the terminal. Nonetheless, I tried the link on the text from United and it directed me to download the United app. I then had to wrack my brain to remember my United password, but was able to provide it. Once it downloaded and I confirmed, after some effort I was able to find the tiny "boarding pass" link. My phone was only 10% charged and I then had a race against time to reach the gate before I lost my digital boarding pass. I did make the flight, but barely. Too bad United didn't tell us in advance that they were making these changes. On my return flight the crew just stood there smiling while all the overhead bins filled up and the passengers, including me, were standing around helpless. They finally informed us that we would be allowed to put our rolling luggage in the first class bins. At my DIA connection the crew were again all smiles. Only after I was in the terminal did I realize that my hour layover was suddenly much shorter. The crew had failed to mention that the plane was thirty minutes late and maybe people with connecting flights should run? I further didn't realize at first because it seems that United has eliminated the arrival boards at DIA . I staggered to the gate as quickly as I could, only to arrive one minute too late (by the clock) and the gate attendant stonily informed me I could not board. My dismay was dispelled when a uniformed stewardess stopped next to me and she told him that she also needed to be on the plane (I think she said she had been on the same flight from SFO) and that she was "dead-headed", which apparently meant that although she wasn't scheduled to be crew on the missed flight, she would end up missing another flight where she was needed. The gate attendant told both of us he would see what he could do and called up his superior. He then told the stewardess that she could board but that I was still out of luck. I then asked for help rebooking. He informed us there was another flight to Baltimore but that it was too late to make the gate, so we would best go to the customer service desk in the other terminal. About maybe one hundred yards along (seven gates) I was shocked to see "Baltimore" on the gate! I rushed to it, but the gate was literally closed in my face and was again told I was too late. Apparently this was the flight the other gate attendant was referring to was this one! We could easily have made it if we had known! The flight was marked as being 10-15 minutes late so perhaps he was not aware of this? Nonetheless, it would have been easy to just call ahead and check or to tell us to run and hope. I ended up having to take a flight back to California to LAX and from there a red-eye to finally arrive at BWI. At least this part of the journey went without a hitch. I will never fly United again.

After I took my seat, my smart watch verified me that my cell phone was not on the plane with me. The crew and attendants were already boarded and the cabin was shut. I was 6 months pregnant at the time of traveling with a husband and 2 children under the ages of 5 who were back at home that I wished to keep in contact with during my travels. I spoke with a flight attendant regarding my missing merchandise and she went above and beyond to ensure I had my cell phone before the plane departed. I am forever grateful for the generosity and stewardship shown by this flight attendant to ensure I was able to keep in contact with my family during my travels.
Other airlines were flying into Rochester, not sure why United couldn't fly. We ended up flying into Buffalo, however, we needed transportation to Rochester.

We arrived in Aspen airport at about 12 noon. Our flight United Express UA4720 was scheduled to depart at 1:52pm. Our boarding passes stated we would commence boarding at 1:27pm. The following Texts received from United: Flight UA4720 is delayed because an earlier impacted your plane’s arrival. It now departs at 2:06pm. Flight UA4720 is further delayed because we are waiting for a gate to become available. It now departs at 3:00. -Flight UA4720 from Aspen is further delayed because we are waiting for gate to become available. It now departs at 3:35. You can rebook your flight to a different day. Flight UA472O from Aspen to Denver is delayed further because it is taking longer than expected to load baggage. It now departs at 4:05. You can rebook your flight to a different day. Flight 4720 did not pull away from the gate until 4:30pm. Due to incoming flights, and being in queue behind a caravan of about a half dozen private jets, we were not cleared for takeoff until shortly after 5:00pm. Due to incoming flights, and being in queue behind a caravan of about a half dozen private jets, we were not cleared for takeoff until shortly after 5:00pm. We missed our outgoing flight and the last flight for the night to Washington DC by approximately 20 minutes. After waiting in line at customer service for almost an hour, the final indignity from United Airlines was the complete lack in compassion from customer service. It was now after 7:00pm. Not allowing my frustration to get in the way, “can you offer us hotel compensation as our departure from Aspen was not a weather related delay”, I calmly asked the agent. “No, I’m very sorry, we can’t offer you a voucher because our computer indicates your flight was held back by the control tower at Aspen Airport”, she responded. I showed her the series of texts we received indicating the contrary and she would not budge. “We have to go by what is indicated in our system; you should address your complaint to Aspen airport” “We have to go by what is indicated in our system; you should address your complaint to Aspen airport”. “As a courtesy, can you at least provide us meal vouchers for dinner?” “No, I’m really sorry, it’s against United Airlines policy”, she countered. With an imperative demeanor, she handed us two water bottles each containing toiletry kits. We have been traveling to Aspen for holiday more than 20 years to enjoy skiing on world class ski slopes, as well as indulging in the many other diversions Aspen offers. In conclusion, we can no longer depend on using United Express as a reliable airline for our future travel needs and will choose a method of conveyance which is more amenable to reach our destination.

Discount airlines boast low fares with the clear understanding that everything including seats selection will be an add on. United operates as a discount airline without the low fares. No electronic boarding pass as you can with any other airline including discount. Economy legroom is less than jet blue! Paid for wifi Not working. Paid for airport lounge So crowded and hot that we left the lounge, people sleeping everywhere and we couldn’t find a seat … to go back into the terminal where the sit down French brasserie had better food (only subs in the lounge) at the same cost per person as the lounge. We checked in one terminal but our gate was 3 terminals buildings away. $700 per person for inconvenient uncomfortable experience for a 2.5 hour flight. When I buy discount airline tickets, I’m not upset because of the trade off with the fare.

On this particular trip, the chief steward was really excellent and most of his staff were good, as well. The meals are still pretty basic for business class. Basically a two plate meal and dessert. Quite a downgrade from pre-Covid times. No longer do they offer any type of Japanese cuisine for the main meal which doesn't make good sense to me. That said, the flight, while not extraordinary, was just fine. Entertainment options were plentiful. Everything went smoothly. My only disappointment would be in the meals, neither which can compare to those offered by Japanese airlines on the same route. I also found the staff to be courteous and attentive throughout. Announcements, though infrequent, were helpful and friendly.

I used to fly United a lot. But having been using Delta. Thought I’d try them out of Newark in Polaris because they were a lot less expensive than Delta/KLM. You get what you pay for. Old tired cabin lousy selection of movies, meal was yuk. They didn’t even ask if I wanted a glass of wine with my meal. USB did not work. Awful experience. Will never fly them again. No wonder they get three stars

I was flying with an elderly person that has hearing difficulties. I needed to be on the same flight. When we checked in for the flight 24 hours in advance. We were both given a seat assignment. About 14 hours before the flight I received a text that I needed to recheck in. When I rechecked in I found that they had moved me to a different flight that was 3 hours earlier. After 4 hours on the phone/computer trying to get back on original flight. I was informed that the flight was oversold. I later found out from the other traveler that there was several lady golfers going to a tournament. They were last minute ticket purchases due to a date mix up. It’s a guess but I bet United sold my economy ticket for a premium. I ask if the fee’s I paid for a checked bag had been transferred to my new check in conformation code. I was assured it had been. Now I need to find a 3 am ride to the airport. After arriving in Houston airport I had to find the elderly traveler. Got on the next leg of flight and made it to final destination. Went to check in for return flight. Found out United didn’t transfer fees I paid for luggage. I had receipts where I had paid. Was told if I wanted bags on plane that I would have to pay fees again. So I did. Once I got home I spent another hour on phone getting a refund for baggage fees. It’s funny how when they charged me it was instant. But my refund will take 14 days. Never again United Airlines.

review_header: "Thank you for getting me home safely"
review_text: My husband requested wheelchair service for all flights for our trip home on Feb. 28th. From Merida Mexico, through to Calgary, the service was definitely better than I had hoped for. Only at 1 gate did I have to wait for a wheelchair (even though they had one ready for me, someone else must have taken it by the time I was the last one off the plane). The stewardesses were very apologetic, and they all waited with me until a wheelchair arrived (which took about 15 minutes). They recognized that my use of crutches down the aisle was an extreme difficulty, and there wasn't any way I could deboard the plane into the airport without the wheelchair. My porters in each airport were friendly and courteous. The airline staff were very patient with my slow mobility, and offered assistance etc. Planes were on time except our departing one out of Denver was delayed by 1.5 hrs, which worked out ok as we had originally only had 45 minutes in between, which would have been very tight with me being the last one off the plane, and waiting another 15 minutes for the wheelchair. We go to Mexico every year, and have flown with United several times, and we will continue to fly United as we feel the service overall is very good. Our delays have always been minor, and we understand many things are simply out of a companies' control when it comes to weather etc. Thank you for getting me home safely after my surgery!

review_header: "United somehow manages to be worse than most"
review_text: At this particular time, my SFO-EWR flight was delayed first by 2 hours due to technical issues, which they apparently didn't even solve, as the plane had to return to SFO after half an hour. Their meal voucher didn't work at two airport vendors (then I gave up trying). Ultimately, the flight had been delayed by 5+ hours before they realized that they had to change the cabin crew who had a very long day already. I would've cancelled the flight but the website (as always) didn't cooperate. The United customer service representative - who was very helpful, but of course couldn't compensate for the overall bad experience - ended up sending me a flight voucher. Sadly it's only available for United flights, rendering it basically worthless.

Our suitcase got lost on the way there. After many emails and phone calls and having provided all the necessary documents, United confirmed on November 27 that they would compensate us with $1500. They also promised to give us a flight voucher valued at $150 per person. We have yet to receive any compensation. Every week, I contact United by phone or email, and I'm told to be patient, because it can take up to 30 business days to transfer the money. Clearly, it has been far more than 30 business days since the initial confirmation on November 27 from United, regarding the compensation. Every week I call about our case, and yet there's no progress whatsoever. I expect better customer service from an American company. I don't know what to do anymore.
Unable to check in or print boarding passes. Waste of time. Partner Air Canada on flight to Ireland had no problem with online checking in and printing boarding passes

review_header: "basic economy I got for a 1st class ticket price"
review_text: We splurged and got 1st class. Worst decision ever - well the 1st was picking United. Anyway attendant never offered 1 drink - hey we were on vaca and I wanted a mimosa - 35 yes is a big deal! She disappeared after our breakfast which was not as we ordered - so who could ask? My husbands seat didn’t recline - broken, my tray table was stuck in up position - basic economy I got for a 1st class ticket price - no TV screen, nothing really zero amenities - I fly 1st class with Delta and American - and they sure give you what you paid for - might as well have been in Frontier, oh I forgot seat pocket in front filled with crayons and someone else’s boarding pass - yeah they cleaned alright!

Maarten safely in the middle of about two hours worth of severe turbulence. Our entire flight lasted a bit over 4 hours total. The plane arrived from its previous destination, Cleveland, 35 minutes ahead of schedule, but left 40 minutes after our scheduled departure time due to severe weather. The plane was 23 years old, but very well-kept. While we were over the continental US the Internet worked great and United now allows you to text for free on multiple platforms. The only thing is that when we lost Internet, I was not able to make a food purchase midair because now you have to register your credit card on the app in order to buy onboard and I failed to do that before take off even tho I was prompted to do so multiple times before my flight. The crew was fast and efficient, once the Captain allowed service in the cabin after the 2 hours of turbulence. The seat was much better than pre reclined ultra low cost carriers, if it wasn’t for the two hours that we buckled like a wild horse, it would’ve been pretty good overall. At the end of the day I’m grateful to United for making the best out of a pretty bad weather situation in the end I arrived safely at my destination and that’s all that really matters.

Everyone else got rest. I got a blaring blue LED light in my face for straight 13 hours. Slept through 85% of my brothers wedding, which was the entire reason for the trip. I’m told by staff to call and explain my horrid situation. It took almost an entire month for United to offer me a $100 in vouchers (1 for $75 and one for $25). That’s not even 1/8th of an upgrade for the flight I was on. United does NOT care about travelers. They care about bottom dollars.

I booked my flight several months ago, traveling with my little one under a year I made sure to book my trip with the least connections. I had troubles adding her on the reservation so I called the airline to get this done. They took quite a bit to help me but was told it was done, there was no added charge and I was going to receive a confirmation in a couple of days. I received an email with a link to the reservation details, when following the link I could see the 3 of us were booked and everything looked good. When check in time came I went to the website and it said I needed to check in at the airport because they first flight was thru air Canada. I showed up to the airport 2 hours ahead even though you only need about an hour for domestic flights. When I get there Air Canada can not find a ticket for my daughter they took a while trying to solve it but in the end they told me to contact United that it should be an easy fix as she was sitting on my lap. When I contacted United the agent treated us as if we were lying and we didn’t register our daughter, he said there was nothing we could do and it needed to be done by air Canada, mind we told him we were at the airport with all our our bags and our little one and have about and hour and a half before the flight leaves. He said I needed to purchase an infant ticket for her and I said that I wasn’t informed when I called to add her but we could pay her ticket if necessary. United kept telling me I should do that with the airport staff and air Canada kept telling me they can’t do that… this took a while. When I saw the time was getting close and we were not getting anywhere, I asked if I could just buy an adult ticket for my daughter for this flight and just continue with the rest of the trip as paid, he said they didn’t have my daughter at all, when I said I had proof that I had called to add her to the flight and her name in the reservation details he went again to talk to his manager (3rd time).. it seemed so unreasonable that they couldn’t do anything when she was traveling on my lap. He came back and said they see her name but because it’s international and we didn’t pay for a ticket they couldn’t help me. By this time we already missed our flight, we asked to be transferred to the manager after about another hour talking she said they could get us on another flight arriving to our destination 3 days later and with an overnight layover and magically, now she was able to get payment for a ticket for her? Both agents kept an unapologetic attitude even though we were not at fault. You would think that if you call the airline to let them know you are traveling with a kid and they take her name and info, they would tell you you need to pay a ticket. I reminded the manager how hard traveling with kids is, and that an overnight layover was not ideal, also that I had book those dates for a specific event that I was now going to miss. I told her that it was a major inconvenience on top of getting stuck at the airport with a little one and all our luggage for hours without them getting anywhere to now have to come back the following day. She basically said that all she could do to help me. I was so frustrated, tired, sleep deprived that honestly could not take anymore from United I asked for a refund and purchased a way more expensive ticket thru another airline - they really screwed me over and not once took ownership for their mistake.

LAX to Denver Feb 23 on the way home.  Each flight on the way there was on time, respectful and friendly. All our luggage's made it on time (We were a group of 9 passengers) On our way home we were delayed in LAX to Denver, the workers there were very nice and respectful to everyone. Our connection in Denver to Edmonton was only 40 minutes. We let them know and they ensured when we landed to ask everyone to remain seated that didn't need to run and allow us off first. We ran to our connecting flight to find out they held the plane back for us. I want to say thank you for the very smooth, reliable, friendly and outstanding services we received.

While I hate to admit it I lost my phone on the plane. They continued to search while boarding two planes and managing all of the chaos. The remained calm and gather my information, I will be forever thankful and I am very pleased with the kind and caring customer service they provided. Thanks so much. And yes they found my phone after 20 minutes of searching.

Firstly, the flight was on time. The flight crew were very professional, laid back, and willing to help. I had the best time chatting with the crew in between food and drink services. The flight itself was very smooth (I know they don't control that) and my seat was comfortable. I would fly United Airlines internationally again.

I like to be comfortable and being served well as I pay for. Food and even snacks are unacceptable, seriously horrendous. Bad menu choices. Staff do not serve first nor Business correctly. They never ask for my jacket to be hanged on a hanger. They serve in plastic cups in 1st class?. Every time, in every United flight (just got back yesterday from Mexico City through Houston to Cleveland, OH) the staff converse with each other very loud. After Covid (who said it is over?) there is no need to wear a mask, yet so many people were coughing and sneezing constantly, as if someone was very sick. Isn't a duty of the stewards to say something such as: "Could you please cover your mouth when you sneeze or cough?". Very mediocre service. It is a shame how disquieting is to pay first class to get such poor service.

I upgraded from Economy to Economy Plus for $109. My ticket was purchased 4 months before the flight. I purchased this upgraded seat because of a back problem that I have. I picked an aisle seat so that I could sit sideways and allieve the back pain that I was expecting. Two days before my flight, my seat and row was changed, giving me a center seat. I complained to 6 different people and they all said this happens all the time. For $109 upgrade this should never happen. I will not be flying United again.

At 6:30am the counter announced they had overbooked and needed 4 people to volunteer for a later flight and $1000 coupon. At 7am it was announced that no one could board until 4 people volunteered to give up their seats--most of us had connecting flights out of Houston, so connections would be missed.Next it was announced all carryons with wheels needed to be checked in on the loading bridge. I asked the agent if it was mandatory to checkin carryons if it was a connecting flight--she replied yes. I said I hoped I didn't miss my connecting flight (also United). We were finally allowed to board, yet sat on the tarmac to be de-iced for a considerable amount of time. We finally landed in Houston at 9:32--My connecting United flight was to depart at 9:44am. I waited to pick up my carry-on, flew through the terminal and arrived at the United counter minutes after the scheduled departure, only to be informed that the door had been closed. No more flights out to Sarasota until the next morning, but one to Tampa at 2:30 pm. My friends had to drive 2.5 hours to get to the Tampa airport (the traffic was crazy that evening) and I had to wait at the airport almost 4 hours. It is unbelievable to me that the flight didn't wait for the people who missed the flight by minutes at United's failures. I will never fly United again.

My flight was cancelled and the earliest they could get me out was 42 hours later. I was able to catch a flight with Southwest the next morning. That United agent said they would reimburse me for the Southwest flight. When I reached out to United to get the reimbursement they indicated they would only refund the portion of my ticket that was cancelled. They were very apologetic and sorry for the inconvenience cancelling my flight, me having to sleep in the Denver airport, but too bad for me. As many miles as I have flown over the years, this was the worst experience I have ever had. Being told one thing and then not honoring their agreement.

This is one of the first times I have chosen to fly with United airlines. Worst experience I have ever had with an airline. Our flight was delayed in Honolulu to san Francisco so we missed our connecting flight. Then they booked us 24 hrs later. That was a problem we both had to work on Monday. So they had another flight that was earlier but to new jersey still put us late on Sunday to arrive in Cleveland. We ended up staying at the airport so we didn't miss our next flight.

Hour and counting delay on flight due to lack a preparation. I have only flown with United one other time in recent memory and the experience was also terrible. Horrible company. Don’t give them a dime. Fly Delta!
Awful airline, the ticket wasn’t cheap, but quality of service is below overage. The flight was delayed and then they forced me to check in my carry on, rude flight attendants, disgusting restrooms.

review_header: "do not plan to fly United again"
review_text: The day we were scheduled to leave San Antonio to fly back to Knoxville via Houston, there was a weather event in Houston, which initially delayed our flight. Unasked, we were put on another flight into Houston. After sitting on the tarmac on that flight for around 2 hours, the pilot stated that the plane was overweight due to fuel, passengers, and baggage, and that they needed volunteers to deplane. The pilot also stated that he had never experienced such a situation in his 25 years of flying. Eventually, enough passengers volunteered to deplane and the flight departed for Houston. Once in Houston, we were informed that our flight to Knoxville had been canceled and rescheduled for the next day. By then, it was around 10 PM. I contacted United customer service via phone while my daughter stood in line at the customer service desk, which eventually closed before she reached the front of the line (there were 85-100 people in line.) The customer service rep I spoke with was hateful and rude, and informed me that, because our flight was canceled "due to weather", we could request cots to sleep in the airport or we could get our own hotel. We got an Uber to a hotel and spent the night, and arrived back at the airport the next day. The new flight went from Houston to Dulles. At Dulles, we boarded a very small Embraer via stairs from the tarmac. It was raining and the metal stairs were very slippery. To top it off, when I got to the top of the stairs, the flight attendant told me, very rudely, to go back down the stairs and gate check my backpack, which was the size of a purse. I was wearing two leg braces and barely made it up the steps to begin with because of severe osteoarthritis. The gate agent could have asked me to gate check the backpack. Someone on the ground could have asked me to gate check the backpack. No one did. Just the rude flight attendant. Luckily, my daughter was a few people behind me and could take the backpack back down the stairs. Again, in the rain. After all this, United sent us each a $150 travel voucher. That is the last thing we want. We do not plan to fly United again, under any circumstances.

I got on the flight in San Francisco with my hand luggage and the crew member said they need to check it in due to the aircraft being full. I said okay, will it come straight to Toronto. He answered yes. Guess what? I had to ask him for my bag tag, he put someone else’s bag tag on my bag and sent it to Denver. I lost very personal items because of some careless mistake of the crew member. They need to understand that they are dealing with peoples belongings and actually do their job properly. Anyways, the bag was not found. It was said it reached the head office, but nothing after that.  Worst airline ever.

Travelling for 3 days from Germany - Munchen to El Paso Texas. I lost all the connections due to delays, I arrived at my destination with both check in luggage lost. United team from El Paso was promising me that my luggage is located and I will have my luggage before Christmas. they never offer me with any voucher as I arrived with zero clothes and personal items to my final destination. It was before Christmas. I needed to go every second day to airport to check if my luggage was found because on the phone that they gave me they never answered. United team told me that my expenses (for my survival days in my vacation)will be reimbursed and Until today I did not receive any money. I spend a lot of money, lost my luggage and they offered me zero support. One of my luggage ( 10kg) was found after 10 days but the big one (23kg) was never found. And I called so many times, filled claims and I received zero compensation from United. Every time I am calling them they give me a different story of my claim.

Check in/Bag drop was the most efficient experience I've had with any airline for each part of the journey. No waiting in long lines to get bag tags, it's via self-serve. Each time, staff offered to help us stick on the tags - travelling with 2 young kids, this little gesture was greatly appreciated. It was also very impressive that bags could then be tracked via the United App. We had no issues at all with our luggage. As far as the aircrafts themselves, we had 3x 787s and a 777 over the journey. Planes were clean, and on par to other airlines 787 and 777. No issues at all with our special meals, and staff were friendly, attentive, and very professional - the kids each got a small activity pack as well. Free Wifi for messaging apps (Text only WhatsApp, Messenger etc) on every flight. Pricing for full internet use was very fair. Entertainment was as good as other airlines, with the ability to also play content on our own devices. Staff had headphones for the kids (as opposed to wired earbuds that everyone else got).  I hope your next trip is as good as ours. I'm not one to leave reviews normally, but this was a truly fantastic experience.

Flight departed on time and arrived an hour early, crew were efficient and came around often with drinks throughout the flight. Food is below average when compared to other PE products but IFE is among the best if not always easy to use the choice us huge. Had the bulk head seat so there was plenty of room and the seat was comfortable, downside is the location of the headphone jack. Overall a good but not fantastic experience and I would fly them again.

I still had my suitcase because we were late getting to the airport. Went through TSA and was told that I could gate check my suitcase. One of the people checking the tickets was about to let me board, but the other lady was belligerent and was complaining about my suitcase being too heavy. She gave me a hard time and rebooked my flight to where I won’t be arriving until super late. On a scale of 1-5 stars, United gets a -2.

Flight was uneventful, departure and arrival were on time, I got lucky in that the seat next to me was empty meaning I had some space, but could have been very cramped otherwise especially for a 12 hr flight. Staff were efficient and came around often with water and several drinks services. Toilets were kept reasonable clean and the entertainment selection was top notch. Let down has to be the food which was average at best and parsimonious in size. Also repeatedly got bumped by the flight attendant when they walked past, not once or twice but the whole flight long. They got me there but have to say that others do it better and had the seat next to me not been empty the rating would be lower. Use would depend on the price.

We checked to bags so they also charged us a second checked bag fee which was ridiculous as well because my son didn’t check a bag so it should have been first checked bag which would have been 15 dollars cheaper! They charged us 75$ for a bag that was within there dimensions specified and we didn’t have to check prior! My fiancé called support and that told here all these hopes we had to jump through for them to make it right! Worst customer service ever and now pretty much told us they won’t refund it! While the staff on the actual plane were amazing! This just put a super bad taste in our mouth the lady at the desk for where we boarded could easily see all the information that we didn’t have a first bag check for my son and was super rude and was just trying to stick it to use. Everything in the bag including the bag wasn’t worth 75$ it was a ridiculous unnecessary up charge for now reason when it fit under the seat! Complete scam and trying to make money off people. Do the people at the desk get bonuses for making people check a bag because that’s what it felt like.
This was our first time again to fly United again, the Flight from DTW to EWR was great and not too crowded. This flight was a code share with ANA.

Completely full flight. My tray table was defective and slanted downward so food and drink would slide off toward me. I brought it to my FAs attention and her solution was lifting my leg up to hold the tray in place. Food was terrible. Flight entertainment was good.
The crew of stewards and stewardesses are very helpful and pleasant. Overall a decent and safe travel experience.

Missed my connection in Denver. United would not pay for a room. Then they have a system of sending you to a non-working web page to fill out complaints. I travel a lot, but United won't be a choice now.
Flight had fuel issues and had to divert to CLT. Fuel at IAD was over filled and first we had to wait for a special truck to refuel the overfill. A fiasco!

We'll to make it short, flying into Houston they announced they had to go around Houston until a severe weather storm was at Houston Airport had passed. Going around not a cloud in the sky and landing everything was dry a calm. Due to United's incompetent running of an airline they had an aircraft at our gate that was the real reason for flying around. We missed our connecting flight and we had to fly Delta to Detroit no thanks from United. They still haven't a clue where our bags are and couldn't care less. Never again will we fly United.

Seats I paid extra for where not given to me and when I went to the United service counter I was told they could do nothing for me. (I was also traveling with a 3 year old and a 7 month old) My party of 6 was spread throughout the plane, even my 3 year old, and United said there was nothing they could do. I purchased a padded stroller bag and when I received my stroller off the luggage belt, the handle was broke in half. I went directly to the United desk again and was told there was nothing they could do. They have zero customer help and don’t stand behind there mistakes. Will never fly this airline again.
Then 1 hour before landing an omlet and some fruits. So terrible for a 14 hour flight.

review_header: "Economy Plus a big waste of money"
review_text: The flight from MLI to ORD there was no beverage service. Cramped seating. No plug in for electronics. Actual flight was uneventful. The flight from ORD to CUN. Again the flight was cramped and seat wouldn't recline. There was a beverage service. No plug in for electronics. I will never pay for premium seats on United. And most likely never fly with them again.

There is an additional charge for every little thing to include carry on. There is also an additional charge for seating regardless of your child's age. When I asked about sitting next to my sons she replied, "we dont move seats with your type of ticket." Like I'm some kind of 3rd class citizen. Customer service is absolutely horrible. They lost my luggage tag, threatened to call the police, required my kids and I to leaving the boarding area, go back through security, which made us minutes from missing our flight. I was told that "if we missed the flight it would be my problem" even though they were the ones who lost the tag. I had my copy of the tag. We fly 6 or 7 times per year and typically I'll look for a reasonably priced ticket. From now on, I'll pay extra to fly on AA or Delta. Never again with United. Be warned!

I am now sitting in the last row with no refund on my upgrade. United has always been the worst airline option and their commitment to that continues. Staff is always friendly however the airline itself is always a significant disappointment.

I had booking from Reno to Saskatoon and day of flight they had some technical issues with the airplane so they cancel our flight for the whole day, and gave me a ticket for next day, and from Vancouver to Saskatoon day after that. They waste my three days and didn't gave me any compensation for that. Not recommend and will never travel with United again.

We missed our flight with Hawaiian and needed to get to Hawaii the same day so we booked the next flight out with United, and my partner paid for Premium economy/economy plus or whatever they call the step above economy. He then got a notification that he was refunded due to an error and so he tried again and again with he same problem each time. We go to check in for our flight and the person checking us in says that there are multiple premium/plus seats available but that he can't upgrade us and our best bet is to ask the reps at the gate. We get there and I explain that I'm looking to upgrade to premium economy and the woman working the gate looks at me and scoffs and says we don't have that on this flight. I asked if she was sure because I was told something different downstairs and she said, "yeah" as if I was a moron. I left and the whole interaction didn't sit well with me so I went back to ask a different rep to upgrade and I told her that I looked online and saw that this particular aircraft does have a step above economy and that it's called economy plus and not premium economy which I had said before because I normally fly with Eva, Hawaiian, etc. And those airlines call those seats by a different name than United does. I explained that I had called it a different name so maybe she didn't understand what I was asking for before (trying to give her the benefit of the doubt) and the same woman as before interjects and laughs at me saying," yeah it's called economy plus, we don't have that other thing you asked for". Unbelievably and unnecessarily rude. What is the point of nit picking about what name I'm using when you obviously know I'm trying to pay for an upgrade? Right after this stupid and mind-numbing interaction, they announce the flight is delayed. They then get back on the speaker and say actually your gate was moved. Then we get to the gate and learn that our flight was delayed again for maintenance and to get a new plane I never fly any other airlines that delay flights like this, but every time I fly with united, without fail, our flight is delayed. I hate them and don't know how they're still in business. We got on our flight and the staff was rude and short with us until they realized that we had given the whole crew some chocolates to share, and then they changed their tune.

Just because you want to save money and fly economy doesn't mean we should be stuck in seats that are sized for a scrawny 10 year old. No leg room at all. I'm 5'4 and weigh approximately 140lbs. My knees were all the way to the seat in front of me. They expect you to put personal items under the seat in front of you but you can't bend down to pick anything up. The thing I hated the most was trying to charge my phone. It's under your seat and not a single one worked. Where it's located I'm sure has been kicked a million times. Overall worst flights. If you are a bigger person skip United or fork out for 1st class. The only nice part was getting off the planes and the crew were nice.

This flight was supposed to be 2 stops, and 23 hour flight. It is now 3 stops, 3 delays and 60 hours so far and I'm still sitting waiting. And all the weather is good. I though to give them a second chance since they fail me before, I was stupid. You had been warned. No more United Airlines.
Haven’t seen this type of compassion, professionalism and service at a check in desk. Well handled. Thanks

Had 40 hours at the airports, online agents are very incompetent. Customer service agent didn’t even bother to help us, after so many complains and emails no help was given. Basically thanks to incompetence of the workers of United airlines I took a hit for extra $3500. Not anymore booking with this company, horrible customer service and horrible experience.

When I called to rebook, I was given no customer service. Then was told I had to wait 48 hours to get a flight out. I paid my fair like everyone else and should have been on the next flight out. Instead I was further inconvenienced twice: first when I told the agent I needed to get back and my job was on the line and he dismissed it. Secondly when I had to book another airline (at twice as much) that took me 14 hours to get home (Great Falls to Seattle to Denver RED EYE (was canceled) then trying Dallas RED EYE (was canceled) then Chicago then to Indianapolis. I work in customer Service for Hilton and work full time in IT. That is not how you do business or customer service. I will be telling others about this experience. It was horrible.

review_header: "annoyed by the rudeness of the pilot"
review_text: I was asked several security questions and when I received my boarding pass it had at the top, SSSS, which means give him enhanced security at the gate. Going through security I received the normal security which means a body scanner, and many pat downs. I went to the lounge and the only hot food was tater tots and mushrooms. They did have wine. I would recommend the Lufthansa Lounge. Make sure you do not go through Passport Control, or it will be too late to get to the lounge. I went to the gate early and United uses the only gate in Terminal B that has Body Scanners. When they saw my boarding pass, I had to go through the Body Scanner, many pat downs and all of my carry-ons were checked. Make sure you do not purchase any liquids at Duty Free if you have SSSS on your boarding pass. The entire process took about five minutes. I was on the plane almost an hour early. When it was time to depart, the fasten seatbelt sign came on and we waited another hour as every five minutes another frustrated person arrived on the plane. The fasten seatbelt sign went off after 90 minutes and lunch was served. I had the braised beef. Service and food were excellent as I was in Business Class. When I asked the flight attendant why the flight was delayed an hour his response was, I don't know. After the dishes were collected, the fasten seatbelt sign came on not once but twice, not because of turbulence but because too many people were trying to use the toilet. Note to United, turning on the fasten seatbelt sign doesn't empty my bladder. The plane was full, no empty seats. One hour before landing, the pilot said, we are expecting turbulence in Newark so we will be preparing the plain for landing early. Toilets were locked, seats had to be upright and tray tables needed to be up. There was no turbulence arriving in Newark and I have flown with this pilot before. Five feet before arriving at the gate, the pilot made the announcement that we are five feet from the gate and already 28 people have their seat belt unfastened. I took this flight three months ago and I'm still annoyed by the rudeness of the pilot. Most airlines say thank you for flying with us.

review_header: "This time definitely hit a new low"
review_text: Flying with United was the worst part of the trip. First, our flight to Japan was delayed due to "mechanical issues" with the aircraft. What was supposed to leave at 10:35am left at 7pm. Second, on our flight back to SFO, they damaged our checked bag. Our luggage (large, hard outer-case suitcase weighing less than 50lb) came out of the carousel about 70 minutes after arrival (along with everyone else's), and it had severe cracks that rendered the suitcase completely unusable in the future (the inner padding was exposed). I tried to tell an agent about this, but no one was present at the United counter at baggage claim. I chatted with an agent on United website about this, but without any apology, she told me to go to a different terminal to see an agent. Who wants to drag a broken luggage across a sprawling airport after a 10-hour flight? In comparison, when a similar thing happened to me on an American Air flight, I was quickly reimbursed for the damage. United has great entertainment onboard and their planes are state-of-the-art, but I have never had a pleasant experience with United as a customer. This time definitely hit a new low.

However, if the Chicago gate crew had given a crap at all, they would have gotten us to Houston in time for our connecting flight to Rio. However, they had one guy retrieving 17 different wheel chairs, one at a time from the cargo area. But worse than that, the gate crew couldn't not have moved slower without backing up. It was painful to watch them eventually start to scan 300+ passengers with one hand-held scanning device that required two or three attempts to get it to work on each and every passenger. They so clearly didn't care! When I got to Houston I raced across the airport only to find that they had held our plane for us for 1 1/2 hours, but left 20 minutes before we got there. They just couldn't wait any longer. But we could have made it with even the slightest concern from the slackers in Chicago. The Chicago crew cares nothing about good service. Clearly there are no consequences to the staff for horrible service. This is a management problem!
Have to cancel our 2 week trip. Can’t be refund by the two Airbnb we rented and we have to persist with United airlines for a refund. They don’t want to give us compensation either.

I had a connection flight from Istanbul airport to Chicago airport and then San Diego, and the employee at Chicago airport told us that we should carry our bags and then check it in again, I didn't know what is the reason to transfer baggage where i had a final destination at San Diego airport, but when I carried my bags and brought them to the employee in order to get the receipt and gave them to the employee who works on the tracks to push the bags in, I told him to be careful when throwing them on the tracks, but the employee looked at me in the eye and threw the bag upside down, and I asked him "why did you do that?" He did not answer at all! These negative behaviors must be dealt with because they reflect the name and reputation of the airline.

Not only did I experience delay after delay - 3.5 hours delay, they have also had to rebook my tickets twice because of this. I’ve had to fly visa Newark to get back to London. And after a long and painful flight, having returned to London Heathrow, they have lost my two checked luggages! United Airlines baggage enquiry staff told me that one of my luggages was in London and made me wait for four hours looking at carousels from other flights, in the end, I went home with zero luggage. They said my luggage will be delivered the day after, but the contact number they have provided to track your lost luggage does not work, very hard to get ahold of United Airlines customer service. What an absolute nightmare of an experience I have had. Very poor service. I will never fly with United again.

I called to see what they could do to switch us to another flight, give us a discount or upgrade us. All they offered was a refund. This has inconvenienced us very much because now we are having to pay at least $1000 more in tickets.

review_header: "we are in a city we didn’t plan to be in"
review_text: On the way to the airport our last connecting flight gets cancelled, booked the “Plan B” they had available. Get to our first stop in Denver then from Denver over to LA. The boarding pass stated from Denver to San Francisco, 6 hr destination error. I am not supposed to be in LAX to begin with. I claim my baggage only to check it back in to send it to Melbourne & I notice a huge slit in my luggage, completely torn apart, I will not be surprised if I’m not reimbursed even partially for this damage. Finally here at my gate that was initially supposed to take off at 4pm, then got delayed to 6.45pm then to 7.30pm. It’s a connecting flight to San Fran to get us to Melbourne, which takes off at 11pm, so another delay is going to cut it very close. Lo and behold, a 3rd delay to 1am! Awesome experience. Not to mention, all the delays came with gate changes. Cancelled flights, delayed flights, damaged personal belongings, & we are in a city we didn’t plan to be in. Any reimbursement? Of course, not to worry, we got an offer of $75 credit towards United Airlines, very generous.
They are ALWAYS departure one hour later for technical problems! The 3 times was one hour late the departure! I won’t use this airline again!

After the flight time kept being pushed back several times due to delay, finally 6 hours later it was canceled. I contacted customer service via text from the airport but never got a response. Eventually I dealt with customer service at the airport and the young lady at San Francisco airport helped me to book a new flight and provided me with a hotel voucher. It was interesting to watch how some customers were being helped and others were simply not. Shame on you United Airlines.

It had good back support, a storage area in the armrest and good storage under the IFE screen, which was quite large. We were given a nice large blanket and a good sized pillow. The food service was excellent, served on china with a cloth napkin and wine. We had dinner and breakfast and both meals were very good. IFE was okay, with enough to watch. We were supplied regularly with water and drinks throughout the 11 hour journey. Staff weren't the most interactive but were friendly and accomodating. We took off on time and arrived early into Houston. The toilets were shared with economy and were spotless. I had a look at the economy seats and they were very cramped in a  
3-4-3 arrangement. All in all, United did not disappoint in PE

Especially traveling after Covid. This airline has been reducing customer service, the staff are rude, I had an awful sleep in Business Class. Traveling after Covid has been a disaster. At Fort Lauderdale, the United Club lounge was disgusting, limited food, using plastic cutlery instead of metal, not enough drinks, cramped and noisy space. United ruined the start of 2023, after 3 bad years due to Covid. It seems like Air Canada and United Airlines have been downgrading their services during Covid and using "Covid" as an excuse for poor customer service. I am so upset with all of the airlines I flew during the Christmas holidays. I am going to avoid Etihad Airways, Air Canada and United Airlines because they were the reason for creating a bad start to 2023. I wish the United Airlines team can learn from Singapore Airlines, when you fly with Singapore Airlines, the service is outstanding and relaxing, also the planes are clean on SIA. This is a bad example of travel after 3 years of Covid. This is not good enough and a horrible start to 2023. These airlines need to buck up and stop using Covid as an excuse.

I was flying out of XNA in Bentonville, AR, and connecting through Denver to then fly to Bozeman, MT. Our flight out of XNA was delayed 30 minutes (which wasn’t a huge deal), and as we got closer to Denver, the flight attendant informed us that they were not going to land in Denver, we were being redirected to Montrose, CO, due to low visibility. We were told we were going to land and be back up in the air shortly and that we were just waiting for the weather to clear. We then had to de-board the plane and wait inside a very small airport that had 5 total gates and 1 terminal. More and more flights being redirected from Denver were landing there and caused the terminal to be so crowded that it was difficult to walk around without getting stuck in a crowd of people. We waited for 3 1/2 hours while only being told to not book a hotel room, and that United was going to get us back to Denver soon. This entire time, we were tracking other United planes that were landing in Denver hours before we were able to fly back. Finally, we re-boarded the plane and flew back to Denver, where the conditions were worse than when we originally attempted to land there. Once we landed in Denver, we spoke to a United Airlines agent because we had just found out that instead of rebooking us on a new flight, they just decided to cancel our boarding passes for the connecting flight to Bozeman without notifying us, that we missed due to the wait in Montrose. We were told we could not be put on another flight until January 4th (it was January 2nd when this all happened) and that the 2 checked bags we had on the plane could either be claimed at the baggage claim, or shipped to Bozeman after we arrive, but would not get there for 2-3 days after we arrived. We decided we would schedule a flight with a different airline for that night, and go down to the baggage claim to get our bags. We were told that United had submitted the request for our bags to be pulled and it would be 1-2 hours before they would end up on the baggage claim carousel. We sat and waited for 4 hours and still did not receive our bags. By the time we reached Bozeman, United had cost us over half a day of travel that cut into our vacation time, and large amounts of stress and annoyance. I will never fly with United again, and hope that anyone who flys with them does not have the same experience I had.

I called them and they told my that my ticket is cancelled without any notice! They told me I should get a new one and i did and purchased a 5 new tickets. Everytime same thing happens! This is the worst experience in my whole life and I will never use United again.

I can't give enough praise to United for the wonderful service we experienced flying out to Denver and back to Eugene, Oregon. The flight out was slightly delayed, but it did not affect our trip. The flight attendants were friendly and personable and certainly made me pause and try to remember when I last had this kind of attention. They were very sorry for the delay and were sincere in the service they provided as a result. A special call-out to flight attendant on the return flight UA318 from Denver to Eugene. He engaged with everyone on the flight in a way that will certainly bring me back for future flights. You need to know when you get it right. You most definitely did for my family and me for this trip. Keep it up!
Plane finally gets boarded, been here for an hour still haven’t even left the terminal. Ruined my ride for when I get home, ruined everything.

Like everything else, no airline is perfect, however the way United manages its resources and keeps 'on-time performance' is phenomenal and commendable. Another big differentiator for United is its automation - United is several step ahead in automation. This made a clear distinction during December 2022 Arctic freeze in North American continent - when airlines like Southwest could not schedule its pilots and dumped customers' luggage wherever they could. United kept most of its services intact with minimum disruption and maximum on-time performance; also United system is able to tell every customer where his luggage is at any point in his trip. The way and with speed at which United came out of COVID-19 was also seamless and shows its resilience. United's cleanliness during pandemic was way superior than others. Its safety video has always been worth watching. Its pricing is mostly very competitive even on routes not originating at its hubs. And usually its customer service responds on feedbacks which they ask for every trip. Overall the best choice for frequent fliers who value their time.

We got free hotel room, free lift to drive us to hotel, and pickup us back to airport + $30 each for dinner and breakfast .Thank you so much, great people, look forward to go back again with United Airlines.

review_header: "another flight that has been delayed 3 hours"
review_text: 35pm Christmas Day. After a 5 hour delay boarding the place and several people taken off because people who paid more for their ticket took their place, the flight was cancelled and we had to get off. Then we stood in line with people from other United flights including an international flight for 3 hours to get rebooked. Now after a week of getting new flights booked and flights canceled not to mention the cost of hotels etc, I am sitting at the airport again waiting for another flight that has been delayed 3 hours. At what point, is United responsible for finally getting me home!!

Connecting flight was delayed 20 hours. Been tossed around from one end of the terminal to another 6 times. Slept on the airport with kids, no assistance given. On our trip back, our flight was canceled because apparently we were a ‘no show’ in our connecting flight to our final destination! Since we were a no-show, and flight being canceled, there were no available flights anymore until after 3 days!
They did exactly the same when I was flying from Munich to San Francisco. It is terrible, completely disrespectful. I completely do not recommend United Airlines.

review_header: "has to be some type of accountability"
review_text: I have been on the phone with the United Airlines call center multiple times with 3-4 hour wait times and meanwhile one of my bags has been on 5 flights and the other bag has been on 4. I also went to Newark airport to collect my bags and they told me to go home because the wait time would be too long and that the call center in India has no clue as to what’s going on in the United States. It’s now 4 days later and one of my bags is in Newark airport and the other bag is sitting in Houston. I have my medication in my bags and the call center told me to take myself to the emergency room to get medication. There has to be some type of accountability. I will never fly United Airlines and if you can’t trust them with your luggage, how could you trust them with your life.

NOT ANY LONGER! Both planes were dirty and the seats were like flying on a discount carrier which I will not fly because of comfort. Flight crew was very unput together clothes look dishevelled hair unkept, Not customer oriented (they acted as this is the worst job ever). Just paid 700 for 800 mile flight. Asked for a Diet Coke only allowed one glass not even the can and no stupid snack really. I fly once every other week this was my first flight with United in a year they can not even compare to Delta or American. I will no longer book with united delta and American has my business or I could use another airport and fly a discount carrier which would match the service and uncomfortable plane literally felt like I was sitting in a plywood bench. I was unable to load my payment info on the app so was unable to use my credit card to even purchase a drink. Then the connection from Chicago they did not provide a beverage service, both other carriers on this route do offer. Very very unhappy with the price and the lack of service provided. I have instructed my husband who owns a travel company based in Philly not avoid booking me on the carrier.

review_header: "needs to get its staff scheduling right"
review_text: Both routes from Newark and Tampa, the flight attendant went missing for hours! This is the first time flying for over 30 yrs I have had this situation where the airline unable to even find backup! Anyway, from Tampa to Newark the flight was delayed by 4 hrs.
