This flight did not feature the Qsuite layout, but the standard Business Class seating was extremely comfortable. Qatar’s cabin crew delivered service that was both warm and precise, among the best in the industry. Overall, the experience reflected a high standard. There were, however, a few shortcomings. The pilot’s announcement was difficult to understand, marred by poor audio quality. The WiFi connection was sluggish and unreliable, despite the $20 charge. As for the food, I chose the Indian vegetarian option, which arrived swimming in oil. A lighter, more balanced preparation would have been preferable.

This flight also lacked the Qsuite configuration, but the conventional Business Class seating was more than comfortable for a short 3-hour hop. Qatar maintains a high standard of service, and the crew lived up to that reputation. The flight left Doha and reached Goa on schedule. The only letdown was the WiFi. I paid the full $20 and once again received only patchy service. One hopes this will be addressed once Starlink is introduced across the fleet.

The flight was diverted and arrived in Doha later than scheduled due to the Iranian attack on Qatar, and this caused a substantial delay for my trip. When I arrived in Doha, I learned that the connecting flight to Sao Paulo on 24th, QR779, was canceled.  I approached staff at the airport but he was not at all helpful. The only thing he could tell me was to go to the transfer counter. When I went to the transfer counter area, I witnessed pandemonium. I could not figure out how to line up for the transfer desk, and asked another staff and he told me to go to the business class lounge. I followed that advice and went there. A staff there told me to just wait for a few hours and come back because the company is handling the situation and things should go back to normal then. In the end, I had to spend 20 some hours before I can get a new ticket, and another 20-some hours at the airport before getting on the plane to Sao Paulo on 26th, two days later than the original connection flight. Meanwhile Qatar Airways put my luggage to an earlier flight to Sao Paulo, I had a tagging device to learn that my luggage was already in Sao Paulo for some time when I arrived there.

When lines started to form at boarding time, the supervisor screamed at the guests: "Sit down, the aircraft is still being cleaned; you need to be patient." Chaos followed when boarding finally started 35 min late. Economy started first which caused business class passengers to complain, which resulted in a rather messy boarding procedure. The service and food was the big letdown on this 6 hour night flight. Service completed almost 3 hours after takeoff which left 2 hours of rest before the lights went on again. The meal I received was a soggy stick mass of pasta with of tomato sauce. (They called it Penne Arabiata) There was no taste and an unpleasant texture. This was one of the worst inflight meal I ever had. The flight attendant in charge of my section was slow, unmotivated and robotic in her service rendered. The seats on the B789 were tight and uncomfortable, making it impossible for a good rest.

So I had to quickly get another flight with another airline at the airport to fly on the same day. They did not contact me to inform that they can only process a refund if I cancel the return flight as well, which I only found out a couple days after I contacted the airline to check on the partial refund for cancelling my departure flights.

My lasting impression is that the cabin crew work extremely hard throughout the whole flights, unlike the crew on certain other airlines. The food in Economy was very poor though. The safety briefings are via pre-recorded videos featuring an actor who turns the whole issue of safety into a huge joke, which is really inappropriate. The pilots were superb and made incredibly smooth landings on all flights. Overall a good airline and decent value. That food though..oh dear!
2 toilets for 130 passengers in economy on the A320. Although Wheel chair was requested I had to walk to the aircraft.

They are the best airline because they pay attention to details that matter to the customer. The cabin crew is efficient professionals. I like that they always know what they are doing, as if they take pride in what they are doing. They are also very warm and personable.  They chat with you rather than talk to you - if you understand what I mean. I also like that they remember your preferences OR take initiative when they need to. My cabin attendant remembered that I preferred sparkling water and delivered it with each meal, but he also knew with which of my meal courses to serve my two different wine selections. The food is excellent and the restrooms are kept clean. Pilots y communicate ahead of time if there will be turbulence or if any information needs to be shared. Little things like these make me feel like they care and if they care then I feel comfortable and safe.

Last minute aircraft switch from A350-1000 to B773, but was equipped with Qsuite. Holding area at Gate A7 did not provide seats for the fully booked flight. Flight departed 30 min later, which resulted in a 1h delay into Heathrow, because of the restricted airspace at the moment. Food was great. Caviar service was a nice touch. The service was ok, but lacked in consistency. Coffee was served 30 min before the meal arrived, and it also took up to 30 min to clear plate between courses during the meal. New WiFi lighting fast, which resulted in loud WiFi chats among some pax. I had to tell them to stop! I think this will become a big issue in the future and IFA should be firmer on those inconsiderate people. Overall a great flight with some room for improvement for onboard service

Boarding a little chaotic, it was a free for all and anyone used any Boarding lane. Eventually on board, very friendly and personalised greeting. Not long after settling in, pretake off drink offered, explanation of seat operation, menu and how dining on demand works. Not long after, meal orders were taken. Once airborne, the crew switched into their routine. It was faultless. It was consistent and again personable. The seating was comfortable. In lie flat position, I slept a solid 8 hours. All food was of a high standard, well presented and taste was fantastic. Beverages were also well presented and always available. The highlight for the wife and to a lesser extent me, was the inflight bar and lounge which was well patronised when we were there. The crew also engaging and very friendly and genuinely interested in their guests. Overall, we rate this flight tops. Way above some of the other major airlines we have flown and better than First Class on some... just saying. Consistency, personable and a very enjoyable first time experience flying with Qatar Airways

Contract lounge with poor food selection and uncleared tables. B773 on this 4h red eye night flight. Boarding via remote stand. I was the first on board, but was ignored by the FA and had to ask for my welcome drink while the plane was already moving. Meal order was taken after take off, which isn’t ideal for a red eye flight. The new irritating safety video was shown with no sound. Service was hectic and not overly friendly. An orange light was left on throughout the night. Overall, a rather average flight. The same flight from Doha to ADD was in comparison so much better.

Boarding via gate rather unorganised. A320 with the flat bed seats. Food and drinks choices outstanding for the 4h flight. What made the flight special was the service rendered by the hardworking cabin crew. It’s not easy to provide a full service for an almost full cabin on a narrow body aircraft, but the two in the front cabin worked wonders; highly recommended!

Contract Miracle lounge at the new Satellite terminal quiet, with poor breakfast options. I should have used the other OW lounges like Cathay or JAL. It’s hard to comprehend why Qatar does not give access to their own lounge to QR Platinum members.  Flight was uneventful with average service and food. WiFi did not work most of the time, seats tight and hard. Flight arrived 15 minutes ahead of schedule

We are a family of 4 with 2 young children. The treatment by the airline to family's was excellent and so helpful. Taking children on long flights can be stressful but Qatar Airways really tries to help out with early boarding to get them sorted and great entertainment and bits for them to do on the flight. All the flights being on time very clean and everything working. Big Thankyou to the amazing crews that would keep checking if needed anything your a credit to the airline and make Qatar what it is.

The flight was full mid day departure from Doha with a strong tail wind arriving in Beirut a full 45 minutes early. IFE was non existent and WIFI worked well at the beginning but became non existent less than an hour into the flight. Catering was OK you can see that the route was not a priority.

I fly to Europe from Per usually once every couple of months sometimes business class when there is a deal but usually economy. Long haul Qatar economy is in a league of its own. I recently flew to LHR and had not noticed that the flight from DOH to LHR was with BA, the difference in seat size and what passes for service in economy on BA these days was unbelievable , I won't make that mistake again Qatar business class is heaven at 40,000 feet and economy his not far behind, the wines on board are exceptional as are all of the team and lounges at DOH are fabulous I have travelled with all of the worlds major airlines and there is no question in my mind Qatar is head and shoulders above all of the rest I just love them
Will definitely fly again with Qatar airways. Fantastic staff, fantastic food, fantastic planes
The seats are terribly uncomfortable, way too narrow with armrests that catch your elbow at the wrong height. I am not overweight and taller than average.

I politely brought it up with a flight attendant and asked if I could be moved to an available seat. But before she could respond, a local Pakistani staff member butted in and rudely told me there was nothing they could do and that I should stop making a fuss. It felt like Qatar Airways is just another part of the lawless mess that defines the Lahore airport experience.

From Athens - Doha and from Doha-Pnohm Penh via Saigon and the return from Bangkok-Doha-Athens. Both legs out and back were outstanding, Starting from the electronic check in and the well organised boarding and finishing with the baggage take out, the service in the plane and the food impeccable. The entertainment very updating and with new movies and games. Free wifi with excellent connectivity and the seats very comfortable for economy class. Also clean restrooms in the plane and the Doha airport super high class.

The Q-suites in business are really nice and being able to close the door provides great privacy. The first class seats are even better with heaps of space but no ability to close off the area like with the Q-suites. Service in both business and first is excellent but it was a bit over the top in first and felt a bit insincere at times. The dedicated first class check-in at Doha is amazing with top notch personalised service and fast track security clearance. The Doha first class lounge is also amazing but on the return journey we were told that we shouldn't have had access to that lounge but they let us in. The big letdown on the flights was the food. We both had special vegan meals on all flights and the food was really bad. We found the Wi-Fi to be patchy during the flights. This may well have been the an issue with the third party provider but when you pay for unlimited Wi-Fi in business, it is frustrating when it doesn't work very well. This was our first time flying with Qatar and we had high hopes from an airline rated so highly. We've had better experiences with other airlines and we would be unlikely to fly Qatar again unless we specifically wanted to have another stopover in Doha.

Check in was horrible with long wait. In-flight staff appeared exhausted. The plane was not connected to the airport and we had to be bused which was inconvenient. My food was poor. It was extremely disappointing.

The service was outstanding, with the cabin crew delivering top-notch hospitality. A special thank you to crew member Juhaina and the entire team for their warmth and professionalism.  I look forward to flying with you again!
We were in an older B777 and it was installed with Qsuites. The new WIFI service is amazing, and nice caviar and Balik salmon with Turbot rounded a delicious meal. The IFE game selection was poor

I purchased tickets through their official website, yet part of the flight didn’t qualify for Qpoints. Their response was that the flight was “operated by another airline”, but this was not clear during booking. This is misleading and not acceptable.

Everything from the seat to the service felt thoughtfully designed and well-executed. It’s easy to see why Qatar Airways is so highly rated — this flight gave me a clear sense of what sets their business class apart. Qsuite privacy: the sliding door and fully enclosed suite created a personal sanctuary — perfect for work, rest, or relaxation. Full flat bed with soft pillows and a duvet for restful sleep. In-seat massage feature added to the comfort, especially on a long-haul journey. Gourmet-quality meals with a diverse menu. Every dish was beautifully presented and tasted amazing. Excellent selection of wines, spirits, and mocktails. High-quality amenity kit, soft pajamas, slippers, and other thoughtful touches. The cabin crew was warm, professional, and attentive throughout the journey. A350 cabin was quiet, smooth ride with mood lighting and large windows. Plenty of room to stow personal items. Wide selection of movies, TV shows, music, and more on a responsive touchscreen.

was disappointed to learn I would not be travelling in their acclaimed Q Suite. They certainly lived up to what you would expect from an airline that has been awarded World’s Best Airline and recognised as having the World’s Best Business Class. There was one thing that needs to be addressed and that is the music played while boarding. It was ridiculously loud. Some of the things that really standout for me: Business Class passengers are given a sleeper suit to wear which was much appreciated. The inflight service was personal and faultless. The lay-flat function of the chair was extremely good, and the bedding material was great. The catering was the best I’ve experienced in a long time. The meals where truly exceptional and the fact they offer caviar to business class passengers is remarkable. This airline truly deserves the accolades it has received, and I can’t wait for my next flights with Qatar which at this stage will be in November this year.

The service was exceptional and i still remember one of the flight attendant Aravind who was going extra mile to help me with the food. I am so proud to become a silver card member in Qatar Airways. Thank you Qatar Airways for all the wonderful service provided to passengers.

The flight left ahead of time because of the great job the ground staff did. The plane had lie flat angled business class had a mid row but I did not mind as a night departure from Male is not like a day time departure which is a heavenly scene. Onboard service was nice and dinner was like Jeckel and Hyde the Tuna and Scallops appetizer was excellent but the steak overdone and unchewable. The WIFI was super fast I could view YouTube and everything else.

Went from Dubai to Milan via Doha and back within five days. The configuration of the seats was different from one leg to another. The first leg was with the Q Suite game changer and the second with a more regular seat but still extremely comfortable. All flights punctual or landed earlier. In all routes the service was impeccable. The catering was comparable with a five star restaurant. Clean toilets. The comfort of the seats was unparalleled. Endless selection of movies. Onboard WiFi was very fast and reasonably priced.

I thoroughly enjoy the QSuite on the long leg of the flights to and from Doha. The privacy and the comfort offered by the QSuite is unparalleled to any other airline which operates on this route. The service from the cabin staff is outstanding, and I have enjoyed attentive service with a smile. Meal options and the option to enjoy meals at one’s convenience is an added feature. I appreciate the fact that, since last Autumn, Qatar flies in and out of Toronto Pearson Airport, which significantly reduces the travel time. We previously had to travel to Montreal in order to take Qatar Airways. Complimentary wifi on board is definitely appreciated.
The cabin service was excellent and WIFi was fantastic even YouTube worked.

Despite having reserved a vegetarian meal, on all flights crew forgot and I had to remind them. I complained on each flight and met the same reaction - a crew member telling me that this never usually happens, apologizing profusely, and promising that everything will be okay on the next flight. By the time it occurred for the 4th time on the 4th flight, I was finding it all rather frustrating and perplexing. On the flight from Bucharest to Doha I was given dirty cutlery and the cabin assistant whose attention I brought it to wasn't apologetic. She took the spoon from me and said it was a mistake and she would get a new one. In the end I had to call the senior cabin assistant who did apologize.  I found the inflight map system on 3 of the 4 flights to be extremely old fashioned. It was just a basic low-resolution non-interactive map of the kind that airlines used to provide when adding maps to the online entertainment was a new thing (fifteen or twenty years ago). On a long flight, I find the interactive maps to be very interesting and help to pass the time.  When I asked a crew member on the Bucharest to Doha flight how to check the movies I had placed on my favorites list, she said that such a feature does not exist on the inflight entertainment system for this aircraft. However, it did as I had already used it on a previous Qatar flight using the same model of aircraft and I had already added my favorite movies for this flight onto my list. I was unable to remember how to view the list. I tried to explain this to her, but she said that no such system existed and explained that not all aircraft have this feature. In the end, I played around for ten minutes or so and figured it out myself. I wouldn't have minded if the crew member was honest and said she didn't know or that she needed to check with someone else. I don't understand how Qatar are ranked up there with the top airline. The only thing that went well was that all four flights left on time.

I have been using Qatar Airways for a few years for all my international travel, and I can plan with confidence my onward travel, meetings etc. The onboarding process is seamless, and the ground staff are knowledgeable, friendly, and helpful. During flights, the same level of professionalism can be expected, and there are no surprises. I fly the same long-distance route approximately every four weeks, and the experience remains consistent. The food is usually excellent, but on my last trip a few days ago, the Doha-Amman leg, the dinner was exceptional, serving dishes that you do not usually see on flights (to clarify - I flew business class). Thank you, Qatar Airways. It remains a pleasure flying with you.

review_header: “still not heard from them for 5 weeks”
review_text: The flight was on July 13th 2024 from Perth Western Australia, due to land at Heathrow Airport London on Sunday afternoon 14th July. Eventually I arrived at Heathrow on Tuesday 16th July at 06:00. I was told that all additional expenses would be refunded. Well, seven months later I am still trying to get a refund. They eventually offered me $250.00 voucher that could only be used with Qatar Airways valid for one year. I declined this offer as the two-night accommodation with meals in Perth city center and vouchers for taxis that I declined as my son was prepared to drive an hour to pick me up at 02:00 in the morning would have cost far more than the voucher they were offering. I was £108.00 out of pocket for my pre-purchased train tickets booked for Sunday 14th and I lost two days of work. Whilst waiting for information on when my newly arranged flight would be leaving, they could not even be bothered to contact me. After an abortive trip to the airport after we found online my boarding pass which had been changed telling me my flight was now at 03:30 Monday morning and a call to Qatar Airlines who told me they did not know, arrived at airport to find out that there was no flight. Their response was oh your contact details is a UK mobile number! As if that made any difference in these circumstances. Eventually after giving the Qatar helpdesk my sons contact details; they informed me they had found a flight from Perth to Doha then to Athens and then finally Heathrow. Then another which was Perth to Doha to Milan to Heathrow. On arrival they told me they had a flight from Perth to Doha and then onto Heathrow. This had a six-hour stopover in Doha. Eventually I arrived home after a nightmare journey at 06:00 on Tuesday morning during rush hour in London. Just the two days late. Despite constant contact with Qatar customer services they just kept telling me that this was their policy and that was the end of the issue. When you do get through you spend another hour telling them that they have all the details. But no, they want to go through it all again. I still have not heard from them for five weeks.

The cabin was unbearably cold, I pushed the call button to request assistance, but no flight attendant responded for over an hour and when someone finally did, they offered no help other than handing me another blanket. This was one of the worst experiences I’ve had. I will be reconsidering future travel with this airline unless they take meaningful steps to improve comfort and responsiveness to passengers.

trip_verified: Trip | Since 2023, I have consistently avoided flying Qatar Airways because of my sub-par experience in Economy Class. There are only 2 options to Maputo either Qatar Airways or Ethiopian and I decided to go with Qatar. Mumbai to Qatar leg is operated by Indigo which has no IFE and on a 3.5 hour flight, you get a sandwich and a small juice with some crackers and really uncomfortable seats (I admit that was my mistake since I did not check thoroughly).  Boarding for the flight to Maputo was chaos by a disorganised gate agent. After departure they served a sandwich, due to the tight connection time, I did not have any time to pick up snacks at the airport. I ended up seated next to a plus sized lady with a rather fussy infant, who had a middle seat. Later, I saw there were quite a few empty seats and they could have just let me move and allowed both of us a bit of comfort, but by the time the seat belt signs were off, others had already spread out and fallen asleep in those seats. The main meal was served 1.5 hours before arrival in Maputo and while the taste was good it was inadequate. My IFE stopped working 5 hours or so into the flight.

trip_verified: Trip Verified I decided to opt for an extra legroom seat up in Economy but the website nor app was allowing me to book the seat or make a payment. I reached out to customer care on email but the agent said that I can book the seat during check-in so to ensure this, I woke up at midnight but the transaction did not go through, the second agent was also equally unhelpful and recommended waiting couple more hours. I stayed awake and tried again but no luck, the third agent then told me that this can be done only before check-in and tried to fob me off with an apology to settle for a seat at airport check-in. Finally the third agent was able to help and I got a good extra legroom seat and thankfully the rest of the journey from Maputo to Doha was great, except for the food quantity which is really not adequate for me. The entertainment selection was not the best but overall this leg was quite comfortable. The crew on-ground and in-air were quite good. The Doha to Bombay leg was less comfortable given that this leg is operated by Indigo. The Indigo service is not up to expectations, there is no IFE, the food offered was a tasteless sandwich and some chips. If you are booking on Qatar Airways to/from India check that the leg from Doha to Qatar is operated by Qatar Airways and not Indigo. I have nothing against Indigo and am perfectly happy to fly them for short domestic flights in India but anything longer than a hour and half with them makes for an uncomfortable flight.

Very consistent service, consistent quality of food and comfortable aircraft. The service on the flight was just spot on. I would recommend them based on how consistent they are.
Amazing service, food and cabin. The variety and the quality of the food is mind blowing. The service was spot on and attentive. The seat was comfortable and private.
The flight was so smooth, and pleasant, the hospitality was amazing.
3 months later, I have yet to get any resolution. They have delayed repeatedly, sending me in an endless circle of unresponsive bureaucracy. I have lost respect for what was once my favorite airline.

Boarding well organized. Delayed by 45 minutes due to bad weather. Flight uneventful. Despite delayed arrival, remote stand with bus transfer. It took me 50 minutes from arrival at remote stand till arrival at the terminal.  My plan to have a nice breakfast at the lounge was shattered. I had just a 10 minutes at the Platinum/Gold lounge, but left because there was no seat available, no clean cup to make a coffee, and long toilet queues. My flight to Bangkok was a remote stand bus gate. Boarding was poorly organized, as Business class and status guests were asked to wait till Economy has done boarding; the gate agent changed his mind and let C Class and status guests on the bus after 2 bus loads of Y class passengers had gone. It was rather chaotic. The flight on a leased CX aircraft was on time and uneventful. The IFE screens in the bulkhead rows of my section were broken, but large IPads were offered as a replacement, which was great. My food was mediocre. The flights were ok, but the chaotic transfer at Hamad airport left a bitter aftertaste.

Check in at BKK airport fast and friendly. Contract lounge at the new Satellite terminal large, but limited western breakfast options. Boarding started 30 minutes late and another 15 minutes wait at the air bridge. Service was good with slightly improved F&B offerings. I was lucky to be on an aircraft with their upgraded WIFI services which worked real well. 3-4-3  configuration with rather hard seats. Transfer in Doha was good with a stay at the Al Safwa F lounge. Food was good. My final leg to Dubai was changed from a Qsuite to a 2-2-2 configuration. After many back and forth, they were willing to change to another Qsuite flight 30 minutes later. The flight was pleasant and uneventful.

We entered the Boeing 777 cabin to find that we had Paid for a Mercedes and would be flying in a Mini-Cooper. I didn't know airplanes with this drastically old configuration were still even in service. TIt was a miserable experience and we are changing our refundable return tickets to another airline. I won't be spending any money on Qatar Airways in the future!

Doha to Colombo was delayed and after take off asked for a drink which I was told would be served in about 10 minutes, it took more than an hour for cabin crew to star serving drinks and food. After the service they never came back to ask if anything else was needed.

Kind and professional staff on both flights, good food options (like that I can chose when to eat), comfortable flights. Due to distances at Doha airport, I appreciated that one of the small cart drivers offered his services to take me as close as possible to the train, connecting me to the center of the main terminal.

In all that time, I have never encountered such an unprecedented level of discourtesy as I did with the security staff at the Qatar Airways gate. at Doha. My husband and I had already smoothly passed through two transit security checks with Qatar Airways on our return journey from New Zealand. As we tried to board Business Class, I was surprised to be pulled over again for another bag check. The treatment I received was rude and demeaning. Everything in my rucksack was unpacked, which was then swabbed inside and out. I was manually body searched in front of everybody and my clothes, shoes and even hair was swabbed. This took place for a prolonged period of time in front of every other passenger that filed past - the flight had been called. When I subsequently touched one of the items in the second tray of my belongings (to open the zip to demonstrate there were only documents inside) the lady raised her voice, ordering me to stand back and not to handle any of my possessions. I tried to explain I was only trying to help but was met with more incivility. I would add that my husband, who was stood with me, had to witness this affront without any recourse to offer his assistance. When I was finally allowed to leave - the lady having found nothing of any suspicion - I felt utterly humiliated. This awful experience with Qatar Airways was only saved by the helpful and impeccable service of a wonderfully professional air steward on board called Eugenia - thank you kind lady. Her humanity and warmth restored my equilibrium. However the overall experience of our return journey was that, with the exception of Eugenia, the customer service is appalling. . I understand security is important but there was no need for my encounter to be as intimidating, embarrassing and uncivil as it was.

The seats were small but had amazing sleep amenities. The amenities kit was excellent. I requested an Asian vegetarian meal, which was very good, but it would have been better if there was naan or roti. The food quantity needs improvement. The legroom was good but could be better. This was my first time flying with Qatar Airways, and I would fly with them again.

The seats are different on this plane compared to the Airbus A350. The 787-8 was really good, but I didn’t like the way the headrests were. The legroom was kinda tight with not much space, and I didn’t get a window seat—I got a middle row seat instead. But the flight was amazing. That mango juice is too good, omg! The food was great as well. There was palak paneer, but there was no paneer, only corn.

This aircraft featured the renowned Qsuite configuration - an epitome of comfort and privacy. Qatar Airways’ onboard service was nothing short of world-class, delivering excellence at every touchpoint. Both the hard and soft product were executed to perfection, setting a standard that is unmatched in commercial aviation.

Service, as expected, was impeccable - flawless execution in line with Qatar Airways’ consistently high standards. Upon arrival in Doha, disembarkation was via stairs rather than an aerobridge. This is where Qatar Airways truly excels: the moment the first batch of Business Class passengers boarded the transfer bus, there was no unnecessary delay. Rather than waiting for it to fill up, the bus departed within minutes - a hallmark of true premium service.

review_header: "excited to fly again on an A380"
review_text: Check-in was nice and friendly, loved the lounge and staff there too! While the male crew were nice and looked happy, the female staff were mostly sour. Did not appreciate when the crew put my meal on my tray while I was at the bar. When I returned, the food was stone cold. I discussed that with the excellent purser. After that, the staff were sickly sweet. I decided to spend most of the time at the bar. Shame, but the next flight on Qatar was again excellent.

But sadly the mask is slipping badly. The 3-4-3 configuration on their 777 fleet has rightly been described as a crime against humanity. My real complaint with the company comes however behind the scenes. If you EVER have to deal with customer services they are obstructive and unhelpful. I paid over £1000 for an Economy Convenience multi-city ticket with some inbuilt ticket flexibility. I wanted, and indeed needed for medical reasons, a 2 hour stop in Doha. I have to administer medication which it is not possible to do on board. It could, indeed, endanger other pax to do it on the aircraft rather than in the airport. So I was pretty miffed when Qatar changed their schedules and cut my connection time down to 1h20 and then refused to listen to me about it. They COULD have agreed to put me on the flight taking off 5 minutes before my original booking to keep my 2 hour layover intact, which was the same price, but they have refused to do this. This isn’t the first time I have bumped up against their intransigence and arrogance and, to be frank, I don’t think I shall ever fly with Qatar again. I would strongly warn you to be very very careful about using them.

I would like to specifically acknowledge Uttam and Wan, who went above and beyond to assist me in retrieving my phone that had fallen between my seat after the flight had already landed. I had to wait for an engineer to come on board, but they were on the floor with various tools trying to reach my phone. I am extremely grateful for their efforts. This is a prime example of going the extra mile, and I hope they receive the recognition they deserve. Please continue to uphold your excellent service standards.

The sector from KUL to DOH was not perfect. The plane used was old and with a 2-2-2 business class configuration. Less privacy and lack of storage space. The crew made up to the deficit. Lobster meal was very good. The next sector from DOH to IAH was perfect. Business class passengers were given much priority. The in-flight supervisor came to introduce herself to each and every business class passenger. The cabin crew worked tirelessly to serve every request. Wonderful. Qsuites business class is simply amazing. I managed to catch 8 hours of sleep all together. The quality of the food served was top-notched. I tried purchasing the WiFi service but not successful though. Overall, very good quality of production and service. Only grudge is probably the price. It was much higher than any other airlines.

Very clean cabin and toilet. Modern in flight entertainment, easy to use and quick response. I was impressed when the Cabin Crew In Charge or Purser came and introduced himself. I enjoyed travelling with their widebody aircraft although on a flight which is less than 5 hours.

The aircraft was modern and clean, with comfortable seating and ample legroom. The inflight entertainment system was impressive, offering a vast selection of movies, TV shows, and music. The food was delicious, with a variety of options to suit different tastes. What truly impressed me, however, was the exceptional service provided by the cabin crew. They were attentive, courteous, and went above and beyond to ensure that all passengers had a comfortable and enjoyable flight. Overall, I would highly recommend Qatar Airways to anyone looking for a top-notch flying experience. Keep up the fantastic work!

Over 10 times per year, and the service is always so good. Very nice staff both at ground and at Cabin. I usually fly Economy and rarely get upgraded or I more often use points to upgrade my self. But still on long flights from Europe to Asia over Doha on Economy is a great experience.

Firstly, the check-in process at Calicut Airport was extremely slow, despite having completed online check-in beforehand. The cabin temperature remained uncomfortably warm throughout most of the flight. The quality of the in-flight meals, while tasty, was somewhat diminished by smaller portions. My breakfast croissant was completely flattened. The seats felt less spacious and harder than I'm accustomed to. Finally, I was disappointed by the limited selection of movies available on Oryx One.

review_header: "consistently ranks at or near the top"
review_text: This short flight, lasting just under three hours, featured Qatar Airways' non-Qsuite Business Class seats. Despite the absence of Qsuite, the experience was supremely comfortable, as is expected. The onboard service was warm and attentive, complemented by their signature on-demand meal offerings. The seamless blend of comfort, service, and sophistication once again highlights why Qatar Airways’ Business Class consistently ranks at or near the top.

This aircraft features Qatar Airways’ standard non-Qsuite Business Class seating configuration. Despite the absence of the Qsuite, the seats are exceptionally comfortable, ensuring a luxurious experience. The inflight service was flawless, showcasing their hallmark on-demand meal service. I was particularly impressed by the noticeable upgrade in meal quality. The vegetarian option was thoughtfully prepared, with a refreshing lightness compared to the heavier, oilier meals of previous years. Overall, this was an outstandingly comfortable flight that lives up to Qatar Airways’ reputation for delivering the finest Business Class experience in the skies.

As always with Qatar Airways, crew are genuinely welcoming and helpful, both on the ground and onboard. I was able to access the Silver Lounge in Doha. Again, crew (mostly from Qatar / Middle East) very welcoming. Food and drinks (including wine) of good quality. Boarding swift. Crew always ready to help. Food, drinks, movies onboard all fine. Qatar Airways still has a miles-based Frequent flyer system (contrary to other airlines within One World Alliance that now have a money-based system) - and this is really appreciated. Last, but not least, i however prefer to fly Airbus (A330 A359 A380) rather than its competitor. Will choose Airbus aircraft within One World Alliance whenever possible, on any given route.

I am a Silver member, and travel exclusively Qatar Airways, and have done for many years but I will start looking at alternatives. My complaints were purely to in respect to the food and the food service. On this occasion it was so bad on both legs of my flight it did really spoil the experience. The plane was lovely, entertainment options good and seating comfortable. I will start with the food service, as a silver member you get a hostess visiting you at the start of the flight and ask you what you would like to eat come meal service, then to be told when the service arrives that that choice has run out. I normally sit with my wife in the central section and I have never fully understood why the food service is not synchronised to start at exactly the same rows on both sides of the plane.  I was in seat D and my wife in seat E, the hostess served my meal and moved on. I asked politely if my wife could have her meal and was informed that he was not doing the E seats only the D seat and she would have to wait till the other server arrived, who was about 15 rows forward and nowhere near our seats. I explained that we like to enjoy our wine and meal together at the same time, and that we were silver members and that someone had already taken our orders. He said he was allocated only to the D seats and could not do anything about it. I had finished my meal and had my tray cleared away and was served coffee, my wife still had not recived her meal, or a drink. It was some 45 minutes after I finished my meal that my wife required her meal and this was very disappointing and could have been resolved with flexibility by the staff. Now for the food Choices that  consisted of rice with  beef, or a chicken sausage wth frittata, and the 3rd which was pasta with a sauce.

review_header: "the flight with Qatar Airways was great"
review_text: For the Munich to Doha route, usually it is flown by the Boeing 787 or A350-900 which does not have QSuite, but on the day of my travel, we got the 777 with QSuite which was a huge upgrade from these types of planes that usually operate this route. Food was great, Staff was great, Entertainment was Good, WIFI is free for Privilege Club Member up to 1 hour. Arrived in Doha and we enjoy their Al Mourjan Business Lounge located at The Garden. Then we continue to Kuala Lumpur with Malaysia Airlines and the food was terrible, entertainment was very limited, WIFI was slow and staff was not so great. Qatar Airways needs to stop handing over their flights to their partners like MH and continue to operate their own daily flights instead.

As we boarded in Barcelona, ​​I noticed that the flight attendants didn't seem particularly friendly. The plane was old, my partner's screen didn't work, and the seat in front of me was difficult to recline. Service on the night flight didn't start until 1.5 hours after takeoff, which pretty much ruined our night. The quality of the food has been better before, there were no refills of drinks and no coffee before landing let alone breakfast. We are very disappointed this time and hope that it was just a bad exception and that Qatar will maintain its level in 2025.

The overall experience was outstanding, both on the outbound and return journeys. The layovers were perfectly coordinated: around 2 hours on the outbound flight and less than an hour on the return. Despite their short duration, everything was handled smoothly and efficiently, without any stress. Onboard, the service was impeccable, with an attentive and professional crew. The food served was of high quality, and the seats were exceptionally comfortable, even on a long-haul flight. I highly recommend Qatar Airways for its seamless organization, exceptional service, and commitment to passenger comfort

On board, the cabin crew is more than just polite, they are warm and friendly. They engage in conversation with you about your trip as if they are genuinely interested in you enjoying your journey and they are happy that they get to be a part of the process. I also liked that you never have to repeat a request. They listen carefully and follow through even with things like "Please wake me up 2 hours before we land" and try their best to accommodate special requests. The team on board this particular flight was one of the best I have experienced. They worked in unison to deliver guest satisfaction. It felt like they actually liked each other and were happy. I want to specially mention Fares who was catering to my side of the cabin. He had a warm, engaging smile. He was attentive and professional. I enjoyed his mannerism and I noticed that he took time to make every single person in his aisle feel special. To conclude, the crew for other airlines are polite, yes, but on Qatar, I feel they are more than just robotic smiling. They choose people who naturally understand good service and treat everyone with equal importance.

When I arrived to Doha I was really disappointed, that nothing was arranged for the missed flight. Instead many passengers were requested to wait in a hall for further arrangement. This was little bit weird, since the flight was delayed 3h and the flight itself took 7h. Why wasn't everything organized for the customers that you knew would miss their connecting flight? Two persons were assigned to help the customers, but that was one of the most confusing experiences I have ever had in an airport. Two guys running around like headless chickens, talking in a low voice and many people couldn’t hear what they say, stopping in middle of the way when some passer by stops them and ask for advice. I had to be alert all by myself, constantly checking when will my new connection flight can be arrangeme. It's either your system is lacking or those two guys are incompetent. One of the guys was also, not only incompetent, but arrogant. Telling customers that an accommadation is arranged in VIP-hotel, then a person ask what's the name of the hotel, he obnoxiously says he just stated the name of the hotel. Instead of clearing the confusion about the name of the hotel, he decides to belittle the tired and confused customer. When I finally got my connection flight ticket sorted and was ready to leave the airport he dragged me out the custom line after almost an hour waiting in the queue. Saying that they won't let out, because I have alcohol with me. He has to see some other arrangement for me. So I followed him, thinking that I wasn't allow to enter the city. In middle of the way he stops and starts to help other people, totally ignoring my existence. After helping others, he noticed me and said to me that my alcohol would be confiscated if I tried to get pass customs and he have to see if he could arrange for me to stay in a lounge room. Why didn't he fully tell me about my options first hand? I thought there were no options for me to leave the airport. It was almost morning. I haven't slept in almost 24hrs and he is suggesting me to stay in a lounge for rest of the time. There was over 20hrs until my next flight. I can’t stay in a lounge where there is no privacy. I refused his incompetent, useless help and wanted to get back to the customs. I demanded him to escort me there, because I didn’t want to queue again, but he refused and said he did his best to help me. Also I almost missed my next day connection flight, because the attendant told me I was arranged to 02.30 flight, but it was actually 1.30 flight. I had to run like crazy in the airport because I got there late and almost missed the flight.

review_header: "I was not recognized in any way"
review_text: On the HKG-Doha flight, which took 9 hours 30 minutes, I was served was a disgusting snack and a mediocre breakfast with coffee that tasted burnt. The cabin temperature was terribly cold and nothing was done to change things. The icing on the cake was the distant, even contemptuous attitude of the flight attendants to me.

From the moment we booked our tickets they contacted us several times to inform us even about secondary issues. The itinerary and stopover in Doha the best we could imagine. All 4 flights left right on time. The food was really good and delicious. The behaviour of the flight attendants was perfect, friendly and professional. Tickets prices were competitive. It was my first time flying with this company and it will be a real pleasure to fly with them again

My meal quality was poor and amount of drinks as required. (Ath~Doh) offered drinks after meals and once during 3 hours flight and after meal, but Doha Tokyo offered drinks during the meals but not after meals, on request. Good seat quality and space.

Did not have a q suite and the seats may need be refreshed but did not matter when you get nice service good food drinks . I never felt discriminated as i often do because i am overweight, it may sound stupid but for me who travels a bit, that feeling is horrible. Thanks Qatar. Keep up the good job!!!
Food excellent!

Food excellent! And took me back to Air France in the 90s on long-haul flights, a lounge in the business class cabin. Excellent for stretching your legs, get a drink and mingle with other passengers. Splendid idea! But not free basic WiFi.

Those who have flown on their Q-Suites (777), 787s, A350s, and their older 777 where it was 2 seats on the window with no real divider or privacy, understand there is a huge difference in quality between their planes and the experience overall. When choosing my route for an upcoming trip with them I chose a route that had a Q-suite followed by a 787, as they offer the most privacy and comfort. I just received notice that they have downgraded my plane from Doha to Johannesburg to their oldest configuration of their 777 where there are 2 seats on the window, no real divider, and no privacy at all. I understand that sometimes changes are necessary, however I've spent 3 days now trying to get them to change the 1 leg of my journey, the leg where they downgraded the plane to the old 777, to an alternative flight that would simply put me back on the 787. I'm not looking for an upgrade to a Q-suite, I just don't want to be on the same plane I booked and paid for. However, their service team refuses to make the change without me paying a fare difference. Apparently the only time they will allow a free change is if they downgrade you from the Q-suite, which is ridiculous. If they moved it from a 787 to an A350 it would have been fine, however their old 777 configuration is by no means anywhere near the same quality of experience. There is no flex, no desire to keep your business. I realize I am complaining about a business class experience, which may seem petty to some, however when you fly a lot, spend a lot of money to do so, there should be an expectation of service from the partners you choose.

“Passengers flying on to Penang should disembark at Phuket.” “Passengers going on to Penang should stay seated.” “Passengers who will go on to Penang should come forward now to disembark.” “You should not be trying to disembark yet.” Now you need to disembark at the rear of the plane.” “You should not be coming back here. Return to the front.” Then a scheduled 90 minute layover became 3 hours. Upon arrival in Penang Qatar did not get a jetway, and it was raining hard. After moving forward to disembark we were told by the pilot that the airport is requiring us to sit on the aircraft for 30 minutes until the rain stops. About 40 minutes later the pilot informed us that we will have to wait at least another 10 minutes.

The Economy regular meals were to die for to be honest- some of the best chicken biryani, which you wouldn’t see in the special meal menus. This time it was stuff that neither me nor my family could get half way through. Either too bland or salty. Also the service was slow - kids get super cranky on late night flights without food and no butter, salt, pepper and sugar.  Unlike many other airlines, QR’s economy class is really good. In fact that was my biggest selling point for wanting to fly QR this time- collecting air miles is not an easy job! An older aircraft having >90% occupancy with an out of order toilet plus wi-fi doesn’t help. On the positive side, massive shout out to QR ground staff from Bos for a smooth path from check in to boarding. Also to the Doh- MAA flight pursers for explaining the shortage of on board meal options- only chicken was available in the general category.

They asked us to contact the Qatar Airways service desk after arriving in Doha. We did this upon arrival but was then referred to another Qatar Airways service desk. After queuing our way through the third service desk, we were told that they could not give us a boarding pass due to the flight being overbooked. They wanted us to go to some other service desk several times. After 3 hours of waiting we finally got boarding shortly after check-in at the gate opened. We had to rush to the gate. Since I had not received a boarding pass at the airport, I could not do any purchases from the airport shops as I normally do. While I wasn't checked in, all the updates via Qatar Airways' app on my mobile didn't show up, which features I appreciate. I have sent an email to their customer service support but no feedback in a month.

This sector was changed a few months after I booked my ticket, and I didn’t mind so much because I was keen to experience Oman Air. The business class layout is ok, and the seat was very comfortable. There were only 3 passengers travelling in business class on this flight and we were well attended to. The food and wine was good. Nothing more, nothing less. The crew were very pleasant and enjoyed a chat. I find the Qatar entertainment very limited and not a wide selection of movies. The flight itself was very smooth. Overall, a comfortable 5 hours in the air.

The food and wine were superb. The FA looking after our section was outstanding in her quiet delivery of her service. I had a very different experience on each of the four sectors I flew, and this sector together with the Doha/Nairobi sector were on par. Attentive service, good food and a comfy seat. The entertainment choices are very limited so I usually end up listening to my own music. The seat was very comfortable and I managed to get 6 hours sleep.

However, the aircraft was changed, and the QSuite was not available. The issues didn’t end there. When I contacted customer service to inquire about rebooking, the agent I spoke with was unhelpful and uninterested in assisting. Unfortunately, the service on board was equally disappointing. During boarding, the cabin crew paid little attention to passengers, creating a lack of warmth and hospitality. The in-flight dining service was far below the standard I expected: The dine-on-demand service was not offered. When I requested mezze, I was told it was unavailable. My alternative request for miso resulted in receiving a completely different dish. For the main course, two out of four options on the menu were unavailable. I was served chicken that appeared to be from the economy menu, and it was tasteless. My second meal, sushi, was barely edible. Even basic items like orange juice for a mocktail were not available. For a 12-hour flight, the limited meal selection and poor quality were unacceptable. When I raised my concerns with the purser, I did not receive an apology but was told I should have pre-ordered my meal—despite not being informed of this requirement beforehand. This experience was far from the premium service Qatar Airways promises its business class passengers. I hope the airline addresses these shortcomings to ensure better service in the future.

I took Qatar Airways for the first time two years ago. As a frequent business traveler, customer experience, value for money and safety are the two most important factors. In my opinion, Qatar Airways achieved full marks in all the three areas. Qatar Airways is now my No. 1 choice. Some of the meals that you have provided onboard have been one of the best experience that I have had over thirty years of flying. I feel treated as a "First Class" passenger on Economy class.

Boarding of the aircraft was efficient and respected the assigned seating Zones. Good service from cabin crew, who were very courteous. The first meal service was a bland chicken sandwich (because the flight operated late at night, when most people just wanted to sleep). A full cooked meal service was provided later in the flight for breakfast, however. The flight operated on time.

The airport struggles to cope with volume of passengers, both land-side and air-side. The flight departed an hour late due to local air traffice restrictions, despite the incoming aircraft having arrived on time. The aircraft was one of the older ones in the fleet, and the IFE was not touch screen, nor did it have the same breadth of range of entertainment options as offered on Qatar's newer aircraft. However, service was good, including food & beverage offerings, despite the aircraft being fully occupied. Cabin crew worked hard and were always polite and attentive. As a result of the late departure, we arrived in Doha an hour late, too. The aircraft was parked a long bus ride away from the terminal, which didn't help the delay.

They have been trained to be polite even in the face of problems. It goes a long way to making the experience more pleasant than it otherwise could have been. The booking experience  via their website was not fully satisfactory as the seat map could not be accessed at the time of booking nor via 'Manage your booking' after the booking was made. I had to ring up the call centre  to request them to book my specific seats. The call-centre staff were polite and very willing to help, but the quality of the phone line was poor. Online check-in could not be fully completed, requiring manual document checks at the airport (Heathrow) for the issue of the boarding pass. However, the queues for the self-service check-in machines at the airport was very long and every passenger seemed to require manual documentation check by staff (who were too few to cope with this - but handled it politely)s. Onboard service was excellent and plenty of food provided for the flight. IFE had an impressive selection of movies and TV shows.

Good provision of food. Excellent range of inflight entertainment. Flight took off and landed on time. My only gripe is that it was difficult to reserve my seat in advance- the online seat map was not working on their website nor on their app, and I had to ring up the call centre to sort it out.

review_header: "leave the queue to adjust the weight"
review_text: We had an allowed baggage weight of 100 kg for our four tickets, each with a 25 kg limit. We checked in two bags, but the staff said that one bag weighed 27 kg instead of 25 kg and demanded payment for the extra 2 kg. We had to leave the queue to adjust the weight and upon returning, were asked to start from the end of the line. Onboard I had to settle for an Indian vegetarian meal, which I did not enjoy. While Doha airport was beautiful, we were transported to our connecting flight to Düsseldorf by bus, which was uncomfortable.
The seats aren't comfortable and my food did not taste good. Planes are smaller than some airlines.

Though I added the baby late, they auto-assigned me a seat with a bassinet. On the flight, they were so kind and helpful. They had baby food and diapers. They helped me fetch milk from my bag. When the baby poured food all over me, they helped me clean up, including a member who wiped my feet. They were so kind and helpful - I was very moved.

The meals they offer, you can choose if you are in the front, from the middle to the back, they only offer you what is left, pasta. The same at breakfast, if you don't want the option they give you, they tell you to wait until they serve the entire plane. You can ignore all this, but when you arrive at your destination and they have lost your luggage, the disappointment is total. And worse, when upon returning home, they lose your luggage again, they deliver it to you later, the suitcases are broken, they follow the instructions of their call center for the claim, and finally they do not take responsibility for the damages.

I was flying business class and was seated in 10A. After we took off, the refreshing towel that was given before mwas still on my counter for about 30 minutes. I was served with breakfast 30 minutes after we took off. They left me for the next 8 hours on a 13 and 1/2 hours flight. I was taking naps off and on but lost track of time. No one checked if I needed anything. When I requested to have my meal served, it took about an hour and half from start to finish. The service was slow. No one was being served at that time around me. My dessert plate sat on my table for another 30 minutes after I finished. I asked for a drink about 2 hours to landing, no one picked up after for an hour or so.

My recent experience on a flight from JFK to Doha was particularly disappointing. The onboard meal service was far below expectations. I had ordered a special Asian vegetarian meal, but the food was of poor quality—extremely salty dal, undercooked rice, and watery, tasteless paneer left much to be desired. The inflight entertainment options were equally disappointing, with no new films available. Instead, the selection consisted of outdated blockbusters, making it hard to pass the time on a long-haul flight. While the new Boeing 777 aircraft offered moderately comfortable seats, the overhead storage was poorly designed, causing significant inconvenience. Adding to the frustration was the baggage policy enforcement. Qatar Airways enforced a single carry-on policy, which I assume is due to the overhead bin space. This policy feels overly restrictive and diminishes the overall travel experience. The service from the cabin crew was another letdown.  What once set this airline apart—exceptional service, quality meals, and attention to detail—now feels like a distant memory.

review_header: “cut my trip short by one day"
review_text: On November 7, Qatar canceled my flight because of "operational issues." I was told that Nepal's airport renovation had resulted in several airline cancellations over the previous eight months. Qatar was aware of this problem for a long time because I made my travel arrangements in April 2024. My original flight (QR 649) was changed from 9 am to 7 pm on November 12 and there were other Qatar flights from Kathmandu to Doha on November 12 however Qatar never accommodated me to take one of those flights. Rather, I was instructed to fly from Kathmandu to Doha on November 18 or from New Delhi to Doha on November 11. I chose to fly from Delhi on November 11 because I had to return to Chicago by November 13 for work. Additionally, Qatar informed me that I would need to arrange my own airfare from Kathmandu to Delhi. I had to pay $500 to another airline for a ticket from Kathmandu to Delhi. I was informed by Qatar that I would not receive reimbursement for this flight. To get home to Chicago, I had to pay an additional $500 and cut my trip short by one day. Furthermore, Qatar misled me by claiming that there would be no additional flights on November 12.

On the return journey wanted to make a date change, so went to the terminal 4 hoping that this would be quicker and simpler. The ticketing staff was unhelpful and I had to stick to the original itinerary. Upon returning to Doha today early morning, there was NO jet bridge so passengers had to uae the stairs.

The FA was reluctant to serve me champagne before take off and when I asked for another glass during dinner, conveniently forgot. I had to ask for my tray to be clreaed after dinner. The same crew member made up the bed which again had to ask. The main meal was ordinary, not the same standard as in the past. The Qsuite was nice and comfortable and managed to sleep 8 hours. I would rate this flight 3 out of 5. My flight from Doha to Nairobi was outstanding. The FA were magnificent, efficient, served me champagne even though it was 2am without any question or judgement. The meals were nice. The flight in the  A350 . I paid BC as this is my trip to celebrate my 70th and was disappointed in the standard of service in the first part of the journey but definitely not the second.
They serve me cold omelette and I asked for cappuccino they serve me like a glass of milk with a small amount of coffee.

2 days before my flight back from London I get a message stating they have cancelled my connecting flight from Doha to KTM and replaced it with a flight next morning, with a 10 hour layover. I expect them to do is provide transit accommodation in Doha, when they they chose to put me through the unwanted 10 hour layover but they don't. I am asked to land in Doha and try my luck with the transfer desk, I am not amused by the thought of running around for accommodation past midnight when my flight lands. I call them, chat with them, my agent in KTM files a request , my travel agent sends a mail, and I filed a formal complaint. Nothing.

2 days before they cancel the flight for operational reasons and offer no alternative route despite having a flight a day before which I was willing to take and assume the cost of the extra night stay. I have traveled with them before, ok in flight, but will never expose myself to this lack of service again.

The aircraft on both legs was very dated, WIFI did not work and the entertainment was terrible. On both flights my main course was very dry and tasteless. My flight between Durban and Doha was chaotic, the cabin was half empty and I still had to keep asking for water or to have a second glass of wine. Drink quality was good but very controlled.

Qatar was excellent between Dublin and Doha. Cabin was modern, service was excellent and food was the best I have had on a flight . I really enjoyed it. The flight between Doha and Cape Town was not so good. It was a much older cabin but as it was a late night flight I did not want food so I cannot really comment on service and food quality although I was disappointed with the seat and the entertainment. There was very little selection, and some of the TV series were season 2 or season 3 which does not make sense if season one is not available. This part of my trip really did bust my bubble. Wifi on both legs was terrible and really not worth the effort.

The staff member had no idea what he was doing. The Economy counter next to me pumped out 3-4 people while this man pondered my check in at snail pace. It was very frustrating, but only the beginning of what was to come. On boarding the aircraft I realised it was a small A320 and had I known that at the time of the upgrade offer, I would never have paid for it. The seat is nothing more than a premium economy, it barely reclined, there was no footrest, there was no entertainment unit (unless you count an annoying stand alone IPad). Honestly, it was horrible. The seat was not comfortable at all, the aircraft was freezing, the windows were absolutely filthy with caked on muck BUT the icing on the cake was inflight service. It was very ordinary and although the food menu presented well and I enjoyed my appetizer and main, they forgot my dessert and coffee altogether. What a waste of money.

I recently flew with Qatar Airways on Flight QR 976 from Doha to Hanoi on October 20, in Business Class, and had the pleasure of being assisted by two amazing flight attendants, Yu Hee and Anastasia. Their service was outstanding from start to finish. They were attentive, friendly, and professional, ensuring that all passengers in Business Class were comfortable and well taken care of. Yu Hee and Anastasia’s warm attitude and attention to detail truly stood out, and they went above and beyond to make the flight a pleasant experience. Whether it was answering questions or offering assistance, they did it all with a smile and genuine care. I want to extend my sincere thanks to these wonderful flight attendants for their excellent service. They truly made a difference in my travel experience, and I look forward to flying with Qatar Airways again.

Their exceptional service consistently impresses me, from lounge amenities to seamless departures and in-flight experiences, culminating in stress-free arrivals. Qatar Airways has earned my loyalty, and I wholeheartedly recommend them to friends and colleagues.

Their only aim is to make you happy. Aircraft is always very clean, comfortable seating, great variety of entertainment, excellent quality of headphones and screens, food in first class could be easily Michelin star rated, great experience and I always look forward to travel in QA.

I downloaded the app which made changing dates and seats a breeze, and it has 247 live chat which is brilliant. First leg on new 777-300ER layout. I found the seats not very comfortable (23C exit seat). Entertainment was fantastic, more than enough to watch, almost like having Netflix onboard. My screen had issues which was frustrating though. Staff very friendlya and approachable. Food very good! Second leg not as good. Same plane but older layout. Food not as good. Really horrible sandwich, and my breakfast was only OK, not that appetising. Seat also not very comfortable (35C exit seat). I always have to pay for exit seats because of my height. I get annoyed when people see empty ones and sit in them when they haven't paid. There were quite a few empty seats on both legs of the journey, yet when I booked 48hrs before departure, there was only 1 seat left. Toilets kept quite clean, but the bins were overflowing on both flights.  Both flights delayed without explanation. Flight arrived 10mins early at final destination. Doha airport I find good. My second flight was not shown on the screens though, so there were a lot of people trying to flag down staff to check what gate.

Qatar really struggle with boarding on occasions and this was no different. Seats were changed at the gate as one of our reserved one’s were wet. Allocated into the rear cabin 38A + B. Seemed to be an older aircraft with an older configuration in the business cabin. Busy flight. The seat proved to be very comfortable and superbly thought out. The best there is I think. Safety issue of individuals roaming around the cabin aisles looking for empty seat rows, including someone moving up and down the aisle with his bags, opening and shutting overhead bins blocking the aisle While the aircraft is taxiing under power for departure. Something that should of been jumped on very quickly, but wasn’t. Food was exceptional for Economy, as was the service from a hard working pleasant crew. Overall this sector proved that this is the best Medium to long haul Economy cabin product there is. . Doha Hamad Airport is exceptional and a pleasant transfer. Second Sector on a Boeing 787-8. 19F + G either side of an aisle. Flight appeared to be full and Departed on time, early hours of the morning. The seat’s on this Aircraft were significantly less comfortable. A . 3-3-3 configuration and the ACDFGJ seats each have an under seat IFE box mounted on it’s side that restricts the width of legroom available. Seats appear far narrower, and not so well thought out. Although I find the cabin appealing and the ride pleasant. I’ll generally avoid this particular type of Aircraft. because I find them particularly uncomfortable in Economy, especially on a busy flight.. Again, exceptional food, great Service and a lovely hard working crew. Nonetheless, overall a very nice Economy experience, highly recommend it.

The hospitality, from check-in to arrival, is outstanding; staff are courteous, attentive, and always ready to assist. Their scheduling is reliable and well-organized, making flights punctual and connections smooth. The ease of booking, online or through the app is incredibly user-friendly, allowing me to arrange trips without hassle. The lounge facilities are superb, offering a quiet, luxurious space to relax before flights with excellent dining options. Both ground and inflight services are top-notch, with a focus on comfort, quality, and efficiency. Qatar Airways truly sets a high standard in global air travel!

As a person with a disability I could not move, request to move was met with only had middle seat, as business class is only for people that pay for them. When I requested to pay by points for upgrade was told none available. When people in front chose to recline hostess reaction they are allowed to recline however when we tried our seats were rudely pushed upright by passengers. I have emailed Qatar as yet no response.

The cabin crew treated me like a VIP, the food & drinks were excellent and the facilities (seat, entertainment, wifi, toilets etc) were all fantastic. It is a real pleasure flying QA. The same goes for the lounges I used in Doha with the only negative being the lounges which they don't control outside of Doha.

Started off well from Dubai to Doha nice 777 in first class which is business class rebranded for this route. Once in Doha the fun started in the Business Class lounge I was told I could only stay 30 minutes and access to the restaurant area was denied because they were busy, so no hot food. Staff were robotic and not at all interested. The connecting flight was an old A320 with a business class seat which was broken and they said cannot be fixed. Hardly any legroom and cramped. Poor inflight entertainment selection and no wifi. Breakfast portions dismal, left the flight hungry.

The crack spanned across the depth of the luggage, from the zipper to the wheel area, and the inner linings of my baggage were clearly visible. As I had left the Airport premises when the damage was found and I acknowledged that there might not be anything the airline could have done for me, their response was the most unhelpful I have ever received. My return flight on 29 September was cancelled. The instructions to collect our baggage and hotel vouchers were poorly communicated, we only heard muffled announcements and did not receive any email or text message on what to do next. It was chaotic and the airline staff were unhelpful, it took us more than 4 hours just to collect our baggage and vouchers at the airport, before we boarded the bus to the assigned hotel.  Following my trip, I also reached out to Qatar Airways Media/Customer Service to share my feedback, however, it does not seem like they took my feedback seriously. They took more than 10 days to inform me that they had forwarded my feedback on baggage irregularities to the Baggage department in Zurich.

Qatar have really gone downhill. During boarding the staff were giving contradictory messages to the passengers, with one person saying a certain group could board and another saying they couldn't. The economy seats are hard, small and uncomfortable. I was able to book an economy comfort++ for one leg of my journey. It should have been two but they changed the hardware, so I was bumped to economy. These seats are much better but it's a lottery if you can book one. My food servings were tiny, and a couple of the meals I couldn't finish they were that bad. The staff were didn't do anything above the bare minimum. The entertainment system on some planes is outdated and unresponsive, although much better on the newer planes. However, the selection of films is quite poor.

The airline is pretty good especially in economy as a Privilege club member with status, expedited check in and lounge access for both Silver & Gold levels. On board assuming you pick the right seat it's comfortable The food is good as is the service, it's very good and probably one of the best. Business class is great on any aircraft, I had my first experience of Q Suites which was nice, although I like the A380 too with a bit more space and a lounge to use. My 8th flight this month in Q suites from DOH to LHR was probably the least enjoyable, boarding was a shambles, the aircraft was a 20 minute bus ride away and once on board remained at 30c + for 45 minutes, the crew were just okay. Food options not available and the area around my seat is not cleaned with rubbish left by the previous passenger. Clearly QR and DOH airport offer great options, we all have off days so hopefully this is what happened with my last flight. Otherwise I will continue to use QR on my 8 to 10 trips each year, they really are customer focused and offer a great product they just need to get there boarding process sorted it's a bit of a let down sometimes.

While I understand that technical issues can occur, there was no effort to provide alternatives. This left us frustrated and disappointed. I have reached out to Qatar Airways multiple times regarding these issues, but their responses have been generic and focused on unrelated matters, such as visa documentation. It feels as if our legitimate complaints are being overlooked. We chose Qatar Airways expecting world-class service, but we received anything but that. The lack of resolution has overshadowed what should have been a joyful occasion.
Poor customer service. Meals repetitive but crew were reasonable.
.. very friendly and attentive, good food, clean cabin and toilets. Streaks ahead of other airlines. Will definitely be flying Qatar wherever I can.

review_header: "pleased with the overall comfort and service"
review_text: We did online check-in and there was dedicated web bag-drop which was quick, and stress-free where the friendly ground staff issued us paper boarding passes. Boarding was scheduled early but on time, and the cabin crew on our first flight from London Gatwick to Doha seemed motivated, hospitable and keen to please providing service with a warm smile. The Boeing 787 on this route is very comfortable to travel on and we arrived early into Doha, where thankfully we could have a leisurely transfer via an airbridge to the terminal and even have some time to experience The Orchard at Doha Hamad as well as a quick spot of Duty Free shopping. Our second flight to Salalah was on time, staff were a little less polished but efficient and friendly. Meals including snacks on both sectors was excellent in quality - very tasty. I was pleased with the overall comfort and service, and it provided a relaxing start to our holiday in Oman.

After checking in online where it was communicated our flight from Doha to London would be on an A380 which we were pleased about, when we went to the airport to bag-drop we enquired if we could be seated on the upper deck economy cabin - the check-in assistant at Salalah airport was struggling to do this so consulted the Qatar Airways station manager there and he informed us the reason it wasn't possible was the plane had been changed to a 777. This plane is is cramped with 10 abreast rows when the plane is designed for 9 abreast, the seats have virtually no padding. On an overnight flight it was a very uncomfortable. The transfer experience early morning at Doha to get to that plane is stressful and chaotic - especially if they make you land at a remote stand, you will struggle to make your connecting flight. It is ridiculous to be using a remote stands and bussing people to the terminal via slow convoluted route at what is very new and modern airport. There is also bag security checks, once a general one then another random one at the gate for our flight back to London. My food was appalling on all sectors with this journey - the funny thing is on our Salalah to Doha sector we got the same meal (chicken mashkool) as on our way to Salalah a week ago, but whilst then it tasted amazing this time it tasted terrible. Cabin crew on both journeys were at best indifferent, but looked unhelpful, unmotivated, lacking warmth and miserable on the second flight from Doha to London Heathrow - this is meant to be one of their flagship routes, yet this is the standard of service.

Excellent service and food very good for economy class, FAs almost perfect. Qatar Airways from Doha to Johannesburg. This flight was the biggest disappointment. Service was we don't care, we just work here. My food was disgusting. Drinks served in glasses.

review_header: "no cordoned off section for Business Class"
review_text: Our dep 2250 for Doha flight checkin time was stated to be 7.45 pm, but the staff were busy chatting, not heeding the time and long queue for Economy. There was no cordoned off section for Business Class passengers. They finally opened 3 counters past check in time and it was a free for all with Economy class passengers shoving ahead. The Barcelona business class lounge, it was very disappointing. Most toilets did not work, there was hair and rubbish stuck in the sinks. In the lounge none of the power points worked for us to charge up our phones. The food offered was the worst in a Business Class Lounge. A few squares of cold lasagne, lots of snacks, and cleaning staff wheeled their wagons around the tables chucking in dirty tableware noisily. The flight to Barcelona to Doha took off late. As a result, in Doha we were not able to enjoy the Business Class lounge, and barely managed to get to our connecting flight to Kuala Lumpur, rushing through the crowded airport.

Without clear advice on the flight out of Turkey we eventually were placed on a flight to Doha. There was chaos at Doha airport with little help and communication in regard to flights to get home to Perth. The systems seemed inadequate to provide information to staff who were extremely inefficient in handling our flights back to Perth.
